general_definition_en: Vitals
lay_definition_en: Vitals are important body measurements like blood pressure and heart rate that reveal how well your body is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Vitalwerte sind wichtige Körperwerte wie Blutdruck und Herzfrequenz, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Vital signs are numbers that tell how well your body is doing, like your pulse, blood pressure, and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Vitalparameter sind Werte, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie es Ihrem Körper geht, beispielsweise Puls, Blutdruck und Temperatur.

general_definition_en: hr
lay_definition_en: Heart rate is how quickly or slowly your heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell oder langsam Ihr Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: RhythmNext
lay_definition_en: A genetic test that checks DNA for heart arrhythmia-related gene variations.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gentest, bei dem die DNA auf Genvariationen untersucht wird, die mit Herzrhythmusstörungen in Zusammenhang stehen.

general_definition_en: Irregular HEART RATE caused by abnormal function of the SINOATRIAL NODE. It is characterized by a greater than 10% change between the maximum and the minimum sinus cycle length or 120 milliseconds.
lay_definition_en: A medical term for issues with your heartbeat's speed or regularity.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Begriff für Störungen der Herzfrequenz oder des Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: A disorder of the arteries supplying the upper and lower extremity and the visceral organs. This includes the mesenteric arteries, the renal arteries and the aorta and excludes cerebrovascular arterial disease. Patients experience cramping and pain usually in the calves and thighs while walking. The symptoms subside with rest.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure in a specific artery.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck in einer bestimmten Arterie.

general_definition_en: One of the ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS (ACE inhibitors), orally active, that has been used in the treatment of hypertension and congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A drug for treating high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A drug used for pain relief, reducing fever and inflammation, and lowering the risk of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Schmerzlinderung, zur Senkung von Fieber und Entzündungen sowie zur Verringerung des Risikos eines Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: A thiazide diuretic often considered the prototypical member of this class. It reduces the reabsorption of electrolytes from the renal tubules. This results in increased excretion of water and electrolytes, including sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium. It is used in the treatment of several disorders including edema, hypertension, diabetes insipidus, and hypoparathyroidism.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce excess fluid in the body and can be used to treat high blood pressure and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Schwellungen eingesetzt werden kann.

general_definition_en: An antagonist of ANGIOTENSIN TYPE 1 RECEPTOR with antihypertensive activity due to the reduced pressor effect of ANGIOTENSIN II.
lay_definition_en: A medication for lowering high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: Heart attack: Death of heart tissue due to lack of oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Herzinfarkt: Absterben von Herzgewebe aufgrund von Sauerstoffmangel.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: Mi is when the heart muscle dies because it isn't getting enough oxygen, also known as a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Mi tritt auf, wenn der Herzmuskel abstirbt, weil er nicht ausreichend mit Sauerstoff versorgt wird; dies wird auch als Herzinfarkt bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a long standing and persistent uncoordinated atrial myocardium activation due to multiple reentry circuits with consequent deterioration of atrial mechanical function. Instead of intermittently contracting, the atria quiver continuously in a chaotic pattern, causing a totally irregular, often tachycardia ventricular rate. On the ECG it is characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape, and timing, associated with an irregular, frequently rapid ventricular response when atrioventricular conduction is intact.
lay_definition_en: Afib is when your heart beats abnormally, making you tired and increasing the risk of a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern schlägt Ihr Herz unregelmäßig, was zu Müdigkeit führt und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöht.

general_definition_en: Pancarditis, involving inflammation of the endocardium, myocardium, and epicardium. It results from an autoimmune reaction following an infection with Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A Streptococci).
lay_definition_en: Heart damage caused by an untreated infection.
lay_definition_de: Durch eine unbehandelte Infektion verursachte Herzschädigung.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving any of the various HEART VALVES and the associated structures (PAPILLARY MUSCLES and CHORDAE TENDINEAE).
lay_definition_en: Valvular Heart Disease is when the valves of the heart do not work properly and affect the flow of blood.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzklappenerkrankung funktionieren die Herzklappen nicht richtig, was den Blutfluss beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: Abnormal blood flow in the heart that can cause issues when severe.
lay_definition_de: Eine Durchblutungsstörung im Herzen, die bei schwerem Verlauf zu Problemen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Pathological condition characterized by the backflow of blood from the ASCENDING AORTA back into the LEFT VENTRICLE, leading to regurgitation. It is caused by diseases of the AORTIC VALVE or its surrounding tissue (aortic root).
lay_definition_en: AI is when the heart's valve doesn't close right, causing blood to flow the wrong way.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzklappeninsuffizienz schließt die Herzklappe nicht richtig, wodurch das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: Persistently high systemic arterial BLOOD PRESSURE. Based on multiple readings (BLOOD PRESSURE DETERMINATION), hypertension is currently defined as when SYSTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when DIASTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.
lay_definition_en: Increased blood pressure in the lung arteries.
lay_definition_de: Erhöhter Blutdruck in den Lungenarterien.

general_definition_en: A condition of mild to moderate high blood pressure that has no identifiable cause.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure without a clear reason.
lay_definition_de: Bluthochdruck ohne erkennbaren Grund.

general_definition_en: A condition of mild to moderate high blood pressure that has no identifiable cause.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure without a known cause.
lay_definition_de: Bluthochdruck ohne bekannte Ursache.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes of CORONARY ARTERIES that may derive from a congenital abnormality, atherosclerotic, or non-atherosclerotic cause.
lay_definition_en: Coronary artery disease is when the blood vessels supplying the heart get blocked, which can be deadly if not managed.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer koronaren Herzkrankheit kommt es zu einer Verstopfung der Blutgefäße, die das Herz versorgen. Wird diese Erkrankung nicht behandelt, kann sie tödlich verlaufen.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: A heart attack is when part of the heart muscle dies from not getting enough oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt liegt vor, wenn ein Teil des Herzmuskels abstirbt, weil er nicht ausreichend mit Sauerstoff versorgt wird.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia without discernible P waves and an irregular ventricular response due to multiple reentry circuits. The rhythm disturbance originates above the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: Atrial fibrillation is when your heart beats irregularly and can make you tired or more likely to have a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern schlägt Ihr Herz unregelmäßig, was zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Related to the blood vessels and heart.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit den Blutgefäßen und dem Herzen.

general_definition_en: A pathological constriction that can occur above (supravalvular stenosis), below (subvalvular stenosis), or at the AORTIC VALVE. It is characterized by restricted outflow from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The largest artery coming out of the heart gets narrower.
lay_definition_de: Die größte Arterie, die vom Herzen ausgeht, verengt sich.

general_definition_en: Abnormal protrusion or billowing of one or both of the leaflets of MITRAL VALVE into the LEFT ATRIUM during SYSTOLE. This allows the backflow of blood into left atrium leading to MITRAL VALVE INSUFFICIENCY; SYSTOLIC MURMURS; or CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA.
lay_definition_en: Mitral valve prolapse is when the valve in the heart doesn't close properly because its flaps are floppy.
lay_definition_de: Ein Mitralklappenprolaps liegt vor, wenn sich die Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, weil ihre Segel zu schlaff sind.

general_definition_en: An antianginal and class III antiarrhythmic drug. It increases the duration of ventricular and atrial muscle action by inhibiting POTASSIUM CHANNELS and VOLTAGE-GATED SODIUM CHANNELS. There is a resulting decrease in heart rate and in vascular resistance.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps control irregular heartbeats and is referred to as a potassium channel blocker.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei der Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft und als Kaliumkanalblocker bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: Lasix
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps to get rid of excess fluid from the body, often used for conditions like heart or kidney issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit aus dem Körper auszuscheiden, und häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herz- oder Nierenproblemen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Lopressor
lay_definition_en: A medicine for chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel gegen Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: An antianginal and class III antiarrhythmic drug. It increases the duration of ventricular and atrial muscle action by inhibiting POTASSIUM CHANNELS and VOLTAGE-GATED SODIUM CHANNELS. There is a resulting decrease in heart rate and in vascular resistance.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps control irregular heartbeats by blocking potassium channels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das durch die Hemmung von Kaliumkanälen zur Kontrolle von Herzrhythmusstörungen beiträgt.

general_definition_en: The calcium salt of atorvastatin, a synthetic lipid-lowering agent. Atorvastatin competitively inhibits hepatic hydroxymethyl-glutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the enzyme which catalyzes the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a key step in cholesterol synthesis. This agent increases the number of LDL receptors on hepatic cell surfaces, enhancing the uptake and catabolism of LDL and reducing LDL production and the number of LDL particles, and lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels. Like other statins, atorvastatin may also display direct antineoplastic activity, possibly by inhibiting farnesylation and geranylgeranylation of proteins such as small GTP-binding proteins, which may result in the arrest of cells in the G1 phase of the cell cycle. This agent may also sensitize tumor cells to cyctostatic drugs, possibly through the mTOR-dependent inhibition of Akt phosphorylation.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps reduce bad cholesterol in the blood to prevent heart issues like stroke and heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, das „schlechte“ Cholesterin im Blut zu senken, um Herzproblemen wie Schlaganfällen und Herzinfarkten vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: FUROSEMIDE
lay_definition_en: Medication used for high blood pressure and swelling, also known as Lasix.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Ödemen, auch bekannt als Lasix.

general_definition_en: LASIX
lay_definition_en: Lasix is a medication that helps your body get rid of extra water and is often used for conditions like heart failure and kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Lasix ist ein Medikament, das Ihrem Körper hilft, überschüssiges Wasser auszuscheiden, und wird häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz und Nierenerkrankungen eingesetzt.

general_definition_en: A synthetic levoisomer of thyroxine (T4), similar to the endogenous hormone produced by the thyroid gland. Thyroxine is de-iodinated to form triiodothyronine (T3) in the peripheral tissues. T3 enters the cell and binds to nuclear thyroid hormone receptors, and the hormone-receptor complex in turn triggers gene expression and produces proteins required in the regulation of cellular respiration, thermogenesis, cellular growth and differentiation, and metabolism of proteins, carbohydrates and lipids. T4 and T3 also possess cardiac stimulatory effect.
lay_definition_en: A medication often prescribed for thyroid hormone replacement.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das häufig zur Substitution von Schilddrüsenhormonen verschrieben wird.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Having to do with the blood vessels and the heart.
lay_definition_de: Was die Blutgefäße und das Herz betrifft.

general_definition_en: A rapid or irregular heartbeat that a person can feel.
lay_definition_en: Feeling like your heart is racing or skipping beats.
lay_definition_de: Das Gefühl, dass das Herz rast oder Aussetzer hat.

general_definition_en: A symptom complex characterized by pain and weakness in SKELETAL MUSCLE group associated with exercise, such as leg pain and weakness brought on by walking. Such muscle limpness disappears after a brief rest and is often relates to arterial STENOSIS; muscle ISCHEMIA; and accumulation of LACTATE.
lay_definition_en: Pain and cramping in the legs or arms that happen when you exercise due to low blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Schmerzen und Krämpfe in den Beinen oder Armen, die beim Sport aufgrund einer verminderten Durchblutung auftreten.

general_definition_en: VITALS
lay_definition_en: VITALS are the numbers that tell how your body is doing, like blood pressure, heart rate, breathing rate, and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Vitalwerte sind die Werte, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie es Ihrem Körper geht, beispielsweise Blutdruck, Herzfrequenz, Atemfrequenz und Temperatur.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: Your pulse is the beat of your heart that you can feel on your body.
lay_definition_de: Dein Puls ist der Herzschlag, den du an deinem Körper spüren kannst.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: Keep an eye on a patient's progress and health over time.
lay_definition_de: Behalten Sie den Verlauf und den Gesundheitszustand eines Patienten über einen längeren Zeitraum hinweg im Auge.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: Measures oxygen levels in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Misst den Sauerstoffgehalt im Blut.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the cardiac rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A regular beat or pattern of movement or sound.
lay_definition_de: Ein regelmäßiger Rhythmus oder ein regelmäßiges Bewegungs- oder Klangmuster.

general_definition_en: Heart murmurs which are systolic in timing. They occur between the first and the second HEART SOUNDS, between the closure of MITRAL VALVE and TRICUSPID VALVE and the closure of semilunar aortic and pulmonary valves. Systolic murmurs include ejection murmurs and regurgitant murmurs.
lay_definition_en: A swishing noise heard from blood flowing through a narrowed blood vessel or faulty heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein rauschendes Geräusch, das entsteht, wenn Blut durch ein verengt Blutgefäß oder eine defekte Herzklappe fließt.

general_definition_en: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Signs that show how well your body is working, like heart rate and blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Anzeichen, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert, wie beispielsweise Herzfrequenz und Blutdruck.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of homocysteine amino acid present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: Amino acid that can lead to health issues like blood clotting and heart disease if levels are too high.
lay_definition_de: Eine Aminosäure, die bei zu hohen Konzentrationen zu gesundheitlichen Problemen wie Blutgerinnseln und Herzerkrankungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: A selective adrenergic beta-1 blocking agent that is commonly used to treat ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; and CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps with chest pain, irregular heartbeats, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: A derivative of LOVASTATIN and potent competitive inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A reductase (HYDROXYMETHYLGLUTARYL COA REDUCTASES), which is the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis. It may also interfere with steroid hormone production. Due to the induction of hepatic LDL RECEPTORS, it increases breakdown of LDL CHOLESTEROL.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps lower cholesterol levels to prevent heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, den Cholesterinspiegel zu senken, um Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: A barbiturate that exerts its effect by mimicking the inhibitory effect of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) by binding to a site, distinct from the benzodiazepine binding site, on the GABA receptor. This leads to an increase in the duration of GABA-mediated opening of chloride channels and enhances the inhibitory effect of GABA. Consequently, its physiologic effects include sedation, hypnosis, reduction of anxiety, and respiratory depression and the drug causes tolerance and dependence. / Analgesic antipyretic derivative of acetanilide. It has weak anti-inflammatory properties and is used as a common analgesic, but may cause liver, blood cell, and kidney damage. / A methylxanthine naturally occurring in some beverages and also used as a pharmacological agent. Caffeine's most notable pharmacological effect is as a central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness and producing agitation. It also relaxes SMOOTH MUSCLE, stimulates CARDIAC MUSCLE, stimulates DIURESIS, and appears to be useful in the treatment of some types of headache. Several cellular actions of caffeine have been observed, but it is not entirely clear how each contributes to its pharmacological profile. Among the most important are inhibition of cyclic nucleotide PHOSPHODIESTERASES, antagonism of ADENOSINE RECEPTORS, and modulation of intracellular calcium handling.
lay_definition_en: A combination of drugs that helps relieve tension headaches.
lay_definition_de: Eine Wirkstoffkombination, die zur Linderung von Spannungskopfschmerzen beiträgt.

general_definition_en: The calcium salt of atorvastatin, a synthetic lipid-lowering agent. Atorvastatin competitively inhibits hepatic hydroxymethyl-glutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the enzyme which catalyzes the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a key step in cholesterol synthesis. This agent increases the number of LDL receptors on hepatic cell surfaces, enhancing the uptake and catabolism of LDL and reducing LDL production and the number of LDL particles, and lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels. Like other statins, atorvastatin may also display direct antineoplastic activity, possibly by inhibiting farnesylation and geranylgeranylation of proteins such as small GTP-binding proteins, which may result in the arrest of cells in the G1 phase of the cell cycle. This agent may also sensitize tumor cells to cyctostatic drugs, possibly through the mTOR-dependent inhibition of Akt phosphorylation.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce bad cholesterol levels to prevent heart issues like stroke or heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, den Spiegel des „schlechten“ Cholesterins zu senken, um Herzproblemen wie einem Schlaganfall oder einem Herzinfarkt vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: A benzoic-sulfonamide-furan. It is a diuretic with fast onset and short duration that is used for EDEMA and chronic RENAL INSUFFICIENCY.
lay_definition_en: Medication that treats high blood pressure and swelling, also known as Lasix.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Ödemen, auch bekannt als Lasix.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: The pulse is the beat of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Puls ist der Herzschlag.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: Sounds in the heart caused by blood flow that can signal underlying health issues.
lay_definition_de: Durch den Blutfluss verursachte Herzgeräusche, die auf zugrunde liegende Gesundheitsprobleme hinweisen können.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with pain, fever, and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei Schmerzen, Fieber und Schwellungen hilft.

general_definition_en: The gluconate salt form of quinidine, an alkaloid with antimalarial and antiarrhythmic (Class la) properties. Quinidine gluconate exerts its anti-malarial activity by acting primarily as an intra-erythrocytic schizonticide through association with the hemepolymer (hemozoin) in the acidic food vacuole of the parasite thereby preventing further polymerization by heme polymerase enzyme. This results in accumulation of toxic heme and death of the parasite. Quinidine gluconate exerts its antiarrhythmic effects by depressing the flow of sodium ions into cells during phase 0 of the cardiac action potential, thereby slowing the impulse conduction through the atrioventricular (AV) node, reducing the maximal rate of phase 0 depolarization and prolonging the refractory period. Quinidine gluconate also reduces the slope of phase 4 depolarization in Purkinje-fibres resulting in slowed conduction and reduced automaticity in the heart.
lay_definition_en: A drug for irregular heartbeats or malaria.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Herzrhythmusstörungen oder Malaria.

general_definition_en: An optical isomer of quinine, extracted from the bark of the CHINCHONA tree and similar plant species. This alkaloid dampens the excitability of cardiac and skeletal muscles by blocking sodium and potassium currents across cellular membranes. It prolongs cellular ACTION POTENTIALS, and decreases automaticity. Quinidine also blocks muscarinic and alpha-adrenergic neurotransmission.
lay_definition_en: A drug called Quinine.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament namens Chinin.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally rapid heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Your heart is beating too fast.
lay_definition_de: Dein Herz schlägt zu schnell.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a change in cardiac electrical activity.
lay_definition_en: A heart test that checks the electric activity and rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität und der Herzrhythmus überprüft werden.

general_definition_en: Abnormal communication most commonly seen between two internal organs, or between an internal organ and the surface of the body. tachycardia
lay_definition_en: Sinus tachycardia is when the heart beats rapidly but consistently at a rate of 100 beats per minute or more while at rest.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Sinustachykardie spricht man, wenn das Herz in Ruhe schnell, aber gleichmäßig mit einer Frequenz von 100 Schlägen pro Minute oder mehr schlägt.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Extra heartbeats that start in the ventricles and are also known as skipped heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzliche Herzschläge, die in den Herzkammern entstehen und auch als Herzaussetzer bezeichnet werden.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart.
lay_definition_en: Related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz betreffend.

general_definition_en: An imbalance between myocardial functional requirements and the capacity of the CORONARY VESSELS to supply sufficient blood flow. It is a form of MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA (insufficient blood supply to the heart muscle) caused by a decreased capacity of the coronary vessels.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the blood vessels supplying blood and oxygen to the heart are narrowed or blocked.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die Blutgefäße, die das Herz mit Blut und Sauerstoff versorgen, verengt oder verstopft sind.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood in CHF.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzinsuffizienz (CHF) hat das Herz Schwierigkeiten, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A spectrum of pathological conditions of impaired blood flow in the brain. They can involve vessels (ARTERIES or VEINS) in the CEREBRUM, the CEREBELLUM, and the BRAIN STEM. Major categories include INTRACRANIAL ARTERIOVENOUS MALFORMATIONS; BRAIN ISCHEMIA; CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; and others. Unexpected and unintentional events, typically resulting in ACCIDENTAL INJURIES.
lay_definition_en: A stroke happens when blood flow to a part of the brain is blocked, causing damage to brain tissue.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlaganfall tritt auf, wenn die Blutversorgung eines Teils des Gehirns unterbrochen wird, wodurch das Hirngewebe geschädigt wird.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: A CVA is when part of the brain is damaged due to lack of blood flow, also known as a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Eine zerebrovaskuläre Accidentie (CVA) liegt vor, wenn ein Teil des Gehirns aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung geschädigt wird; dies wird auch als Schlaganfall bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes of CORONARY ARTERIES that may derive from a congenital abnormality, atherosclerotic, or non-atherosclerotic cause.
lay_definition_en: When the blood vessels that supply blood to the heart get blocked, it can be dangerous.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Blutgefäße, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen, verstopft sind, kann das gefährlich sein.

general_definition_en: A synthetic levoisomer of thyroxine (T4), similar to the endogenous hormone produced by the thyroid gland. Thyroxine is de-iodinated to form triiodothyronine (T3) in the peripheral tissues. T3 enters the cell and binds to nuclear thyroid hormone receptors, and the hormone-receptor complex in turn triggers gene expression and produces proteins required in the regulation of cellular respiration, thermogenesis, cellular growth and differentiation, and metabolism of proteins, carbohydrates and lipids. T4 and T3 also possess cardiac stimulatory effect.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat thyroid conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Schilddrüsenerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: A measurement of the median number of cycles of contraction and subsequent relaxation of the heart, usually expressed as beats per minute, obtained from a set of measurements of the heart rate.
lay_definition_en: A heart rate shows how quickly or slowly your heart is beating.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell oder langsam Ihr Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: Systematic and thorough inspection of the patient for physical signs of disease or abnormality. Constitutional
lay_definition_en: Checking your temperature, blood pressure, and heart rate when you see the doctor.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem Arztbesuch werden Ihre Temperatur, Ihr Blutdruck und Ihre Herzfrequenz gemessen.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography.
lay_definition_en: A heart picture taken from the outside using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzaufnahme, die von außen mithilfe von Schallwellen aufgenommen wurde.

general_definition_en: The left ventricular volume calculated as the difference between the epicardium delimited volume and the left ventricular chamber volume.
lay_definition_en: The big heart chamber pumping blood around the body.
lay_definition_de: Die große Herzkammer, die das Blut durch den Körper pumpt.

general_definition_en: ECG
lay_definition_en: It's a heart test that checks the electrical activity of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität Ihres Herzens überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: Localized reduction of blood flow to brain tissue due to arterial obstruction or systemic hypoperfusion. This frequently occurs in conjunction with brain hypoxia (HYPOXIA, BRAIN). Prolonged ischemia is associated with BRAIN INFARCTION.
lay_definition_en: Not enough blood flow due to blocked or narrowed blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Unzureichende Durchblutung aufgrund verstopfter oder verengter Blutgefäße.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: Arrhythmia is a deviation from the regular heartbeat pattern.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arrhythmie ist eine Abweichung vom normalen Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: A common irregular heart rhythm affecting the ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Eine häufige Herzrhythmusstörung, die die Herzkammern betrifft.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: Extra heartbeats in the atria.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzliche Herzschläge in den Vorhöfen.

lay_definition_en: A safe radioisotope used in nuclear medicine scans for cardiac stress tests.
lay_definition_de: Ein sicheres Radioisotop, das in der Nuklearmedizin für Herzbelastungstests verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial CAROTID ARTERIES and the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the CIRCLE OF WILLIS. Cerebral angiogram shows the puff-of-smoke (moyamoya) collaterals at the base of the brain. It is characterized by endothelial HYPERPLASIA and FIBROSIS with thickening of arterial walls. This disease primarily affects children but can also occur in adults.
lay_definition_en: Moyamoya disease is a rare condition where arteries at the base of the brain get blocked, leading to the formation of tiny blood vessels as a workaround.
lay_definition_de: Die Moyamoya-Krankheit ist eine seltene Erkrankung, bei der Arterien an der Hirnbasis verstopfen, was zur Bildung winziger Blutgefäße als Umgehungsweg führt.

general_definition_en: A chronic inflammatory connective tissue disease marked by skin rashes, joint pain and swelling, inflammation of the kidneys, inflammation of the fibrous tissue surrounding the heart (i.e., the pericardium), as well as other problems. Not all affected individuals display all of these problems.
lay_definition_en: A chronic condition where the immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own tissues.
lay_definition_de: Eine chronische Erkrankung, bei der das Immunsystem fälschlicherweise das körpereigene Gewebe angreift.

general_definition_en: Decrease in the size of a cell, tissue, organ, or multiple organs, associated with a variety of pathological conditions such as abnormal cellular changes, ischemia, malnutrition, or hormonal changes.
lay_definition_en: When a body part or tissue shrinks or weakens, it's called atrophy.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein Körperteil oder Gewebe schrumpft oder an Kraft verliert, spricht man von Atrophie.

general_definition_en: A methylxanthine naturally occurring in some beverages and also used as a pharmacological agent. Caffeine's most notable pharmacological effect is as a central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness and producing agitation. It also relaxes SMOOTH MUSCLE, stimulates CARDIAC MUSCLE, stimulates DIURESIS, and appears to be useful in the treatment of some types of headache. Several cellular actions of caffeine have been observed, but it is not entirely clear how each contributes to its pharmacological profile. Among the most important are inhibition of cyclic nucleotide PHOSPHODIESTERASES, antagonism of ADENOSINE RECEPTORS, and modulation of intracellular calcium handling.
lay_definition_en: Caffeine is a common stimulant found in coffee and tea that can increase heart rate and help you stay alert.
lay_definition_de: Koffein ist ein weit verbreitetes Stimulans, das in Kaffee und Tee enthalten ist und die Herzfrequenz erhöhen sowie dazu beitragen kann, dass man wachsam bleibt.

general_definition_en: small vessel ischemic
lay_definition_en: When small blood vessels in the heart are damaged, it can lead to a form of heart disease that may also increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Wenn kleine Blutgefäße im Herzen geschädigt werden, kann dies zu einer Form von Herzerkrankung führen, die auch das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: The thickening of the wall of the small arteries and arterioles. It is caused by deposition of hyaline material in the wall or concentric smooth muscle wall hypertrophy. It results in lumen narrowing and tissue ischemia.
lay_definition_en: Arterionephrosclerosis is when the arteries in the kidneys become thick or hard.
lay_definition_de: Bei der Arterionephrosklerose kommt es zu einer Verdickung oder Verhärtung der Arterien in den Nieren.

general_definition_en: Abnormally high systolic blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure occurs when the force of blood in the arteries is too high.
lay_definition_de: Bluthochdruck liegt vor, wenn der Blutdruck in den Arterien zu hoch ist.

general_definition_en: The signs of life that may be monitored or measured, namely pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, and blood pressure. SIGNS
lay_definition_en: Numbers that indicate how your body is doing, like blood pressure and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Werte, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie es Ihrem Körper geht, wie zum Beispiel Blutdruck und Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of episodic atrial fibrillation with abrupt onset and termination.
lay_definition_en: Paroxysmal AF is a sudden onset of irregular heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Paroxysmales Vorhofflimmern ist ein plötzlich auftretender unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is like a tiny device that helps control your heart rate by sending electrical signals.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein winziges Gerät, das durch das Senden elektrischer Signale dabei hilft, die Herzfrequenz zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: A conducting cell of the nervous system that has only one process extending from the cell body. It is always a sensory neuron. Anatomical orientation which is the standard position of the human body: erect, upper limbs adducted with palms facing anteriorly and lower limbs straight with soles facing inferiorly. Examples: There is only one anatomical position.
lay_definition_en: Instructions given to a pacemaker to govern its functioning.
lay_definition_de: Anweisungen an einen Herzschrittmacher zur Steuerung seiner Funktion.

general_definition_en: under - Problem associated with the amount of input required by the device to detect a signal being higher than expected/desired.
lay_definition_en: When a pacemaker needs to be adjusted.
lay_definition_de: Wann muss ein Herzschrittmacher eingestellt werden?

general_definition_en: AAI
lay_definition_en: AAI is a type of setting on a pacemaker that helps control heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: AAI ist eine Einstellungsoption bei Herzschrittmachern, die zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus beiträgt.

general_definition_en: An imbalance between myocardial functional requirements and the capacity of the CORONARY VESSELS to supply sufficient blood flow. It is a form of MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA (insufficient blood supply to the heart muscle) caused by a decreased capacity of the coronary vessels.
lay_definition_en: A condition where blood vessels carrying blood to the heart become narrow or blocked.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem sich die Blutgefäße, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen, verengen oder verstopfen.

general_definition_en: Abnormally high systolic blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure is when the force of blood in your arteries is too high.
lay_definition_de: Von Bluthochdruck spricht man, wenn der Druck des Blutes in den Arterien zu hoch ist.

general_definition_en: An abstract class to capture the concept of an event (either in the laboratory or a computational analysis). (caMAGE) In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A device that tracks your heart's electrical activity when you have symptoms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das die elektrische Aktivität Ihres Herzens aufzeichnet, wenn Sie Symptome haben.

general_definition_en: ANKRD1 gene
lay_definition_en: The ANKRD1 gene is a specific spot on a chromosome that can lead to heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Das ANKRD1-Gen ist eine bestimmte Stelle auf einem Chromosom, die zu Herzerkrankungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: A widely used non-cardioselective beta-adrenergic antagonist. Propranolol has been used for MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; ARRHYTHMIA; ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; HYPERTHYROIDISM; MIGRAINE; PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA; and ANXIETY but adverse effects instigate replacement by newer drugs.
lay_definition_en: Propranolol is a medicine that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Propranolol ist ein Arzneimittel, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: An ambulatory electrocardiography technique that records a continuous electrocardiographic rhythm pattern for 24 hours or more to detect heart arrhythmias.
lay_definition_en: A Holter monitor is a device you wear that tracks your heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Holter-Monitor ist ein Gerät, das Sie am Körper tragen und das Ihren Herzschlag aufzeichnet.

general_definition_en: Region of wall of right ventricle which has as its parts the mural and septal limbs of supraventricular crest.
lay_definition_en: Above the lower heart chambers.
lay_definition_de: Oberhalb der unteren Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Irregular heartbeats originating from the lower part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Herzrhythmusstörungen, die ihren Ursprung im unteren Teil des Herzens haben.

general_definition_en: A nicotinic antagonist that has been used as a ganglionic blocker in hypertension, as an adjunct to anesthesia, and to induce hypotension during surgery. A drug combination with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity against both gram-positive and gram-negative organisms. It is effective in the treatment of many infections, including PNEUMOCYSTIS PNEUMONIA in AIDS.
lay_definition_en: A drug mix that fights various infections.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikamentencocktail zur Bekämpfung verschiedener Infektionen.

general_definition_en: Drugs used in the treatment of acute or chronic vascular HYPERTENSION regardless of pharmacological mechanism. Among the antihypertensive agents are DIURETICS; (especially DIURETICS, THIAZIDE); ADRENERGIC BETA-ANTAGONISTS; ADRENERGIC ALPHA-ANTAGONISTS; ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS; CALCIUM CHANNEL BLOCKERS; GANGLIONIC BLOCKERS; and VASODILATOR AGENTS.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A thiazide diuretic often considered the prototypical member of this class. It reduces the reabsorption of electrolytes from the renal tubules. This results in increased excretion of water and electrolytes, including sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium. It is used in the treatment of several disorders including edema, hypertension, diabetes insipidus, and hypoparathyroidism.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps reduce fluid in the body and can treat high blood pressure and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Schwellungen eingesetzt werden kann.

general_definition_en: Toprol
lay_definition_en: Medication for heart-related conditions like chest pain, heart failure, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen wie Brustschmerzen, Herzinsuffizienz und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Bradycardia is when your heart beats slower than it should.
lay_definition_de: Von Bradykardie spricht man, wenn das Herz langsamer schlägt, als es sollte.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by excessive levels of thyroid hormone in the body. Common causes include an overactive thyroid gland or thyroid hormone overdose.
lay_definition_en: A condition where your thyroid gland in the neck works too hard, leading to symptoms like fast heart rate and weight loss.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der die Schilddrüse im Halsbereich überaktiv ist, was zu Symptomen wie Herzrasen und Gewichtsverlust führt.

general_definition_en: The most abundant protein component of HIGH DENSITY LIPOPROTEINS or HDL. This protein serves as an acceptor for CHOLESTEROL released from cells thus promoting efflux of cholesterol to HDL then to the LIVER for excretion from the body (reverse cholesterol transport). It also acts as a cofactor for LECITHIN CHOLESTEROL ACYLTRANSFERASE that forms CHOLESTEROL ESTERS on the HDL particles. Mutations of this gene APOA1 cause HDL deficiency, such as in FAMILIAL ALPHA LIPOPROTEIN DEFICIENCY DISEASE and in some patients with TANGIER DISEASE.
lay_definition_en: ApoA-1 is a component of HDL that can reduce the risk of heart disease and stroke when levels are high.
lay_definition_de: ApoA-1 ist ein Bestandteil des HDL, der bei hohen Konzentrationen das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und Schlaganfälle senken kann.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A medication used to ease pain, reduce fever, inflammation, and lower the risk of heart attacks by thinning blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das zur Schmerzlinderung, Fiebersenkung und Entzündungshemmung eingesetzt wird und durch seine blutverdünnende Wirkung das Risiko von Herzinfarkten senkt.

general_definition_en: A cardioselective beta-1 adrenergic blocker possessing properties and potency similar to PROPRANOLOL, but without a negative inotropic effect.
lay_definition_en: Medicine that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: ascending Pathological processes involving any part of the AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The spot where the aorta starts from the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Stelle, an der die Aorta vom Herzen ausgeht.

general_definition_en: A surgical procedure to place a stent within a vessel.
lay_definition_en: Placing a tube to keep a blocked artery or duct open.
lay_definition_de: Einlegen eines Schlauchs, um eine verstopfte Arterie oder einen verstopften Gang offen zu halten.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that carries oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: An abnormally rapid ventricular rhythm usually in excess of 150 beats per minute. It is generated within the ventricle below the BUNDLE OF HIS, either as autonomic impulse formation or reentrant impulse conduction. Depending on the etiology, onset of ventricular tachycardia can be paroxysmal (sudden) or nonparoxysmal, its wide QRS complexes can be uniform or polymorphic, and the ventricular beating may be independent of the atrial beating (AV dissociation).
lay_definition_en: The heart beating irregularly because its lower chambers are ticking too quickly.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz schlägt unregelmäßig, weil seine unteren Kammern zu schnell schlagen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates in the sinus node.
lay_definition_en: When your heart races faster than usual.
lay_definition_de: Wenn dein Herz schneller schlägt als sonst.

general_definition_en: Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: These drugs help reduce blood pressure by slowing down the heart.
lay_definition_de: Diese Medikamente tragen dazu bei, den Blutdruck zu senken, indem sie die Herzfrequenz verlangsamen.

general_definition_en: Abnormally low BLOOD PRESSURE that can result in inadequate blood flow to the brain and other vital organs. Common symptom is DIZZINESS but greater negative impacts on the body occur when there is prolonged depravation of oxygen and nutrients.
lay_definition_en: Low blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Niedriger Blutdruck.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, blood goes the wrong way: mitral regurgitation.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung: Mitralinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Flow in the opposite direction from normal, as the casting up of undigested food or gas from the stomach, or the backward flowing of blood into the heart, or between the chambers of the heart when a valve is incompetent. fraction
lay_definition_en: Regurgitant fraction is a way to measure how much blood is flowing backwards through a heart valve, with higher values indicating the valve is not working properly.
lay_definition_de: Die Regurgitationsfraktion ist ein Maß dafür, wie viel Blut durch eine Herzklappe zurückfließt; höhere Werte deuten darauf hin, dass die Klappe nicht richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a pathological increase in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure is when the force of blood in the arteries is too high.
lay_definition_de: Von Bluthochdruck spricht man, wenn der Blutdruck in den Arterien zu hoch ist.

general_definition_en: A potent and specific inhibitor of PEPTIDYL-DIPEPTIDASE A. It blocks the conversion of ANGIOTENSIN I to ANGIOTENSIN II, a vasoconstrictor and important regulator of arterial blood pressure. Captopril acts to suppress the RENIN-ANGIOTENSIN SYSTEM and inhibits pressure responses to exogenous angiotensin.
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure, heart failure, and kidney issues in diabetes patients.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, Herzinsuffizienz und Nierenprobleme bei Diabetespatienten.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a sudden drop of the blood pressure, bradycardia, and peripheral vasodilation that may lead to loss of consciousness. It results from an increase in the stimulation of the vagus nerve.
lay_definition_en: Related to a sudden decrease in blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit einem plötzlichen Blutdruckabfall.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps with pain, fever, and inflammation.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Schmerzen, Fieber und Entzündungen hilft.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: A protein necessary for muscle movement in the body, particularly the heart, that can indicate heart damage when found in blood tests.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, das für die Muskelbewegung im Körper, insbesondere im Herzen, notwendig ist und dessen Nachweis in Blutuntersuchungen auf eine Herzschädigung hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: Enfamil Pathological condition characterized by the backflow of blood from the ASCENDING AORTA back into the LEFT VENTRICLE, leading to regurgitation. It is caused by diseases of the AORTIC VALVE or its surrounding tissue (aortic root).
lay_definition_en: A type of baby formula with added rice starch to help with digestion.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art Babynahrung mit zugesetzter Reisstärke, die die Verdauung unterstützt.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by occlusion of terminal aorta, the primary branches of the ABDOMINAL AORTA, as in aortoiliac obstruction. Leriche syndrome usually occurs in males and is characterized by IMPOTENCE, absence of a pulse in the femoral arteries, weakness and numbness in the lower back, buttocks, hips, and lower limbs.
lay_definition_en: A serious condition where clogged arteries in the lower body cause symptoms like leg pain, sexual dysfunction, and weak pulses in the legs.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwerwiegende Erkrankung, bei der verstopfte Arterien in den Beinen Symptome wie Beinschmerzen, sexuelle Funktionsstörungen und einen schwachen Puls in den Beinen verursachen.

general_definition_en: guiding A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A small tube used to place stents in the heart and open up blood vessels, also measuring pressure or injecting dye.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner Schlauch, der dazu dient, Stents im Herzen zu platzieren und Blutgefäße zu erweitern sowie den Druck zu messen oder Kontrastmittel zu injizieren.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart.
lay_definition_en: Related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz betreffend.

general_definition_en: The arterial trunk that arises from the abdominal aorta and after a short course divides into the left gastric, common hepatic and splenic arteries.
lay_definition_en: A celiac is a major blood vessel in the belly region that delivers blood to the organs there.
lay_definition_de: Die Zöliakie ist ein großes Blutgefäß im Bauchraum, das die dortigen Organe mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: This structure includes the thin muscular atrial septum between the two HEART ATRIA, and the thick muscular ventricular septum between the two HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: A septum is a barrier that divides two spaces or cavities from each other.
lay_definition_de: Ein Septum ist eine Trennwand, die zwei Räume oder Hohlräume voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: A balloon-like bulge in a blood vessel that can burst and cause dangerous internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine ballonartige Ausbuchtung in einem Blutgefäß, die reißen und gefährliche innere Blutungen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: An arterial segment arising from the abdominal aorta that supplies blood to the abdominal organs, other structures, genitalia and the lower limbs. The aortic branches include terminal branches called the common iliac arteries, the celiac artery, the superior mesenteric artery, the inferior mesenteric artery, the renal arteries, the suprarenal arteries, the testicular (internal spermatic) arteries, the ovarian arteries, the inferior phrenic arteries, lumbar arteries and the middle sacral artery.
lay_definition_en: The main artery that runs through the belly, supplying blood to the belly and lower body.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptarterie, die durch den Bauch verläuft und den Bauch sowie den Unterkörper mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to create new paths for blood flow around blocked heart arteries.
lay_definition_de: Herzoperation zur Schaffung neuer Blutbahnen um verstopfte Herzarterien herum.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Related to the lower parts of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf die unteren Teile des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: When the heart takes a breather in between beats.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz zwischen zwei Schlägen eine kleine Verschnaufpause einlegt.

general_definition_en: Bernheim A pathologic condition that results from a disease, treatment, or injury.
lay_definition_en: The Bernheim effect is when the heart's right ventricle is squeezed, leading to heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Der Bernheim-Effekt tritt auf, wenn der rechte Ventrikel des Herzens zusammengedrückt wird, was zu einer Herzinsuffizienz führt.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The blood vessels that carry oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut von der Lunge zum Herzen transportieren.

general_definition_en: A bipolar electrocardiogram limb lead which records the voltage between the positive electrode near the apex of the heart (located in the ICS of left 5-6 rib close to the sternum) and the negative electrode behind the right ear near the right mastoid process. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Affecting your spine, chest, and pelvis.
lay_definition_de: Betroffen sind Ihre Wirbelsäule, Ihr Brustkorb und Ihr Becken.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: Aneurysms are like bubbles that form in blood vessels and can be really dangerous if they burst.
lay_definition_de: Aneurysmen sind wie Blasen, die sich in Blutgefäßen bilden und sehr gefährlich sein können, wenn sie platzen.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: A murmur is noise from blood moving through the heart, which may suggest a health issue.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzgeräusch ist ein Geräusch, das durch den Blutfluss im Herzen entsteht und auf ein gesundheitliches Problem hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed with the purpose of replacing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. mitral valve with bioprosthetic, homograft or autograft valve.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to replace the valve in the heart that controls blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Operative Eingriff zum Austausch der Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss reguliert.

general_definition_en: A volatile vasodilator which relieves ANGINA PECTORIS by stimulating GUANYLATE CYCLASE and lowering cytosolic calcium. It is also sometimes used for TOCOLYSIS and explosives.
lay_definition_en: A tube that goes from your nose to your stomach to help with feeding or draining.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der von der Nase bis in den Magen verläuft und zur Ernährung oder zur Entleerung dient.

general_definition_en: A neurovascular syndrome associated with compression of the BRACHIAL PLEXUS; SUBCLAVIAN ARTERY; and SUBCLAVIAN VEIN at the superior thoracic outlet. This may result from a variety of anomalies such as a CERVICAL RIB, anomalous fascial bands, and abnormalities of the origin or insertion of the anterior or medial scalene muscles. Clinical features may include pain in the shoulder and neck region which radiates into the arm, PARESIS or PARALYSIS of brachial plexus innervated muscles, PARESTHESIA, loss of sensation, reduction of arterial pulses in the affected extremity, ISCHEMIA, and EDEMA. (Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp214-5).
lay_definition_en: The area between the collarbone and the first rib that contains blood vessels, nerves, and muscles.
lay_definition_de: Der Bereich zwischen dem Schlüsselbein und der ersten Rippe, in dem sich Blutgefäße, Nerven und Muskeln befinden.

general_definition_en: Removal of a wedge-shaped portion of tissue, for microscopic examinaton.
lay_definition_en: A method for assessing the pumping function of the left atrium in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Beurteilung der Pumpfunktion des linken Vorhofs im Herzen.

general_definition_en: Carbon monoxide (CO). A poisonous colorless, odorless, tasteless gas. It combines with hemoglobin to form carboxyhemoglobin, which has no oxygen carrying capacity. The resultant oxygen deprivation causes headache, dizziness, decreased pulse and respiratory rates, unconsciousness, and death. (From Merck Index, 11th ed)
lay_definition_en: Blood flow pumped by the heart per minute.
lay_definition_de: Vom Herzen pro Minute gepumptes Blutvolumen.

general_definition_en: A branch of the abdominal aorta which supplies the kidneys, adrenal glands and ureters.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that supplies blood to the kidney, adrenal gland, and ureter.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das die Niere, die Nebenniere und den Harnleiter mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A procedure to open an occluded coronary artery, performed by percutaneous introduction of a catheter into a peripheral (usually femoral) artery which is directed in a retrograde fashion to reach the diseased coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: Procedure where a small balloon is inflated in a blood vessel to clear blockages.
lay_definition_de: Verfahren, bei dem ein kleiner Ballon in einem Blutgefäß aufgeblasen wird, um Verstopfungen zu beseitigen.

general_definition_en: OM2
lay_definition_en: One of the heart's left circumflex artery branches.
lay_definition_de: Einer der Äste der linken Herzumlaufarterie.

general_definition_en: A left coronary artery branch that descends on the anterior portion of the heart through the anterior interventricular groove.
lay_definition_en: An artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: Septin-9 (586 aa, ~65 kDa) is encoded by the human SEPT9 gene. This protein plays a role in the mediation of cytoskeletal filament formation.
lay_definition_en: The first major branch off of the left anterior descending artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der erste größere Ast der linken vorderen absteigenden Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: Culotte
lay_definition_en: A procedure for inserting stents in two branches of a heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zum Einsetzen von Stents in zwei Äste einer Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: A synthetic nonsteroidal estrogen used in the treatment of menopausal and postmenopausal disorders. It was also used formerly as a growth promoter in animals. According to the Fourth Annual Report on Carcinogens (NTP 85-002, 1985), diethylstilbestrol has been listed as a known carcinogen. (Merck, 11th ed)
lay_definition_en: A DES is a type of stent that slowly releases medicine to keep a blocked artery open.
lay_definition_de: Ein DES ist eine Art Stent, der nach und nach Wirkstoffe freisetzt, um eine verstopfte Arterie offen zu halten.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of ST segment depression below the baseline, often described as up sloping, down sloping or horizontal.
lay_definition_en: A sign of abnormal heart activity shown in an ECG trace where the ST segment is lowered.
lay_definition_de: Ein Anzeichen für eine Herzfunktionsstörung, das sich in einer EKG-Kurve durch eine Senkung des ST-Segments zeigt.

general_definition_en: lopressor
lay_definition_en: Lopressor is a medication that helps with chest pain, irregular heartbeats, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Lopressor ist ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography.
lay_definition_en: A heart picture taken using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bild des Herzens, das mithilfe von Schallwellen aufgenommen wurde.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: Keeping an eye on someone to see how they are progressing.
lay_definition_de: Jemanden im Auge behalten, um zu sehen, wie er oder sie vorankommt.

general_definition_en: lasix
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps get rid of extra fluid in the body, commonly used in conditions like heart failure, liver disease, and kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit aus dem Körper auszuscheiden, und häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz, Lebererkrankungen und Nierenerkrankungen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: SVGs
lay_definition_en: A vein taken from the leg and redirected to the heart in bypass surgery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Vene, die aus dem Bein entnommen und bei einer Bypass-Operation zum Herzen umgeleitet wird.

general_definition_en: A subject domain utilized for the submission of information encompassing and representing data, vocabulary or records related to organ measurement.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: A condition of abnormally low AMNIOTIC FLUID volume. Principal causes include malformations of fetal URINARY TRACT; FETAL GROWTH RETARDATION; GESTATIONAL HYPERTENSION; nicotine poisoning; and PROLONGED PREGNANCY.
lay_definition_en: Oligohydramnios is when there's too little amniotic fluid around a baby before birth.
lay_definition_de: Von Oligohydramnion spricht man, wenn vor der Geburt zu wenig Fruchtwasser um das Baby herum vorhanden ist.

general_definition_en: A benzothiazepine calcium channel blocking agent. Diltiazem hydrochloride inhibits the transmembrane influx of extracellular calcium ions into select myocardial and vascular smooth muscle cells, causing dilatation of coronary and systemic arteries and decreasing myocardial contractility. Because of its vasodilatory activity, this agent has been shown to improve the microcirculation in some tumors, thereby potentially improving the delivery of antineoplastic agents to tumor cells. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: A medicine used to control high blood pressure and irregular heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: Keep an eye on someone to see how they are doing over a period of time.
lay_definition_de: Jemanden im Auge behalten, um zu sehen, wie es ihm über einen bestimmten Zeitraum hinweg geht.

general_definition_en: A noninvasive blood pressure measurement system is a device that provides a signal from which systolic, diastolic, mean, or any combination of the three pressures can be derived through the use of tranducers placed on the surface of the body.
lay_definition_en: A method for tracking blood pressure constantly for extended periods.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur kontinuierlichen Blutdrucküberwachung über längere Zeiträume.

lay_definition_en: Having a slower than usual heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine langsamere Herzfrequenz als gewöhnlich.

general_definition_en: A procedure to open an occluded coronary artery, performed by percutaneous introduction of a catheter into a peripheral (usually femoral) artery which is directed in a retrograde fashion to reach the diseased coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: A procedure where a small balloon is inflated in a blood vessel to clear a blockage.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem ein kleiner Ballon in einem Blutgefäß aufgeblasen wird, um eine Verstopfung zu beseitigen.

general_definition_en: The movement and the forces involved in the movement of the blood through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: Hemodynamics is all about how blood flows in your body.
lay_definition_de: Bei der Hämodynamik dreht sich alles darum, wie das Blut durch den Körper fließt.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: MAP is the average pressure in your arteries during one heart cycle.
lay_definition_de: Der MAP ist der durchschnittliche Druck in Ihren Arterien während eines Herzzyklus.

general_definition_en: A bilateral retinopathy occurring in premature infants treated with excessively high concentrations of oxygen, characterized by vascular dilatation, proliferation, and tortuosity, edema, and retinal detachment, with ultimate conversion of the retina into a fibrous mass that can be seen as a dense retrolental membrane. Usually growth of the eye is arrested and may result in microophthalmia, and blindness may occur. (Dorland, 27th ed)
lay_definition_en: Drugs used during surgery that make patients not remember the procedure or feel any pain.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die während einer Operation eingesetzt werden, damit sich die Patienten weder an den Eingriff erinnern noch Schmerzen verspüren.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in signal transduction. It is involved in several cellular functions including cytoskeletal remodeling and cell differentiation.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure to diagnose and treat heart conditions by inserting a tube into an artery and the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff zur Diagnose und Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen, bei dem ein Schlauch in eine Arterie und bis ins Herz eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: Hand-sized cards with built-in computer chips used for accessing, storing, and protecting patients' medical information.
lay_definition_en: Heart doctors specialized in heart diseases.
lay_definition_de: Herzspezialisten, die auf Herzerkrankungen spezialisiert sind.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: A protein that indicates heart damage when detected in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, dessen Nachweis im Blut auf eine Herzschädigung hindeutet.

general_definition_en: An imaging technique using compounds labelled with short-lived positron-emitting radionuclides (such as carbon-11, nitrogen-13, oxygen-15 and fluorine-18) to measure cell metabolism. It has been useful in study of soft tissues such as CANCER; CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM; and brain. SINGLE-PHOTON EMISSION-COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY is closely related to positron emission tomography, but uses isotopes with longer half-lives and resolution is lower.
lay_definition_en: A tube put into your windpipe.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der in die Luftröhre eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography under conditions intended to elicit signs and symptoms of myocardial ischemia. Conditions often include exercise, pharmacologic agents or pacing.
lay_definition_en: A picture of the heart created using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bild des Herzens, das mithilfe von Schallwellen erstellt wurde.

general_definition_en: The condition in which both atria are joined to the left ventricle each by its own atrioventricular valve. Usually there is a hypoplastic right ventricle, which may be on the opposite side of the heart as usual. [DDD:dbrown, HPO:probinson]
lay_definition_en: A heart problem from birth where there is only one pumping chamber in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein angeborener Herzfehler, bei dem das Herz nur eine Pumpkammer aufweist.

general_definition_en: The curved section of the aorta between the ascending and the descending tracts. The brachiocephalic, left common carotid and left subclavian arteries branch from the aorta at this section.
lay_definition_en: The curved part of the aorta above the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der gekrümmte Abschnitt der Aorta oberhalb des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A plastic tube that connects an artery to a vein for hemodialysis.
lay_definition_de: Ein Kunststoffschlauch, der zur Hämodialyse eine Arterie mit einer Vene verbindet.

general_definition_en: recurrent stenosis; occurs usually after corrective surgery to the orifice of a heart valve.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel narrowing again.
lay_definition_de: Wieder eine Verengung eines Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a QT interval corrected for heart rate that is shorter than the lower limit of normal. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: QTC is a measure of heart rhythm used to gauge potential heart rhythm issues.
lay_definition_de: QTC ist ein Maß für den Herzrhythmus, mit dem potenzielle Herzrhythmusstörungen ermittelt werden können.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: A thin plastic tube inserted into a vein in the chest or neck and advanced into a major vein near the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Kunststoffschlauch, der in eine Vene im Brust- oder Halsbereich eingeführt und bis in eine große Vene in der Nähe des Herzens vorgeschoben wird.

general_definition_en: An augmented unipolar electrocardiogram limb lead in which the positive (white) electrode is situated on the right thoracic limb and the negative electrode is a combination of the left thoracic limb (black) electrode and the left pelvic limb (red) electrode. Measures the electrical activity of the electrode on the right thoracic limb.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to swap a failing heart valve.
