lay_definition_de: Eine Operation zum Austausch einer defekten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A medical device that increases myocardial oxygen perfusion while at the same time increasing cardiac output. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: A long, skinny balloon that helps the heart pump more blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein langer, schmaler Ballon, der dem Herzen hilft, mehr Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Heart condition where the heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankung, bei der das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, Blut effektiv zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: The beat of your heart that you can feel at different spots in your body.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzschlag, den man an verschiedenen Stellen des Körpers spüren kann.

general_definition_en: NQMI
lay_definition_en: A type of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form des Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: A protein found in bacteria and eukaryotic mitochondria which delivers aminoacyl-tRNA's to the A site of the ribosome. The aminoacyl-tRNA is first bound to a complex of elongation factor Tu containing a molecule of bound GTP. The resulting complex is then bound to the 70S initiation complex. Simultaneously the GTP is hydrolyzed and a Tu-GDP complex is released from the 70S ribosome. The Tu-GTP complex is regenerated from the Tu-GDP complex by the Ts elongation factor and GTP.
lay_definition_en: A metric for judging how efficiently the heart pumps blood, used in diagnosing heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß für die Effizienz der Blutförderung durch das Herz, das bei der Diagnose von Herzinsuffizienz herangezogen wird.

general_definition_en: av paced
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a device that helps control the heart rate by sending electrical signals to both the atria and ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, die Herzfrequenz zu steuern, indem es elektrische Signale sowohl an die Vorhöfe als auch an die Herzkammern sendet.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of total skeletal troponin I in a biological sample.
lay_definition_en: Spine parts in the chest and lower back.
lay_definition_de: Wirbelsäulenabschnitte im Brust- und Lendenbereich.

general_definition_en: The dilated portion of the common carotid artery at its bifurcation into external and internal carotids. It contains baroreceptors which, when stimulated, cause slowing of the heart, vasodilatation, and a fall in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: The carotid sinus is the spot where the carotid arteries come together and widen.
lay_definition_de: Der Karotissinus ist die Stelle, an der die Halsschlagadern zusammenlaufen und sich erweitern.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a sudden drop of the blood pressure, bradycardia, and peripheral vasodilation that may lead to loss of consciousness. It results from an increase in the stimulation of the vagus nerve.
lay_definition_en: Relating to a sudden drop in blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit einem plötzlichen Blutdruckabfall.

general_definition_en: An imbalance between myocardial functional requirements and the capacity of the CORONARY VESSELS to supply sufficient blood flow. It is a form of MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA (insufficient blood supply to the heart muscle) caused by a decreased capacity of the coronary vessels.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the blood vessels supplying the heart are narrowed or blocked, causing heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der die das Herz versorgenden Blutgefäße verengt oder verstopft sind, was zu Herzproblemen führt.

general_definition_en: carbomedica
lay_definition_en: Carbomedica is the name of a man-made heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Carbomedica ist der Name einer künstlichen Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Juice made form dark, purple grapes that contain polyphenols with antioxidant and potential cardiovascular protecting activities. Purple grape juice contains high amounts of flavonoids that may increase antioxidant activity and reduce oxidative stress, reduce low-density lipoprotein (LDL), and improve nitric oxide formation, endothelial function and vasodilation.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure involving inserting a tube from the belly into the stomach for feeding or drainage purposes.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein Schlauch vom Bauchraum in den Magen eingeführt wird, um den Patienten zu ernähren oder Flüssigkeit abzuleiten.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by recurrent apneas during sleep despite persistent respiratory efforts. It is due to upper airway obstruction. The respiratory pauses may induce HYPERCAPNIA or HYPOXIA. Cardiac arrhythmias and elevation of systemic and pulmonary arterial pressures may occur. Frequent partial arousals occur throughout sleep, resulting in relative SLEEP DEPRIVATION and daytime tiredness. Associated conditions include OBESITY; ACROMEGALY; MYXEDEMA; micrognathia; MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY; adenotonsilar dystrophy; and NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p395)
lay_definition_en: When your airways get blocked during sleep, causing poor quality of sleep and various symptoms.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich Ihre Atemwege im Schlaf verengen, führt dies zu einer schlechten Schlafqualität und verschiedenen Symptomen.

general_definition_en: Not an aneurysm but a well-defined collection of blood and CONNECTIVE TISSUE outside the wall of a blood vessel or the heart. It is the containment of a ruptured blood vessel or heart, such as sealing a rupture of the left ventricle. False aneurysm is formed by organized THROMBUS and HEMATOMA in surrounding tissue.
lay_definition_en: A pseudoaneurysm is a blood collection outside of an artery's layers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Pseudoaneurysma ist eine Blutansammlung außerhalb der Schichten einer Arterie.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries. root
lay_definition_en: The aortic root is where the heart is connected to a major blood vessel, the aorta.
lay_definition_de: An der Aortenwurzel ist das Herz mit einem großen Blutgefäß, der Aorta, verbunden.

general_definition_en: A cardiotonic glycoside obtained mainly from Digitalis lanata; it consists of three sugars and the aglycone DIGOXIGENIN. Digoxin has positive inotropic and negative chronotropic activity. It is used to control ventricular rate in ATRIAL FIBRILLATION and in the management of congestive heart failure with atrial fibrillation. Its use in congestive heart failure and sinus rhythm is less certain. The margin between toxic and therapeutic doses is small. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p666)
lay_definition_en: A medication for fixing abnormal heart rhythms and certain heart failure cases.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Formen der Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Receptors in the vascular system, particularly the aorta and carotid sinus, which are sensitive to stretch of the vessel walls.
lay_definition_en: Medications that raise blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die den Blutdruck erhöhen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a pathological increase in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure: when the force of blood in your arteries is too high.
lay_definition_de: Bluthochdruck: Wenn der Blutdruck in Ihren Arterien zu hoch ist.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in cell-cell signaling and signal transduction.
lay_definition_en: When your heart rate is regulated by a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihre Herzfrequenz durch einen Herzschrittmacher geregelt wird.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: PVC is when your heart has early extra beats.
lay_definition_de: Von PVC spricht man, wenn das Herz vorzeitige Extraschläge aufweist.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of pathologic Q waves in leads V1 through V4, which is suggestive of myocardial infarction of the anteroseptal wall of the left ventricle. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: The front part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der vordere Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: Heart attack: when the heart muscle dies because it doesn't get enough oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Herzinfarkt: Wenn der Herzmuskel abstirbt, weil er nicht ausreichend mit Sauerstoff versorgt wird.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive cardiac ultrasound performed by placing the transducer on the chest.
lay_definition_en: A TTE is a common heart ultrasound test.
lay_definition_de: Eine TTE ist eine gängige Herzultraschalluntersuchung.

general_definition_en: A fibrous membrane that attaches to, and provides support for, the aortic valve leaflets. vegetations
lay_definition_en: Weird growths full of bacteria that grow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Seltsame, mit Bakterien besetzte Wucherungen, die im Herzen wachsen.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: Relating to the largest artery in the body, the aorta.
lay_definition_de: In Bezug auf die größte Arterie des Körpers, die Aorta.

general_definition_en: Any of the three cardiac veins including the small, middle and great cardiac veins.
lay_definition_en: Cordis is a company that creates stents and other medical devices.
lay_definition_de: Cordis ist ein Unternehmen, das Stents und andere Medizinprodukte herstellt.

general_definition_en: The lower right and left chambers of the heart. The right ventricle pumps venous BLOOD into the LUNGS and the left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood into the systemic arterial circulation.
lay_definition_en: A term that describes the two main chambers at the bottom of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Begriff, der die beiden Hauptkammern am unteren Ende des Herzens bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The top number in a blood pressure reading, reflecting the pressure in the arteries during heart muscle contraction.
lay_definition_de: Der obere Wert bei einer Blutdruckmessung, der den Druck in den Arterien während der Kontraktion des Herzmuskels angibt.

general_definition_en: milranone
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps the heart pump better for people with heart failure or high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Menschen mit Herzinsuffizienz oder pulmonalem Bluthochdruck die Pumpfunktion des Herzens verbessert.

general_definition_en: An inherited disorder of connective tissue with extensive degeneration and calcification of ELASTIC TISSUE primarily in the skin, eye, and vasculature. At least two forms exist, autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant. This disorder is caused by mutations of one of the ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS. Patients are predisposed to MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: A set of conditions that impact the body's elastic tissues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Reihe von Erkrankungen, die das elastische Gewebe des Körpers betreffen.

general_definition_en: An inherited disorder of connective tissue with extensive degeneration and calcification of ELASTIC TISSUE primarily in the skin, eye, and vasculature. At least two forms exist, autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant. This disorder is caused by mutations of one of the ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS. Patients are predisposed to MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: A condition that affects the skin, blood vessels, and eyes due to issues with elastic tissue.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die aufgrund von Störungen des Bindegewebes die Haut, die Blutgefäße und die Augen betrifft.

general_definition_en: Fatty acid esters of cholesterol which constitute about two-thirds of the cholesterol in the plasma. The accumulation of cholesterol esters in the arterial intima is a characteristic feature of atherosclerosis.
lay_definition_en: Fat in the blood produced by the liver and found in foods like eggs and milk, with high levels potentially leading to atherosclerosis.
lay_definition_de: Von der Leber produziertes Blutfett, das auch in Lebensmitteln wie Eiern und Milch vorkommt; hohe Werte können zu Arteriosklerose führen.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: To watch and keep track of someone's progress or condition over time.
lay_definition_de: Den Fortschritt oder den Zustand einer Person im Laufe der Zeit beobachten und verfolgen.

general_definition_en: Abnormally low BLOOD PRESSURE that can result in inadequate blood flow to the brain and other vital organs. Common symptom is DIZZINESS but greater negative impacts on the body occur when there is prolonged depravation of oxygen and nutrients.
lay_definition_en: Hypotension means low blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Hypotonie bedeutet niedrigen Blutdruck.

general_definition_en: A type of computed tomography in which a calibration standard correlates radiodensity values to quantitative tissue density values. interval
lay_definition_en: A QCT interval is like a snapshot of the heart's electrical activity shown on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Ein QCT-Intervall ist wie eine Momentaufnahme der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens, die im EKG dargestellt wird.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of an atypical cardiac rhythm resulting from a pathologic process in the cardiac atria.
lay_definition_en: Heart rhythm that's not consistent.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of the 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetic acid in a sample.
lay_definition_en: A type of monitor used in hospitals to keep track of a patient's heart rate and oxygen levels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das in Krankenhäusern eingesetzt wird, um die Herzfrequenz und den Sauerstoffgehalt eines Patienten zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: The right atrium is the top part of the right side of the heart where blood from the body and head comes in.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Vorhof ist der obere Teil der rechten Herzhälfte, in den das Blut aus dem Körper und dem Kopf einströmt.

general_definition_en: A short-acting hypnotic-sedative drug with anxiolytic and amnestic properties. It is used in dentistry, cardiac surgery, endoscopic procedures, as preanesthetic medication, and as an adjunct to local anesthesia. The short duration and cardiorespiratory stability makes it useful in poor-risk, elderly, and cardiac patients. It is water-soluble at pH less than 4 and lipid-soluble at physiological pH.
lay_definition_en: A sedative often used during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Beruhigungsmittel, das häufig während operativer Eingriffe eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: DVI
lay_definition_en: A method using a pacemaker to control heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Steuerung des Herzrhythmus mithilfe eines Herzschrittmachers.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heart block is when the heart's electrical signals don't pass through properly, affecting its rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzblock liegt vor, wenn die elektrischen Signale des Herzens nicht richtig weitergeleitet werden, was sich auf den Herzrhythmus auswirkt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A problem with the heart's electrical system causing an abnormal heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Eine Störung des elektrischen Systems des Herzens, die zu einem unregelmäßigen Herzschlag führt.

general_definition_en: cath lab
lay_definition_en: A procedure to diagnose and treat heart conditions by inserting a tube into an artery to reach the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Diagnose und Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen, bei dem ein Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um zum Herzen zu gelangen.

general_definition_en: Continued electrical rhythmicity of the heart in the absence of effective mechanical function.
lay_definition_en: Cardiac arrest without a pulse.
lay_definition_de: Herzstillstand ohne Puls.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: When the heart stops working.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz aufhört zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: A rapid or irregular heartbeat that a person can feel.
lay_definition_en: When you can feel your heart beating fast or irregularly, it's called palpitations.
lay_definition_de: Wenn man spürt, dass das Herz schnell oder unregelmäßig schlägt, spricht man von Herzklopfen.

general_definition_en: Implantable devices which continuously monitor the electrical activity of the heart and automatically detect and terminate ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) and VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. They consist of an impulse generator, batteries, and electrodes.
lay_definition_en: A device implanted in the body to correct irregular heartbeats with a tiny electric jolt.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das in den Körper implantiert wird, um Herzrhythmusstörungen mit einem winzigen Stromimpuls zu korrigieren.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by recurrent apneas during sleep despite persistent respiratory efforts. It is due to upper airway obstruction. The respiratory pauses may induce HYPERCAPNIA or HYPOXIA. Cardiac arrhythmias and elevation of systemic and pulmonary arterial pressures may occur. Frequent partial arousals occur throughout sleep, resulting in relative SLEEP DEPRIVATION and daytime tiredness. Associated conditions include OBESITY; ACROMEGALY; MYXEDEMA; micrognathia; MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY; adenotonsilar dystrophy; and NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p395)
lay_definition_en: When your breathing is interrupted while you sleep, it can cause poor sleep quality and potentially lead to health issues.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihre Atmung im Schlaf unterbrochen wird, kann dies zu einer schlechten Schlafqualität führen und möglicherweise gesundheitliche Probleme nach sich ziehen.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION in which the inferior wall of the heart is involved. It is often caused by occlusion of the right coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: A type of heart muscle damage due to a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form der Herzmuskelschädigung, die durch eine verstopfte Arterie verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: When the heart muscle is damaged and weakened due to reduced blood flow from coronary artery disease.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Herzmuskel aufgrund einer verminderten Durchblutung infolge einer koronaren Herzkrankheit geschädigt und geschwächt ist.

general_definition_en: A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A PA catheter is a long, thin tube inserted into a major artery in the heart to help diagnose and treat health issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein PA-Katheter ist ein langer, dünner Schlauch, der in eine große Arterie des Herzens eingeführt wird, um bei der Diagnose und Behandlung von Gesundheitsproblemen zu helfen.

general_definition_en: Natriuretic peptides A (153 aa, ~17 kDa) is encoded by the human NPPA gene. This protein is involved in uterine artery remodeling, trophoblast invasion, natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation.
lay_definition_en: CDP is a measure of how well the heart is pumping blood through the veins back to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der CDP ist ein Maß dafür, wie gut das Herz Blut durch die Venen zurück zum Herzen pumpt.

general_definition_en: A SI derived unit of pressure equivalent to one newton per square meter or 10 bars or to 1.45x10E-4 pounds per square inch.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure in the artery that carries blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck in der Arterie, die das Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: The measurement of the mean left arterial pressure, as measured by a catheter introduced into the distal pulmonary artery, is high.
lay_definition_en: A measure of heart function that looks at how well blood is moving through the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß für die Herzfunktion, das angibt, wie gut das Blut durch das Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: An isoenzyme complex comprised of a heterodimer of creatine kinase M-type and B-type.
lay_definition_en: A heart attack indicator enzyme called CK-MB.
lay_definition_de: Ein Enzym namens CK-MB, das als Indikator für einen Herzinfarkt dient.

general_definition_en: A multisystem disorder that is characterized by aplasia of intrahepatic bile ducts (BILE DUCTS, INTRAHEPATIC), and malformations in the cardiovascular system, the eyes, the vertebral column, and the facies. Major clinical features include JAUNDICE, and congenital heart disease with peripheral PULMONARY STENOSIS. Alagille syndrome may result from heterogeneous gene mutations, including mutations in JAG1 on CHROMOSOME 20 (Type 1) and NOTCH2 on CHROMOSOME 1 (Type 2).
lay_definition_en: A rare genetic disorder that causes defects in the tubes carrying fluid out of the liver.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene genetische Erkrankung, die zu Fehlbildungen der Kanäle führt, die Flüssigkeit aus der Leber ableiten.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: When your heart squeezes and pumps blood into your arteries.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich dein Herz zusammenzieht und Blut in deine Arterien pumpt.

general_definition_en: An orally available, piperazine derivative with anti-anginal and potential antineoplastic activities. Ranolazine's mechanism of action for its anti-ischemic effects has yet to be fully elucidated but may involve the alteration of the trans-cellular late sodium current in the ischemic myocyte. By preventing the rise of intracellular sodium levels, ranolazine may affect the transport activity of sodium-dependent calcium channels and prevent the calcium overload during myocardial ischemia, thereby preventing cellular injury. Ranolazine's potential antineoplastic effect may depend on its inhibitory effect on fatty acid oxidation, which may sensitize tumor cells to apoptosis and decrease tumor cell proliferation; fatty acid oxidation provides energy and promotes tumor cell proliferation and survival.
lay_definition_en: Medication used to treat chest pain or angina.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Brustschmerzen oder Angina pectoris.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: A setting on a breathing machine that determines the average pressure in the airway.
lay_definition_de: Eine Einstellung an einem Beatmungsgerät, die den durchschnittlichen Druck in den Atemwegen bestimmt.

general_definition_en: A hypoperfusion of the BLOOD through an organ or tissue caused by a PATHOLOGIC CONSTRICTION or obstruction of its BLOOD VESSELS, or an absence of BLOOD CIRCULATION.
lay_definition_en: When blood flow is reduced due to narrowed or blocked blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Durchblutung aufgrund verengter oder verstopfter Blutgefäße eingeschränkt ist.

general_definition_en: mv
lay_definition_en: The mitral valve is a crucial part of the heart that helps control blood flow between the left atrium and left ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Die Mitralklappe ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil des Herzens, der den Blutfluss zwischen dem linken Vorhof und der linken Herzkammer reguliert.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Extra beat in the lower chambers of the heart, also known as a skipped heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzlicher Herzschlag in den unteren Herzkammern, auch als Herzaussetzer bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: The heart's beat felt at different places in the body.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzschlag ist an verschiedenen Stellen des Körpers zu spüren.

general_definition_en: A short-acting hypnotic-sedative drug with anxiolytic and amnestic properties. It is used in dentistry, cardiac surgery, endoscopic procedures, as preanesthetic medication, and as an adjunct to local anesthesia. The short duration and cardiorespiratory stability makes it useful in poor-risk, elderly, and cardiac patients. It is water-soluble at pH less than 4 and lipid-soluble at physiological pH.
lay_definition_en: A drug that makes you sleepy and calm during medical procedures.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei medizinischen Eingriffen für Schläfrigkeit und Ruhe sorgt.

general_definition_en: A beta-adrenergic antagonist that is similar in action to PROPRANOLOL; the levo-isomer is more active. Timolol has been proposed as an anti-hypertensive, anti-arrhythmic, anti-angina, and anti-glaucoma agent. It is also used in the treatment of MIGRAINE DISORDERS and tremor.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to lower eye pressure and manage eye conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Senkung des Augeninnendrucks und zur Behandlung von Augenerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: A prostaglandin F analog used to treat OCULAR HYPERTENSION in patients with GLAUCOMA.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps reduce eye pressure in treating glaucoma.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei der Behandlung des Glaukoms zur Senkung des Augendrucks beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A transient loss of consciousness and postural tone caused by diminished blood flow to the brain (i.e., BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Presyncope refers to the sensation of lightheadedness and loss of strength that precedes a syncopal event or accompanies an incomplete syncope. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp367-9)
lay_definition_en: Transient means something that happens quickly and then ends almost immediately.
lay_definition_de: „Transient“ bezeichnet etwas, das schnell eintritt und dann fast sofort wieder endet.

general_definition_en: The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: CPR is used to restart someone's heart in an emergency.
lay_definition_de: Die Herz-Lungen-Wiederbelebung (HLW) wird eingesetzt, um im Notfall das Herz einer Person wieder zum Schlagen zu bringen.

general_definition_en: mr
lay_definition_en: Leaky heart valve causing backflow of blood in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine undichte Herzklappe, die einen Rückfluss des Blutes im Herzen verursacht.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to create new pathways for blood flow around blocked heart arteries.
lay_definition_de: Herzoperation zur Schaffung neuer Blutgefäße, um verstopfte Herzarterien zu umgehen.

general_definition_en: Non-invasive method of vascular imaging and determination of internal anatomy without injection of contrast media or radiation exposure. The technique is used especially in CEREBRAL ANGIOGRAPHY as well as for studies of other vascular structures.
lay_definition_en: Average pressure inside the right atrium.
lay_definition_de: Durchschnittlicher Druck im rechten Vorhof.

general_definition_en: The blood pressure as recorded after wedging a CATHETER in a small PULMONARY ARTERY; believed to reflect the PRESSURE in the pulmonary CAPILLARIES.
lay_definition_en: A measurement of heart function by assessing the operation of its ventricle, atrium, and valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung der Herzfunktion durch Beurteilung der Tätigkeit von Herzkammer, Vorhof und Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A congenital cardiovascular malformation in which the AORTA arises entirely from the RIGHT VENTRICLE, and the PULMONARY ARTERY arises from the LEFT VENTRICLE. Consequently, the pulmonary and the systemic circulations are parallel and not sequential, so that the venous return from the peripheral circulation is re-circulated by the right ventricle via aorta to the systemic circulation without being oxygenated in the lungs. This is a potentially lethal form of heart disease in newborns and infants.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the main arteries of the heart are switched around from their normal positions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die Hauptarterien des Herzens im Vergleich zu ihrer normalen Lage vertauscht sind.

general_definition_en: vs
lay_definition_en: vs measures are signs of how well your body is functioning such as blood pressure, heart rate, and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Vitalwerte sind Anzeichen dafür, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert, wie beispielsweise Blutdruck, Herzfrequenz und Körpertemperatur.

general_definition_en: A positive inotropic cardiotonic agent with vasodilator properties. It inhibits cAMP phosphodiesterase type 3 activity in myocardium and vascular smooth muscle. Milrinone is a derivative of amrinone and has 20-30 times the inotropic potency of amrinone.
lay_definition_en: Medication used to help the heart pump better in patients with heart failure or high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel, die dazu dienen, die Pumpfunktion des Herzens bei Patienten mit Herzinsuffizienz oder pulmonalem Bluthochdruck zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: Use or insertion of a tubular device into a duct, blood vessel, hollow organ, or body cavity for injecting or withdrawing fluids for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It differs from INTUBATION in that the tube here is used to restore or maintain patency in obstructions.
lay_definition_en: A method where a thin tube is put into an artery to help with heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzprobleme zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: A finding indicating that an excess amount of normetanephrine is secreted by a tumor.
lay_definition_en: A substance produced by a benign tumor that can lead to dangerously high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz, die von einem gutartigen Tumor gebildet wird und zu gefährlich hohem Blutdruck führen kann.

general_definition_en: toprol
lay_definition_en: Toprol is a medicine that helps with chest pain, heart failure, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Toprol ist ein Arzneimittel, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzinsuffizienz und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: A regimen consisting of epoetin alfa that may be used in the management of anemia secondary to chemotherapy, HIV infection, or chronic kidney disease (CKD); and in the prevention of anemia in certain patients undergoing elective non-cardiac surgical procedures.
lay_definition_en: A medication that boosts the body's red blood cell production.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Bildung roter Blutkörperchen im Körper anregt.

general_definition_en: A direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, high blood pressure, and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: A potassium sparing diuretic that acts by antagonism of aldosterone in the distal renal tubules. It is used mainly in the treatment of refractory edema in patients with congestive heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, or hepatic cirrhosis. Its effects on the endocrine system are utilized in the treatments of hirsutism and acne but they can lead to adverse effects. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p827)
lay_definition_en: A medication used for treating high blood pressure and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: An antianginal and class III antiarrhythmic drug. It increases the duration of ventricular and atrial muscle action by inhibiting POTASSIUM CHANNELS and VOLTAGE-GATED SODIUM CHANNELS. There is a resulting decrease in heart rate and in vascular resistance.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help maintain a regular heart rhythm and are sometimes called potassium channel blockers.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die dazu beitragen, einen regelmäßigen Herzrhythmus aufrechtzuerhalten, und die manchmal als Kaliumkanalblocker bezeichnet werden.

general_definition_en: a drug that prevents heart attack
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps prevent blood clots and reduces the chance of heart attack and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt und das Risiko für Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps lessen pain, fever, and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das Schmerzen, Fieber und Schwellungen lindert.

general_definition_en: LOPRESSOR
lay_definition_en: Medication for chest pain, abnormal heart rhythms, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel gegen Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: brand name of a high blood pressure medication
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: norvasc
lay_definition_en: Norvasc is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure and thin the blood.
lay_definition_de: Norvasc ist ein Medikament, das hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken und das Blut zu verdünnen.

general_definition_en: hyzar
lay_definition_en: A hyzar is a medicine that helps control high blood pressure and lowers the chances of stroke and heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Hyzar ist ein Medikament, das zur Kontrolle von Bluthochdruck beiträgt und das Risiko für Schlaganfälle und Herzinfarkte senkt.

general_definition_en: One of the ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS (ACE inhibitors), orally active, that has been used in the treatment of hypertension and congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_en: Medication for high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente gegen Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A non-selective beta-adrenergic antagonist with a long half-life, used in cardiovascular disease to treat arrhythmias, angina pectoris, and hypertension. Nadolol is also used for MIGRAINE DISORDERS and for tremor.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with high blood pressure, chest pain, and an irregular heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Bluthochdruck, Brustschmerzen und Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft.

general_definition_en: A thiazide diuretic often considered the prototypical member of this class. It reduces the reabsorption of electrolytes from the renal tubules. This results in increased excretion of water and electrolytes, including sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium. It is used in the treatment of several disorders including edema, hypertension, diabetes insipidus, and hypoparathyroidism.
lay_definition_en: A medication that reduces body fluids, used to treat high blood pressure and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Körperflüssigkeit reduziert und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Schwellungen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A synthetic levoisomer of thyroxine (T4), similar to the endogenous hormone produced by the thyroid gland. Thyroxine is de-iodinated to form triiodothyronine (T3) in the peripheral tissues. T3 enters the cell and binds to nuclear thyroid hormone receptors, and the hormone-receptor complex in turn triggers gene expression and produces proteins required in the regulation of cellular respiration, thermogenesis, cellular growth and differentiation, and metabolism of proteins, carbohydrates and lipids. T4 and T3 also possess cardiac stimulatory effect.
lay_definition_en: Levothyroxine is a drug.
lay_definition_de: Levothyroxin ist ein Arzneimittel.

general_definition_en: The maleate salt of amlodipine, a synthetic phenylpyridine vasodilator with antihypertensive and antianginal effects. Amlodipine inhibits the influx of extracellular calcium ions into myocardial and peripheral vascular smooth muscle cells, thereby preventing vascular and myocardial contraction. Furthermore, decreased myocardial contractility and dilation of the main coronary and systemic arteries lead to increased blood flow and oxygen delivery to the myocardial tissue and decreases total peripheral resistance. This agent may also modulate multi-drug response activity through inhibition of the p-glycoprotein efflux pump.
lay_definition_en: Amlodipine is a medication that helps lower blood pressure and is sometimes known as Norvasc.
lay_definition_de: Amlodipin ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt und manchmal auch unter dem Namen Norvasc bekannt ist.

general_definition_en: Hyzaar
lay_definition_en: A medicine for high blood pressure that lowers the chance of stroke and heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, das das Risiko für Schlaganfälle und Herzinfarkte senkt.

general_definition_en: Norvasc
lay_definition_en: A medication used to lower high blood pressure and thin the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck und zur Blutverdünnung.

general_definition_en: Plendil
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps lower high blood pressure levels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das dabei hilft, einen hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: Uroxatral
lay_definition_en: Uroxatral is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Uroxatral ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A benzothiazepine calcium channel blocking agent. Diltiazem hydrochloride inhibits the transmembrane influx of extracellular calcium ions into select myocardial and vascular smooth muscle cells, causing dilatation of coronary and systemic arteries and decreasing myocardial contractility. Because of its vasodilatory activity, this agent has been shown to improve the microcirculation in some tumors, thereby potentially improving the delivery of antineoplastic agents to tumor cells. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: A medicine used to control high blood pressure and irregular heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: One of the ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS (ACE inhibitors), orally active, that has been used in the treatment of hypertension and congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_en: Lisinopril is a drug that helps control high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Lisinopril ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A cardioselective beta-1 adrenergic blocker possessing properties and potency similar to PROPRANOLOL, but without a negative inotropic effect.
lay_definition_en: A medication for chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: a drug that prevents heart attack
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps prevent blood clots and reduces the chances of heart attack and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt und das Risiko für Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps with pain, fever, inflammation, and can lower the risk of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei Schmerzen, Fieber und Entzündungen hilft und das Risiko eines Herzinfarkts senken kann.

general_definition_en: A vasodilator used in angina of effort or ischemic heart disease.
lay_definition_en: A medication used for treating angina and other heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Angina pectoris und anderen Herzerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: brand name of a high blood pressure medication
lay_definition_en: Medication to help lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A benzothiazepine calcium channel blocking agent. Diltiazem hydrochloride inhibits the transmembrane influx of extracellular calcium ions into select myocardial and vascular smooth muscle cells, causing dilatation of coronary and systemic arteries and decreasing myocardial contractility. Because of its vasodilatory activity, this agent has been shown to improve the microcirculation in some tumors, thereby potentially improving the delivery of antineoplastic agents to tumor cells. (NCI04) The hydrochloride salt form of aminolevulinic acid, an aminoketone, used for local photosensitizing therapy. Aminolevulinic acid (ALA) is a metabolic pro-drug that is converted into the photosensitizer protoporphyrin IX (PpIX), which accumulates intracellularly. Upon exposure to light of appropriate wavelength (red, or blue), PpIX catalyzes oxygen to singlet oxygen, an intracellular toxin, which can further react to form superoxide and hydroxyl radicals. This leads to cellular cytotoxic effects.
lay_definition_en: Medication used for high blood pressure and irregular heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: Cozaar
lay_definition_en: A medicine for high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Dilacor
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with high blood pressure and irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft.

general_definition_en: A vasodilator used in the treatment of ANGINA PECTORIS. Its actions are similar to NITROGLYCERIN but with a slower onset of action.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps treat chest pain by relaxing blood vessels to improve blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen hilft, indem es die Blutgefäße entspannt und so die Durchblutung des Herzens verbessert.

general_definition_en: Treatment based on nutrition. It includes checking a person's nutrition status, and giving the right foods or nutrients to treat conditions such as those caused by diabetes, heart disease, and cancer. It may involve simple changes in a person's diet, or intravenous or tube feeding. Medical nutrition therapy may help patients recover more quickly and spend less time in the hospital.
lay_definition_en: Treatment that uses nutrition to help manage health conditions or improve health.
lay_definition_de: Eine Behandlung, bei der Ernährung eingesetzt wird, um Erkrankungen zu lindern oder die Gesundheit zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: Cardiac arrhythmias that are characterized by excessively slow HEART RATE, usually below 50 beats per minute in human adults. They can be classified broadly into SINOATRIAL NODE dysfunction and ATRIOVENTRICULAR BLOCK.
lay_definition_en: Getting smaller or going down.
lay_definition_de: Kleiner werden oder abnehmen.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: A setting on a breathing machine that measures the average pressure in the airway.
lay_definition_de: Eine Einstellung an einem Beatmungsgerät, mit der der durchschnittliche Druck in den Atemwegen gemessen wird.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: MAP is the average air pressure in the airway over time on a breathing machine.
lay_definition_de: MAP ist der durchschnittliche Luftdruck in den Atemwegen über einen bestimmten Zeitraum hinweg bei Verwendung eines Beatmungsgeräts.

general_definition_en: Sudden onset of shortness of breath that causes one to awaken coughing or wheezing; it may be associated with congestive heart failure or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
lay_definition_en: Sudden breathing struggles and coughing that mainly happens at night, waking the person up and causing fear.
lay_definition_de: Plötzliche Atembeschwerden und Husten, die vor allem nachts auftreten, die betroffene Person aufwecken und Angst auslösen.

general_definition_en: The percentage of the end-diastolic volume pumped out of the heart during SYSTOLE.
lay_definition_en: A measure of how efficiently the heart pumps blood, often used to diagnose heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effizient das Herz Blut pumpt; wird häufig zur Diagnose von Herzinsuffizienz herangezogen.

general_definition_en: A chronic inflammatory connective tissue disease marked by skin rashes, joint pain and swelling, inflammation of the kidneys, inflammation of the fibrous tissue surrounding the heart (i.e., the pericardium), as well as other problems. Not all affected individuals display all of these problems.
lay_definition_en: It's a chronic condition where your immune system turns against your own body, causing issues in skin, joints, kidneys, and blood.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine chronische Erkrankung, bei der sich das Immunsystem gegen den eigenen Körper wendet und dadurch Probleme an Haut, Gelenken, Nieren und im Blut verursacht.

general_definition_en: An anticoagulant that acts by inhibiting the synthesis of vitamin K-dependent coagulation factors. Warfarin is indicated for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism, and atrial fibrillation with embolization. It is also used as an adjunct in the prophylaxis of systemic embolism after myocardial infarction. Warfarin is also used as a rodenticide.
lay_definition_en: Warfarin is a medication that helps prevent blood clots.
lay_definition_de: Warfarin ist ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart. flow-type murmur
lay_definition_en: A funny noise that happens when your heart squeezes is called a systolic flow-type murmur.
lay_definition_de: Ein seltsames Geräusch, das auftritt, wenn sich Ihr Herz zusammenzieht, wird als systolisches Strömungsgeräusch bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: A proprietary device system comprising a sensor and a monitor for continuous determination of a patient's fluid status and cardiac output directly from the arterial line.
lay_definition_en: A system that measures blood pressure in an artery to show how the heart is working.
lay_definition_de: Ein System, das den Blutdruck in einer Arterie misst, um die Herzfunktion darzustellen.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: A thin tube inserted into a vein and heart to monitor various health issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der in eine Vene und ins Herz eingeführt wird, um verschiedene Gesundheitszustände zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: A PAC is a certified healthcare provider who helps doctors with patient care.
lay_definition_de: Ein PAC ist ein zertifizierter Gesundheitsdienstleister, der Ärzte bei der Patientenversorgung unterstützt.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: The pressure of the blood flowing in the arteries.
lay_definition_de: Der Druck des in den Arterien fließenden Blutes.

general_definition_en: Decrease in the size of a cell, tissue, organ, or multiple organs, associated with a variety of pathological conditions such as abnormal cellular changes, ischemia, malnutrition, or hormonal changes.
lay_definition_en: When something shrinks or wastes away, it's atrophied.
lay_definition_de: Wenn etwas schrumpft oder verkümmert, ist es atrophiert.

general_definition_en: A state in the North Region of Brazil. Its capital is Belem. - The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: A cluster of lymph nodes located in front of the lower back near the aorta.
lay_definition_de: Ein Lymphknotenhaufen, der sich vor dem unteren Rückenbereich in der Nähe der Aorta befindet.

general_definition_en: A derivative of LOVASTATIN and potent competitive inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A reductase (HYDROXYMETHYLGLUTARYL COA REDUCTASES), which is the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol biosynthesis. It may also interfere with steroid hormone production. Due to the induction of hepatic LDL RECEPTORS, it increases breakdown of LDL CHOLESTEROL.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower cholesterol levels to prevent heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Cholesterinspiegels beiträgt und so Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen vorbeugt.

general_definition_en: Nipride
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: CTEPH
lay_definition_en: When blood clots cause high blood pressure in the lungs, it's called CTEPH.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Blutgerinnsel einen erhöhten Blutdruck in der Lunge verursachen, spricht man von CTEPH.

general_definition_en: The movement and the forces involved in the movement of the blood through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: Having to do with the movement of blood in the body.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf den Blutkreislauf im Körper.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel in your chest that brings blood to your chest, head, neck, shoulder, and arms.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß in Ihrer Brust, das Blut in Ihre Brust, Ihren Kopf, Ihren Hals, Ihre Schultern und Ihre Arme befördert.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: It's a big blood vessel in the chest that provides blood to the upper body.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein großes Blutgefäß im Brustkorb, das den Oberkörper mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A mechanical device designed to control the flow of a fluid.
lay_definition_en: Valves are like little doors in your heart and blood vessels that control the flow of blood.
lay_definition_de: Herzklappen sind wie kleine Türen in Ihrem Herzen und Ihren Blutgefäßen, die den Blutfluss regulieren.

general_definition_en: A medical device that increases myocardial oxygen perfusion while at the same time increasing cardiac output. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: A skinny balloon that assists the heart in pumping more blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Ballon, der das Herz dabei unterstützt, mehr Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that carries blood to the heart from the body's tissues.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das Blut aus dem Körpergewebe zum Herzen transportiert.

general_definition_en: The portion of the aorta following the aortic arch passing into the chest and abdomen creating the thoracic and abdominal segments.
lay_definition_en: The descending thoracic aorta is the part of the aorta in the chest that moves downward.
lay_definition_de: Die absteigende Brustaorta ist der Abschnitt der Aorta im Brustkorb, der nach unten verläuft.

general_definition_en: A methylxanthine naturally occurring in some beverages and also used as a pharmacological agent. Caffeine's most notable pharmacological effect is as a central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness and producing agitation. It also relaxes SMOOTH MUSCLE, stimulates CARDIAC MUSCLE, stimulates DIURESIS, and appears to be useful in the treatment of some types of headache. Several cellular actions of caffeine have been observed, but it is not entirely clear how each contributes to its pharmacological profile. Among the most important are inhibition of cyclic nucleotide PHOSPHODIESTERASES, antagonism of ADENOSINE RECEPTORS, and modulation of intracellular calcium handling.
lay_definition_en: A substance found in tea and coffee that boosts our heart rate and helps us stay awake.
lay_definition_de: Ein Stoff, der in Tee und Kaffee vorkommt, unsere Herzfrequenz erhöht und uns hilft, wach zu bleiben.

general_definition_en: A data type comprised of a text string that can be displayed or machine processed. The condition of being elevated.
lay_definition_en: ST elevations are changes seen in a heart test that indicate a heart attack is happening.
lay_definition_de: ST-Hebungen sind Veränderungen, die bei einer Herzuntersuchung festgestellt werden und auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeuten.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a tachycardia which does not originate in the ventricles or His Purkinje system. There is an abnormally high heart rate and QRS complexes are typically narrow, but aberration or preexcitation may be present. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A kind of fast heart rate caused by problems with the heart's electrical signals in the upper chambers.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form von Herzrasen, die durch Störungen der elektrischen Signale in den oberen Herzkammern verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: ST-T wave
lay_definition_en: The electrical signals on an electrocardiogram showing the heart's activity.
lay_definition_de: Die elektrischen Signale auf einem Elektrokardiogramm, die die Herzaktivität anzeigen.

general_definition_en: One of the catecholamine NEUROTRANSMITTERS in the brain. It is derived from TYROSINE and is the precursor to NOREPINEPHRINE and EPINEPHRINE. Dopamine is a major transmitter in the extrapyramidal system of the brain, and important in regulating movement. A family of receptors (RECEPTORS, DOPAMINE) mediate its action.
lay_definition_en: Dopamine is a natural chemical in the brain that affects movement, mood, pleasure, heart rate, and blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Dopamin ist ein natürlich im Gehirn vorkommender Botenstoff, der Bewegung, Stimmung, Lustempfinden, Herzfrequenz und Durchblutung beeinflusst.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a regulatory role in the propagation of pro-apoptotic events.
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure, heart failure, and kidney issues related to diabetes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, Herzinsuffizienz und diabetesbedingte Nierenprobleme.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: The aorta is like the body's main highway for blood from the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Aorta ist so etwas wie die Hauptverkehrsader des Körpers, über die das Blut vom Herzen transportiert wird.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall midway between leads V2 and V4. In large and small animals, it is placed over the dorsal spinous process of the 7th thoracic vertebra.
lay_definition_en: The third bone in the neck.
lay_definition_de: Der dritte Halswirbel.

general_definition_en: A syndrome associated with traumatic injury to the cervical or upper thoracic regions of the spinal cord characterized by weakness in the arms with relative sparing of the legs and variable sensory loss. This condition is associated with ischemia, hemorrhage, or necrosis involving the central portions of the spinal cord. Corticospinal fibers destined for the legs are spared due to their more external location in the spinal cord. This clinical pattern may emerge during recovery from spinal shock. Deficits may be transient or permanent.
lay_definition_en: Central cord syndrome is when you can't move your arms and legs due to a spinal cord injury.
lay_definition_de: Beim Zentralen Rückenmarkssyndrom kann man aufgrund einer Rückenmarksverletzung weder Arme noch Beine bewegen.

general_definition_en: combined A disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure or right heart failure. and Enlargement of air spaces distal to the TERMINAL BRONCHIOLES where gas-exchange normally takes place. This is usually due to destruction of the alveolar wall. Pulmonary emphysema can be classified by the location and distribution of the lesions.
lay_definition_en: It's a serious lung disease showcasing emphysema in the upper lobe and fibrosis in the lower lobe.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine schwere Lungenerkrankung, die durch ein Emphysem im Oberlappen und eine Fibrose im Unterlappen gekennzeichnet ist.

general_definition_en: endograft
lay_definition_en: A tube inserted in a major blood vessel to prevent it from bursting due to high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der in ein großes Blutgefäß eingeführt wird, um zu verhindern, dass dieses aufgrund von Bluthochdruck platzt.

general_definition_en: A phospholipid-stabilized suspension composed of microbubbles containing the gas perfluorobutane (perflubutane, PFB) with an outer layer of hydrogenated egg phosphatidylserine (HEPS), which can be used as an ultrasound imaging contrast agent. Upon administration, the PFB microbubbles enhance echo differences between various tissues, which enhances the visualization of images during ultrasound. In particular, the PFB microbubbles seem to preferentially target the reticuloendothelial system (RES); they are taken up by macrophages in the spleen and liver (Kupffer cells), and are taken up in lymph nodes. This may aid in the detection and diagnosis of cancer and liver disease, and may improve imaging of the lymphatic and vascular systems. The microbubbles provide increased stability during ultrasound imaging. contrast
lay_definition_en: A substance added to body to enhance images during medical scans.
lay_definition_de: Ein Stoff, der dem Körper zugeführt wird, um die Bildqualität bei medizinischen Untersuchungen zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: The left lower chamber of the heart that receives blood from the left atrium and pumps it through the aorta to the body.
lay_definition_en: The main pumping chamber of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptpumpkammer des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A rare inherited syndrome characterized by juxtaglomerular cell hyperplasia, hyperaldosteronism, hypokalemia, and alkalosis. Patients have high levels of plasma renin concentration which is not associated with hypertension.
lay_definition_en: A group of inherited disorders that cause kidney function defects in families.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gruppe von Erbkrankheiten, die in Familien zu Nierenfunktionsstörungen führen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a pathological increase in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure occurs when the force of blood in the arteries is higher than normal.
lay_definition_de: Bluthochdruck liegt vor, wenn der Blutdruck in den Arterien höher als normal ist.

general_definition_en: Bleeding into the thick layer of immature cells under the ependymal lining at the ventrolateral aspect of the lateral cerebral ventricles occurring around the time of birth. Bleeding into one or both CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES including the BASAL GANGLIA and the CEREBRAL CORTEX. It is often associated with HYPERTENSION and CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA.
lay_definition_en: Bleeding in a baby's brain.
lay_definition_de: Blutung im Gehirn eines Säuglings.

general_definition_en: Treatment to block production of adrenal hormones.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help lower blood pressure and slow down heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die helfen, den Blutdruck zu senken und die Herzfrequenz zu verlangsamen.

general_definition_en: dilta
lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat high blood pressure and irregular heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: Condition in which the plasma levels of homocysteine and related metabolites are elevated (>13.9 ��mol/l). Hyperhomocysteinemia can be familial or acquired. Development of the acquired hyperhomocysteinemia is mostly associated with vitamins B and/or folate deficiency (e.g., PERNICIOUS ANEMIA, vitamin malabsorption). Familial hyperhomocysteinemia often results in a more severe elevation of total homocysteine and excretion into the urine, resulting in HOMOCYSTINURIA. Hyperhomocysteinemia is a risk factor for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative diseases, osteoporotic fractures and complications during pregnancy.
lay_definition_en: Having too much homocysteine in your blood could be a sign of health issues like heart disease or a genetic condition.
lay_definition_de: Ein zu hoher Homocysteinspiegel im Blut kann ein Anzeichen für gesundheitliche Probleme wie Herzerkrankungen oder eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung sein.

general_definition_en: Compounds that inhibit HMG-CoA reductases. They have been shown to directly lower cholesterol synthesis.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps decrease cholesterol levels to reduce the chances of heart problems like heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, den Cholesterinspiegel zu senken, um das Risiko von Herzproblemen wie Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen zu verringern.

general_definition_en: A biochemical messenger and regulator, synthesized from the essential amino acid L-TRYPTOPHAN. In humans it is found primarily in the central nervous system, gastrointestinal tract, and blood platelets. Serotonin mediates several important physiological functions including neurotransmission, gastrointestinal motility, hemostasis, and cardiovascular integrity. Multiple receptor families (RECEPTORS, SEROTONIN) explain the broad physiological actions and distribution of this biochemical mediator.
lay_definition_en: Serotonin is a chemical in the brain that helps to transmit signals between nerve cells.
lay_definition_de: Serotonin ist ein Botenstoff im Gehirn, der die Signalübertragung zwischen Nervenzellen unterstützt.

general_definition_en: Treatment that combines chemotherapy with radiation therapy. Chemoradiation can be concurrent or sequential.
lay_definition_en: A medical treatment that helps regulate the heart's rhythm using a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Eine medizinische Behandlung, die mithilfe eines Herzschrittmachers zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus beiträgt.

general_definition_en: C2TR01
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker's ID code.
lay_definition_de: Der ID-Code eines Herzschrittmachers.

general_definition_en: A derivative of the insecticide DICHLORODIPHENYLDICHLOROETHANE that specifically inhibits cells of the adrenal cortex and their production of hormones. It is used to treat adrenocortical tumors and causes CNS damage, but no bone marrow depression.
lay_definition_en: A setting on a pacemaker that controls dual shocking and sensing in both the atria and the ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Eine Einstellung am Herzschrittmacher, die die doppelte Stimulation und Erfassung sowohl in den Vorhöfen als auch in den Herzkammern steuert.

general_definition_en: The muscle tissue of the HEART. It is composed of striated, involuntary muscle cells (MYOCYTES, CARDIAC) connected to form the contractile pump to generate blood flow. The dormant state in which some warm-blooded animal species pass the winter. It is characterized by narcosis and by sharp reduction in body temperature and metabolic activity and by a depression of vital signs.
lay_definition_en: When heart muscles become dormant due to inadequate blood supply, it's called myocardial hibernation.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Herzmuskelzellen aufgrund einer unzureichenden Blutversorgung in einen Ruhezustand übergehen, spricht man von einer Myokardhibernation.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: Stress is when the heart is put to the test by exercising or using medication to see how well it works under pressure.
lay_definition_de: Unter Belastung versteht man, wenn das Herz durch körperliche Belastung oder durch die Einnahme von Medikamenten auf die Probe gestellt wird, um zu sehen, wie gut es unter Druck funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A progressive tear in the tissue lining the aorta, characterized by the passage of blood from the tunica intima into, and partially through, the tunica media.
lay_definition_en: A tear in the body's largest artery, the aorta, requiring immediate medical attention.
lay_definition_de: Ein Riss in der größten Arterie des Körpers, der Aorta, der eine sofortige medizinische Versorgung erfordert.

general_definition_en: A positive inotropic cardiotonic (CARDIOTONIC AGENTS) with vasodilator properties, phosphodiesterase 3 inhibitory activity, and the ability to stimulate calcium ion influx into the cardiac cell.
lay_definition_en: A drug called Amrinone.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament namens Amrinon.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: When your heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, das Blut effizient zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: The movement and the forces involved in the movement of the blood through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: When someone is hemodynamically stable, it means their blood flow is good and their heart is pumping well.
lay_definition_de: Wenn jemand hämodynamisch stabil ist, bedeutet das, dass die Durchblutung gut ist und das Herz gut pumpt.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive method that uses a CT scanner for capturing images of blood vessels and tissues. A CONTRAST MATERIAL is injected, which helps produce detailed images that aid in diagnosing VASCULAR DISEASES.
lay_definition_en: Angiography is a way to take a picture of the inside of blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Die Angiographie ist ein Verfahren, mit dem man Aufnahmen vom Inneren der Blutgefäße erstellen kann.

general_definition_en: A volatile vasodilator which relieves ANGINA PECTORIS by stimulating GUANYLATE CYCLASE and lowering cytosolic calcium. It is also sometimes used for TOCOLYSIS and explosives.
lay_definition_en: Nitroglycerin is a medication for heart problems that helps improve blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Nitroglycerin ist ein Medikament gegen Herzbeschwerden, das dazu beiträgt, die Durchblutung des Herzens zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: Trop T
lay_definition_en: A protein released from the heart when it's damaged, with high levels signaling a possible heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, das bei einer Schädigung des Herzens freigesetzt wird; erhöhte Werte deuten auf einen möglichen Herzinfarkt hin.

general_definition_en: Drugs that bind to but do not activate MUSCARINIC RECEPTORS, thereby blocking the actions of endogenous ACETYLCHOLINE or exogenous agonists. lay_definition_de: Mit „AV“ sind die Vorhöfe und Herzkammern des Herzens gemeint.

lay_definition_en: A protein released from the heart when it's injured, like in a heart attack.

lay_definition_en: A medication that helps the heart muscle contract, used for heart failure or pulmonary hypertension.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Kontraktion des Herzmuskels fördert und bei Herzinsuffizienz oder pulmonaler Hypertonie eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A catecholamine derivative with specificity for BETA-1 ADRENERGIC RECEPTORS. It is commonly used as a cardiotonic agent after CARDIAC SURGERY and during DOBUTAMINE STRESS ECHOCARDIOGRAPHY.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that boosts blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das den Blutdruck erhöht.

general_definition_en: Use or insertion of a tubular device into a duct, blood vessel, hollow organ, or body cavity for injecting or withdrawing fluids for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It differs from INTUBATION in that the tube here is used to restore or maintain patency in obstructions.
lay_definition_en: Inserting a thin tube into a blood vessel to reach the heart for diagnosis or treatment of certain heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Das Einführen eines dünnen Schlauchs in ein Blutgefäß, um das Herz zu erreichen und bestimmte Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren oder zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north. main

lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell oder langsam Ihr Herz schlägt.

lay_definition_en: Aortic valve is a heart valve that controls blood flow from the heart to the aorta.
lay_definition_de: Die Aortenklappe ist eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss vom Herzen in die Aorta regelt.

general_definition_en: LASIC

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit aus dem Körper auszuscheiden, die durch Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz, Lebererkrankungen und Nierenerkrankungen verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: A rare type of ectodermal dysplasia. Less than 50 cases have been described in the literature so far. Clinically, the syndrome has characteristics of severe hand and/or foot anomalies, and hypoplasia/aplasia of the mammary gland and nipple. Clinical expression is extremely variable. Individuals with mild LMS have isolated athelia. All three major categories of limb defects (i.e., deficiencies, duplications and fusion/separation defects), as well as several combinations of these anomalies, were observed. Variation in the severity of the limb defects may be observed, not only between individuals but also between the left and right hand/foot of one individual. Skin and hair are spared. An autosomal dominant disease caused by loss-of-function mutations in exon 13 and 14 of the TP63 gene found on the subtelomeric region of chromosome 3 (3q27).
lay_definition_en: A major artery that supplies blood to the left side of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Arterie, die die linke Herzhälfte mit Blut versorgt.

The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: A goal map is a target setting on a machine that controls airflow, representing the average pressure in the airway over a period.
lay_definition_de: Eine Zielkurve ist eine Sollwertvorgabe an einem Gerät zur Steuerung des Luftstroms, die den durchschnittlichen Druck in den Atemwegen über einen bestimmten Zeitraum darstellt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Having a slow heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Einen langsamen Herzschlag haben.
