lay_definition_en: A door-like flap between the left chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine klappenartige Struktur zwischen den linken Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: A complication of OVULATION INDUCTION in infertility treatment. It is graded by the severity of symptoms which include OVARY enlargement, multiple OVARIAN FOLLICLES; OVARIAN CYSTS; ASCITES; and generalized EDEMA. The full-blown syndrome may lead to RENAL FAILURE, respiratory distress, and even DEATH. Increased capillary permeability is caused by the vasoactive substances, such as VASCULAR ENDOTHELIAL GROWTH FACTORS, secreted by the overly-stimulated OVARIES.
lay_definition_en: OHSS is a condition where the ovaries get bloated and painful due to too many hormones being released.
lay_definition_de: Das OHSS ist ein Zustand, bei dem sich die Eierstöcke aufgrund einer übermäßigen Hormonausschüttung anschwellen und schmerzen.

general_definition_en: cozaar
lay_definition_en: A medication to help lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Irregular HEART RATE caused by abnormal function of the SINOATRIAL NODE. It is characterized by a greater than 10% change between the maximum and the minimum sinus cycle length or 120 milliseconds. drug
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps correct abnormal heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das dabei hilft, Herzrhythmusstörungen zu beheben.

general_definition_en: A quinoline and tetrazole derivative that acts as a phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitor, with anti-platelet and vasodilating activity. It is used in the treatment of PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASES; ISCHEMIC HEART DISEASE; and in the prevention of stroke.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat heart conditions and prevent blood clots.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen und zur Vorbeugung von Blutgerinnseln.

general_definition_en: Situated farthest from a point of attachment or origin, as of a limb or bone; or directed away from the midline of the body. The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. lay_definition_en: Pulses felt in areas farther from the chest, like the wrists and ankles.
lay_definition_de: Pulse, die an Stellen spürbar sind, die weiter vom Brustkorb entfernt liegen, wie beispielsweise an den Handgelenken und Knöcheln.

general_definition_en: A beta-adrenergic antagonist that is similar in action to PROPRANOLOL; the levo-isomer is more active. Timolol has been proposed as an anti-hypertensive, anti-arrhythmic, anti-angina, and anti-glaucoma agent. It is also used in the treatment of MIGRAINE DISORDERS and tremor.
lay_definition_en: Timolol is a medication that helps reduce eye pressure and treat eye conditions.
lay_definition_de: Timolol ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Augeninnendrucks und zur Behandlung von Augenerkrankungen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed at the fourth intercostal space on the anterior chest wall (between ribs 4 and 5) to the right of the sternal border. In small animals, it is placed at the right fifth intercostal space near the sternum.
lay_definition_en: The first neck bone at the top of your spine.
lay_definition_de: Der erste Halswirbel ganz oben an der Wirbelsäule.

lay_definition_de: Ärzte, die sich auf die Behandlung von Herzproblemen spezialisiert haben.

lay_definition_en: Vascular surgery is when doctors operate on your blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Bei der Gefäßchirurgie führen Ärzte Operationen an Ihren Blutgefäßen durch.

general_definition_en: A technique in which tissue is rendered resistant to the deleterious effects of prolonged ISCHEMIA and REPERFUSION by prior exposure to brief, repeated periods of vascular occlusion. (Am J Physiol 1995 May;268(5 Pt 2):H2063-7, Abstract)
lay_definition_en: Preparing tissues to prevent damage with drugs or treatments.
lay_definition_de: Gewebe vorbereiten, um Schäden durch Medikamente oder Behandlungen zu vermeiden.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Lungenhochdruck verbessert die körperliche Leistungsfähigkeit.

lay_definition_en: A thin tube inserted into the heart to monitor serious health conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der in das Herz eingeführt wird, um schwerwiegende Erkrankungen zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: CVP is a way of measuring how well the heart pumps blood by looking at the pressure in the main veins.

Clinical manifestations are present at birth and include diminished lacrimation, defective thermoregulation, orthostatic hypotension (HYPOTENSION, ORTHOSTATIC), fixed pupils, excessive SWEATING, loss of pain and temperature sensation, and absent reflexes. Pathologic features include reduced numbers of small diameter peripheral nerve fibers and autonomic ganglion neurons. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1348; Nat Genet 1993;4(2):160-4)
lay_definition_en: A place that looks after kids.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ort, an dem man sich um Kinder kümmert.

lay_definition_de: Eine Hirnblutung liegt vor, wenn es zu einer Blutung im Gehirn kommt; dabei handelt es sich um eine Form des Schlaganfalls.

lay_definition_de: Indikatoren für die Funktionsweise Ihres Körpers, wie Blutdruck und Herzfrequenz.

lay_definition_de: Bei der V-Paced-Therapie werden die Herzkammern mithilfe eines Herzschrittmachers elektrisch stimuliert, um einen langsamen Herzschlag zu regulieren.

lay_definition_de: Die Ablagerung von Cholesterinplaques in den Arterien führt zu einer Blockade der Herzdurchblutung.

lay_definition_en: Fats that are solid at room temperature.

The term is often used during gross pathologic inspection to describe blurred cortical margins and decreased consistency of brain tissue following infarction. Multicystic encephalomalacia refers to the formation of multiple cystic cavities of various sizes in the cerebral cortex of neonates and infants following injury, most notably perinatal hypoxia-ischemic events. (From Davis et al., Textbook of Neuropathology, 2nd ed, p665; J Neuropathol Exp Neurol, 1995 Mar;54(2):268-75)
lay_definition_en: Brain tissue softening or damage resulting from injury or illness.

lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat severe allergic reactions and cardiac arrest.

lay_definition_de: Von einer T-Wellen-Alternanz spricht man, wenn sich die T-Welle in einem Elektrokardiogramm (EKG) hinsichtlich ihrer Größe oder Form ständig verändert.

lay_definition_de: Ein Herzbild, das mithilfe von Schallwellen erstellt wurde.

lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um festzustellen, wie gut die Hauptherzkammer Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: The fraction of the left ventricular end diastolic volume ejected with each beat. The left ventricular ejection fraction is equal to the left ventricular stroke volume divided by the left ventricular end diastolic volume.

lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effektiv die Hauptpumpkammer des Herzens, der linke Ventrikel, Blut fördert.

general_definition_en: Radionuclide ventriculography where scintigraphic data is acquired during repeated cardiac cycles at specific times in the cycle, using an electrocardiographic synchronizer or gating device. Analysis of right ventricular function is difficult with this technique; that is best evaluated by first-pass ventriculography (VENTRICULOGRAPHY, FIRST-PASS). Any record of a medical imaging event whether physical or electronic.
lay_definition_en: A test that shows how much blood is in the heart at different times during the heartbeat.

Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.

lay_definition_de: Einsatz von Computern, um Krankheiten schneller und genauer zu erkennen als Menschen.

lay_definition_de: Ein Teil eines Blutgefäßes im Herzen, das von der rechten Koronararterie abzweigt.

general_definition_en: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: When the heart takes a break between beats.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz zwischen zwei Schlägen eine Pause macht.

general_definition_en: Human ACACA wild-type allele is located in the vicinity of 17q21 and is approximately 325 kb in length. This allele, which encodes acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1 protein, is involved in long-chain fatty acid biosynthesis. Mutation of the gene is associated with acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1 deficiency.
lay_definition_en: Calcium buildup in blood vessel walls that may indicate heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Kalziumablagerungen in den Blutgefäßwänden, die auf eine Herzerkrankung hindeuten können.

general_definition_en: The resistance to blood flow offered by all systemic vasculature, excluding pulmonary vasculature. The major determinant of SVR is arteriolar tone, but blood viscosity and vascular capacitance are also contributing factors.
lay_definition_en: SVR is a way to check how smoothly blood is moving through the heart during each beat.
lay_definition_de: Mit der SVR lässt sich überprüfen, wie reibungslos sich das Blut bei jedem Herzschlag durch das Herz bewegt.

general_definition_en: An autosomal dominant disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE with abnormal features in the heart, the eye, and the skeleton. Cardiovascular manifestations include MITRAL VALVE PROLAPSE, dilation of the AORTA, and aortic dissection. Other features include lens displacement (ectopia lentis), disproportioned long limbs and enlarged DURA MATER (dural ectasia). Marfan syndrome is associated with mutations in the gene encoding fibrillin, a major element of extracellular microfibrils of connective tissue.
lay_definition_en: A genetic condition that affects various parts of the body, making affected individuals tall and thin.
lay_definition_de: Eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, die verschiedene Körperteile betrifft und dazu führt, dass die Betroffenen groß und schlank sind.

general_definition_en: A salicylamide derivative that is a non-cardioselective blocker of BETA-ADRENERGIC RECEPTORS and ALPHA-1 ADRENERGIC RECEPTORS.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps treat high blood pressure and lower heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei der Behandlung von Bluthochdruck hilft und die Herzfrequenz senkt.

general_definition_en: A noninvasive blood pressure measurement system is a device that provides a signal from which systolic, diastolic, mean, or any combination of the three pressures can be derived through the use of tranducers placed on the surface of the body.
lay_definition_en: A method to track your blood pressure constantly for extended durations.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, mit der Sie Ihren Blutdruck über längere Zeiträume hinweg kontinuierlich überwachen können.

general_definition_en: Swelling due to excessive accumulation of fluid under the skin defined by a persistent indentation when pressure is applied to the swollen area. Causes include systemic conditions (e.g., heart failure, liver failure, or kidney failure) and local conditions affecting the extremities.
lay_definition_en: Swelling in the body that leaves an indention (pit) when pressed.
lay_definition_de: Eine Schwellung am Körper, die beim Drücken eine Vertiefung hinterlässt.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: AF is a heart condition that can lead to tiredness and strokes due to an erratic heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Vorhofflimmern ist eine Herzerkrankung, die aufgrund eines unregelmäßigen Herzschlags zu Müdigkeit und Schlaganfällen führen kann.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which there are two R waves, which are two deflections above the baseline resulting from a single ventricular depolarization. The first upward deflection in the complex is the R wave. The S is the first downward deflection. A second upward deflection is called the R-prime wave.
lay_definition_en: Abnormal heart activity seen on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Im EKG festgestellte Herzrhythmusstörung.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: PACs are extra heartbeats caused by abnormal electrical activity in the heart.
lay_definition_de: PACs sind zusätzliche Herzschläge, die durch eine abnormale elektrische Aktivität im Herzen verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: paced
lay_definition_en: When your heart's rhythm is regulated by a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herzrhythmus durch einen Herzschrittmacher gesteuert wird.

general_definition_en: VVI
lay_definition_en: A VVI is a type of pacemaker that helps control heart rhythm in patients with one chamber.
lay_definition_de: Ein VVI ist eine Art Herzschrittmacher, der bei Patienten mit nur einer Herzkammer zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus beiträgt.

general_definition_en: vitals
lay_definition_en: Vitals are the numbers that tell us how healthy our body is, like heart rate and blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Vitalwerte sind die Werte, die uns Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gesund unser Körper ist, wie beispielsweise Herzfrequenz und Blutdruck.

general_definition_en: Any of the three cardiac veins including the small, middle and great cardiac veins.
lay_definition_en: A brand of central venous catheters.
lay_definition_de: Eine Marke für zentralvenöse Katheter.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of an atypical cardiac rhythm resulting from a pathologic process in the cardiac atria.
lay_definition_en: A simple condition where the heart rhythm is irregular.
lay_definition_de: Eine einfache Erkrankung, bei der der Herzrhythmus unregelmäßig ist.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: PAC is when there���s a hiccup in the heart's rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Von einem Vorhofflimmern spricht man, wenn es zu einer Störung des Herzrhythmus kommt.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: An extra heartbeat that starts in the heart's lower chambers, also known as a skipped heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein zusätzlicher Herzschlag, der in den unteren Herzkammern entsteht, auch als Herzaussetzer bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Extra heartbeats that occur before the regular heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzliche Herzschläge, die vor dem regulären Herzschlag auftreten.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a QT interval corrected for heart rate that is shorter than the lower limit of normal. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: The estimated time it takes for the heart to reset between beats, used to detect heart rhythm issues.
lay_definition_de: Die geschätzte Zeit, die das Herz benötigt, um sich zwischen zwei Herzschlägen zu erholen; wird zur Erkennung von Herzrhythmusstörungen herangezogen.

general_definition_en: A drug used to treat high blood pressure. It is also being studied in the treatment of certain types of cancer pain. It blocks the release of chemicals from nerve endings that make blood vessels constrict (get narrower). Catapres is a type of antihypertensive agent and a type of alpha-adrenergic agonist.
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure that can also help with anxiety and pain by relaxing blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, das durch die Entspannung der Blutgefäße auch bei Angstzuständen und Schmerzen helfen kann.

general_definition_en: Human NKX2-5 wild-type allele is located in the vicinity of 5q34 and is approximately 3 kb in length. This allele, which encodes homeobox protein Nkx-2.5, is involved in both heart development and the modulation of transcription. Mutation of the gene is associated with atrial septal defect type 7, tetralogy of Fallot, and congenital hypothyroidism non-goitrous type 5.
lay_definition_en: Tests that check for germs in tissue or body fluids.
lay_definition_de: Untersuchungen, bei denen Gewebe oder Körperflüssigkeiten auf Keime untersucht werden.

general_definition_en: A technique that utilizes a Doppler transducer to monitor fetal heart rate. The transducer is placed on the maternal abdomen and detects fetal cardiac motion using ultrasound.
lay_definition_en: A tool that monitors a baby's heart rate and the mother's contractions during labor.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das während der Wehen die Herzfrequenz des Babys und die Wehen der Mutter überwacht.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the inability of the heart to pump blood at an adequate volume to meet tissue metabolic requirements, or, the ability to do so only at an elevation in the filling pressure.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood effectively in heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzinsuffizienz hat das Herz Schwierigkeiten, das Blut effizient zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A blood vessel in the heart which returns coronary blood to the right atrium.
lay_definition_en: Coronary means having to do with the blood vessels that bring blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Koronar“ bedeutet, dass es sich um die Blutgefäße handelt, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: A blood vessel in the heart which returns coronary blood to the right atrium.
lay_definition_en: Coronary means having to do with the blood vessels that deliver blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Koronar“ bedeutet, dass es sich um die Blutgefäße handelt, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a long standing and persistent uncoordinated atrial myocardium activation due to multiple reentry circuits with consequent deterioration of atrial mechanical function. Instead of intermittently contracting, the atria quiver continuously in a chaotic pattern, causing a totally irregular, often tachycardia ventricular rate. On the ECG it is characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape, and timing, associated with an irregular, frequently rapid ventricular response when atrioventricular conduction is intact.
lay_definition_en: A type of irregular heart rhythm that can make you tired and increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: Drugs used in the treatment of acute or chronic vascular HYPERTENSION regardless of pharmacological mechanism. Among the antihypertensive agents are DIURETICS; (especially DIURETICS, THIAZIDE); ADRENERGIC BETA-ANTAGONISTS; ADRENERGIC ALPHA-ANTAGONISTS; ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS; CALCIUM CHANNEL BLOCKERS; GANGLIONIC BLOCKERS; and VASODILATOR AGENTS.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help with high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente gegen Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Natural or synthetic beta adrenergic antagonists selectively blocking or diminishing physiologic beta-adrenergic agonist actions on the sympathetic system. This group of antagonists are generally used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety. Check for "https://www.cancer.gov/about-cancer/treatment/clinical-trials/intervention/C29576" active clinical trials using this agent. ("http://ncit.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI%20Thesaurus&code=C29576" NCI Thesaurus)
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps to slow down your heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, Ihre Herzfrequenz zu verlangsamen.

general_definition_en: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Vital signs are measurements that reveal how well the body is functioning, such as blood pressure, heart rate, breathing rate, and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Vitalparameter sind Messwerte, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut der Körper funktioniert, beispielsweise Blutdruck, Herzfrequenz, Atemfrequenz und Temperatur.

general_definition_en: III
lay_definition_en: A lead used in an ECG to record heart electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ableitung, die bei einem EKG zur Aufzeichnung der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: The maleate salt of amlodipine, a synthetic phenylpyridine vasodilator with antihypertensive and antianginal effects. Amlodipine inhibits the influx of extracellular calcium ions into myocardial and peripheral vascular smooth muscle cells, thereby preventing vascular and myocardial contraction. Furthermore, decreased myocardial contractility and dilation of the main coronary and systemic arteries lead to increased blood flow and oxygen delivery to the myocardial tissue and decreases total peripheral resistance. This agent may also modulate multi-drug response activity through inhibition of the p-glycoprotein efflux pump.
lay_definition_en: Amlodipine is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Amlodipin ist ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A carboxyl-containing angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor with antihypertensive activity. As a prodrug, benazepril is metabolized to its active form benazeprilat. Benazeprilat competitively binds to and inhibits ACE, thereby blocking the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II. This prevents the potent vasoconstrictive actions of angiotensin II resulting in vasodilation. Benazeprilat also decreases angiotensin II-induced aldosterone secretion by the adrenal cortex, which leads to an increase in sodium excretion and subsequently increases water outflow.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps improve blood flow and decrease high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung und zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: flolan
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure in the lung arteries that helps improve exercise capacity.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck in den Lungenarterien, das zur Verbesserung der körperlichen Leistungsfähigkeit beiträgt.

general_definition_en: a drug that prevents heart attack
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps prevent blood clots and reduces the chance of heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt und das Risiko für Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: Application of a life support system that circulates the blood through an oxygenating system, which may consist of a pump, a membrane oxygenator, and a heat exchanger. Examples of its use are to assist victims of SMOKE INHALATION INJURY; RESPIRATORY FAILURE; and CARDIAC FAILURE.
lay_definition_en: A machine that helps sick people breathe when their own lungs and heart can't do the job.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das kranken Menschen beim Atmen hilft, wenn ihre eigenen Lungen und ihr Herz diese Aufgabe nicht mehr bewältigen können.

general_definition_en: A syndrome characterized by the clinical triad of advanced chronic liver disease, pulmonary vascular dilatations, and reduced arterial oxygenation (HYPOXEMIA) in the absence of intrinsic cardiopulmonary disease. This syndrome is common in the patients with LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL).
lay_definition_en: A rare lung condition in people with severe liver disease where blood vessels in the lungs widen and multiply, making it difficult for oxygen to be absorbed efficiently.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Lungenerkrankung bei Menschen mit schwerer Lebererkrankung, bei der sich die Blutgefäße in der Lunge erweitern und vermehren, wodurch die effiziente Aufnahme von Sauerstoff erschwert wird.

general_definition_en: A substance that blocks the binding of the endothelin-1 protein to its receptor. Endothelin-1 is a small molecule that causes changes in blood vessels and helps regulate blood pressure. It can also stimulate the growth of some types of cells.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with high blood pressure in the lungs and cancer treatment.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei erhöhtem Blutdruck in der Lunge und bei der Krebsbehandlung hilft.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an increase in pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.
lay_definition_en: A condition that leads to high blood pressure specifically in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die speziell in der Lunge zu Bluthochdruck führt.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in signal transduction. It is involved in several cellular functions including cytoskeletal remodeling and cell differentiation.
lay_definition_en: A procedure where a tube is inserted into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem ein Katheter in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Located around the heart or relating to or affecting the pericardium.
lay_definition_en: A protective layer around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Schutzschicht um das Herz herum.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION in which the inferior wall of the heart is involved. It is often caused by occlusion of the right coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: A heart attack caused by a blockage in a blood vessel that affects the lower part of the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt, der durch eine Verstopfung eines Blutgefäßes verursacht wird, das den unteren Teil des Herzmuskels versorgt.

general_definition_en: splintered complexes
lay_definition_en: A splintered complexes refers to a changed pattern in a heart activity trace on an ECG/EKG.
lay_definition_de: Unter „Splitterkomplexen“ versteht man ein verändertes Muster in der Herzaktivitätskurve eines EKG.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes or diseases where cerebral MICROVESSELS show abnormalities. They are often associated with aging, hypertension and risk factors for lacunar infarcts (see LACUNAR INFARCTION); LEUKOARAIOSIS; and CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: Damage to very small blood vessels caused by conditions like diabetes, which can harm various organs in the body.
lay_definition_de: Schäden an sehr kleinen Blutgefäßen, die durch Erkrankungen wie Diabetes verursacht werden und verschiedene Organe im Körper schädigen können.

general_definition_en: The average (mean) number of cycles of contraction and subsequent relaxation of the ventricles, usually expressed as beats per minute, obtained from a set of measurements of the ventricular rate.
lay_definition_en: The ventricular rate is how fast the heart's lower chambers contract and relax.
lay_definition_de: Die Ventrikelfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell sich die unteren Herzkammern zusammenziehen und wieder entspannen.

general_definition_en: A method of hemostasis utilizing various agents such as Gelfoam, silastic, metal, glass, or plastic pellets, autologous clot, fat, and muscle as emboli. It has been used in the treatment of spinal cord and INTRACRANIAL ARTERIOVENOUS MALFORMATIONS, renal arteriovenous fistulas, gastrointestinal bleeding, epistaxis, hypersplenism, certain highly vascular tumors, traumatic rupture of blood vessels, and control of operative hemorrhage.
lay_definition_en: Blocking an artery with a balloon or object to control or stop bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie mit einem Ballon oder einem Gegenstand verschließen, um eine Blutung einzudämmen oder zu stoppen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates above the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A too-fast heartbeat due to an electrical problem in the top part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein zu schneller Herzschlag aufgrund einer elektrischen Störung im oberen Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: lead
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker wire used to deliver electrical signals to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmacherelektrode, die dazu dient, elektrische Signale an das Herz zu übertragen.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the ventricular rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: It's when a pacemaker helps speed up a slow heart rate by stimulating the ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Das ist der Fall, wenn ein Herzschrittmacher durch die Stimulation der Herzkammern dazu beiträgt, eine langsame Herzfrequenz zu beschleunigen.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding that represents depolarization of the ventricular myocardium. Normally the ventricles are activated simultaneously.
lay_definition_en: The QRS complexes are the three waves on an EKG that show when the heart's lower chambers are ready to contract.
lay_definition_de: Die QRS-Komplexe sind die drei Wellen im EKG, die anzeigen, wann die unteren Herzkammern bereit sind, sich zusammenzuziehen.

general_definition_en: Increased time for the complex comprised of the Q wave, R wave, and S wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).. In adults, normal values are 0.06 - 0.10 sec. [HPO:probinson]
lay_definition_en: Three distinctive electrical waves in the heart shown on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Drei charakteristische elektrische Wellen im Herzen, die auf einem EKG zu sehen sind.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Atrial means something related to the upper chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Atrial“ bedeutet, dass etwas mit den oberen Herzkammern zu tun hat.

general_definition_en: The region on either side of the body that extends from the last rib to the hip. period
lay_definition_en: A blanking period is when a pacemaker can't detect any signals for a certain amount of time.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausblendphase liegt vor, wenn ein Herzschrittmacher über einen bestimmten Zeitraum hinweg keine Signale empfangen kann.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of an inversion of the T wave from the expected axis.
lay_definition_en: A sign of heart abnormalities seen on an EKG test.
lay_definition_de: Ein Anzeichen für Herzanomalien, das bei einer EKG-Untersuchung festgestellt wird.

general_definition_en: V2-V3
lay_definition_en: Two particular leads on an ECG/EKG machine that go on the front of the chest.
lay_definition_de: Zwei bestimmte Ableitungen eines EKG-Geräts, die an der Vorderseite der Brust angebracht werden.

general_definition_en: The purified, alkaloidal, extra-potent form of cocaine. It is smoked (free-based), injected intravenously, and orally ingested. Use of crack results in alterations in function of the cardiovascular system, the autonomic nervous system, the central nervous system, and the gastrointestinal system. The slang term "crack" was derived from the crackling sound made upon igniting of this form of cocaine for smoking.
lay_definition_en: A smokable form of cocaine known in slang as crack.
lay_definition_de: Eine rauchbare Form von Kokain, die im Slang als „Crack“ bekannt ist.

general_definition_en: Carbon monoxide (CO). A poisonous colorless, odorless, tasteless gas. It combines with hemoglobin to form carboxyhemoglobin, which has no oxygen carrying capacity. The resultant oxygen deprivation causes headache, dizziness, decreased pulse and respiratory rates, unconsciousness, and death. (From Merck Index, 11th ed)
lay_definition_en: Your heart's pumping capacity per minute.
lay_definition_de: Die Pumpleistung Ihres Herzens pro Minute.

general_definition_en: A potassium sparing diuretic that acts by antagonism of aldosterone in the distal renal tubules. It is used mainly in the treatment of refractory edema in patients with congestive heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, or hepatic cirrhosis. Its effects on the endocrine system are utilized in the treatments of hirsutism and acne but they can lead to adverse effects. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p827)
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps control blood pressure and potassium levels, while also reducing excess fluid in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, den Blutdruck und den Kaliumspiegel zu regulieren und gleichzeitig überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen.

general_definition_en: A condition that is characterized by the presence of generalized edema. Causes include congestive heart failure, liver failure, renal failure, and severe malnutrition.
lay_definition_en: Intense swelling throughout the body due to various medical issues.
lay_definition_de: Starke Schwellungen am ganzen Körper aufgrund verschiedener gesundheitlicher Probleme.

general_definition_en: A drug used to treat high blood pressure. It is also being studied in the treatment of certain types of cancer pain. It blocks the release of chemicals from nerve endings that make blood vessels constrict (get narrower). Catapres is a type of antihypertensive agent and a type of alpha-adrenergic agonist.
lay_definition_en: A medication that relaxes blood vessels to treat high blood pressure, anxiety, and certain types of pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Blutgefäße entspannt und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck, Angstzuständen und bestimmten Arten von Schmerzen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Simple rapid heartbeats caused by rapid discharge of impulses from the SINOATRIAL NODE, usually between 100 and 180 beats/min in adults. It is characterized by a gradual onset and termination. Sinus tachycardia is common in infants, young children, and adults during strenuous physical activities.
lay_definition_en: When your heart beats really fast - that's tachy.
lay_definition_de: Wenn dein Herz richtig schnell schlägt – das ist Tachykardie.

general_definition_en: Idiopathic painful nonsuppurative swellings of one or more costal cartilages, especially of the second rib. The anterior chest pain may mimic that of coronary artery disease. (Dorland, 27th ed.)
lay_definition_en: Pain and irritation near where your ribs meet your breastbone.
lay_definition_de: Schmerzen und Reizungen im Bereich, wo die Rippen auf das Brustbein treffen.

general_definition_en: The first and largest artery branching from the aortic arch. It distributes blood to the right side of the head and neck and to the right arm.
lay_definition_en: A big vein that moves blood from your head and neck to your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine große Vene, die Blut aus dem Kopf und Hals zum Herzen transportiert.

general_definition_en: The first and largest artery branching from the aortic arch. It distributes blood to the right side of the head and neck and to the right arm.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that transports blood from the head and neck to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das Blut aus dem Kopf und Hals zum Herzen transportiert.

general_definition_en: A condition that occurs when the obstruction of the thin-walled SUPERIOR VENA CAVA interrupts blood flow from the head, upper extremities, and thorax to the RIGHT ATRIUM. Obstruction can be caused by NEOPLASMS; THROMBOSIS; ANEURYSM; or external compression. The syndrome is characterized by swelling and/or CYANOSIS of the face, neck, and upper arms.
lay_definition_en: A large vein returning blood from the head to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine große Vene, die das Blut vom Kopf zum Herzen zurückführt.

general_definition_en: A spectrum of pathological conditions of impaired blood flow in the brain. They can involve vessels (ARTERIES or VEINS) in the CEREBRUM, the CEREBELLUM, and the BRAIN STEM. Major categories include INTRACRANIAL ARTERIOVENOUS MALFORMATIONS; BRAIN ISCHEMIA; CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; and others. accident
lay_definition_en: A cerebrovascular accident is just a stroke, causing damage to the brain due to lack of blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein zerebrovaskulärer Vorfall ist nichts anderes als ein Schlaganfall, bei dem es aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung zu einer Schädigung des Gehirns kommt.

general_definition_en: ring
lay_definition_en: A ring is a circular band used to fix a heart valve back to its regular form and size.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ring ist ein kreisförmiges Band, mit dem eine Herzklappe wieder in ihre normale Form und Größe gebracht wird.

general_definition_en: A measurement of the backward flow of blood through the tricuspid valve during right ventricle contraction. It correlates with pulmonary artery systolic pressure at rest and with exercise. A tricuspid regurgitation velocity greater than or equal to 2.5 m/sec on echocardiography is a surrogate marker for pulmonary hypertension in adults with sickle cell disease.
lay_definition_en: TRV means "across."
lay_definition_de: TRV bedeutet „quer“.

general_definition_en: The quality of affecting MYOCARDIUM contractility, positively or negatively.
lay_definition_en: Inotropism refers to how the strength of heart contractions is influenced or regulated.
lay_definition_de: Unter Inotropismus versteht man die Art und Weise, wie die Stärke der Herzkontraktionen beeinflusst oder reguliert wird.

general_definition_en: 3RD Intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: In a 3rd degree heart block, the signal between the upper and lower heart chambers gets disrupted, causing the lower chamber to beat at its own pace, often resulting in an irregular and slow heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem Herzblock dritten Grades wird die Signalübertragung zwischen den oberen und unteren Herzkammern unterbrochen, wodurch die untere Herzkammer in ihrem eigenen Rhythmus schlägt, was häufig zu einem unregelmäßigen und langsamen Herzschlag führt.

general_definition_en: NON-ISCHEMIC CARDIOMYOPATHY
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle not working properly because of reasons other than a heart attack or blockages.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzmuskel funktioniert nicht richtig, was jedoch nicht auf einen Herzinfarkt oder Verstopfungen zurückzuführen ist.

general_definition_en: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Measurements that indicate how the body is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Messwerte, die Aufschluss über die Funktionsweise des Körpers geben.

general_definition_en: An abnormally rapid ventricular rhythm usually in excess of 150 beats per minute. It is generated within the ventricle below the BUNDLE OF HIS, either as autonomic impulse formation or reentrant impulse conduction. Depending on the etiology, onset of ventricular tachycardia can be paroxysmal (sudden) or nonparoxysmal, its wide QRS complexes can be uniform or polymorphic, and the ventricular beating may be independent of the atrial beating (AV dissociation).
lay_definition_en: When the lower chambers of the heart beat too fast, causing an irregular heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die unteren Herzkammern zu schnell schlagen und dadurch einen unregelmäßigen Herzrhythmus verursachen.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: Arrest means when the heart has stopped beating.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzstillstand liegt vor, wenn das Herz aufgehört hat zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: The superior portion of the heart located opposite to the apical portion. It is formed mainly by the left atrium.
lay_definition_en: Related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz betreffend.

general_definition_en: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the terminal end of the left coronary artery between the angle formed by the anterior interventricular branch and the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery and supplies the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A diagonal is a branch of a major artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Diagonale ist ein Ast einer Hauptarterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart defect characterized by the persistent opening of fetal DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS that connects the PULMONARY ARTERY to the descending aorta (AORTA, DESCENDING) allowing unoxygenated blood to bypass the lung and flow to the PLACENTA. Normally, the ductus is closed shortly after birth.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that takes blood from the heart to all parts of the body: PDA.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen in alle Teile des Körpers transportiert: PDA.

general_definition_en: Shock resulting from diminution of cardiac output in heart disease.
lay_definition_en: When your heart can't pump enough blood to your body, it's a life-threatening situation called cardiogenic shock.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz nicht genug Blut in Ihren Körper pumpen kann, handelt es sich um einen lebensbedrohlichen Zustand, der als kardiogener Schock bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: A medicine for chest pain, high blood pressure, and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel gegen Brustschmerzen, Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medications that decrease heart rate and blood pressure to help the heart function better.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die die Herzfrequenz und den Blutdruck senken, damit das Herz besser arbeiten kann.

general_definition_en: The movement and the forces involved in the movement of the blood through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: Describes how blood flows through the body.
lay_definition_de: Beschreibt, wie das Blut durch den Körper fließt.

general_definition_en: An ethanolamine derivative that is an adrenergic alpha-1 agonist. It is used as a vasoconstrictor agent in the treatment of HYPOTENSION.
lay_definition_en: A medication for heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: A heart condition that makes it harder for the heart to pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, die es dem Herzen erschwert, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart.
lay_definition_en: Related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz betreffend.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: Heart attack: when the heart doesn't receive enough blood suddenly.
lay_definition_de: Herzinfarkt: Wenn das Herz plötzlich nicht mehr ausreichend mit Blut versorgt wird.

general_definition_en: Cardiac enzymes
lay_definition_en: Proteins released when the heart is damaged, and high levels could mean a heart attack happened.
lay_definition_de: Proteine, die bei einer Schädigung des Herzens freigesetzt werden; erhöhte Werte könnten auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeuten.

general_definition_en: Cardiac Enzymes
lay_definition_en: Proteins released into the blood when the heart muscle is damaged, signaling a possible heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Proteine, die bei einer Schädigung des Herzmuskels ins Blut freigesetzt werden und auf einen möglichen Herzinfarkt hindeuten.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a device that uses electrical signals to regulate the heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das mithilfe elektrischer Signale den Herzschlag reguliert.

general_definition_en: Implantable devices which continuously monitor the electrical activity of the heart and automatically detect and terminate ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) and VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. They consist of an impulse generator, batteries, and electrodes.
lay_definition_en: A defibrillator is a tool that helps fix a wonky heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Defibrillator ist ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, einen gestörten Herzrhythmus wiederherzustellen.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Ventricular means relating to the lower chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Ventrikulär“ bedeutet: sich auf die unteren Herzkammern beziehend.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: A heart procedure to diagnose and treat certain conditions by inserting a tube into an artery and guiding it to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzverfahren zur Diagnose und Behandlung bestimmter Erkrankungen, bei dem ein Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt und bis zum Herzen vorgeschoben wird.

general_definition_en: An artery arising from the bifurcation of the left coronary artery that runs along the coronary grove with branches supplying the atria and ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery on the left side.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie auf der linken Seite.

general_definition_en: The vessels carrying blood away from the heart.
lay_definition_en: A tube that carries blood from the heart to the entire body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gefäß, das Blut vom Herzen in den gesamten Körper transportiert.

general_definition_en: Catheters inserted into various locations within the heart for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.
lay_definition_en: A heart test where a tube is put into an artery and guided to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der ein Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt und bis zum Herzen vorgeschoben wird.

general_definition_en: Qualified medical professionals who specialize in preventing and treating disorders of the heart and CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: A cardiologist is a doctor who helps with heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Kardiologe ist ein Arzt, der bei Herzproblemen hilft.

general_definition_en: Branch of the common carotid artery which supplies the exterior of the head, the face, and the greater part of the neck.
lay_definition_en: Blood vessels that carry oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportieren.

general_definition_en: The volume of distribution at steady state based on the observed CLST for a substance administered by intravascular dosing divided by the dose.
lay_definition_en: Your body's important measurements like heart rate and blood pressure are normal.
lay_definition_de: Die wichtigen Körperwerte wie Herzfrequenz und Blutdruck liegen im Normbereich.

general_definition_en: Caduet
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps with high blood pressure and chest pain caused by high cholesterol.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Bluthochdruck und Brustschmerzen hilft, die durch einen hohen Cholesterinspiegel verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Heart condition where the heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankung, bei der das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, Blut effektiv zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Imidazole derivative anesthetic and hypnotic with little effect on blood gases, ventilation, or the cardiovascular system. It has been proposed as an induction anesthetic.
lay_definition_en: A drug that makes you sleep during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dafür sorgt, dass man während der Operation schläft.

general_definition_en: Records pertaining to the interactive response technology used in the clinical trial.
lay_definition_en: The time in milliseconds between the aortic valve closing and the mitral valve opening in the heart cycle.
lay_definition_de: Die Zeit in Millisekunden zwischen dem Schließen der Aortenklappe und dem Öffnen der Mitralklappe im Herzzyklus.

general_definition_en: A pathological constriction that can occur above (supravalvular stenosis), below (subvalvular stenosis), or at the AORTIC VALVE. It is characterized by restricted outflow from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The biggest artery coming out of the heart gets clogged and narrowed.
lay_definition_de: Die größte Arterie, die vom Herzen ausgeht, verstopft und verengt sich.

general_definition_en: Widening of a stenosed HEART VALVE by the insertion of a balloon CATHETER into the valve and inflation of the balloon.
lay_definition_en: A procedure that uses a balloon to open a blocked heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Eingriff, bei dem eine verstopfte Herzklappe mithilfe eines Ballons geöffnet wird.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Sudden heart failure with quick symptoms is known as dCHF.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Herzversagen mit schnell auftretenden Symptomen wird als dCHF bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: To revive someone by helping them breathe again with fluids.
lay_definition_de: Jemanden wiederbeleben, indem man ihm mit Flüssigkeit hilft, wieder zu atmen.

general_definition_en: pa
lay_definition_en: Pressure of blood in the artery from heart to lungs.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck in der Arterie, die vom Herzen zur Lunge führt.

general_definition_en: Arylsulfatase A (507 aa, ~54 kDa) is encoded by the human ARSA gene. This protein is involved in the hydrolysis of cerebroside sulfate.
lay_definition_en: An uncommon aortic arch configuration where the right subclavian artery originates directly from the aortic arch instead of the brachiocephalic artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine ungewöhnliche Ausbildung des Aortenbogens, bei der die rechte Arteria subclavia direkt aus dem Aortenbogen entspringt und nicht aus der Arteria brachiocephalica.

general_definition_en: Provision of diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders affecting the heart
lay_definition_en: Heart doctors who help with heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Herzspezialisten, die bei Herzproblemen helfen.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of brain natriuretic peptide present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: A BNP test measures how your heart is doing by looking at a specific protein in your blood that goes up in congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein BNP-Test gibt Aufschluss über die Funktion Ihres Herzens, indem er ein bestimmtes Protein in Ihrem Blut misst, dessen Konzentration bei einer Herzinsuffizienz ansteigt.

general_definition_en: Removal of a wedge-shaped portion of tissue, for microscopic examinaton.
lay_definition_en: Wedge is a way to assess the pumping ability of the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Mit dem „Wedge“-Verfahren lässt sich die Pumpfunktion des linken Vorhofs des Herzens beurteilen.

general_definition_en: AFlutter
lay_definition_en: AFlutter is a condition where the heart's upper chambers beat too quickly, potentially leading to a fast heart rate and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Vorhofflimmern ist eine Erkrankung, bei der die oberen Herzkammern zu schnell schlagen, was zu Herzrasen und Schlaganfällen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Dilation of an occluded coronary artery (or arteries) by means of a balloon catheter to restore myocardial blood supply.
lay_definition_en: A balloon angioplasty is a medical procedure that widens a blocked blood vessel by inflating a small balloon inside it.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ballonangioplastie ist ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein verstopftes Blutgefäß durch das Aufblasen eines kleinen Ballons im Inneren erweitert wird.

general_definition_en: Inflammation of the inner lining of the heart (ENDOCARDIUM), the continuous membrane lining the four chambers and HEART VALVES. It is often caused by microorganisms including bacteria, viruses, fungi, and rickettsiae. Left untreated, endocarditis can damage heart valves and become life-threatening.
lay_definition_en: Bacterial infection in the heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Bakterielle Infektion der Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A A catheter guide wire is a coiled wire that is designed to fit inside a percutaneous catheter for the purpose of directing the catheter through a blood vessel.
lay_definition_en: Wires connected to a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: An einen Herzschrittmacher angeschlossene Kabel.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: When an artery and a vein are connected.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Arterie und eine Vene miteinander verbunden sind.

general_definition_en: Diseases of the parasympathetic or sympathetic divisions of the AUTONOMIC NERVOUS SYSTEM; which has components located in the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM and PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM. Autonomic dysfunction may be associated with HYPOTHALAMIC DISEASES; BRAIN STEM disorders; SPINAL CORD DISEASES; and PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM DISEASES. Manifestations include impairments of vegetative functions including the maintenance of BLOOD PRESSURE; HEART RATE; pupil function; SWEATING; REPRODUCTIVE AND URINARY PHYSIOLOGY; and DIGESTION.
lay_definition_en: When your body's automatic functions like heart rate, digestion, and sweating go haywire.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die automatischen Körperfunktionen wie Herzfrequenz, Verdauung und Schweißbildung aus dem Gleichgewicht geraten.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A small device that helps regulate the heartbeat when placed in the chest.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleines Gerät, das den Herzschlag reguliert, wenn es in die Brust implantiert wird.

general_definition_en: Not an aneurysm but a well-defined collection of blood and CONNECTIVE TISSUE outside the wall of a blood vessel or the heart. It is the containment of a ruptured blood vessel or heart, such as sealing a rupture of the left ventricle. False aneurysm is formed by organized THROMBUS and HEMATOMA in surrounding tissue.
lay_definition_en: A pseudoaneurysm is a pool of blood that develops outside of an artery's layers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Pseudoaneurysma ist eine Blutansammlung, die sich außerhalb der Schichten einer Arterie bildet.

general_definition_en: Shock resulting from diminution of cardiac output in heart disease.
lay_definition_en: The heart can't pump enough blood, often due to a severe heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz kann nicht genug Blut pumpen, was häufig auf einen schweren Herzinfarkt zurückzuführen ist.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: A protein in your blood that shows up when your muscles get hurt.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein im Blut, das auftritt, wenn Ihre Muskeln verletzt werden.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE. / An assessment of the reactivity between host immune cells and donor human leukocyte antigen. This test is most commonly carried out in subjects awaiting transplant. The recipient's blood or serum is mixed with either a panel of lymphocytes from random blood donations or a potential donor's purified human leukocyte antigens (HLA). Host reactivity is scored as a percent.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks the balance between two hormones that can indicate a condition where the adrenal glands produce excessive aldosterone.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, der das Gleichgewicht zwischen zwei Hormonen überprüft, das auf eine Erkrankung hinweisen kann, bei der die Nebennieren zu viel Aldosteron produzieren.

general_definition_en: A finding indicating that an excess amount of normetanephrine is secreted by a tumor.
lay_definition_en: A substance produced by a certain type of tumor that can lead to high blood pressure and risky health conditions.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz, die von einer bestimmten Art von Tumor gebildet wird und zu Bluthochdruck sowie zu gesundheitlichen Risiken führen kann.

general_definition_en: An immunosuppressive agent used in combination with cyclophosphamide and hydroxychloroquine in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. According to the Fourth Annual Report on Carcinogens (NTP 85-002, 1985), this substance has been listed as a known carcinogen. (Merck Index, 11th ed)
lay_definition_en: Using a heart pacer to regulate a fast heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Einsatz eines Herzschrittmachers zur Regulierung einer zu schnellen Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: dig
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with irregular heart rhythms and certain heart failure conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Formen der Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: II
lay_definition_en: It's a type of heart monitor shown on an electrocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Art Herzmonitor, der auf einem Elektrokardiogramm dargestellt wird.

general_definition_en: An augmented unipolar electrocardiogram limb lead in which the positive (red) electrode is situated on the left pelvic limb and the negative electrode is a combination of the right thoracic limb (white) electrode and the left thoracic limb (black) electrode. Measures the electrical activity of the electrode on the left pelvic limb.
lay_definition_en: A lead used in an ECG that records a portion of the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ableitung im EKG, mit der ein Teil der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens aufgezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A finding associated with a patient based on the functional classification developed by the New York Heart Association (NYHA), for categorizing patients with defined or presumed cardiac disease. The classification system is based on the ability, or lack thereof, to engage in physical activity. The classification system comprises four classes, though NYHA Class III and Class IV are often aggregated for the purpose of outcomes analysis. class 1
lay_definition_en: A way to show how bad heart failure is, with Class 1 meaning no physical limits and no symptoms during daily activities.
lay_definition_de: Eine Möglichkeit, den Schweregrad einer Herzinsuffizienz darzustellen, wobei Klasse 1 bedeutet, dass keine körperlichen Einschränkungen vorliegen und bei alltäglichen Aktivitäten keine Symptome auftreten.

general_definition_en: An alkaloid, originally from Atropa belladonna, but found in other plants, mainly SOLANACEAE. Hyoscyamine is the 3(S)-endo isomer of atropine.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps decrease saliva and mucus production and control heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, die Speichel- und Schleimproduktion zu verringern und die Herzfrequenz zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: A left coronary artery branch that descends on the anterior portion of the heart through the anterior interventricular groove.
lay_definition_en: A lad is a part of the heart that carries blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein „Lad“ ist ein Teil des Herzens, der Blut transportiert.

general_definition_en: An ultrasonic examination of the fetus in the late first trimester to measure the clear space at the back of the fetal neck to assess risk of genetic or cardiac abnormalities. - Natriuretic peptides B (134 aa, ~15 kDa) is encoded by the human NPPB gene. This protein is involved in the maintenance of cardiac homeostasis.
lay_definition_en: A substance in your blood that can show heart issues if levels are high.
lay_definition_de: Ein Stoff im Blut, dessen erhöhte Werte auf Herzprobleme hindeuten können.

general_definition_en: Incomplete transposition of the great vessels in which both the AORTA and the PULMONARY ARTERY arise from the RIGHT VENTRICLE. The only outlet of the LEFT VENTRICLE is a large ventricular septal defect (VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECTS or VSD). The various subtypes are classified by the location of the septal defect, such as subaortic, subpulmonary, or noncommitted.
lay_definition_en: A heart defect where the aorta is connected to the wrong part of the heart since birth.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzfehler, bei dem die Aorta von Geburt an mit dem falschen Teil des Herzens verbunden ist.

general_definition_en: A myocardial infarction that produces elevation in the ST segments of the ECG.
lay_definition_en: A severe kind of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwere Form des Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: The hollow, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood.
lay_definition_en: Inside an artery that supplies blood to the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Im Inneren einer Arterie, die den Herzmuskel mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: Minihep
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps prevent blood clots in people with angina.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Menschen mit Angina pectoris dazu beiträgt, Blutgerinnseln vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The big blood vessel moving poorly-oxygenated blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Das große Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: ARTERIAL
lay_definition_en: An arterial is a blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie ist ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen wegbefördert.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: When the heart has stopped beating.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz aufgehört hat zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: transvenous pacing
lay_definition_en: A method for controlling the heart rate and rhythm with a pacemaker placed through a vein.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Steuerung der Herzfrequenz und des Herzrhythmus mithilfe eines über eine Vene implantierten Herzschrittmachers.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by fluid collection within the pericardial sac, usually due to inflammation.
lay_definition_en: Extra fluid around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Flüssigkeitsansammlung um das Herz herum.

general_definition_en: A positive inotropic cardiotonic agent with vasodilator properties. It inhibits cAMP phosphodiesterase type 3 activity in myocardium and vascular smooth muscle. Milrinone is a derivative of amrinone and has 20-30 times the inotropic potency of amrinone.
lay_definition_en: Drug that helps the heart pump blood better for people with heart failure or high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das Menschen mit Herzinsuffizienz oder pulmonalem Bluthochdruck hilft, das Blut besser zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A methyl xanthine derivative from tea with diuretic, smooth muscle relaxant, bronchial dilation, cardiac and central nervous system stimulant activities. Theophylline inhibits the 3',5'-CYCLIC NUCLEOTIDE PHOSPHODIESTERASE that degrades CYCLIC AMP thus potentiates the actions of agents that act through ADENYLYL CYCLASES and cyclic AMP.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps people breathe better when they have trouble breathing.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das Menschen hilft, besser zu atmen, wenn sie Atembeschwerden haben.

general_definition_en: NVSS
lay_definition_en: NVSS is a series of basic measurements to check if the body is okay by monitoring things like temperature and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: NVSS ist eine Reihe von Basisuntersuchungen, bei denen durch die Überwachung von Parametern wie Temperatur und Herzfrequenz überprüft wird, ob der Körper in Ordnung ist.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a rhythm which originates in the AV junction and results in a normal heart rate. It is characterized by retrograde P waves which may be obscured by or may follow the QRS complexes. The QRS complexes may be narrow or may demonstrate aberration. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heartbeat that starts from a different place than normal, closer to where the atria and ventricles meet in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschlag, der an einer anderen Stelle als gewöhnlich beginnt, näher an der Stelle, an der sich Vorhöfe und Herzkammern im Herzen treffen.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: A heart procedure that involves inserting a tube through an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzverfahren, bei dem ein Schlauch durch eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a progressively lengthening PR interval prior to the blocking of an atrial impulse. This is the result of intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction through the atrioventricular (AV) node to the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the electrical signals are irregular.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der die elektrischen Signale unregelmäßig sind.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a progressively lengthening PR interval prior to the blocking of an atrial impulse. This is the result of intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction through the atrioventricular (AV) node to the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: Mobitz is a type of heart problem.
lay_definition_de: Mobitz ist eine Form von Herzfehler.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the heart's electrical system malfunctions, causing an abnormal rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der das elektrische Leitungssystem des Herzens gestört ist, was zu einem Herzrhythmusstörung führt.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta which prevents backflow into the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: The aortic valve helps the heart pump blood into the body's main artery.
lay_definition_de: Die Aortenklappe unterstützt das Herz dabei, Blut in die Hauptarterie des Körpers zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Inflammation of the inner lining of the heart (ENDOCARDIUM), the continuous membrane lining the four chambers and HEART VALVES. It is often caused by microorganisms including bacteria, viruses, fungi, and rickettsiae. Left untreated, endocarditis can damage heart valves and become life-threatening.
lay_definition_en: Inflammation in the inner lining of the heart, often due to an infection.
lay_definition_de: Entzündung der Herzwand, häufig infolge einer Infektion.

general_definition_en: Ultrasonic recording of the size, motion, and composition of the heart and surrounding tissues using a transducer placed in the esophagus.
lay_definition_en: A test that uses sound waves to create a picture of the heart by passing a tube through your mouth and throat.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe von Schallwellen ein Bild des Herzens erstellt wird, indem ein Schlauch durch Mund und Rachen eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: A fulminating disease of neonates in which there is extensive mucosal ulceration, pseudomembrane formation, submucosal hemorrhage, and necrosis usually of the right colon, cecum, terminal ileum, and appendix, possibly due to perinatal intestinal ischemia and bacterial invasion. Progression can lead to necrosis, perforation and/or scarring of the intestinal tract.
lay_definition_en: A serious gut problem that affects premature babies causing inflammation and tissue death.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwerwiegende Darmerkrankung, von der Frühgeborene betroffen sind und die Entzündungen und Gewebetod verursacht.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: When heavy alcoholics abruptly stop drinking, they might experience a mental state with shaking, confusion, and other symptoms known as delirium tremens.
lay_definition_de: Wenn starke Alkoholiker plötzlich mit dem Trinken aufhören, kann es zu einem psychischen Zustand kommen, der durch Zittern, Verwirrung und andere Symptome gekennzeichnet ist und als Delirium tremens bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta which prevents backflow into the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: The aortic valve is a tissue flap in the heart that allows blood to flow into the body's largest artery.
lay_definition_de: Die Aortenklappe ist eine Gewebeklappe im Herzen, die den Blutfluss in die größte Arterie des Körpers ermöglicht.

general_definition_en: The minimal cross-sectional area of the flow jet downstream of a cardiac valve.
lay_definition_en: EOA measures the function of a prosthetic valve.
lay_definition_de: Die EOA misst die Funktion einer Herzklappenprothese.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: Something related to the aorta, which is the body's largest artery.
lay_definition_de: Etwas, das mit der Aorta zu tun hat, der größten Arterie des Körpers.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of AORTA.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in a large heart blood vessel that can burst and cause severe internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung in einem großen Herzblutgefäß, die reißen und schwere innere Blutungen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of AORTA.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in a major blood vessel leaving the heart that can burst and lead to internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung an einem großen Blutgefäß, das vom Herzen ausgeht; diese kann reißen und zu inneren Blutungen führen.

general_definition_en: Agents that control agitated psychotic behavior, alleviate acute psychotic states, reduce psychotic symptoms, and exert a quieting effect. They are used in SCHIZOPHRENIA; senile dementia; transient psychosis following surgery; or MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; etc. These drugs are often referred to as neuroleptics alluding to the tendency to produce neurological side effects, but not all antipsychotics are likely to produce such effects. Many of these drugs may also be effective against nausea, emesis, and pruritus.
lay_definition_en: Medications used to treat certain mental disorders.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung bestimmter psychischer Störungen.

general_definition_en: The lesion considered to be responsible for the acute coronary syndrome. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: The person responsible for causing a problem.
lay_definition_de: Die Person, die für ein Problem verantwortlich ist.

general_definition_en: A heart disease that is present at birth. Representative examples include atrial septal defect, ventricular septal defect, tetralogy of Fallot, and patent foramen ovale.
lay_definition_en: A heart problem a person is born with.
lay_definition_de: Ein angeborenes Herzleiden.

general_definition_en: The measure of an individual's cardiac output as divided by their body surface area (CI= CO/BSA). This calculation is a useful function to determine an individual's cardiac performance in relation to their body size, providing an overview of global cardiovascular function.
lay_definition_en: A way to measure how effectively your heart is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um zu messen, wie gut Ihr Herz funktioniert.

general_definition_en: electrocardiogram
lay_definition_en: A test that shows how your heart is working by recording its electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens aufgezeichnet wird, um dessen Funktionsweise zu beurteilen.

general_definition_en:
