Deciduous maxillary right second molar tooth; Universal designation A; ISO designation 55

A data type comprised of a numerator quantity divided by a denominator quantity.
lay_definition_en: A measure of heart function using ultrasound to look at the left ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung der Herzfunktion mittels Ultraschall zur Beurteilung des linken Ventrikels.

general_definition_en: Pathological condition characterized by the backflow of blood from the ASCENDING AORTA back into the LEFT VENTRICLE, leading to regurgitation. It is caused by diseases of the AORTIC VALVE or its surrounding tissue (aortic root).
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn���t close properly causing blood to go the wrong way.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung.

general_definition_en: A nonreassuring fetal status (NRFS) indicating that the FETUS is compromised (American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists 1988). It can be identified by sub-optimal values in FETAL HEART RATE; oxygenation of FETAL BLOOD; and other parameters.
lay_definition_en: When test results show that a baby might be in some trouble near the end of the pregnancy or during childbirth.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Untersuchungsergebnisse darauf hindeuten, dass es bei einem Baby gegen Ende der Schwangerschaft oder während der Geburt zu Komplikationen kommen könnte.

general_definition_en: An alkaloid, originally from Atropa belladonna, but found in other plants, mainly SOLANACEAE. Hyoscyamine is the 3(S)-endo isomer of atropine.
lay_definition_en: A drug that reduces saliva, mucus, and controls heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das den Speichelfluss und die Schleimbildung verringert und die Herzfrequenz reguliert.

general_definition_en: Receptors in the vascular system, particularly the aorta and carotid sinus, which are sensitive to stretch of the vessel walls.
lay_definition_en: Medications that raise blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die den Blutdruck erhöhen.

general_definition_en: An orally active nonpeptide triazole-derived antagonist of angiotensin (AT) II with antihypertensive properties. Valsartan selectively and competitively blocks the binding of angiotensin II to the AT1 subtype receptor in vascular smooth muscle and the adrenal gland, preventing AT II-mediated vasoconstriction, aldosterone synthesis and secretion, and renal reabsorption of sodium, and resulting in vasodilation, increased excretion of sodium and water, a reduction in plasma volume, and a reduction in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the top part beats too early.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der der obere Teil des Herzens zu früh schlägt.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: When someone is really confused and can't think straight, that's delirium.
lay_definition_de: Wenn jemand völlig verwirrt ist und nicht mehr klar denken kann, spricht man von Delirium.

general_definition_en: A selective adrenergic beta-1 blocking agent that is commonly used to treat ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; and CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with heart-related issues by controlling heart rhythms and blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzproblemen hilft, indem es den Herzrhythmus und den Blutdruck reguliert.

general_definition_en: Restoration of blood supply to tissue which is ischemic due to decrease in normal blood supply. The decrease may result from any source including atherosclerotic obstruction, narrowing of the artery, or surgical clamping. It is primarily a procedure for treating infarction or other ischemia, by enabling viable ischemic tissue to recover, thus limiting further necrosis. However, it is thought that reperfusion can itself further damage the ischemic tissue, causing REPERFUSION INJURY.
lay_definition_en: Reperfuse means restoring blood flow to a tissue or organ.
lay_definition_de: „Reperfusion“ bedeutet die Wiederherstellung der Durchblutung eines Gewebes oder Organs.

general_definition_en: B-blocker
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps lower high blood pressure to treat hypertension.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Agents that have a strengthening effect on the heart or that can increase cardiac output. They may be CARDIAC GLYCOSIDES; SYMPATHOMIMETICS; or other drugs. They are used after MYOCARDIAL INFARCT; CARDIAC SURGICAL PROCEDURES; in SHOCK; or in congestive heart failure (HEART FAILURE).
lay_definition_en: Helping to protect the heart and keep it working well.
lay_definition_de: Trägt dazu bei, das Herz zu schützen und seine Funktion aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: A modification of the standard method of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation developed to allow for the therapy to be extended to a patient population that is unable to tolerate treatment with the conventional procedure due to its toxicity. Human EMILIN1 wild-type allele is located within 2p23.3 and is approximately 8 kb in length. This allele, which encodes EMILIN-1 protein, plays a role in the regulation of both blood vessel structure and transforming growth factor beta signaling.
lay_definition_en: NST EMI is a milder form of heart attack than an ST elevation heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein NST-EMI ist eine mildere Form des Herzinfarkts als ein Herzinfarkt mit ST-Strecken-Hebung.

general_definition_en: Use or insertion of a tubular device into a duct, blood vessel, hollow organ, or body cavity for injecting or withdrawing fluids for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It differs from INTUBATION in that the tube here is used to restore or maintain patency in obstructions.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure involving inserting a tube into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein Katheter in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

lay_definition_en: The right ventricle of the heart is not pumping properly.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Ventrikel des Herzens pumpt nicht richtig.

general_definition_en: A class of enzymes that catalyze the hydrolysis of one of the two ester bonds in a phosphodiester compound. EC 3.1.4. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A drug type that helps by blocking a certain enzyme to treat heart failure and COPD.
lay_definition_de: Eine Wirkstoffklasse, die durch die Hemmung eines bestimmten Enzyms bei der Behandlung von Herzinsuffizienz und COPD hilft.

general_definition_en: A local anesthetic and cardiac depressant used as an antiarrhythmia agent. Its actions are more intense and its effects more prolonged than those of PROCAINE but its duration of action is shorter than that of BUPIVACAINE or PRILOCAINE.
lay_definition_en: A thick form of numbing medication that sticks to the skin.
lay_definition_de: Ein dickflüssiges Betäubungsmittel, das auf der Haut haftet.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: Pulse is the beat of your heart as it pumps blood through your body.
lay_definition_de: Der Puls ist der Rhythmus deines Herzens, wenn es Blut durch deinen Körper pumpt.

general_definition_en: A potent and specific inhibitor of PEPTIDYL-DIPEPTIDASE A. It blocks the conversion of ANGIOTENSIN I to ANGIOTENSIN II, a vasoconstrictor and important regulator of arterial blood pressure. Captopril acts to suppress the RENIN-ANGIOTENSIN SYSTEM and inhibits pressure responses to exogenous angiotensin.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to manage high blood pressure, heart failure, and kidney issues linked to diabetes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck, Herzinsuffizienz und Nierenproblemen im Zusammenhang mit Diabetes.

general_definition_en: V Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: A dangerous irregular heartbeat that can disrupt blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein gefährlicher Herzrhythmusstörung, der den Blutfluss beeinträchtigen kann.

general_definition_en: The active sympathomimetic hormone from the ADRENAL MEDULLA. It stimulates both the alpha- and beta- adrenergic systems, causes systemic VASOCONSTRICTION and gastrointestinal relaxation, stimulates the HEART, and dilates BRONCHI and cerebral vessels. It is used in ASTHMA and CARDIAC FAILURE and to delay absorption of local ANESTHETICS.
lay_definition_en: A substance that makes your body work faster when you're stressed out.
lay_definition_de: Ein Stoff, der deinen Körper dazu bringt, schneller zu arbeiten, wenn du gestresst bist.

general_definition_en: The hydrochloride salt form of esmolol, a short and rapid-acting beta adrenergic antagonist belonging to the class II anti-arrhythmic drugs and devoid of intrinsic sympathomimetic activity. Esmolol hydrochloride competitively blocks beta-1 adrenergic receptors in cardiac muscle and reduces the contractility and cardiac rate of heart muscle, thereby decreasing cardiac output and myocardial oxygen demands. This agent also decreases sympathetic output centrally and blocks renin secretion. At higher doses, esmolol hydrochloride also blocks beta-2 receptors located in bronchial and vascular smooth muscle, thereby leading to smooth muscle relaxation.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps regulate irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, unregelmäßigen Herzschlag zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: mech valve-
lay_definition_en: A mechanical valve is an artificial substitute for a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine mechanische Herzklappe ist ein künstlicher Ersatz für eine Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A brownish-white colored, sand-like powder with a phosgene-like odor that emits toxic fumes of phosgene gas, hydrochloric acid and other chlorinated compounds when heated to decomposition. a-Hexachlorocyclohexane is the alpha-isomer of hexachlorocyclohexane and is used as an insecticide to treat lice and scabies. Inhalation exposure to this substance causes severe irritation of the nose, throat and lungs; causes anemia, and affects the liver, kidneys, nervous system, cardiovascular system and immune system. a-Hexachlorocyclohexane is reasonably anticipated to be a human carcinogen. (NCI05)
lay_definition_en: A small tube put in the skin to check blood pressure and take samples.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleines Röhrchen, das in die Haut eingeführt wird, um den Blutdruck zu messen und Proben zu entnehmen.

general_definition_en: LIMA
lay_definition_en: A major artery in the chest that doctors use to bypass a clogged heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Arterie im Brustkorb, die Ärzte verwenden, um eine verstopfte Herzarterie zu überbrücken.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: A severe condition that can affect alcoholics when they quit drinking, causing symptoms like tremors and confusion.
lay_definition_de: Ein schwerwiegender Zustand, der bei Alkoholikern auftreten kann, wenn sie mit dem Trinken aufhören, und der Symptome wie Zittern und Verwirrung hervorruft.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: An irregular heart rhythm that can lead to tiredness and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus, der zu Müdigkeit und Schlaganfällen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Immunoglobulin molecules having a specific amino acid sequence by virtue of which they interact only with the ANTIGEN (or a very similar shape) that induced their synthesis in cells of the lymphoid series (especially PLASMA CELLS).
lay_definition_en: A common issue in premature babies where they briefly stop breathing, triggering a low heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein häufiges Problem bei Frühgeborenen, bei dem sie kurzzeitig aufhören zu atmen, was zu einer niedrigen Herzfrequenz führt.

general_definition_en: A widely used non-cardioselective beta-adrenergic antagonist. Propranolol has been used for MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; ARRHYTHMIA; ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; HYPERTHYROIDISM; MIGRAINE; PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA; and ANXIETY but adverse effects instigate replacement by newer drugs.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm problems, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A halter monitor is a portable device that measures your heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Halter-Monitor ist ein tragbares Gerät, das Ihre Herzfrequenz misst.

general_definition_en: lax
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps decrease excess fluid in the body, often prescribed for conditions like heart failure, liver disease, and kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, und häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz, Lebererkrankungen und Nierenerkrankungen verschrieben wird.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A device implanted in the body to monitor heart rate and rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das in den Körper implantiert wird, um Herzfrequenz und Herzrhythmus zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the progressive loss of function and/or structure of the affected tissues. Change in or modification of the systolic or diastolic pressure
lay_definition_en: Degenerative changes happen when things start breaking down or not working as well due to aging or wear and tear.
lay_definition_de: Degenerative Veränderungen treten auf, wenn Dinge aufgrund von Alterung oder Abnutzung anfangen, kaputtzugehen oder nicht mehr so gut zu funktionieren.

general_definition_en: A local anesthetic and cardiac depressant used as an antiarrhythmia agent. Its actions are more intense and its effects more prolonged than those of PROCAINE but its duration of action is shorter than that of BUPIVACAINE or PRILOCAINE.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps reduce pain before an incision is made in the skin.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, die Schmerzen vor dem Einstich in die Haut zu lindern.

general_definition_en: Cath Lab
lay_definition_en: A type of examination and treatment for heart issues that involves inserting a thin tube into an artery near the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchungs- und Behandlungsmethode bei Herzproblemen, bei der ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie in der Nähe des Herzens eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: A medical device that increases myocardial oxygen perfusion while at the same time increasing cardiac output. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: A skinny balloon that helps the heart pump more blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Ballon, der dem Herzen hilft, mehr Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Any anomaly of the P wave of the EKG, which results from atrial depolarization. The P wave occurs when the sinoatrial node creates an action potential that depolarizes the atria. []
lay_definition_en: A P wave is a type of electrical activity in the heart that can show if the upper chambers are working properly.
lay_definition_de: Eine P-Welle ist eine Form der elektrischen Aktivität im Herzen, anhand derer sich feststellen lässt, ob die Herzkammern ordnungsgemäß funktionieren.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding that represents depolarization of the ventricular myocardium. Normally the ventricles are activated simultaneously.
lay_definition_en: Three heart waves indicating ventricular activity on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Drei Herzwellen, die im EKG die ventrikuläre Aktivität anzeigen.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding about the position of the heart in the chest (axis). The electrical axis of the heart is a term used to describe the mean direction and magnitude of electrical impulses generated by the heart during the cardiac cycle. Normally, the heart is positioned in the chest so that the majority of the electrical impulse travels downward (interior) and towards the left. The normal axis of the heart is called normal axis deviation. Age, body build, and sex may influence axis location and produce a number of normal variations. The axis may deviate from normal position due to structural problems (valve conditions), pulmonary or systemic hypertension and/or heart attacks.
lay_definition_en: When the electrical direction of the bottom heart chamber is off.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die elektrische Leitungsrichtung der unteren Herzkammer gestört ist.

general_definition_en: A form of heart block in which the electrical stimulation of HEART VENTRICLES is interrupted at either one of the branches of BUNDLE OF HIS thus preventing the simultaneous depolarization of the two ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A delay or blockage of electrical signals to the left side of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Verzögerung oder Blockade der elektrischen Signale zur linken Herzhälfte.

general_definition_en: A light microscopic finding that describes the cellular characteristics and architectural patterns of cell populations in a tissue sample.
lay_definition_en: Morphology is how the heart's electrical activity looks on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Die Morphologie beschreibt, wie sich die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens im EKG darstellt.

general_definition_en: One of four chambers of the heart, which receives blood from the pulmonary veins and pumps blood through the mitral valve into the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart where blood enters before moving to the left ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Herzens, in den das Blut einströmt, bevor es in die linke Herzkammer gelangt.

general_definition_en: A data type comprised of a text string that can be displayed or machine processed. Change in or modification of the systolic or diastolic pressure
lay_definition_en: ST changes are patterns seen on an EKG that can indicate heart problems.
lay_definition_de: ST-Veränderungen sind Muster im EKG, die auf Herzprobleme hinweisen können.

general_definition_en: A finding of an increase in the jugular venous pressure, as measured by the height of the mean jugular venous waveform above the right atrium.
lay_definition_en: JVP is a pressure in the big vein in the neck that shows how well the heart is pumping blood.
lay_definition_de: Der JVP ist der Druck in der großen Halsvene, der Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie gut das Herz Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Extra heartbeats that start in the lower chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzliche Herzschläge, die in den unteren Herzkammern entstehen.

general_definition_en: An antianginal and class III antiarrhythmic drug. It increases the duration of ventricular and atrial muscle action by inhibiting POTASSIUM CHANNELS and VOLTAGE-GATED SODIUM CHANNELS. There is a resulting decrease in heart rate and in vascular resistance.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps control irregular heartbeats by blocking certain pathways in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, Herzrhythmusstörungen zu kontrollieren, indem es bestimmte Signalwege im Herzen blockiert.

general_definition_en: v
lay_definition_en: A lead in an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ableitung im EKG.

general_definition_en: A laboratory test result indicating an increased amount of cholesterol in the blood.
lay_definition_en: Having lots of cholesterol in your blood can raise your chances of having a heart attack or stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein hoher Cholesterinspiegel im Blut kann das Risiko für einen Herzinfarkt oder einen Schlaganfall erhöhen.

general_definition_en: qt
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart's activity shown on an echocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil der Herzaktivität, der auf einem Echokardiogramm dargestellt wird.

A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.

Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. general_definition_en: An autosomal recessively inherited glycogen storage disease caused by GLUCAN 1,4-ALPHA-GLUCOSIDASE deficiency. Large amounts of GLYCOGEN accumulate in the LYSOSOMES of skeletal muscle (MUSCLE, SKELETAL); HEART; LIVER; SPINAL CORD; and BRAIN. Three forms have been described: infantile, childhood, and adult. The infantile form is fatal in infancy and presents with hypotonia and a hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (CARDIOMYOPATHY, HYPERTROPHIC). The childhood form usually presents in the second year of life with proximal weakness and respiratory symptoms. The adult form consists of a slowly progressive proximal myopathy. (From Muscle Nerve 1995;3:S61-9; Menkes, Textbook of Child Neurology, 5th ed, pp73-4)

MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.

Some patients may have additional features observed in mitochondrial disorders, including pigmentary retinopathy, ptosis, cardiomyopathy, myopathy, renal problems, and neuropsychiatric symptoms.
lay_definition_en: NIDD is when you have type 2 diabetes because you're obese and have high blood sugar.
lay_definition_de: Von NIDD spricht man, wenn man Typ-2-Diabetes hat, weil man übergewichtig ist und einen hohen Blutzuckerspiegel aufweist.

general_definition_en: Precordial pain at rest, which may precede a MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION. Angina pectoris which has not recently changed in frequency, duration or intensity. Stable angina pectoris is relieved by rest or administration or oral, sublingual or transdermal antianginal medications.
lay_definition_en: Tricky chest pain that's more severe and persistent than typical, could signal a heart attack and needs immediate attention.
lay_definition_de: Unklare Brustschmerzen, die stärker und anhaltender sind als üblich, könnten auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeuten und erfordern sofortige ärztliche Hilfe.

general_definition_en: Use or insertion of a tubular device into a duct, blood vessel, hollow organ, or body cavity for injecting or withdrawing fluids for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It differs from INTUBATION in that the tube here is used to restore or maintain patency in obstructions.
lay_definition_en: A procedure where a thin tube is inserted into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed with the purpose of replacing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. aortic valve with a bioprosthetic, homograft, or autograft valve.
lay_definition_en: A surgery done to swap out a faulty heart valve with either a mechanical or tissue valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem eine defekte Herzklappe durch eine mechanische oder eine Gewebeklappe ersetzt wird.

general_definition_en: The calcium salt of atorvastatin, a synthetic lipid-lowering agent. Atorvastatin competitively inhibits hepatic hydroxymethyl-glutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the enzyme which catalyzes the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a key step in cholesterol synthesis. This agent increases the number of LDL receptors on hepatic cell surfaces, enhancing the uptake and catabolism of LDL and reducing LDL production and the number of LDL particles, and lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels. Like other statins, atorvastatin may also display direct antineoplastic activity, possibly by inhibiting farnesylation and geranylgeranylation of proteins such as small GTP-binding proteins, which may result in the arrest of cells in the G1 phase of the cell cycle. This agent may also sensitize tumor cells to cyctostatic drugs, possibly through the mTOR-dependent inhibition of Akt phosphorylation.
lay_definition_en: A medication that reduces bad cholesterol levels to prevent heart-related issues like strokes and heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das den Spiegel des „schlechten“ Cholesterins senkt, um Herzproblemen wie Schlaganfällen und Herzinfarkten vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: Developmental abnormalities in any portion of the ATRIAL SEPTUM resulting in abnormal communications between the two upper chambers of the heart. Classification of atrial septal defects is based on location of the communication and types of incomplete fusion of atrial septa with the ENDOCARDIAL CUSHIONS in the fetal heart. They include ostium primum, ostium secundum, sinus venosus, and coronary sinus defects.
lay_definition_en: A small hole in the heart tissue.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleines Loch im Herzgewebe.

general_definition_en: Developmental abnormalities in any portion of the VENTRICULAR SEPTUM resulting in abnormal communications between the two lower chambers of the heart. Classification of ventricular septal defects is based on location of the communication, such as perimembranous, inlet, outlet (infundibular), central muscular, marginal muscular, or apical muscular defect.
lay_definition_en: A VSD is a heart problem caused by a strange connection between two heart chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein VSD ist eine Herzerkrankung, die durch eine ungewöhnliche Verbindung zwischen zwei Herzkammern verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: The resistance to blood flow offered by the pulmonary vasculature, which is normally one sixth of SVR. The major determinant of PVR is pulmonary vessel constriction, most often caused by hypoxia and/or hypercardia. Prolonged elevated PVR can cause right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks leg artery blood flow without the need for invasive procedures.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, mit dem die Durchblutung der Beinarterien ohne invasive Eingriffe überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: A group of islands consisting of nine coral atolls in the South Pacific Ocean, about one-half of the way from Hawaii to Australia, west of Tokelau and north of Fiji.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve that controls blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert.

general_definition_en: A communication from a clinical trial monitor to a clinical trial investigator following a clinical trial site visit.
lay_definition_en: MVR is surgery to fix the heart valve that lets blood in and out of the heart, replacing it with either a mechanical or tissue valve.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer MVR handelt es sich um einen chirurgischen Eingriff zur Korrektur der Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss in das Herz hinein und aus dem Herz heraus regelt, wobei diese entweder durch eine mechanische oder eine Gewebeklappe ersetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A form of CARDIAC MUSCLE disease, characterized by left and/or right ventricular hypertrophy (HYPERTROPHY, LEFT VENTRICULAR; HYPERTROPHY, RIGHT VENTRICULAR), frequent asymmetrical involvement of the HEART SEPTUM, and normal or reduced left ventricular volume. Risk factors include HYPERTENSION; AORTIC STENOSIS; and gene MUTATION; (FAMILIAL HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY).
lay_definition_en: The heart muscle becomes thicker than usual in hypertropic obstructive cardiomyopathy.
lay_definition_de: Bei der hypertrophen obstruktiven Kardiomyopathie verdickt sich der Herzmuskel stärker als gewöhnlich.

general_definition_en: PERICARDITIS
lay_definition_en: Inflammation with pain, redness, and swelling around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Entzündung mit Schmerzen, Rötung und Schwellung im Bereich des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Abnormally low BLOOD PRESSURE that can result in inadequate blood flow to the brain and other vital organs. Common symptom is DIZZINESS but greater negative impacts on the body occur when there is prolonged depravation of oxygen and nutrients.
lay_definition_en: Low blood pressure means that the blood isn't pushing as hard against the walls of the blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Niedriger Blutdruck bedeutet, dass das Blut nicht so stark gegen die Wände der Blutgefäße drückt.

general_definition_en: Located around the heart or relating to or affecting the pericardium.
lay_definition_en: A layer of tissue that wraps around your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gewebeschicht, die das Herz umgibt.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left atrium and left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A flap in the heart that separates its left sections.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die die linken Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed for the purpose of repairing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. heart valve.
lay_definition_en: Fixing a messed-up heart valve through surgery.
lay_definition_de: Die chirurgische Korrektur einer defekten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a long standing and persistent uncoordinated atrial myocardium activation due to multiple reentry circuits with consequent deterioration of atrial mechanical function. Instead of intermittently contracting, the atria quiver continuously in a chaotic pattern, causing a totally irregular, often tachycardia ventricular rate. On the ECG it is characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape, and timing, associated with an irregular, frequently rapid ventricular response when atrioventricular conduction is intact.
lay_definition_en: AFIB is a heart condition that can make you feel tired and increase your risk of having a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Vorhofflimmern ist eine Herzerkrankung, die zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: Troponin is a protein that helps muscles contract and is released into the blood during heart damage.
lay_definition_de: Troponin ist ein Protein, das die Muskelkontraktion unterstützt und bei einer Herzschädigung ins Blut freigesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A nonmetallic, diatomic gas that is a trace element and member of the halogen family. It is used in dentistry as fluoride (FLUORIDES) to prevent dental caries.
lay_definition_en: A lead used in an ECG to capture the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ableitung, die bei einem EKG verwendet wird, um die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens zu erfassen.

general_definition_en: V4
lay_definition_en: A type of lead that records a specific part of the heart's electrical activity in an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ableitung, die einen bestimmten Teil der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens im EKG aufzeichnet.

general_definition_en: V5
lay_definition_en: V5 is a way to measure the electrical activity of your heart during an ECG.
lay_definition_de: V5 ist eine Methode zur Messung der elektrischen Aktivität Ihres Herzens während eines EKGs.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site at which the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall level with lead V5 at the left midaxillary line.
lay_definition_en: A specific recording tool in an ECG that shows a segment of the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Ein spezielles Aufzeichnungsinstrument im EKG, das einen Ausschnitt der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens anzeigt.

general_definition_en: The number of heartbeats measured per minute time. per minute
lay_definition_en: Heart rate measured in one minute.
lay_definition_de: In einer Minute gemessene Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: right heart failure
lay_definition_en: Right heart failure is when the side of your heart that pumps blood to the lungs can't work properly.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Rechtsherzinsuffizienz spricht man, wenn die Herzhälfte, die das Blut in die Lunge pumpt, nicht mehr richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A clinical syndrome characterized by the development of CHEST PAIN at rest with concomitant transient ST segment elevation in the ELECTROCARDIOGRAM, but with preserved exercise capacity.
lay_definition_en: A type of chest pain that comes and goes while someone is not active, caused by narrowed heart vessels due to muscle contractions.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Brustschmerzen, die im Ruhezustand zeitweise auftreten und wieder verschwinden und durch eine Verengung der Herzgefäße infolge von Muskelkontraktionen verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: Cardiac arrest is when the heart suddenly stops beating.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzstillstand liegt vor, wenn das Herz plötzlich aufhört zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart. Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Systolic CHF refers to the pressure in your arteries when your heart muscle contracts.
lay_definition_de: Unter systolischer Herzinsuffizienz versteht man den Druck in den Arterien, wenn sich der Herzmuskel zusammenzieht.

general_definition_en: A coronary artery that arises from the aorta and bifurcates into the left anterior descending artery and the left circumflex artery.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in the regulation of DNA methylation.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery called LCX.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie namens LCX.

general_definition_en: BRIDE Situated or running side by side; accompaniment to something else.
lay_definition_en: Extra blood vessels that help blood travel around a blocked heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Zusätzliche Blutgefäße, die dafür sorgen, dass das Blut eine verstopfte Herzarterie umgehen kann.

general_definition_en: The blood pressure in the pulmonary artery during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: It's the pressure in your arteries when your heart pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Das ist der Druck in deinen Arterien, wenn dein Herz Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: A potent vasodilator agent with calcium antagonistic action. It is a useful anti-anginal agent that also lowers blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: A medication often taken to help with specific chest pain (angina).
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das häufig zur Linderung bestimmter Brustschmerzen (Angina pectoris) eingenommen wird.

general_definition_en: A transient loss of consciousness and postural tone caused by diminished blood flow to the brain (i.e., BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Presyncope refers to the sensation of lightheadedness and loss of strength that precedes a syncopal event or accompanies an incomplete syncope. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp367-9)
lay_definition_en: When you blackout, you faint or have moments when you're not aware or can't remember what happened.
lay_definition_de: Wenn man einen Blackout hat, wird man ohnmächtig oder erlebt Momente, in denen man sich nichts bewusst ist oder sich nicht daran erinnern kann, was passiert ist.

general_definition_en: An autosomal dominant disorder caused by mutations in a tumor suppressor gene. This syndrome is characterized by abnormal growth of small blood vessels leading to a host of neoplasms. They include HEMANGIOBLASTOMA in the RETINA; CEREBELLUM; and SPINAL CORD; PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA; pancreatic tumors; and renal cell carcinoma (see CARCINOMA, RENAL CELL). Common clinical signs include HYPERTENSION and neurological dysfunctions.
lay_definition_en: A genetic illness causing tumors to develop in various parts of the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, bei der sich Tumore an verschiedenen Stellen des Körpers bilden.

general_definition_en: Rare congenital deformity syndrome characterized by a combination of five anomalies as a result of neural tube defect. The five anomalies are a midline supraumbilical abdominal wall defect (e.g., OMPHALOCELE), a lower STERNUM defect, a congenital intracardiac defect, an anterior DIAPHRAGM defect, and a diaphragmatic PERICARDIUM defect (e.g., PERICARDIAL EFFUSION). Variants with incomplete and variable combinations of the defects are known. ECTOPIA CORDIS; CLEFT LIP; and CLEFT PALATE are often associated with the syndrome.
lay_definition_en: A muscle in your leg that helps you move your foot.
lay_definition_de: Ein Muskel im Bein, der dir hilft, den Fuß zu bewegen.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a regulatory role in megakaryocytopoiesis and platelet formation.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery responsible for supplying blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie, die für die Blutversorgung des Herzens zuständig ist.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Blood vessels that carry oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut von der Lunge zum Herzen transportieren.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Pulmonary veins are the vessels that carry oxygen-rich blood from the lungs to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Lungenvenen sind die Gefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut von der Lunge zum Herzen transportieren.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a myocardial infarction that does not produce elevations in the ST segment of the EKG.
lay_definition_en: A type of heart attack that causes less damage than an ST elevation heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form des Herzinfarkts, die weniger Schäden verursacht als ein Herzinfarkt mit ST-Strecken-Hebung.

general_definition_en: A communication from a clinical trial monitor to a clinical trial investigator following a clinical trial site visit.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to replace the tissue that controls blood flow in the heart with either a mechanical or tissue valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzoperation, bei der das Gewebe, das den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert, durch eine mechanische oder eine Gewebeklappe ersetzt wird.

lay_definition_en: A sudden appearance of symptoms like seizures and headaches caused by brain swelling and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Auftreten von Symptomen wie Krampfanfällen und Kopfschmerzen, die durch eine Hirnschwellung und Bluthochdruck verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: Striated muscle cells found in the heart. They are derived from cardiac myoblasts (MYOBLASTS, CARDIAC).
lay_definition_en: Myofibers are muscle cells.
lay_definition_de: Myofasern sind Muskelzellen.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: Ace is a type of medication that helps to lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ace ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A mechanical pump which also includes a control system and an energy supply. It receives blood from the left ventricle and delivers it to the aorta, thus helping the heart to pump sufficient blood to the body.
lay_definition_en: A heart pump implanted inside the body to help pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzpumpe, die in den Körper implantiert wird, um das Pumpen des Blutes zu unterstützen.

general_definition_en: The 10th cranial nerve. The vagus is a mixed nerve which contains somatic afferents (from skin in back of the ear and the external auditory meatus), visceral afferents (from the pharynx, larynx, thorax, and abdomen), parasympathetic efferents (to the thorax and abdomen), and efferents to striated muscle (of the larynx and pharynx).
lay_definition_en: A nerve that runs from your brain through your neck and chest down to your belly, controlling various functions like heart rate and digestion.
lay_definition_de: Ein Nerv, der vom Gehirn über den Hals und den Brustkorb bis in den Bauch verläuft und verschiedene Funktionen wie die Herzfrequenz und die Verdauung steuert.

general_definition_en: A syndrome associated with damage to the spinal cord above the mid thoracic level (see SPINAL CORD INJURIES) characterized by a marked increase in the sympathetic response to minor stimuli such as bladder or rectal distention. Manifestations include HYPERTENSION; TACHYCARDIA (or reflex bradycardia); FEVER; FLUSHING; and HYPERHIDROSIS. Extreme hypertension may be associated with a STROKE. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp538 and 1232; J Spinal Cord Med 1997;20(3):355-60) - Diseases of the parasympathetic or sympathetic divisions of the AUTONOMIC NERVOUS SYSTEM; which has components located in the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM and PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM. Autonomic dysfunction may be associated with HYPOTHALAMIC DISEASES; BRAIN STEM disorders; SPINAL CORD DISEASES; and PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM DISEASES. Manifestations include impairments of vegetative functions including the maintenance of BLOOD PRESSURE; HEART RATE; pupil function; SWEATING; REPRODUCTIVE AND URINARY PHYSIOLOGY; and DIGESTION.
lay_definition_en: Dysreflexia is a condition causing a sudden spike in blood pressure, often seen in individuals with spinal cord injuries.
lay_definition_de: Dysreflexie ist eine Erkrankung, die einen plötzlichen Blutdruckanstieg verursacht und häufig bei Menschen mit Rückenmarksverletzungen auftritt.

general_definition_en: A potassium sparing diuretic that acts by antagonism of aldosterone in the distal renal tubules. It is used mainly in the treatment of refractory edema in patients with congestive heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, or hepatic cirrhosis. Its effects on the endocrine system are utilized in the treatments of hirsutism and acne but they can lead to adverse effects. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p827)
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps control blood pressure and balance potassium levels by reducing fluid in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das durch die Verringerung der Flüssigkeitsmenge im Körper zur Regulierung des Blutdrucks und zum Ausgleich des Kaliumspiegels beiträgt.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Having to do with the upper part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf den oberen Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia without cardiac electrical activity. Typically, this is accompanied by cessation of the pumping function of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The heart stopped beating.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz hörte auf zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: A type of surgical portasystemic shunt to reduce portal hypertension with associated complications of esophageal varices and ascites. It is performed percutaneously through the jugular vein and involves the creation of an intrahepatic shunt between the hepatic vein and portal vein. The channel is maintained by a metallic stent. The procedure can be performed in patients who have failed sclerotherapy and is an additional option to the surgical techniques of portocaval, mesocaval, and splenorenal shunts. It takes one to three hours to perform. (JAMA 1995;273(23):1824-30)
lay_definition_en: Procedure that creates new blood pathways in a liver with medical problems.
lay_definition_de: Verfahren, bei dem in einer erkrankten Leber neue Blutbahnen geschaffen werden.

general_definition_en: RVEDP
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure inside the heart's ventricle showing risk for heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck im Herzkammerbereich als Indikator für das Risiko einer Herzerkrankung.

general_definition_en: The average blood pressure reading in the pulmonary artery as calculated through multiple cardiac cycles.
lay_definition_en: mPAP is a way to see how well your heart is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Mit mPAP lässt sich feststellen, wie gut Ihr Herz funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The pressure within the left ventricle following the completion of diastolic filling, just prior to systole.
lay_definition_en: Heart ventricle blood pressure indicating risk for heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck in den Herzkammern als Indikator für das Risiko einer Herzerkrankung.

general_definition_en: The blood pressure as recorded after wedging a CATHETER in a small PULMONARY ARTERY; believed to reflect the PRESSURE in the pulmonary CAPILLARIES.
lay_definition_en: A measure of heart function that assesses the performance of specific heart chambers and valves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß für die Herzfunktion, mit dem die Leistung bestimmter Herzkammern und Herzklappen beurteilt wird.

general_definition_en: Air-filled spaces located within the bones around the NASAL CAVITY. They are extensions of the nasal cavity and lined by the ciliated NASAL MUCOSA. Each sinus is named for the cranial bone in which it is located, such as the ETHMOID SINUS; the FRONTAL SINUS; the MAXILLARY SINUS; and the SPHENOID SINUS.
lay_definition_en: The sinus helps regulate a person's heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Der Sinusknoten trägt zur Regulierung der Herzfrequenz eines Menschen bei.

general_definition_en: Enlargement of the LEFT VENTRICLE of the heart. This increase in ventricular mass is attributed to sustained abnormal pressure or volume loads and is a contributor to cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
lay_definition_en: LVH is when the main pumping chamber of the heart gets bigger and thicker.
lay_definition_de: Von einer LVH spricht man, wenn sich die Hauptpumpkammer des Herzens vergrößert und verdickt.

general_definition_en: An insulated electrical conductor designed to connect to an electrocardiogram machine.
lay_definition_en: An ECG is a digital recording that provides a detailed overview of heart function.
lay_definition_de: Ein EKG ist eine digitale Aufzeichnung, die einen detaillierten Überblick über die Herzfunktion liefert.

general_definition_en: A test of fetal well-being performed using a combination of ultrasound parameters (fetal movement, fetal tone, fetal breathing, amniotic fluid) and a non-stress test (NST).
lay_definition_en: A test during pregnancy that checks the health of a baby using heart rate monitoring and ultrasound.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung während der Schwangerschaft, bei der der Gesundheitszustand des Kindes mithilfe von Herzfrequenzmessung und Ultraschall überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: The rhythmical expansion and contraction of an ARTERY produced by waves of pressure caused by the ejection of BLOOD from the left ventricle of the HEART as it contracts.
lay_definition_en: A perp pulse is the heartbeat you can feel in your arms or legs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Perp-Puls ist der Herzschlag, den man in den Armen oder Beinen spüren kann.

general_definition_en: holosystolic murmur
lay_definition_en: A continuous sound in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein anhaltendes Geräusch im Herzen.

general_definition_en: Swelling due to excessive accumulation of fluid under the skin defined by a persistent indentation when pressure is applied to the swollen area. Causes include systemic conditions (e.g., heart failure, liver failure, or kidney failure) and local conditions affecting the extremities.
lay_definition_en: Swelling in the body that doesn't leave an impression when pressed.
lay_definition_de: Eine Schwellung am Körper, die beim Drücken keine Delle hinterlässt.

general_definition_en: V
lay_definition_en: One of the leads that records heart activity in an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine der Ableitungen, die die Herzaktivität in einem EKG aufzeichnet.

general_definition_en: A hypermetabolic syndrome caused by excess THYROID HORMONES which may come from endogenous or exogenous sources. The endogenous source of hormone may be thyroid HYPERPLASIA; THYROID NEOPLASMS; or hormone-producing extrathyroidal tissue. Thyrotoxicosis is characterized by NERVOUSNESS; TACHYCARDIA; FATIGUE; WEIGHT LOSS; heat intolerance; and excessive SWEATING.
lay_definition_en: When you have too much thyroid hormone in your body.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich zu viel Schilddrüsenhormon in Ihrem Körper befindet.

general_definition_en: Cyclopentanophenanthrenes with a 5- or 6-membered lactone ring attached at the 17-position and SUGARS attached at the 3-position. Plants they come from have long been used in congestive heart failure. They increase the force of cardiac contraction without significantly affecting other parameters, but are very toxic at larger doses. Their mechanism of action usually involves inhibition of the NA(+)-K(+)-EXCHANGING ATPASE and they are often used in cell biological studies for that purpose.
lay_definition_en: A type of drug used to treat heart failure that can be harmful if taken in high doses.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzinsuffizienz, das bei Einnahme in hohen Dosen gesundheitsschädlich sein kann.

general_definition_en: aortobifemoral
lay_definition_en: A surgical procedure that connects the aorta with the femoral arteries to treat peripheral arterial disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem die Aorta mit den Oberschenkelarterien verbunden wird, um eine periphere arterielle Verschlusskrankheit zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Precordial pain at rest, which may precede a MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION.
lay_definition_en: Chest pain from reduced blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Brustschmerzen aufgrund einer verminderten Durchblutung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A surgical procedure in which the doctor creates a new pathway for the flow of body fluids.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to create a new route for blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Operative Schaffung eines neuen Blutflusswegs.

general_definition_en: Oversensing manifests as sensing of electrical signals not related to cardiac depolarization of the lead chamber that cannot be resolved acceptably by device reprogramming. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: When a pacemaker picks up on abnormal signals and doesn't function properly.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein Herzschrittmacher abnormale Signale empfängt und nicht ordnungsgemäß funktioniert.

general_definition_en: Capable of being handled or touched or felt.
lay_definition_en: The pulse is the throbbing sensation you can feel in your arteries that shows your heart is beating properly and the artery is clear.
lay_definition_de: Der Puls ist das Pochen, das man in den Arterien spürt und das anzeigt, dass das Herz richtig schlägt und die Arterie frei ist.

general_definition_en: Persistently high systemic arterial BLOOD PRESSURE. Based on multiple readings (BLOOD PRESSURE DETERMINATION), hypertension is currently defined as when SYSTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when DIASTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.
lay_definition_en: When the pressure of blood against blood vessels gets too high, it can cause health issues like heart attacks or strokes, and may also happen during pregnancy.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Blutdruck zu hoch wird, kann dies zu gesundheitlichen Problemen wie Herzinfarkten oder Schlaganfällen führen; dies kann auch während der Schwangerschaft auftreten.

general_definition_en: Restoration of blood supply to tissue which is ischemic due to decrease in normal blood supply. The decrease may result from any source including atherosclerotic obstruction, narrowing of the artery, or surgical clamping. It is primarily a procedure for treating infarction or other ischemia, by enabling viable ischemic tissue to recover, thus limiting further necrosis. However, it is thought that reperfusion can itself further damage the ischemic tissue, causing REPERFUSION INJURY.
lay_definition_en: Reperfusion is the process of restoring blood flow to a tissue or organ.
lay_definition_de: Reperfusion ist der Vorgang, bei dem die Durchblutung eines Gewebes oder Organs wiederhergestellt wird.

general_definition_en: The chloride salt form of thallium-201, a cyclotron produced isotope use in diagnostic imaging. Thallous chloride TI-201 accumulates in myocardial cells and other tissues in an analogous way as potassium, and can be evaluated as a function of blood flow. By scintigraphic means, areas with decreased blood flow, consisting of ischemic cells, can be visualized due to decreased uptake of TI-201 in contrast to areas with normal blood flow.
lay_definition_en: A radioactive substance used in medical imaging to check the heart's blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein radioaktiver Stoff, der in der medizinischen Bildgebung zur Untersuchung des Blutflusses im Herzen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: The muscle of the heart is known as the myocardium.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzmuskel wird als Myokard bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: A line used to administer a substance into an artery
lay_definition_en: A tiny tube inserted into an artery to check blood pressure and draw blood samples.
lay_definition_de: Ein winziger Schlauch, der in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um den Blutdruck zu messen und Blutproben zu entnehmen.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography under conditions intended to elicit signs and symptoms of myocardial ischemia. Conditions often include exercise, pharmacologic agents or pacing.
lay_definition_en: A picture of the heart created using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bild des Herzens, das mithilfe von Schallwellen erstellt wurde.

general_definition_en: An opening located in the septum primum that allows blood to flow directly between the right and left atrium, and which serves as a precursor to the interatrial septum.
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart between two chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Herzens zwischen zwei Kammern.

general_definition_en: Developmental abnormalities in any portion of the ATRIAL SEPTUM resulting in abnormal communications between the two upper chambers of the heart. Classification of atrial septal defects is based on location of the communication and types of incomplete fusion of atrial septa with the ENDOCARDIAL CUSHIONS in the fetal heart. They include ostium primum, ostium secundum, sinus venosus, and coronary sinus defects.
lay_definition_en: A hole in the heart tissue dividing the upper chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Loch im Herzgewebe, das die oberen Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: TropT
lay_definition_en: A protein released when heart muscle is damaged, like in a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, das bei einer Schädigung des Herzmuskels, beispielsweise bei einem Herzinfarkt, freigesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: XACT
lay_definition_en: A type of stent used for the carotid artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Stent, der für die Halsschlagader verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: The placement of an angioplasty guide wire, balloon, or other device (e.g. stent, atherectomy, brachytherapy, or thrombectomy catheter) into a native coronary artery or coronary artery bypass graft for the purpose of mechanical coronary revascularization.
lay_definition_en: PCI is a procedure where a tube is inserted into the heart to check for blockages in the arteries.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer PCI wird ein Katheter in das Herz eingeführt, um die Arterien auf Verstopfungen zu untersuchen.

general_definition_en: imi
lay_definition_en: Damage to the bottom of the left ventricle due to a blockage in the right coronary artery.
lay_definition_de: Schädigung des linken Ventrikelbodens aufgrund einer Verstopfung der rechten Koronararterie.

general_definition_en: Radiographic visualization of the aorta and its branches by injection of contrast media, using percutaneous puncture or catheterization procedures.
lay_definition_en: It's an X-ray of your biggest artery, the aorta.
lay_definition_de: Das ist eine Röntgenaufnahme Ihrer größten Arterie, der Aorta.

general_definition_en: CABBAGE
lay_definition_en: A cabbage is a type of heart surgery that creates an alternate route for blood flow when an artery is blocked.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bypass ist eine Art von Herzoperation, bei der ein alternativer Blutweg geschaffen wird, wenn eine Arterie verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: NON-CORONARY
lay_definition_en: Not related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Hat nichts mit dem Herzen zu tun.

general_definition_en: A group of cardiac arrhythmias in which the cardiac contractions are not initiated at the SINOATRIAL NODE. They include both atrial and ventricular premature beats, and are also known as extra or ectopic heartbeats. Their frequency is increased in heart diseases. beats
lay_definition_en: A skipped or extra heart beat.
lay_definition_de: Ein ausgelassener oder zusätzlicher Herzschlag.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a change in cardiac electrical activity.
lay_definition_en: A test that tracks your heart's electrical activity and rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität und der Rhythmus Ihres Herzens gemessen werden.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by recurrent apneas during sleep despite persistent respiratory efforts. It is due to upper airway obstruction. The respiratory pauses may induce HYPERCAPNIA or HYPOXIA. Cardiac arrhythmias and elevation of systemic and pulmonary arterial pressures may occur. Frequent partial arousals occur throughout sleep, resulting in relative SLEEP DEPRIVATION and daytime tiredness. Associated conditions include OBESITY; ACROMEGALY; MYXEDEMA; micrognathia; MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY; adenotonsilar dystrophy; and NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p395)
lay_definition_en: When you have trouble breathing properly while sleeping due to blockages in your airways.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Sie aufgrund von Verstopfungen in den Atemwegen Probleme haben, im Schlaf richtig zu atmen.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in a blood vessel that can be life-threatening if it tears and causes bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung in einem Blutgefäß, die lebensbedrohlich sein kann, wenn sie reißt und Blutungen verursacht.

lay_definition_en: A sudden group of symptoms like seizures and headaches caused by brain swelling and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Auftreten einer Reihe von Symptomen wie Krampfanfälle und Kopfschmerzen, verursacht durch eine Schwellung des Gehirns und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia without cardiac electrical activity. Typically, this is accompanied by cessation of the pumping function of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Asystole is when the heart stops beating.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Asystolie spricht man, wenn das Herz aufhört zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: It's a medical procedure where a thin tube is placed into a blood vessel to check and fix heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Dabei handelt es sich um einen medizinischen Eingriff, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in ein Blutgefäß eingeführt wird, um Herzprobleme zu untersuchen und zu beheben.

general_definition_en: Being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north. main
lay_definition_en: A major artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: recurrent stenosis; occurs usually after corrective surgery to the orifice of a heart valve.
lay_definition_en: When a blood vessel gets blocked again after being cleared.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein Blutgefäß nach einer Durchgängigkeitsherstellung erneut verstopft.

general_definition_en: The segment of the left circumflex artery that is between the second and third obtuse marginal branches.
lay_definition_en: The circumflex coronary artery supplies blood to the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Die Koronarzirkumflexarterie versorgt den Herzmuskel mit Blut.

general_definition_en: Natural or synthetic beta adrenergic antagonists selectively blocking or diminishing physiologic beta-adrenergic agonist actions on the sympathetic system. This group of antagonists are generally used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety. Check for "https://www.cancer.gov/about-cancer/treatment/clinical-trials/intervention/C29576" active clinical trials using this agent. ("http://ncit.nci.nih.gov/ncitbrowser/ConceptReport.jsp?dictionary=NCI%20Thesaurus&code=C29576" NCI Thesaurus)
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps reduce the heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung der Herzfrequenz beiträgt.

general_definition_en: bowel ischemia
lay_definition_en: When a blocked blood vessel causes reduced blood flow to the intestines.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein verstopftes Blutgefäß zu einer verminderten Durchblutung des Darms führt.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Ventricular means holes in the brain filled with fluid.
lay_definition_de: Als „Ventrikel“ bezeichnet man mit Flüssigkeit gefüllte Hohlräume im Gehirn.

general_definition_en: An imaging technique using compounds labelled with short-lived positron-emitting radionuclides (such as carbon-11, nitrogen-13, oxygen-15 and fluorine-18) to measure cell metabolism. It has been useful in study of soft tissues such as CANCER; CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM; and brain. SINGLE-PHOTON EMISSION-COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY is closely related to positron emission tomography, but uses isotopes with longer half-lives and resolution is lower.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks how your heart works when you exercise.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, bei dem untersucht wird, wie Ihr Herz bei körperlicher Belastung funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A computer application that is used by patients to access, manage, and share their digitally represented health information in a private, secure, and confidential environment.
lay_definition_en: The fastest heart rate you should aim for during exercise.
lay_definition_de: Die höchste Herzfrequenz, die Sie beim Training anstreben sollten.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: A bypass graft is a surgery that creates an alternate route around a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Bypass-Operation wird ein Umgehungsweg um eine verstopfte Arterie herum geschaffen.

general_definition_en: The section of the right coronary artery between the right ventricular artery and the acute marginal artery.
lay_definition_en: Type of bacteria that causes infections and is difficult to treat with conventional antibiotics.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die Infektionen verursacht und mit herkömmlichen Antibiotika nur schwer zu behandeln ist.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries. Extravasation of blood into the arterial wall following a tear in the intima and leading to separation of the layers of the wall.
lay_definition_en: A tear in the largest artery in your body, the aorta, is called aortic dissection and requires immediate medical attention.
lay_definition_de: Ein Riss in der größten Arterie Ihres Körpers, der Aorta, wird als Aortendissektion bezeichnet und erfordert sofortige ärztliche Hilfe.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery. SERIES
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that brings oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: It's a weird connection between arteries and veins that doesn't have the tiny blood vessels between them like it normally would.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine ungewöhnliche Verbindung zwischen Arterien und Venen, bei der die dazwischenliegenden kleinen Blutgefäße fehlen, wie es normalerweise der Fall wäre.

general_definition_en: PFO\AORTIC
lay_definition_en: A hole in the upper heart that typically closes on its own but can be serious if it remains open.
lay_definition_de: Ein Loch im oberen Teil des Herzens, das sich in der Regel von selbst schließt, aber schwerwiegende Folgen haben kann, wenn es offen bleibt.

general_definition_en: VALVE Restoration of an organ or other structure to its original site.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to swap out a damaged heart valve with a new one.
lay_definition_de: Eine Operation, bei der eine beschädigte Herzklappe durch eine neue ersetzt wird.

general_definition_en: PFO\AORTIC
lay_definition_en: A hole between the upper parts of the heart that typically closes by itself in early infancy.
lay_definition_de: Ein Loch zwischen den oberen Herzkammern, das sich in der Regel im frühen Säuglingsalter von selbst schließt.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: It's all about the muscles in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Es dreht sich alles um die Muskeln im Herzen.

general_definition_en: The section of the left anterior descending coronary artery that arises from the left main coronary artery and extends to the first diagonal branch.
lay_definition_en: A part of a big heart artery on the left side.
lay_definition_de: Ein Abschnitt einer großen Herzarterie auf der linken Seite.

general_definition_en: The segment of the left anterior descending (LAD) artery that is distal to the third diagonal branch.
lay_definition_en: A key blood vessel in the heart's left ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Ein wichtiges Blutgefäß im linken Ventrikel des Herzens.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in the regulation of the inflammatory response.
lay_definition_en: A type of artery found in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Arterie, die im Herzen vorkommt.

general_definition_en: The segment of the left anterior descending (LAD) artery between the first and third diagonal branches.
lay_definition_en: The middle section of the biggest heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Der mittlere Abschnitt der größten Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: mid A left coronary artery branch that descends on the anterior portion of the heart through the anterior interventricular groove.
lay_definition_en: The middle portion of the main heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Der mittlere Abschnitt der Hauptherzarterie.

general_definition_en: Thickening and loss of elasticity of the CORONARY ARTERIES, leading to progressive arterial insufficiency (CORONARY DISEASE).
lay_definition_en: Atheroma is a clump of fat and junk that clogs arteries, potentially restricting blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Atherom ist eine Ansammlung von Fett und Ablagerungen, die die Arterien verstopft und dadurch möglicherweise den Blutfluss einschränkt.

general_definition_en: Ctnt
lay_definition_en: A heart protein that is released into the blood due to heart damage, like a heart attack, and is measured to assess heart damage.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzprotein, das bei einer Herzschädigung, beispielsweise einem Herzinfarkt, ins Blut freigesetzt wird und zur Beurteilung des Ausmaßes der Herzschädigung gemessen wird.

general_definition_en: A complication of PREGNANCY, characterized by a complex of symptoms including maternal HYPERTENSION and PROTEINURIA with or without pathological EDEMA. Symptoms may range between mild and severe. Pre-eclampsia usually occurs after the 20th week of gestation, but may develop before this time in the presence of trophoblastic disease.
lay_definition_en: A serious pregnancy condition with high blood pressure and excess fluid in tissues.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwerwiegende Schwangerschaftserkrankung, die durch Bluthochdruck und übermäßige Flüssigkeitsansammlung im Gewebe gekennzeichnet ist.

general_definition_en: The volume of BLOOD passing through the HEART per unit of time. It is usually expressed as liters (volume) per minute so as not to be confused with STROKE VOLUME (volume per beat).
lay_definition_en: The cardiac output is how much blood your heart pumps in a minute.
lay_definition_de: Das Herzzeitvolumen gibt an, wie viel Blut Ihr Herz pro Minute pumpt.

general_definition_en: The two large endothelium-lined venous channels that begin at the internal occipital protuberance at the back and lower part of the CRANIUM and travels laterally and forward ending in the internal jugular vein (JUGULAR VEINS). One of the transverse sinuses, usually the right one, is the continuation of the SUPERIOR SAGITTAL SINUS. The other transverse sinus is the continuation of the straight sinus. Inflammation of the spinal cord. Relatively common etiologies include infections; AUTOIMMUNE DISEASES; SPINAL CORD; and ischemia (see also SPINAL CORD VASCULAR DISEASES). Clinical features generally include weakness, sensory loss, localized pain, incontinence, and other signs of autonomic dysfunction.
lay_definition_en: A condition where inflammation in the spinal cord leads to weakness in the arms and legs.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der eine Entzündung des Rückenmarks zu einer Schwäche in den Armen und Beinen führt.

general_definition_en: Abnormal position of a part or organ. A species of the Beta genus. Cultivars are used as a source of beets (root) or chard (leaves).
lay_definition_en: An extra, abnormal heartbeat caused by an issue in the heart's electrical system.
lay_definition_de: Ein zusätzlicher, abnormaler Herzschlag, der durch eine Störung im elektrischen Leitungssystem des Herzens verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: Simple rapid heartbeats caused by rapid discharge of impulses from the SINOATRIAL NODE, usually between 100 and 180 beats/min in adults. It is characterized by a gradual onset and termination. Sinus tachycardia is common in infants, young children, and adults during strenuous physical activities.
lay_definition_en: Tachy means your heart is beating too fast.
lay_definition_de: „Tachy“ bedeutet, dass Ihr Herz zu schnell schlägt.

general_definition_en: Having a severe and rapid onset of symptoms with short duration. Islands in the Gulf of Guinea, just north of the Equator, and west of Gabon.
lay_definition_en: A severe and critical form of a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwere und lebensbedrohliche Form eines Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: Country in eastern Asia, islands bordering the East China Sea, Philippine Sea, South China Sea, and Taiwan Strait, north of the Philippines, off the southeastern coast of China. The capital is Taipei. The alternate country name is Republic of China.
lay_definition_en: The time it takes for the heart's ventricle to recharge.
lay_definition_de: Die Zeit, die der Herzventrikel benötigt, um sich wieder zu füllen.

general_definition_en: One of the ANGIOTENSIN-CONVERTING ENZYME INHIBITORS (ACE inhibitors), orally active, that has been used in the treatment of hypertension and congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A drug for high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A thiazide diuretic often considered the prototypical member of this class. It reduces the reabsorption of electrolytes from the renal tubules. This results in increased excretion of water and electrolytes, including sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium. It is used in the treatment of several disorders including edema, hypertension, diabetes insipidus, and hypoparathyroidism.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps remove excess fluid from the body, used to treat high blood pressure and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit aus dem Körper auszuscheiden, und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Schwellungen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Use or insertion of a tubular device into a duct, blood vessel, hollow organ, or body cavity for injecting or withdrawing fluids for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes. It differs from INTUBATION in that the tube here is used to restore or maintain patency in obstructions.
lay_definition_en: It's a medical procedure where a thin tube is put into an artery to check and fix heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Dabei handelt es sich um einen medizinischen Eingriff, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzprobleme zu untersuchen und zu beheben.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Having a slower than normal heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschlag, der langsamer ist als normal.

general_definition_en: Impaired impulse conduction from HEART ATRIA to HEART VENTRICLES. AV block can mean delayed or completely blocked impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: AV block means there's an issue with the electrical signals between the upper and lower chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein AV-Block bedeutet, dass ein Problem mit den elektrischen Signalen zwischen der oberen und der unteren Herzkammer vorliegt.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: VPC is a common irregular heartbeat from the bottom chamber of the heart.
lay_definition_de: VPC ist eine häufige Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die von der unteren Herzkammer ausgeht.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A device that keeps track of your health stats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das Ihre Gesundheitsdaten erfasst.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: The radial pulse is the heartbeat you feel on the inner side of your wrist.
