lay_definition_de: Der Radialpuls ist der Herzschlag, den man an der Innenseite des Handgelenks spürt.

general_definition_en: A prostaglandin F analog used to treat OCULAR HYPERTENSION in patients with GLAUCOMA.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce the pressure in the eye, commonly used for treating glaucoma.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Augeninnendrucks beiträgt und häufig zur Behandlung des Glaukoms eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: Imidazole derivative anesthetic and hypnotic with little effect on blood gases, ventilation, or the cardiovascular system. It has been proposed as an induction anesthetic.
lay_definition_en: A drug that makes you fall asleep for surgery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das einen für eine Operation einschlafen lässt.

general_definition_en: A special purpose domain that associates the subject with the medical conclusions contained in the PB domain based on the observations reported in PF. An electrocardiographic finding in which the cardiac rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: When your heart beats too slowly.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz zu langsam schlägt.

general_definition_en: A noninvasive blood pressure measurement system is a device that provides a signal from which systolic, diastolic, mean, or any combination of the three pressures can be derived through the use of tranducers placed on the surface of the body.
lay_definition_en: A method to track blood pressure data continuously for extended durations.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur kontinuierlichen Erfassung von Blutdruckdaten über längere Zeiträume hinweg.

general_definition_en: Delivery of drugs into an artery.
lay_definition_en: Going straight into an artery.
lay_definition_de: Direkt in eine Arterie.

general_definition_en: lpressor
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to a node, any bulge or swelling of an anatomical structure or part.
lay_definition_en: Describing something related to the heart's natural pacemaker known as the sinoatrial node.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf den natürlichen Schrittmacher des Herzens, den sogenannten Sinusknoten.

general_definition_en: apaced
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm with no natural atrial activity that may happen when a pacemaker is in use.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzrhythmus ohne natürliche Vorhofaktivität, der bei Verwendung eines Herzschrittmachers auftreten kann.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart defect characterized by the persistent opening of fetal DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS that connects the PULMONARY ARTERY to the descending aorta (AORTA, DESCENDING) allowing unoxygenated blood to bypass the lung and flow to the PLACENTA. Normally, the ductus is closed shortly after birth.
lay_definition_en: A heart birth defect known as PDA.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzfehler, der als PDA bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A local anesthetic and cardiac depressant used as an antiarrhythmia agent. Its actions are more intense and its effects more prolonged than those of PROCAINE but its duration of action is shorter than that of BUPIVACAINE or PRILOCAINE. A salt that is comprised of a hydrogen and chloride ion that can be linked to a base form of a drug making it water-soluble. (NCI)
lay_definition_en: A drug given before surgery to numb the area and reduce pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das vor einer Operation verabreicht wird, um den Bereich zu betäuben und Schmerzen zu lindern.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: Procedure to widen a narrowed blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Verfahren zur Erweiterung eines verengten Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: The movement of the BLOOD as it is pumped through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM. volume
lay_definition_en: The amount of liquid flowing through your blood vessels and heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Flüssigkeitsmenge, die durch Ihre Blutgefäße und Ihr Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: CASP8 and FADD-like apoptosis regulator isoform 2 (221 aa, ~25 kDa) is encoded by the human CFLAR gene. This protein is involved in the regulation of caspase-dependent apoptosis.
lay_definition_en: T flips show up on EKG heart tests and could indicate a heart issue.
lay_definition_de: T-Wellen-Umkehrungen sind im EKG zu erkennen und können auf ein Herzproblem hindeuten.

general_definition_en: late-peaking
lay_definition_en: A late-peaking is a murmur that happens at the end of the heart's contraction and could indicate a problem with the mitral valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein spätes Herzgeräusch ist ein Geräusch, das am Ende der Herzkontraktion auftritt und auf ein Problem mit der Mitralklappe hindeuten könnte.

general_definition_en: Precordial pain at rest, which may precede a MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION.
lay_definition_en: A crescendo is like a heart murmur that gets louder and stronger over time.
lay_definition_de: Ein Crescendo ist wie ein Herzgeräusch, das mit der Zeit immer lauter und kräftiger wird.

general_definition_en: decrescendo
lay_definition_en: A decrescendo is when a heart murmur gets quieter.
lay_definition_de: Ein Decrescendo liegt vor, wenn ein Herzgeräusch leiser wird.

general_definition_en: A combination of two synthetic agents with central nervous system stimulant activity. Both agents are non-catecholamine, sympathomimetic agents that elevate blood pressure and cause bronchodilation. These agents are commonly abused psychostimulant drugs that induce psychologic dependence manifested by elevated mood, increased wakefulness, concentration, physical performance and a feeling of well-being. Tolerance to various effects develops unequally, so that tachycardia and enhanced alertness diminish while psychotoxic effects (hallucinations and delusions) may occur. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps with medical issues by giving an energy boost.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei gesundheitlichen Problemen hilft, indem es einen Energieschub verleiht.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the inability of the heart to pump blood at an adequate volume to meet tissue metabolic requirements, or, the ability to do so only at an elevation in the filling pressure.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz hat Schwierigkeiten, das Blut effizient zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: It's the top number in blood pressure readings showing artery pressure when the heart contracts.
lay_definition_de: Das ist der obere Wert bei der Blutdruckmessung, der den Druck in den Arterien angibt, wenn sich das Herz zusammenzieht.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive method that uses a CT scanner for capturing images of blood vessels and tissues. A CONTRAST MATERIAL is injected, which helps produce detailed images that aid in diagnosing VASCULAR DISEASES.
lay_definition_en: A procedure that takes pictures of blood vessels from the inside.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem Blutgefäße von innen abgebildet werden.

general_definition_en: Enlargement of the HEART, usually indicated by a cardiothoracic ratio above 0.50. Heart enlargement may involve the right, the left, or both HEART VENTRICLES or HEART ATRIA. Cardiomegaly is a nonspecific symptom seen in patients with chronic systolic heart failure (HEART FAILURE) or several forms of CARDIOMYOPATHIES.
lay_definition_en: When someone's heart is bigger than it should be.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz eines Menschen größer ist, als es sein sollte.

general_definition_en: A disease of the heart muscle or myocardium proper whose cause is unknown.
lay_definition_en: A condition that affects the heart muscle, making it more difficult for the heart to efficiently pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die den Herzmuskel beeinträchtigt und es dem Herzen erschwert, Blut effizient zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: An expected natural death from a cardiac cause. This condition usually occurs in persons with pre-existing cardiac abnormalities or disease.
lay_definition_en: When the heart stops beating out of nowhere, blood flow to important body parts also stops, leading to sudden cardiac death.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz plötzlich aufhört zu schlagen, wird auch die Blutversorgung wichtiger Körperteile unterbrochen, was zum plötzlichen Herztod führt.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG). equip
lay_definition_en: Tools used in healthcare to keep track of a patient's vital signs and health status.
lay_definition_de: Instrumente, die im Gesundheitswesen eingesetzt werden, um die Vitalparameter und den Gesundheitszustand eines Patienten zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: flutter line
lay_definition_en: The flutter line is where there's an electrical short circuit in the heart during atrial flutter.
lay_definition_de: Die Flutterlinie ist der Bereich, in dem während eines Vorhofflatterns ein elektrischer Kurzschluss im Herzen auftritt.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: A procedure to widen a narrow blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Ein Eingriff zur Erweiterung eines verengten Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: A surgery that adds a new vein to bypass clogged heart vessels to maintain blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem eine neue Vene eingesetzt wird, um verstopfte Herzgefäße zu umgehen und so den Blutfluss aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: The blood vessel that supplies the breast and the anterior chest wall with arterial blood. It is located in the chest wall.
lay_definition_en: It's a blood vessel that provides blood to the breast and front chest.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein Blutgefäß, das die Brust und den vorderen Brustkorb mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A left coronary artery branch that descends on the anterior portion of the heart through the anterior interventricular groove.
lay_definition_en: One of the heart's arteries.
lay_definition_de: Eine der Herzarterien.

general_definition_en: cardio - Care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities associated with the cardiopulmonary system. It includes the therapeutic use of medical gases and their administrative apparatus, environmental control systems, humidification, aerosols, ventilatory support, bronchopulmonary drainage and exercise, respiratory rehabilitation, assistance with cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and maintenance of natural, artificial, and mechanical airways. The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: An emergency procedure to restart a person's heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Notfallverfahren zur Wiederbelebung des Herzens einer Person.

general_definition_en: A technique that utilizes a wire attached to the fetal scalp to monitor fetal heart rate. The wire detects fetal cardiac electrical activity to determine the baseline fetal heart rate and variability.
lay_definition_en: FSE is a way to capture MRI images quickly.
lay_definition_de: FSE ist ein Verfahren zur schnellen Aufnahme von MRT-Bildern.

general_definition_en: A heterogeneous group of sporadic or familial disorders characterized by AMYLOID deposits in the walls of small and medium sized blood vessels of CEREBRAL CORTEX and MENINGES. Clinical features include multiple, small lobar CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; cerebral ischemia (BRAIN ISCHEMIA); and CEREBRAL INFARCTION. Cerebral amyloid angiopathy is unrelated to generalized AMYLOIDOSIS. Amyloidogenic peptides in this condition are nearly always the same ones found in ALZHEIMER DISEASE. (from Kumar: Robbins and Cotran: Pathologic Basis of Disease, 7th ed., 2005)
lay_definition_en: A condition where protein fragments accumulate in the brain, commonly found in Alzheimer's and other forms of dementia.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem sich Proteinfragmente im Gehirn ansammeln; dies tritt häufig bei Alzheimer und anderen Formen der Demenz auf.

general_definition_en: A type of surgical portasystemic shunt to reduce portal hypertension with associated complications of esophageal varices and ascites. It is performed percutaneously through the jugular vein and involves the creation of an intrahepatic shunt between the hepatic vein and portal vein. The channel is maintained by a metallic stent. The procedure can be performed in patients who have failed sclerotherapy and is an additional option to the surgical techniques of portocaval, mesocaval, and splenorenal shunts. It takes one to three hours to perform. (JAMA 1995;273(23):1824-30)
lay_definition_en: The end of something.
lay_definition_de: Das Ende von etwas.

general_definition_en: A direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to help with chest pain, high blood pressure, and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Brustschmerzen, Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A congenital anomaly caused by the failed development of TRUNCUS ARTERIOSUS into separate AORTA and PULMONARY ARTERY. It is characterized by a single arterial trunk that forms the outlet for both HEART VENTRICLES and gives rise to the systemic, pulmonary, and coronary arteries. It is always accompanied by a ventricular septal defect.
lay_definition_en: A medical treatment where a balloon is used to clear a clogged artery and restore blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinisches Verfahren, bei dem mithilfe eines Ballons eine verstopfte Arterie freigemacht und der Blutfluss wiederhergestellt wird.

general_definition_en: pocket site
lay_definition_en: A pocket site is where a pacemaker can be placed, usually below the collarbone.
lay_definition_de: Eine Implantationsstelle ist die Stelle, an der ein Herzschrittmacher eingesetzt werden kann, in der Regel unterhalb des Schlüsselbeins.

general_definition_en: Dilation of an occluded coronary artery (or arteries) by means of a balloon catheter to restore myocardial blood supply.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure that widens a narrowed blood vessel using a balloon.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein verengtes Blutgefäß mithilfe eines Ballons erweitert wird.

general_definition_en: A paced
lay_definition_en: A paced rhythm is when a pacemaker controls the heart's rhythm without natural activity from the atria.
lay_definition_de: Ein stimulierter Rhythmus liegt vor, wenn ein Herzschrittmacher den Herzrhythmus steuert, ohne dass eine natürliche Aktivität der Vorhöfe stattfindet.

general_definition_en: A state of internal activity of an organism that is a necessary condition before a given stimulus will elicit a class of responses; e.g., a certain level of hunger (drive) must be present before food will elicit an eating response. bts
lay_definition_en: Heart beats that start naturally, not from a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Herzschläge, die auf natürliche Weise entstehen und nicht von einem Herzschrittmacher ausgelöst werden.

general_definition_en: coreg
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure and heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Herzprobleme.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart. A hole or opening made through a membrane or other tissue or material.
lay_definition_en: Accidental heart holes made during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Während einer Operation versehentlich entstandene Löcher im Herzen.

general_definition_en: The standard deviations of the sample in a frequency distribution, obtained by dividing the standard deviation by the square root of the total number of cases in the frequency distribution.
lay_definition_en: Abnormal sound of blood flow caused by a narrowed vessel or irregular heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ungewöhnliches Geräusch des Blutflusses, verursacht durch eine Gefäßverengung oder eine Herzklappenfehlbildung.

general_definition_en: A cardiotonic glycoside obtained mainly from Digitalis lanata; it consists of three sugars and the aglycone DIGOXIGENIN. Digoxin has positive inotropic and negative chronotropic activity. It is used to control ventricular rate in ATRIAL FIBRILLATION and in the management of congestive heart failure with atrial fibrillation. Its use in congestive heart failure and sinus rhythm is less certain. The margin between toxic and therapeutic doses is small. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p666)
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with heartbeat issues and certain heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Herzproblemen hilft.

general_definition_en: The segment of the left anterior descending (LAD) artery between the first and third diagonal branches.
lay_definition_en: It's the middle part of a heart artery called the left anterior descending.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um den mittleren Abschnitt einer Herzarterie, die als „linke vordere absteigende Arterie“ bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in transcription and growth.
lay_definition_en: A coronary artery that helps supply blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzkranzarterie, die zur Blutversorgung des Herzens beiträgt.

general_definition_en: pace maker
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a small device in your chest that helps control your heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein kleines Gerät in Ihrer Brust, das dabei hilft, Ihre Herzfrequenz zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: A potent calcium channel blockader with marked vasodilator action. It has antihypertensive properties and is effective in the treatment of angina and coronary spasms without showing cardiodepressant effects. It has also been used in the treatment of asthma and enhances the action of specific antineoplastic agents.
lay_definition_en: Medication that lowers high blood pressure and can help with chest pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das hohen Blutdruck senkt und bei Brustschmerzen helfen kann.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to bypass a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Herzoperation zur Umgehung einer verstopften Arterie.

general_definition_en: q
lay_definition_en: Heart's electrical activity, which may become irregular after a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens, die nach einem Herzinfarkt unregelmäßig werden kann.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: A medical test and treatment where a long tube is placed into an artery to check and fix heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine medizinische Untersuchung und Behandlung, bei der ein langer Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzprobleme zu untersuchen und zu beheben.

general_definition_en: An expandable hollow tube that is advanced into an obstructed or narrow coronary artery to restore blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_en: Putting a tube in a heart artery to clear a blockage.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch wird in eine Herzarterie eingeführt, um eine Verstopfung zu beseitigen.

general_definition_en: PRESSURE of the BLOOD on the ARTERIES and other BLOOD VESSELS.
lay_definition_en: The pressure of blood against artery walls when the heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Der Druck, den das Blut beim Schlagen des Herzens auf die Arterienwände ausübt.

general_definition_en: Abnormally rapid heartbeat, usually with a HEART RATE above 100 beats per minute for adults. Tachycardia accompanied by disturbance in the cardiac depolarization (cardiac arrhythmia) is called tachyarrhythmia. ventricular rate
lay_definition_en: a fast and irregular heart rate due to rapid ventricular contractions
lay_definition_de: ein schneller und unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus aufgrund schneller ventrikulärer Kontraktionen

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia without discernible P waves and an irregular ventricular response due to multiple reentry circuits. The rhythm disturbance originates above the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: Atrial fibrillation is when your heart beats in a weird way that can make you tired and increase your risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern schlägt Ihr Herz auf ungewöhnliche Weise, was zu Müdigkeit führen und Ihr Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: The calculated average time period between the recording of a Q wave on ECG and the onset of the aortic blood pressure pulse as determined over a number of cardiac cycles during a given interval of time.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps with epilepsy seizures.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei epileptischen Anfällen hilft.

lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with heart rhythm issues and certain heart failure cases.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Formen der Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: 0.5mcg
lay_definition_en: A low dose of medication to help heart muscle function better for heart failure or pulmonary hypertension patients.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament in niedriger Dosierung, das bei Patienten mit Herzinsuffizienz oder pulmonaler Hypertonie die Funktion des Herzmuskels verbessert.

general_definition_en: The second day of the week; the first working day.
lay_definition_en: A procedure using a thin tube inserted into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: or
lay_definition_en: A ventricular assist device is a mechanical pump that helps a damaged heart pump blood more effectively.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzunterstützungssystem ist eine mechanische Pumpe, die einem geschädigten Herzen hilft, Blut effektiver zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in extracellular signal transduction that is coupled to transcriptional responses. - Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help the heart pump more efficiently by lowering heart rate and blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die dem Herzen helfen, effizienter zu pumpen, indem sie die Herzfrequenz und den Blutdruck senken.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by failure of the left ventricle to produce adequate output.
lay_definition_en: The main part of the heart isn't functioning properly.
lay_definition_de: Der Hauptteil des Herzens funktioniert nicht richtig.

general_definition_en: An optical isomer of quinine, extracted from the bark of the CHINCHONA tree and similar plant species. This alkaloid dampens the excitability of cardiac and skeletal muscles by blocking sodium and potassium currents across cellular membranes. It prolongs cellular ACTION POTENTIALS, and decreases automaticity. Quinidine also blocks muscarinic and alpha-adrenergic neurotransmission.
lay_definition_en: Medicine used to treat malaria.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Malaria.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: When the heart stops, that's cardiac arrested.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz aufhört zu schlagen, spricht man von einem Herzstillstand.

general_definition_en: The wire which connects a pacemaker or defibrillator to the atrial tissue. Rhthym
lay_definition_en: Atrial rhythm is an irregular heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Vorhofrhythmus ist ein unregelmäßiger Herzschlag.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: A heart condition that weakens the heart's ability to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, die die Fähigkeit des Herzens beeinträchtigt, Blut effektiv zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography under conditions intended to elicit signs and symptoms of myocardial ischemia. Conditions often include exercise, pharmacologic agents or pacing.
lay_definition_en: An echo is a heart image created using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Echo ist eine Herzdarstellung, die mithilfe von Schallwellen erstellt wird.

general_definition_en: Hardening of the KIDNEY due to infiltration by fibrous connective tissue (FIBROSIS), usually caused by renovascular diseases or chronic HYPERTENSION. Nephrosclerosis leads to renal ISCHEMIA.
lay_definition_en: Thickening of bone during the healing process.
lay_definition_de: Knochenverdickung während des Heilungsprozesses.

general_definition_en: The movement of the BLOOD as it is pumped through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: Blood flowing through your body.
lay_definition_de: Das Blut, das durch deinen Körper fließt.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A monitor is a device that tracks your health information.
lay_definition_de: Ein Monitor ist ein Gerät, das Ihre Gesundheitsdaten erfasst.

general_definition_en: Extravasation of blood into the arterial wall following a tear in the intima and leading to separation of the layers of the wall.
lay_definition_en: A dissection is like a tear or split in an artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Dissektion ist wie ein Riss oder eine Spalte in einer Arterie.

general_definition_en: arch shaped bony structure of the foot
lay_definition_en: The arch is the curved portion of the aorta above the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Aortenbogen ist der gekrümmte Abschnitt der Aorta oberhalb des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The left ventricular volume calculated as the difference between the epicardium delimited volume and the left ventricular chamber volume.
lay_definition_en: The main pump in the heart that sends blood to the body.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptpumpe im Herzen, die das Blut in den Körper pumpt.

lay_definition_en: A drug that helps control high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei der Kontrolle von Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: Procedures using an electrically heated wire or scalpel to treat hemorrhage (e.g., bleeding ulcers) and to ablate tumors, mucosal lesions, and refractory arrhythmias. It is different from ELECTROSURGERY which is used more for cutting tissue than destroying and in which the patient is part of the electric circuit.
lay_definition_en: A procedure that uses electric current heat to destroy tissue for medical purposes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem Gewebe zu medizinischen Zwecken mithilfe von durch elektrischen Strom erzeugter Wärme zerstört wird.

general_definition_en: Blood pressure within the left atrium. It is commonly measured indirectly by a pulmonary capillary wedge pressure.
lay_definition_en: The pressure of the blood in the right atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck im rechten Vorhof des Herzens.

lay_definition_en: A sudden group of symptoms like seizures and headaches caused by brain swelling and linked to high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Auftreten einer Reihe von Symptomen wie Krampfanfälle und Kopfschmerzen, die durch eine Schwellung des Gehirns verursacht werden und mit Bluthochdruck in Zusammenhang stehen.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: It's one of the top chambers in the heart where blood comes back to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Es ist eine der wichtigsten Kammern im Herzen, in die das Blut zum Herzen zurückfließt.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The AV valve is where the heart pushes blood through to maintain one-way flow in the body's largest artery.
lay_definition_de: Über die AV-Klappe pumpt das Herz Blut weiter, um den Einwegfluss in der größten Arterie des Körpers aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: Problem associated with the loss of the minimum amount of energy, voltage, or current needed to consistently stimulate the heart muscle.
lay_definition_en: A threshold is a setting used to adjust a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schwellenwert ist eine Einstellung, mit der ein Herzschrittmacher angepasst wird.

general_definition_en: A volatile vasodilator which relieves ANGINA PECTORIS by stimulating GUANYLATE CYCLASE and lowering cytosolic calcium. It is also sometimes used for TOCOLYSIS and explosives. tube
lay_definition_en: A tube inserted through the nose into the stomach for feeding, medication, or removing contents.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der durch die Nase in den Magen eingeführt wird, um den Patienten zu ernähren, ihm Medikamente zu verabreichen oder Mageninhalt zu entnehmen.

general_definition_en: Albumin protein in urine samples, which is a marker for kidney dysfunction. Persistently elevated concentrations of albumin in the urine can be diagnostic for kidney damage caused by diabetes, high blood pressure, heart failure, cirrhosis, or lupus.
lay_definition_en: A protein produced by the liver that helps maintain fluid balance in the bloodstream and transports nutrients throughout the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein von der Leber gebildetes Protein, das zur Aufrechterhaltung des Flüssigkeitshaushalts im Blutkreislauf beiträgt und Nährstoffe durch den Körper transportiert.

general_definition_en: A class of agents that act by selectively inhibiting angiotensin II receptor activation in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system. Angiotensin II receptor antagonists bind to and block the activation of angiotensin II type 1 (AT1) receptors, thereby reducing production and secretion of aldosterone, amongst other actions. The combined effects result in reduction of blood pressure. Although this class of agents is also used in diabetic nephropathy (kidney damage due to diabetes) and congestive heart failure, it is primarily used for the treatment of hypertension in cases where the patient is intolerant of ACE inhibitor therapy.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps to lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: Change of heartbeat induced by pressure on the eyeball, manipulation of extraocular muscles, or pressure upon the tissue remaining in the orbital apex after enucleation.
lay_definition_en: When you put pressure on your eye, your heart rate may slow down.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Sie Druck auf Ihr Auge ausüben, kann sich Ihre Herzfrequenz verlangsamen.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: Proteins that show up in the blood when the heart is damaged.
lay_definition_de: Proteine, die bei einer Schädigung des Herzens im Blut nachweisbar sind.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood in CHF.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzinsuffizienz (CHF) hat das Herz Schwierigkeiten, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A surgical specialty that focuses on diagnosis and management of disorders of the arterial, venous and lymphatic systems, other than the intracranial vessels and the heart.
lay_definition_en: Vascular surgeries fix blood vessel problems through operations.
lay_definition_de: In der Gefäßchirurgie werden Probleme mit den Blutgefäßen durch Operationen behoben.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes or diseases where cerebral MICROVESSELS show abnormalities. They are often associated with aging, hypertension and risk factors for lacunar infarcts (see LACUNAR INFARCTION); LEUKOARAIOSIS; and CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: When small blood vessels are diseased.
lay_definition_de: Wenn kleine Blutgefäße erkrankt sind.

general_definition_en: aortosphaenous
lay_definition_en: A surgery that uses a vein from the leg to bypass a blocked heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem eine Vene aus dem Bein verwendet wird, um eine verstopfte Herzarterie zu überbrücken.

general_definition_en: Heart murmurs which are systolic in timing. They occur between the first and the second HEART SOUNDS, between the closure of MITRAL VALVE and TRICUSPID VALVE and the closure of semilunar aortic and pulmonary valves. Systolic murmurs include ejection murmurs and regurgitant murmurs.
lay_definition_en: Sound of blood flowing through a tight or irregular heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Geräusch von Blut, das durch eine verengte oder unregelmäßige Herzklappe fließt.

general_definition_en: A dihydropyridine calcium antagonist with positive inotropic effects. It lowers blood pressure by reducing peripheral vascular resistance through a highly selective action on smooth muscle in arteriolar resistance vessels.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A local anesthetic and cardiac depressant used as an antiarrhythmia agent. Its actions are more intense and its effects more prolonged than those of PROCAINE but its duration of action is shorter than that of BUPIVACAINE or PRILOCAINE.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps fix problems with your heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft.

general_definition_en: An imbalance between myocardial functional requirements and the capacity of the CORONARY VESSELS to supply sufficient blood flow. It is a form of MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA (insufficient blood supply to the heart muscle) caused by a decreased capacity of the coronary vessels.
lay_definition_en: CAD is when your heart's blood vessels get clogged and can be deadly if not treated.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer koronaren Herzkrankheit (KHK) verstopfen die Blutgefäße des Herzens, was unbehandelt tödlich enden kann.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart. -
lay_definition_en: When an artery and a vein are surgically joined together.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Arterie und eine Vene chirurgisch miteinander verbunden werden.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive test usually done during the third trimester to check for fetal well being. It is performed using an external fetal heart rate monitor to assess the fetal heart rate response to fetal movements.
lay_definition_en: Checking how well your heart functions under pressure by making it work harder through exercise or medication.
lay_definition_de: Überprüfung der Herzfunktion unter Belastung, indem das Herz durch körperliche Betätigung oder Medikamente stärker beansprucht wird.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Pulmonary arteries transport blood from the heart to the lungs for oxygenation.
lay_definition_de: Die Lungenarterien transportieren Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge, wo es mit Sauerstoff angereichert wird.

general_definition_en: Unroofed coronary sinus (CS) is a rare congenital cardiac anomaly in which there is partial (either focal or fenestrated) or complete absence of the roof of the CS, which results in a communication between the CS and the LA. Unroofed CS is the rarest type of atrial septal defect. It is often associated with persistent left superior vena cava (LSVC) and other forms of complex congenital heart disease, usually heterotaxia syndromes. The morphological types have been classified into 4 groups: Type I, completely unroofed with persistent LSVC; type II, completely unroofed without persistent LSVC; type III, partially unroofed mid portion; and type IV, partially unroofed terminal portion. [PMID:19398672]
lay_definition_en: Unroofed means removing the top to open up.
lay_definition_de: „Unroofed“ bedeutet, das Dach abzunehmen, um den Raum zu öffnen.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: A CVA is when a stroke occurs, causing damage to brain tissue due to a lack of blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein CVA liegt vor, wenn ein Schlaganfall auftritt, der aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung zu einer Schädigung des Hirngewebes führt.

general_definition_en: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia that is characterized by uncoordinated extremely rapid firing of electrical impulses (400-600/min) in HEART VENTRICLES. Such asynchronous ventricular quivering or fibrillation prevents any effective cardiac output and results in unconsciousness (SYNCOPE). It is one of the major electrocardiographic patterns seen with CARDIAC ARREST.
lay_definition_en: A dangerous type of irregular heartbeat that can disrupt blood circulation.
lay_definition_de: Eine gefährliche Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die den Blutkreislauf beeinträchtigen kann.

general_definition_en: Application of a life support system that circulates the blood through an oxygenating system, which may consist of a pump, a membrane oxygenator, and a heat exchanger. Examples of its use are to assist victims of SMOKE INHALATION INJURY; RESPIRATORY FAILURE; and CARDIAC FAILURE.
lay_definition_en: It's like a super machine helping with heart and lung function.
lay_definition_de: Es ist wie eine Supermaschine, die die Herz- und Lungenfunktion unterstützt.

general_definition_en: The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: A life-saving technique to restart someone's heart during an emergency.
lay_definition_de: Eine lebensrettende Methode, um das Herz einer Person in einer Notfallsituation wieder zum Schlagen zu bringen.

general_definition_en: An individual trained and certified to provide all basic and intermediate life support measures in addition to using invasive medical procedures (including intravenous therapy, cardiac defibrillation, administering medications and solutions, and using ventilation devices) as dictated by state law and performed under medical control in case of medical emergencies, hazardous materials exposure, child birth, abuse, fires, flood, accidents, trauma, and psychiatric crises.
lay_definition_en: Someone who is trained to help and transport sick people in emergencies.
lay_definition_de: Jemand, der dafür ausgebildet ist, kranken Menschen in Notfällen zu helfen und sie zu transportieren.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: When the heart beats too slowly, it's called AV block.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz zu langsam schlägt, spricht man von einem AV-Block.

general_definition_en: transpulmonary gradient
lay_definition_en: A measure of blood pressure in the lung artery that can show if there is a heart issue.
lay_definition_de: Eine Messung des Blutdrucks in der Lungenarterie, anhand derer sich feststellen lässt, ob ein Herzproblem vorliegt.

general_definition_en: The resistance to blood flow offered by the pulmonary vasculature, which is normally one sixth of SVR. The major determinant of PVR is pulmonary vessel constriction, most often caused by hypoxia and/or hypercardia. Prolonged elevated PVR can cause right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: The resistance in the blood vessels between the lungs and the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Widerstand in den Blutgefäßen zwischen Lunge und Herz.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: Heart attack: when the heart muscle dies due to lack of oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Herzinfarkt: Wenn der Herzmuskel aufgrund von Sauerstoffmangel abstirbt.

general_definition_en: Cardiolite
lay_definition_en: A substance used for a test to detect heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz, die bei einer Untersuchung zum Nachweis von Herzerkrankungen verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Abnormally high systolic blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure is when the force of blood in your arteries becomes too high.
lay_definition_de: Von Bluthochdruck spricht man, wenn der Druck des Blutes in den Arterien zu hoch wird.

general_definition_en: Any doughnut-shaped device.
lay_definition_en: A ring is a circular band used to fix a heart valve's size and shape.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ring ist ein kreisförmiges Band, mit dem Größe und Form einer Herzklappe fixiert werden.

general_definition_en: Implantable devices which continuously monitor the electrical activity of the heart and automatically detect and terminate ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) and VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. They consist of an impulse generator, batteries, and electrodes.
lay_definition_en: An ICD is a small device implanted in the body to correct irregular heart rhythms by delivering a tiny electric shock when needed.
lay_definition_de: Ein ICD ist ein kleines Gerät, das in den Körper implantiert wird, um Herzrhythmusstörungen zu korrigieren, indem es bei Bedarf einen winzigen Stromstoß abgibt.

general_definition_en: Natural or synthetic Antihypertensive Preparations reduce elevated blood pressure through diverse mechanisms: calcium channel (and conductance) blockage, beta- and alpha-adrenergic blockage, angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibition, etc.. Their effects induce diuresis and peripheral vasodilation. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: Medicine used to decrease high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Intensely discomforting, distressful, or agonizing sensation associated with trauma or disease, with well-defined location, character, and timing. NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: A heart attack is when the heart doesn't get enough blood suddenly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt tritt auf, wenn das Herz plötzlich nicht mehr ausreichend mit Blut versorgt wird.

general_definition_en: EKG
lay_definition_en: A test that checks the electrical activity of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität Ihres Herzens überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: It's a test to check how well your heart is working, used for those who can't do a treadmill test.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um einen Test zur Überprüfung der Herzfunktion, der bei Personen durchgeführt wird, die keinen Laufbandtest absolvieren können.

general_definition_en: A rating scale included in the Behavior Assessment System for Children that measures mood swings, bizarre thought, subjective experiences associated with obsessive compulsive disorder, and odd behaviors in the subject. Agents that control agitated psychotic behavior, alleviate acute psychotic states, reduce psychotic symptoms, and exert a quieting effect. They are used in SCHIZOPHRENIA; senile dementia; transient psychosis following surgery; or MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; etc. These drugs are often referred to as neuroleptics alluding to the tendency to produce neurological side effects, but not all antipsychotics are likely to produce such effects. Many of these drugs may also be effective against nausea, emesis, and pruritus.
lay_definition_en: A type of medication to help with mental health issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei psychischen Problemen hilft.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography under conditions intended to elicit signs and symptoms of myocardial ischemia. Conditions often include exercise, pharmacologic agents or pacing.
lay_definition_en: A picture of the heart created using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bild des Herzens, das mithilfe von Schallwellen erstellt wurde.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: An extra heartbeat that starts in the heart's lower chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein zusätzlicher Herzschlag, der in den unteren Herzkammern entsteht.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of an atypical cardiac rhythm resulting from a pathologic process in the cardiac ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A dysrhythmia is when your heart beats differently than usual.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung liegt vor, wenn Ihr Herz anders als gewöhnlich schlägt.

general_definition_en: An adrenergic beta-antagonist that is used in the treatment of life-threatening arrhythmias.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps with heart rhythm issues, belonging to the group of beta blockers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft und zur Gruppe der Betablocker gehört.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a tiny device placed inside your body to keep your heart beating properly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein winziges Gerät, das in Ihren Körper eingesetzt wird, um einen regelmäßigen Herzrhythmus aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive method that uses a CT scanner for capturing images of blood vessels and tissues. A CONTRAST MATERIAL is injected, which helps produce detailed images that aid in diagnosing VASCULAR DISEASES.
lay_definition_en: A test that takes a picture of the blood vessels in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der eine Aufnahme der Blutgefäße im Gehirn angefertigt wird.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample. inhibitors
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps open up blood vessels and reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, die Blutgefäße zu erweitern und hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: Receptors in the vascular system, particularly the aorta and carotid sinus, which are sensitive to stretch of the vessel walls.
lay_definition_en: A medication that raises blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das den Blutdruck erhöht.

general_definition_en: An endocrine disorder characterized by excessive production of aldosterone by the adrenal glands. Causes include adrenal gland adenoma and adrenal gland hyperplasia. The overproduction of aldosterone results in sodium and water retention and hypokalemia. Patients present with high blood pressure, muscle weakness, and headache.
lay_definition_en: A hormonal disorder where too much aldosterone is released, causing high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Eine Hormonstörung, bei der zu viel Aldosteron ausgeschüttet wird, was zu Bluthochdruck führt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a change in cardiac electrical activity.
lay_definition_en: It's a test that shows how your heart's electricity is doing.
lay_definition_de: Bei diesem Test wird untersucht, wie die elektrische Aktivität Ihres Herzens aussieht.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that takes oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head through the neck.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen über den Hals zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A small tube inserted into a blood vessel near the heart to check for diseases or monitor treatment progress.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner Schlauch, der in ein Blutgefäß in der Nähe des Herzens eingeführt wird, um nach Erkrankungen zu suchen oder den Behandlungsfortschritt zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Arteries that bring blood to your heart.
lay_definition_de: Arterien, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: An octapeptide that is a potent but labile vasoconstrictor. It is produced from angiotensin I after the removal of two amino acids at the C-terminal by ANGIOTENSIN CONVERTING ENZYME. The amino acid in position 5 varies in different species. To block VASOCONSTRICTION and HYPERTENSION effect of angiotensin II, patients are often treated with ACE INHIBITORS or with ANGIOTENSIN II TYPE 1 RECEPTOR BLOCKERS.
lay_definition_en: Angiotensin is a substance that constricts blood vessels and increases blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Angiotensin ist eine Substanz, die die Blutgefäße verengt und den Blutdruck erhöht.

general_definition_en: Signs and symptoms related to acute ischemia of the myocardium secondary to coronary artery disease. The clinical presentation covers a spectrum of heart diseases from unstable angina to myocardial infarction.
lay_definition_en: Sudden blockage of blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Plötzliche Unterbrechung der Blutversorgung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A monitor is a machine that checks a patient's important health signs and alerts if something is not right.
lay_definition_de: Ein Monitor ist ein Gerät, das die wichtigen Vitalparameter eines Patienten überwacht und Alarm auslöst, wenn etwas nicht in Ordnung ist.

general_definition_en: Onset of HYPERREFLEXIA; SEIZURES; or COMA in a previously diagnosed pre-eclamptic patient (PRE-ECLAMPSIA).
lay_definition_en: Seizures during or after pregnancy caused by high blood pressure and other issues.
lay_definition_de: Krampfanfälle während oder nach der Schwangerschaft, die durch Bluthochdruck und andere Ursachen hervorgerufen werden.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving the HEART including its structural and functional abnormalities.
lay_definition_en: Heart disease is a health problem that impacts the heart or blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankungen sind Gesundheitsprobleme, die das Herz oder die Blutgefäße betreffen.

general_definition_en: The part of the brain that connects the CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES with the SPINAL CORD. It consists of the MESENCEPHALON; PONS; and MEDULLA OBLONGATA.
lay_definition_en: The brain stem controls vital functions like breathing and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Der Hirnstamm steuert lebenswichtige Funktionen wie die Atmung und die Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: wide complex tachycardias
lay_definition_en: Fast heart rate with prolonged QRS complex on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Schnelle Herzfrequenz mit verlängertem QRS-Komplex im EKG.

general_definition_en: A coronary artery that originates above the right coronary cusp and supplies blood predominantly to the right side of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel on the right side of the heart that brings blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß auf der rechten Seite des Herzens, das Blut zum Herzen führt.

general_definition_en: treadmill stress test
lay_definition_en: A treadmill stress test checks if your heart is working properly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Laufband-Belastungstest dient dazu, zu überprüfen, ob Ihr Herz ordnungsgemäß funktioniert.

general_definition_en: Postoperative hemorrhage from an endovascular AORTIC ANEURYSM repaired with endoluminal placement of stent grafts (BLOOD VESSEL PROSTHESIS IMPLANTATION). It is associated with pressurization, expansion, and eventual rupture of the aneurysm.
lay_definition_en: Endoleak is a complication that can happen after surgery to fix blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Endoleak ist eine Komplikation, die nach einer Operation zur Behandlung von Blutgefäßerkrankungen auftreten kann.

general_definition_en: Apparatus that provides mechanical circulatory support during open-heart surgery, by passing the heart to facilitate surgery on the organ. The basic function of the machine is to oxygenate the body's venous supply of blood and then pump it back into the arterial system. The machine also provides intracardiac suction, filtration, and temperature control. Some of the more important components of these machines include pumps, oxygenators, temperature regulators, and filters. (UMDNS, 1999)
lay_definition_en: Using a machine to pump blood during heart surgery.
lay_definition_de: Einsatz einer Maschine zur Blutumwälzung während einer Herzoperation.

general_definition_en: A procedure to stop the contraction of MYOCARDIUM during HEART SURGERY. It is usually achieved with the use of chemicals (CARDIOPLEGIC SOLUTIONS) or cold temperature (such as chilled perfusate).
lay_definition_en: Stoppping the heart intentionally during heart surgery.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz während einer Herzoperation absichtlich zum Stillstand bringen.

general_definition_en: Radioactive substances added in minute amounts to the reacting elements or compounds in a chemical process and traced through the process by appropriate detection methods, e.g., Geiger counter. Compounds containing tracers are often said to be tagged or labeled. (Hawley's Condensed Chemical Dictionary, 12th ed) iodine
lay_definition_en: A treatment given for thyroid issues that impact heart rate and other important functions.
lay_definition_de: Eine Behandlung bei Schilddrüsenproblemen, die sich auf die Herzfrequenz und andere wichtige Funktionen auswirken.

general_definition_en: The act of dilating.
lay_definition_en: Predilate means to widen an artery before a heart procedure.
lay_definition_de: „Predilate“ bedeutet, eine Arterie vor einem Herz Eingriff zu erweitern.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: Angioplasty is a procedure that widens a narrowed blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Die Angioplastie ist ein Eingriff, bei dem ein verengtes Blutgefäß erweitert wird.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: Doing a surgery again to open up a narrow blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Erneut eine Operation durchführen, um ein verengt Blutgefäß zu erweitern.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION in which the anterior wall of the heart is involved. Anterior wall myocardial infarction is often caused by occlusion of the left anterior descending coronary artery. It can be categorized as anteroseptal or anterolateral wall myocardial infarction. cerebral
lay_definition_en: It's a blood vessel that supplies blood to the brain.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein Blutgefäß, das das Gehirn mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of AORTA.
lay_definition_en: When a big blood vessel near your heart gets swollen, it's called AAA.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich ein großes Blutgefäß in der Nähe des Herzens ausbeult, spricht man von einem AAA.

general_definition_en: An identifier for a drug for which administration has ended. - eluting Devices that provide support for tubular structures that are being anastomosed or for body cavities during skin grafting.
lay_definition_en: A drug-eluting stent slowly releases medication to keep a blocked artery open.
lay_definition_de: Ein medikamentenbeschichteter Stent gibt nach und nach Wirkstoffe ab, um eine verstopfte Arterie offen zu halten.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: An area on the upper chest below the collarbone.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bereich im oberen Brustbereich unterhalb des Schlüsselbeins.

general_definition_en: A layer of epithelium that lines the heart, blood vessels (ENDOTHELIUM, VASCULAR), lymph vessels (ENDOTHELIUM, LYMPHATIC), and the serous cavities of the body.
lay_definition_en: The lining cells found inside the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Die Auskleidungszellen, die im Inneren des Herzens und der Blutgefäße zu finden sind.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of three or more consecutive complexes of ventricular origin with a rate less than a certain threshold (100 or 120 beats per minute are commonly used). The QRS complexes are wide and have an abnormal morphology. (CDISC) paced
lay_definition_en: Heart rhythm set by the heart's ventricles determining the heartbeat speed.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzrhythmus wird von den Herzkammern bestimmt, die die Herzfrequenz festlegen.

general_definition_en: Intraocular hemorrhage from the vessels of various tissues of the eye. A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: Sudden bleeding in or around the brain that can be more serious than a regular stroke.
lay_definition_de: Plötzliche Blutungen im oder um das Gehirn herum, die schwerwiegender sein können als ein gewöhnlicher Schlaganfall.

general_definition_en: A non-essential amino acid present abundantly throughout the body and is involved in many metabolic processes. It is synthesized from GLUTAMIC ACID and AMMONIA. It is the principal carrier of NITROGEN in the body and is an important energy source for many cells. - A unit of exposure to ionizing radiation in CGS system. One roentgen is the amount of gamma or x-rays required to produce ions resulting in a charge of 2.58E-4 coulombs/kilogram of air under standard conditions. axis
lay_definition_en: A way to show how electricity moves in the heart on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Möglichkeit, anhand eines EKGs zu veranschaulichen, wie sich der Strom im Herzen ausbreitet.

general_definition_en: V-V offset
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker setting that adjusts the timing between the heart's two ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmacher-Einstellung, die das Timing zwischen den beiden Herzkammern reguliert.

general_definition_en: The hemodynamic and electrophysiological action of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: How well the main part of the heart pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Wie gut der Hauptteil des Herzens Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: Bleeding into one or both CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES including the BASAL GANGLIA and the CEREBRAL CORTEX. It is often associated with HYPERTENSION and CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA.
lay_definition_en: Bleeding inside the brain, a type of stroke.
lay_definition_de: Eine Blutung im Gehirn, eine Form des Schlaganfalls.

general_definition_en: To cease by degrees; decrease; diminish. -
lay_definition_en: A technique for coronary bypasses that doesn't require a heart-lung bypass machine.
lay_definition_de: Eine Technik für Koronarbypässe, bei der keine Herz-Lungen-Maschine erforderlich ist.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: The right atrial is the upper chamber of the heart that receives blood from the body and head.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Vorhof ist die obere Herzkammer, die das Blut aus dem Körper und dem Kopf aufnimmt.

general_definition_en: P
lay_definition_en: An abnormal heart activity that may indicate an issue with the upper chambers of the heart when seen on an electrocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Eine abnormale Herzaktivität, die im Elektrokardiogramm auf ein Problem mit den oberen Herzkammern hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: An abnormally rapid ventricular rhythm usually in excess of 150 beats per minute. It is generated within the ventricle below the BUNDLE OF HIS, either as autonomic impulse formation or reentrant impulse conduction. Depending on the etiology, onset of ventricular tachycardia can be paroxysmal (sudden) or nonparoxysmal, its wide QRS complexes can be uniform or polymorphic, and the ventricular beating may be independent of the atrial beating (AV dissociation).
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm problem where the lower chambers beat too quickly, affecting blood pumping.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung, bei der die unteren Herzkammern zu schnell schlagen, was die Blutförderung beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, letting blood leak back into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, fließt Blut zurück ins Herz.

general_definition_en: An electrical current applied to the HEART to terminate a CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA.
