lay_definition_de: Das Blutkreislaufsystem in der Niere.

general_definition_en: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a simvastatin stimulus. Simvastatin is a statin used as a cholesterol-lowering and anti-cardiovascular disease drug. [GO_REF:0000071, GOC:sl, GOC:TermGenie, PMID:23100282]
lay_definition_en: A pill that helps reduce high levels of fat in your blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Tablette, die dabei hilft, einen hohen Fettgehalt im Blut zu senken.

general_definition_en: Softening or loss of brain tissue following CEREBRAL INFARCTION; cerebral ischemia (see BRAIN ISCHEMIA), infection, CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA, or other injury. The term is often used during gross pathologic inspection to describe blurred cortical margins and decreased consistency of brain tissue following infarction. Multicystic encephalomalacia refers to the formation of multiple cystic cavities of various sizes in the cerebral cortex of neonates and infants following injury, most notably perinatal hypoxia-ischemic events. (From Davis et al., Textbook of Neuropathology, 2nd ed, p665; J Neuropathol Exp Neurol, 1995 Mar;54(2):268-75)
lay_definition_en: Brain tissue getting soft or damaged after injury or illness.
lay_definition_de: Gehirngewebe, das nach einer Verletzung oder Erkrankung weich wird oder geschädigt ist.

general_definition_en: The vein accompanying the femoral artery in the same sheath; it is a continuation of the popliteal vein and becomes the external iliac vein.
lay_definition_en: Veins in the legs that bring blood back to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Venen in den Beinen, die das Blut zum Herzen zurücktransportieren.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A cluster of unique cells that regulate heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gruppe einzigartiger Zellen, die die Herzfrequenz regulieren.

general_definition_en: Isopropyl analog of EPINEPHRINE; beta-sympathomimetic that acts on the heart, bronchi, skeletal muscle, alimentary tract, etc. It is used mainly as bronchodilator and heart stimulant.
lay_definition_en: A medicine for low heart rate, heart block, and sometimes asthma.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel gegen Herzrhythmusstörungen, Herzblock und manchmal auch Asthma.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left atrium and left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A flap in the heart that helps control blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die zur Regulierung des Blutflusses beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close correctly, causing blood to flow back into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, sodass Blut zurück ins Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the PULMONARY ARTERY into the RIGHT VENTRICLE due to imperfect closure of the PULMONARY VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When the heart valve allowing blood flow from the right ventricle to the lungs leaks, causing blood to flow back into the heart instead of reaching the lungs for oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss vom rechten Ventrikel in die Lunge ermöglicht, undicht ist, fließt das Blut zurück ins Herz, anstatt zur Sauerstoffaufnahme in die Lunge zu gelangen.

general_definition_en: Increase in size of the left atrium. []
lay_definition_en: When the top left chamber of the heart is bigger than usual, it can cause problems like stroke and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die obere linke Herzkammer größer als normal ist, kann dies zu Problemen wie einem Schlaganfall und Herzinsuffizienz führen.

general_definition_en: Peptide Elongation Factor 2 catalyzes the translocation of peptidyl-tRNA from the A site to the P site of eukaryotic ribosomes by a process linked to the hydrolysis of GTP to GDP.
lay_definition_en: How well the heart pumps blood, measured to diagnose heart failure, ideally falls between 50 and 70 percent.
lay_definition_de: Die Pumpleistung des Herzens, die zur Diagnose einer Herzinsuffizienz gemessen wird, liegt im Idealfall zwischen 50 und 70 Prozent.

general_definition_en: A conical fibro-serous sac surrounding the HEART and the roots of the great vessels (AORTA; VENAE CAVAE; PULMONARY ARTERY). Pericardium consists of two sacs: the outer fibrous pericardium and the inner serous pericardium. The latter consists of an outer parietal layer facing the fibrous pericardium, and an inner visceral layer (epicardium) resting next to the heart, and a pericardial cavity between these two layers.
lay_definition_en: The pericardium is like a two-layer protective bag around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Perikard ist wie ein zweischichtiger Schutzbeutel, der das Herz umgibt.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: A protein in your blood that shows up when your muscles get hurt.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein im Blut, das auftritt, wenn Ihre Muskeln verletzt werden.

general_definition_en: A class of agents that act by selectively inhibiting angiotensin II receptor activation in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system. Angiotensin II receptor antagonists bind to and block the activation of angiotensin II type 1 (AT1) receptors, thereby reducing production and secretion of aldosterone, amongst other actions. The combined effects result in reduction of blood pressure. Although this class of agents is also used in diabetic nephropathy (kidney damage due to diabetes) and congestive heart failure, it is primarily used for the treatment of hypertension in cases where the patient is intolerant of ACE inhibitor therapy.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps lower blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A form of creatine kinase found in the BRAIN.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower high blood pressure and decrease heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, hohen Blutdruck zu senken und die Herzfrequenz zu verringern.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of brain natriuretic peptide present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: A test that measures heart function based on levels of BNP in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, bei dem die Herzfunktion anhand des BNP-Spiegels im Blut gemessen wird.

general_definition_en: A class of lipoproteins of small size (4-13 nm) and dense (greater than 1.063 g/ml) particles. HDL lipoproteins, synthesized in the liver without a lipid core, accumulate cholesterol esters from peripheral tissues and transport them to the liver for re-utilization or elimination from the body (the reverse cholesterol transport). Their major protein component is APOLIPOPROTEIN A-I. HDL also shuttle APOLIPOPROTEINS C and APOLIPOPROTEINS E to and from triglyceride-rich lipoproteins during their catabolism. HDL plasma level has been inversely correlated with the risk of cardiovascular diseases.
lay_definition_en: It's a good cholesterol that takes bad stuff away.
lay_definition_de: Es ist das „gute“ Cholesterin, das die „schlechten“ Stoffe abbaut.

general_definition_en: A class of lipoproteins of very light (0.93-1.006 g/ml) large size (30-80 nm) particles with a core composed mainly of TRIGLYCERIDES and a surface monolayer of PHOSPHOLIPIDS and CHOLESTEROL into which are imbedded the apolipoproteins B, E, and C. VLDL facilitates the transport of endogenously made triglycerides to extrahepatic tissues. As triglycerides and Apo C are removed, VLDL is converted to INTERMEDIATE-DENSITY LIPOPROTEINS, then to LOW-DENSITY LIPOPROTEINS from which cholesterol is delivered to the extrahepatic tissues.
lay_definition_en: A component in the blood that transports fat and can raise the risk of heart disease and stroke when levels are elevated.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bestandteil des Blutes, der Fett transportiert und bei erhöhten Werten das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und Schlaganfälle steigern kann.

general_definition_en: A vasodilator used in the treatment of ANGINA PECTORIS. Its actions are similar to NITROGLYCERIN but with a slower onset of action.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps to prevent chest pain in people with a heart condition by widening blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das durch die Erweiterung der Blutgefäße dazu beiträgt, Brustschmerzen bei Menschen mit einer Herzerkrankung vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: A mechanical pump which also includes a control system and an energy supply. It receives blood from the left ventricle and delivers it to the aorta, thus helping the heart to pump sufficient blood to the body.
lay_definition_en: An LVAD is a special pump that goes inside your body to help your heart work better.
lay_definition_de: Ein LVAD ist eine spezielle Pumpe, die in Ihren Körper eingesetzt wird, um die Herzfunktion zu unterstützen.

general_definition_en: An echocardiograph is a device that uses ultrasonic energy to create images of cardiovascular structures. It includes phased arrays and two-dimensional scanners.
lay_definition_en: An echocardiogram is a non-invasive test that uses sound waves to create images of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Echokardiogramm ist eine nichtinvasive Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe von Schallwellen Bilder des Herzens erstellt werden.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography.
lay_definition_en: A heart picture taken using sound waves from outside the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzaufnahme, die mithilfe von Schallwellen von außerhalb des Körpers aufgenommen wurde.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: Where the aorta connects to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Stelle, an der die Aorta mit dem Herzen verbunden ist.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES. Diameter
lay_definition_en: It's a way of gauging how big a specific part of the heart is.
lay_definition_de: Auf diese Weise lässt sich feststellen, wie groß ein bestimmter Teil des Herzens ist.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: An atrium is a top chamber in the heart for blood to flow back into.
lay_definition_de: Ein Vorhof ist eine obere Herzkammer, in die das Blut zurückfließt.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
lay_definition_en: Diastolic is the pressure in your arteries when your heart is at rest between beats, as it fills with blood and oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Der diastolische Druck ist der Druck in Ihren Arterien, wenn sich Ihr Herz zwischen zwei Schlägen in Ruhe befindet und sich mit Blut und Sauerstoff füllt.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: The aortic is where the main blood vessel connects to the heart.
lay_definition_de: An der Aorta mündet das Hauptblutgefäß in das Herz.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Where blood goes into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wo das Blut ins Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: bumex
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps the body get rid of excess salt and water to treat conditions like high blood pressure and kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das dem Körper hilft, überschüssiges Salz und Wasser auszuscheiden, um Erkrankungen wie Bluthochdruck und Nierenerkrankungen zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Lanoxin
lay_definition_en: A medication for irregular heartbeat and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Herzrhythmusstörungen und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A vasodilator used in the treatment of ANGINA PECTORIS. Its actions are similar to NITROGLYCERIN but with a slower onset of action. mononitrate
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps reduce chest pain by relaxing blood vessels and improving blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das Brustschmerzen lindert, indem es die Blutgefäße entspannt und die Durchblutung des Herzens verbessert.

general_definition_en: Branch of the common carotid artery which supplies the exterior of the head, the face, and the greater part of the neck.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that brings oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES; VEINS; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.
lay_definition_en: A vascular disease is any illness that impacts the body's blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gefäßerkrankung ist jede Erkrankung, die die Blutgefäße des Körpers betrifft.

general_definition_en: recurrent stenosis; occurs usually after corrective surgery to the orifice of a heart valve.
lay_definition_en: A condition where a blood vessel narrows again.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem sich ein Blutgefäß erneut verengt.

general_definition_en: Care which provides integrated, accessible health care services by clinicians who are accountable for addressing a large majority of personal health care needs, developing a sustained partnership with patients, and practicing in the context of family and community. (JAMA 1995;273(3):192) Team of hospital doctors and nurses who respond immediately to patients suffering cardiac arrest.
lay_definition_en: The main doctors in charge of a patient's treatment at the hospital.
lay_definition_de: Die für die Behandlung eines Patienten im Krankenhaus hauptverantwortlichen Ärzte.

general_definition_en: Extravasation of blood into the arterial wall following a tear in the intima and leading to separation of the layers of the wall.
lay_definition_en: A dissection is a tear in an artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Dissektion ist ein Riss in einer Arterie.

general_definition_en: A compound consisting of dark green crystals or crystalline powder, having a bronze-like luster. Solutions in water or alcohol have a deep blue color. Methylene blue is used as a bacteriologic stain and as an indicator. It inhibits GUANYLATE CYCLASE, and has been used to treat cyanide poisoning and to lower levels of METHEMOGLOBIN. - A transferase that catalyzes formation of PHOSPHOCREATINE from ATP + CREATINE. The reaction stores ATP energy as phosphocreatine. Three cytoplasmic ISOENZYMES have been identified in human tissues: the MM type from SKELETAL MUSCLE, the MB type from myocardial tissue and the BB type from nervous tissue as well as a mitochondrial isoenzyme. Macro-creatine kinase refers to creatine kinase complexed with other serum proteins.
lay_definition_en: A heart enzyme released in the blood during heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzenzym, das bei Herzinfarkten ins Blut freigesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: The portion of the aorta following the aortic arch passing into the chest and abdomen creating the thoracic and abdominal segments. The portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta and extending to the DIAPHRAGM, eventually connecting to the ABDOMINAL AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The descending thoracic aorta is the section of the main artery as it travels down through the chest.
lay_definition_de: Die absteigende Brustaorta ist der Abschnitt der Hauptschlagader, der durch den Brustkorb nach unten verläuft.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The pulmonary artery is a big blood vessel that takes oxygen-depleted blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Die Lungenarterie ist ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: A malignant form of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia that is characterized by HEART RATE between 200 and 250 beats per minute, and QRS complexes with changing amplitude and twisting of the points. The term also describes the syndrome of tachycardia with prolonged ventricular repolarization, long QT intervals exceeding 500 milliseconds or BRADYCARDIA. Torsades de pointes may be self-limited or may progress to VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. A malignant form of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia that is characterized by HEART RATE between 200 and 250 beats per minute, and QRS complexes with changing amplitude and twisting of the points. The term also describes the syndrome of tachycardia with prolonged ventricular repolarization, long QT intervals exceeding 500 milliseconds or BRADYCARDIA. Torsades de pointes may be self-limited or may progress to VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION.
lay_definition_en: A scary and rare abnormal heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein beängstigender und seltener Herzrhythmusfehler.

general_definition_en: The succinate salt form of metoprolol, a cardioselective competitive beta-1 adrenergic receptor antagonist with antihypertensive properties and devoid of intrinsic sympathomimetic activity. Metoprolol succinate antagonizes beta 1-adrenergic receptors in the myocardium, thereby reducing the rate and force of myocardial contraction, and consequently a diminished cardiac output. This agent may also reduce the secretion of renin with subsequent reduction in levels of angiotensin II thus decreasing sympathetic activation, including vasoconstriction, aldosterone secretion.
lay_definition_en: a medication used for heart conditions like chest pain, irregular heartbeats, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen wie Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A rapid or irregular heartbeat that a person can feel.
lay_definition_en: Palpitations are when your heart beats fast, strong, or irregularly due to reasons like stress or illness.
lay_definition_de: Von Herzklopfen spricht man, wenn das Herz aufgrund von Stress oder einer Erkrankung schnell, stark oder unregelmäßig schlägt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a tachycardia which does not originate in the ventricles or His Purkinje system. There is an abnormally high heart rate and QRS complexes are typically narrow, but aberration or preexcitation may be present. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A fast heartbeat due to wonky electrical signals in the top part of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein schneller Herzschlag aufgrund von Störungen der elektrischen Signale im oberen Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Disturbance, impairment or abnormality of function.
lay_definition_en: Not working properly.
lay_definition_de: Funktioniert nicht richtig.

general_definition_en: PRINIVIL
lay_definition_en: PRINIVIL is a medication for high blood pressure and heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: PRINIVIL ist ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Herzerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: Cells that line the inner and outer surfaces of the body by forming cellular layers (EPITHELIUM) or masses. Epithelial cells lining the SKIN; the MOUTH; the NOSE; and the ANAL CANAL derive from ectoderm; those lining the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM and the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM derive from endoderm; others (CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM and LYMPHATIC SYSTEM) derive from mesoderm. Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Cells that form the outer layers of the body inside and out.
lay_definition_de: Zellen, die die äußeren Schichten des Körpers innen und außen bilden.

general_definition_en: Cells that line the inner and outer surfaces of the body by forming cellular layers (EPITHELIUM) or masses. Epithelial cells lining the SKIN; the MOUTH; the NOSE; and the ANAL CANAL derive from ectoderm; those lining the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM and the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM derive from endoderm; others (CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM and LYMPHATIC SYSTEM) derive from mesoderm. Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Skin-related or surface-lining cells.
lay_definition_de: Hautzellen oder Zellen der Oberflächenauskleidung.

general_definition_en: A chronic form of cutaneous lupus erythematosus (LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, CUTANEOUS) in which the skin lesions mimic those of the systemic form but in which systemic signs are rare. It is characterized by the presence of discoid skin plaques showing varying degrees of edema, erythema, scaliness, follicular plugging, and skin atrophy. Lesions are surrounded by an elevated erythematous border. The condition typically involves the face and scalp, but widespread dissemination may occur. anticoagulant
lay_definition_en: An antibody that can increase the risk of blood clots, stroke, and heart attack in some people with lupus.
lay_definition_de: Ein Antikörper, der bei manchen Menschen mit Lupus das Risiko für Blutgerinnsel, Schlaganfälle und Herzinfarkte erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of AORTA.
lay_definition_en: It's when the main blood vessel leaving the heart bulges and can tear, leading to life-threatening internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Dies ist der Fall, wenn sich das Hauptblutgefäß, das vom Herzen ausgeht, ausbeult und reißen kann, was zu lebensbedrohlichen inneren Blutungen führt.

general_definition_en: An eccentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the abdominal aorta that involves only a portion of the circumference of the vessel wall. []
lay_definition_en: A bulge in the main blood vessel in the belly that can tear and lead to dangerous internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung des Hauptblutgefäßes im Bauchraum, die reißen und zu gefährlichen inneren Blutungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: CAVOATRIAL A functional unit located near the cell apex at the points of contact between epithelial cells, which in vertebrates is composed of the tight junction, the zonula adherens, and desmosomes and in some invertebrates, such as Drosophila, is composed of the subapical complex (SAC), the zonula adherens and the septate junction. Functions in the regulation of cell polarity, tissue integrity and intercellular adhesion and permeability. [GOC:go_curators, GOC:kmv, PMID:12525486, PMID:15196556]
lay_definition_en: A spot in the heart where the superior vena cava joins the right atrium's upper wall.
lay_definition_de: Eine Stelle im Herzen, an der die obere Hohlvene in die obere Wand des rechten Vorhofs mündet.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: An area on your upper chest just below your collarbone.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bereich an der oberen Brust, direkt unterhalb des Schlüsselbeins.

general_definition_en: A beta-adrenergic antagonist that is similar in action to PROPRANOLOL; the levo-isomer is more active. Timolol has been proposed as an anti-hypertensive, anti-arrhythmic, anti-angina, and anti-glaucoma agent. It is also used in the treatment of MIGRAINE DISORDERS and tremor. maleate
lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat high blood pressure and glaucoma.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und Glaukom.

general_definition_en: A hypermetabolic syndrome caused by excess THYROID HORMONES which may come from endogenous or exogenous sources. The endogenous source of hormone may be thyroid HYPERPLASIA; THYROID NEOPLASMS; or hormone-producing extrathyroidal tissue. Thyrotoxicosis is characterized by NERVOUSNESS; TACHYCARDIA; FATIGUE; WEIGHT LOSS; heat intolerance; and excessive SWEATING.
lay_definition_en: When your thyroid gland releases too many hormones, it can make your heart race and cause sweating.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihre Schilddrüse zu viele Hormone ausschüttet, kann dies zu Herzrasen und Schweißausbrüchen führen.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Cardiovascular means related to blood vessels and the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Kardiovaskulär“ bedeutet „die Blutgefäße und das Herz betreffend“.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Atrium is the entrance chamber for blood in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Vorhof ist die Einlasskammer für das Blut im Herzen.

general_definition_en: His
lay_definition_en: The heart's natural pacemaker controlling the heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Der natürliche Schrittmacher des Herzens, der den Herzschlag steuert.

general_definition_en: The branch of the right coronary artery that supplies blood to the right ventricular wall.
lay_definition_en: A heart chamber on the right side.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzkammer auf der rechten Seite.

general_definition_en: Outflow part of ventricle which is continuous with the aorta.
lay_definition_en: The part of the heart ventricle right before the blood goes into the artery.
lay_definition_de: Der Teil des Herzventrikels, der unmittelbar vor dem Eintritt des Blutes in die Arterie liegt.

general_definition_en: pacing Problem associated with the loss of the minimum amount of energy, voltage, or current needed to consistently stimulate the heart muscle.
lay_definition_en: A measurement of how efficiently a pacemaker keeps the heart beating.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effizient ein Herzschrittmacher den Herzschlag aufrechterhält.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve. VALVE
lay_definition_en: A valve in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: leads
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker wire.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmacher-Elektrode.

general_definition_en: tpa
lay_definition_en: An enzyme that breaks down blood clots in heart attack and stroke treatments.
lay_definition_de: Ein Enzym, das bei der Behandlung von Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen Blutgerinnsel auflöst.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: It's like a stroke, when part of your brain doesn't get enough blood and gets hurt.
lay_definition_de: Das ist wie bei einem Schlaganfall, wenn ein Teil des Gehirns nicht ausreichend durchblutet wird und Schaden nimmt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a long standing and persistent uncoordinated atrial myocardium activation due to multiple reentry circuits with consequent deterioration of atrial mechanical function. Instead of intermittently contracting, the atria quiver continuously in a chaotic pattern, causing a totally irregular, often tachycardia ventricular rate. On the ECG it is characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape, and timing, associated with an irregular, frequently rapid ventricular response when atrioventricular conduction is intact.
lay_definition_en: An irregular heartbeat that can make you feel tired and increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus, der zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to create new routes for blood flow when an artery is blocked.
lay_definition_de: Herzoperation zur Schaffung neuer Blutbahnen, wenn eine Arterie verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: The rhythmical expansion and contraction of an ARTERY produced by waves of pressure caused by the ejection of BLOOD from the left ventricle of the HEART as it contracts.
lay_definition_en: A sudden decrease in blood pressure that can signal potential heart or lung issues when inhaling deeply.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzlicher Blutdruckabfall, der beim tiefen Einatmen auf mögliche Herz- oder Lungenprobleme hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: You can feel your heartbeat on the inside of your wrist.
lay_definition_de: Du kannst deinen Herzschlag an der Innenseite deines Handgelenks spüren.

general_definition_en: A combination of congenital heart defects consisting of three key features including ATRIAL SEPTAL DEFECTS; PULMONARY STENOSIS; and RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY.

lay_definition_en: A medication often used to treat heart conditions.

general_definition_en: Persistently high systemic arterial BLOOD PRESSURE. Based on multiple readings (BLOOD PRESSURE DETERMINATION), hypertension is currently defined as when SYSTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when DIASTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure in the lung arteries.

lay_definition_en: Gradually increasing the amount of medication based on how the patient reacts.

lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankung, bei der sich die Herzmuskeln nicht richtig entspannen.

general_definition_en: Enlargement of the LEFT VENTRICLE of the heart. This increase in ventricular mass is attributed to sustained abnormal pressure or volume loads and is a contributor to cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
lay_definition_en: When the main pumping chamber of the heart gets bigger and thicker.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Hauptpumpkammer des Herzens größer und dicker wird.

lay_definition_de: Die Herzhülle verdickt sich und vernarbt, wodurch das Herz nur noch schwer richtig arbeiten kann.

general_definition_en: Cardiomyopathy which is characterized by dilation and contractile dysfunction of the left and right ventricles. It may be idiopathic, or it may result from a myocardial infarction, myocardial infection, or alcohol abuse. It is a cause of congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the heart muscle weakens and can't pump blood efficiently.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der der Herzmuskel geschwächt ist und das Blut nicht mehr effizient pumpen kann.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: A condition where your heartbeat is too fast for your body to handle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem Ihr Herzschlag so schnell ist, dass Ihr Körper damit überfordert ist.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure or right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: Pulmonary fibrosis is a lung disease where lung tissue gets damaged or scarred.
lay_definition_de: Eine Lungenfibrose ist eine Lungenerkrankung, bei der das Lungengewebe geschädigt wird oder sich vernarbt.

general_definition_en: An adverse event characterized by impaired functioning of the left ventricle of the heart during the diastole phase of the cardiac cycle.
lay_definition_en: When your heart struggles to fill up with blood and pumps out less blood to your body.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, sich mit Blut zu füllen, und weniger Blut in Ihren Körper pumpt.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. lay_definition_en: Sounds made by blood flowing through the heart that could signal a health issue.
lay_definition_de: Geräusche, die durch den Blutfluss im Herzen entstehen und auf ein gesundheitliches Problem hindeuten könnten.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: Nonischemic cardiomyopathy is a heart problem where the left ventricle doesn't pump blood well.
lay_definition_de: Die nicht-ischämische Kardiomyopathie ist eine Herzerkrankung, bei der der linke Ventrikel das Blut nicht richtig pumpt.

lay_definition_en: A rare and complicated heart condition.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene und komplizierte Herzerkrankung.

lay_definition_en: A heart murmur is a weird sound that your doctor can hear when they listen to your heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzgeräusch ist ein ungewöhnliches Geräusch, das Ihr Arzt hören kann, wenn er Ihr Herz abhört.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the ABDOMINAL AORTA which gives rise to the visceral, the parietal, and the terminal (iliac) branches below the aortic hiatus at the diaphragm.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in a major blood vessel in the belly that can tear and cause serious internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung in einem großen Blutgefäß im Bauchraum, die reißen und schwere innere Blutungen verursachen kann.

lay_definition_en: A bulge in the main blood vessel in the belly that can tear and lead to severe internal bleeding, which can be life-threatening.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung des Hauptblutgefäßes im Bauchraum, die reißen und zu schweren inneren Blutungen führen kann, die lebensbedrohlich sein können.

general_definition_en: Rapid, irregular atrial contractions caused by a block of electrical impulse conduction in the right atrium and a reentrant wave front traveling up the inter-atrial septum and down the right atrial free wall or vice versa. Unlike ATRIAL FIBRILLATION which is caused by abnormal impulse generation, typical atrial flutter is caused by abnormal impulse conduction. As in atrial fibrillation, patients with atrial flutter cannot effectively pump blood into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES).
lay_definition_en: An irregular heart rhythm causing the upper chambers to beat rapidly and potentially leading to strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus, der zu einem schnellen Schlagen der oberen Herzkammern führt und möglicherweise Schlaganfälle verursachen kann.

lay_definition_en: A drug that helps prevent blood clots and reduce the chances of heart attack and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, Blutgerinnseln vorzubeugen und das Risiko für Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle zu senken.

Measures the electrical activity of the electrode on the right thoracic limb.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: AV means when the lower heart chambers don't beat in sync with the upper ones, signaling an issue with the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: AV bedeutet, dass die unteren Herzkammern nicht synchron mit den oberen schlagen, was auf eine Störung der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens hindeutet.

general_definition_en: Irregular HEART RATE caused by abnormal function of the SINOATRIAL NODE. It is characterized by a greater than 10% change between the maximum and the minimum sinus cycle length or 120 milliseconds.
lay_definition_en: Arrhythmic means having an issue with the speed or rhythm of your heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: „Arrhythmisch“ bedeutet, dass ein Problem mit der Geschwindigkeit oder dem Rhythmus des Herzschlags vorliegt.

lay_definition_en: Vasculopathy is a general term used for any issues or diseases affecting veins or arteries.
lay_definition_de: Vaskulopathie ist ein Oberbegriff für alle Probleme oder Erkrankungen, die Venen oder Arterien betreffen.

general_definition_en: The sounds heard over the cardiac region produced by the functioning of the heart. There are four distinct sounds: the first occurs at the beginning of SYSTOLE and is heard as a "lubb" sound; the second is produced by the closing of the AORTIC VALVE and PULMONARY VALVE and is heard as a "dupp" sound; the third is produced by vibrations of the ventricular walls when suddenly distended by the rush of blood from the HEART ATRIA; and the fourth is produced by atrial contraction and ventricular filling.
lay_definition_en: Sounds come from both right and left sides.

general_definition_en: The hydrochloride form of labetalol, a third generation selective alpha-1-adrenergic antagonist and non-selective beta-adrenergic antagonist with vasodilatory and antihypertensive properties. Labetalol competitively binds to alpha-1-adrenergic receptors in vascular smooth muscle, thereby inhibiting the adrenergic stimulation of endothelial cell function and vasoconstriction in peripheral blood vessels. This agent also binds to beta-receptors in the bronchial and vascular smooth muscle, resulting in a decrease in adrenergic stimulation. The result is a decrease in resting and exercise heart rates, cardiac output, and in both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, thereby resulting in vasodilation, and negative chronotropic and inotropic cardiac effects.
lay_definition_en: Giving medicines and fluids through a needle into a vein.
lay_definition_de: Verabreichung von Medikamenten und Flüssigkeiten über eine Nadel in eine Vene.

general_definition_en: Agents used for the treatment or prevention of cardiac arrhythmias. They may affect the polarization-repolarization phase of the action potential, its excitability or refractoriness, or impulse conduction or membrane responsiveness within cardiac fibers. Anti-arrhythmia agents are often classed into four main groups according to their mechanism of action: sodium channel blockade, beta-adrenergic blockade, repolarization prolongation, or calcium channel blockade.
lay_definition_en: Medicines that help regulate a patient's heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel, die dabei helfen, den Herzrhythmus eines Patienten zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: The recurrent, measured movements (rhythm) of a beating heart.
lay_definition_en: Heartbeat pattern.

general_definition_en: The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: CPR is a rescue measure to restart someone's heart during an emergency.
lay_definition_de: Die Herz-Lungen-Wiederbelebung (HLW) ist eine Rettungsmaßnahme, um das Herz einer Person in einem Notfall wieder zum Schlagen zu bringen.

general_definition_en: A diet which contains very little sodium chloride. It is prescribed by some for hypertension and for edematous states. (Dorland, 27th ed)

lay_definition_de: Natrium in Ihrer Ernährung trägt dazu bei, dass Ihre Nerven und Muskeln gut funktionieren.

general_definition_en: Within an artery (blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to tissues and organs in the body).

lay_definition_de: Während der arteriellen Phase einer CT-Untersuchung befindet sich das Kontrastmittel in den Arterien, bevor es die Organe erreicht.

general_definition_en: A type of computed tomography whereby images are taken at the venous phase post contrast medium injection. The venous phase is defined as the time period in which the contrast medium has passed the heart and the arterial blood vessels and has entered the venous blood vessel system.
lay_definition_en: Venous phase in a CT scan is when the contrast dye reaches the liver veins, showing enhanced details.
lay_definition_de: Die venöse Phase bei einer CT-Untersuchung ist der Zeitpunkt, zu dem das Kontrastmittel die Lebervenen erreicht und dadurch eine verbesserte Darstellung der Details ermöglicht.

It blocks the release of chemicals from nerve endings that make blood vessels constrict (get narrower). Catapres is a type of antihypertensive agent and a type of alpha-adrenergic agonist.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, das durch die Entspannung der Blutgefäße auch bei Angstzuständen und Schmerzen helfen kann.

general_definition_en: Thickening and loss of elasticity of the CORONARY ARTERIES, leading to progressive arterial insufficiency (CORONARY DISEASE).
lay_definition_en: Atherosclerotic disease is when plaque builds up in arteries, potentially causing heart attacks, strokes, and other serious health issues.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer atherosklerotischen Erkrankung lagern sich Plaques in den Arterien ab, was zu Herzinfarkten, Schlaganfällen und anderen schwerwiegenden Gesundheitsproblemen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES; VEINS; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.
lay_definition_en: A vasculopathy is a problem with your veins or arteries.
lay_definition_de: Eine Vaskulopathie ist eine Erkrankung der Venen oder Arterien.

general_definition_en: A benign vascular lesion characterized by the presence of a complex network of communicating arterial and venous vascular structures.
lay_definition_en: A tangled web of arteries and veins that a person is born with.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gewirr aus Arterien und Venen, mit dem ein Mensch geboren wird.

general_definition_en: The thin membrane-like muscular structure separating the right and the left upper chambers (HEART ATRIA) of a heart.
lay_definition_en: The wall that separates the top chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Wand, die die oberen Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that gives blood to the organs in the belly.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das die Organe im Bauchraum mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: A rough guess of the amount of blood present in the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine grobe Schätzung der im Körper vorhandenen Blutmenge.

general_definition_en: Restoration of blood supply to tissue which is ischemic due to decrease in normal blood supply. The decrease may result from any source including atherosclerotic obstruction, narrowing of the artery, or surgical clamping. It is primarily a procedure for treating infarction or other ischemia, by enabling viable ischemic tissue to recover, thus limiting further necrosis. However, it is thought that reperfusion can itself further damage the ischemic tissue, causing REPERFUSION INJURY.
lay_definition_en: Failed to restore blood supply.
lay_definition_de: Die Wiederherstellung der Durchblutung ist fehlgeschlagen.

general_definition_en: Restoration of blood supply to tissue which is ischemic due to decrease in normal blood supply. The decrease may result from any source including atherosclerotic obstruction, narrowing of the artery, or surgical clamping. It is primarily a procedure for treating infarction or other ischemia, by enabling viable ischemic tissue to recover, thus limiting further necrosis. However, it is thought that reperfusion can itself further damage the ischemic tissue, causing REPERFUSION INJURY.
lay_definition_en: Reperfused means allowing blood flow back to a tissue or organ.
lay_definition_de: „Reperfusion“ bedeutet, dass der Blutfluss zu einem Gewebe oder Organ wiederhergestellt wird.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a sinus beat followed by a premature atrial complexes for three or more consecutive cycles; a regularly irregular rhythm of normal and abnormal P waves in a 1-1 ratio. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm disorder where your heartbeat alternates between two different intervals.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung, bei der der Herzschlag zwischen zwei verschiedenen Intervallen wechselt.

lay_definition_en: The spot where the food pipe meets the stomach.
lay_definition_de: Die Stelle, an der die Speiseröhre in den Magen mündet.

general_definition_en: Presence of air or gas in the space between the heart and the PERICARDIUM. The degree of respiratory distress depends on the amount of trapped air and circulation blocked in the systemic and pulmonary veins.
lay_definition_en: Air getting into the area around the heart causing a condition.
lay_definition_de: Luft gelangt in den Bereich um das Herz und verursacht eine Erkrankung.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic recording in which one or more leads display extraneous signals which do not represent cardiac electrical activity. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Something that looks like it's in a test result but is actually not, leading to misinterpretation.
lay_definition_de: Etwas, das so aussieht, als wäre es Teil eines Testergebnisses, es aber tatsächlich nicht ist, was zu Fehlinterpretationen führt.

general_definition_en: Anastomosis of splenic vein to renal vein to relieve portal hypertension.
lay_definition_en: A link between the splenic vein and the left renal vein related to portal hypertension.
lay_definition_de: Eine Verbindung zwischen der Milzvene und der linken Nierenvene im Zusammenhang mit einer portalen Hypertonie.

general_definition_en: ISCHEMIA
lay_definition_en: Ischemia is when your blood flow is reduced because your blood vessels are blocked or narrowed.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Ischämie spricht man, wenn die Durchblutung eingeschränkt ist, weil die Blutgefäße verstopft oder verengt sind.

general_definition_en: The first and largest artery branching from the aortic arch. It distributes blood to the right side of the head and neck and to the right arm.
lay_definition_en: A major artery in the chest that branches off from the aortic arch to supply blood to the right arm, head, and neck.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Arterie im Brustkorb, die vom Aortenbogen abzweigt und den rechten Arm, den Kopf und den Hals mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: The tendinous cords that connect each cusp of the two atrioventricular HEART VALVES to appropriate PAPILLARY MUSCLES in the HEART VENTRICLES, preventing the valves from reversing themselves when the ventricles contract.
lay_definition_en: Stringy cords in the heart valve system.
lay_definition_de: Faserige Stränge im Herzklappensystem.

general_definition_en: A condition associated with VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECT and other congenital heart defects that allow the mixing of pulmonary and systemic circulation, increase blood flow into the lung, and subsequent responses to low oxygen in blood. This complex is characterized by progressive PULMONARY HYPERTENSION; HYPERTROPHY of the RIGHT VENTRICLE; CYANOSIS; and ERYTHROCYTOSIS.
lay_definition_en: Eisenmenger's is when a heart defect makes it hard for the heart to pump blood, leading to poor oxygen supply and thickening of the heart wall.
lay_definition_de: Beim Eisenmenger-Syndrom führt ein Herzfehler dazu, dass das Herz nur schwer Blut pumpen kann, was zu einer schlechten Sauerstoffversorgung und einer Verdickung der Herzwand führt.

general_definition_en: NECROSIS of the MYOCARDIUM caused by an obstruction of the blood supply to the heart (CORONARY CIRCULATION).
lay_definition_en: When the heart muscle dies because it doesn't get enough oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Herzmuskel abstirbt, weil er nicht genügend Sauerstoff erhält.

general_definition_en: The time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the cardiac cycle.
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart's activity shown on a heart scan.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ausschnitt der Herzaktivität, dargestellt auf einer Herzuntersuchung.

general_definition_en: An acute or subacute reversible condition characterized by headaches, mental status changes, visual disturbances, and seizures associated with imaging findings of posterior leukoencephalopathy. It has been observed in association with hypertensive encephalopathy, eclampsia, and immunosuppressive and cytotoxic drug treatment.
lay_definition_en: When your brain swells up quickly, causing symptoms like seizures and headaches due to high blood pressure, it's called PRES.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Gehirn aufgrund von Bluthochdruck schnell anschwillt und dadurch Symptome wie Krampfanfälle und Kopfschmerzen verursacht, spricht man von PRES.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in leads V1 or V2 of an initial R wave duration greater than or equal to 40 ms, R wave greater than S wave, and upright T wave, which is suggestive of myocardial infarction of the posterior wall of the left ventricle. Evidence of inferior or lateral myocardial infarction is usually also present. (CDISC) reversible encephalopathy syndrome
lay_definition_en: A sudden occurrence of symptoms like seizures and headaches due to brain swelling, typically linked to high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Auftreten von Symptomen wie Krampfanfällen und Kopfschmerzen aufgrund einer Hirnschwellung, die typischerweise mit Bluthochdruck in Verbindung steht.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic recording that does not demonstrate any significant signs of ischemia or conduction abnormalities.
lay_definition_en: Not important for your health.
lay_definition_de: Für Ihre Gesundheit nicht von Bedeutung.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a QS wave, which is atypical.
lay_definition_en: Heart's electricity that could show a problem when someone had a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens, die bei einem Herzinfarkt auf ein Problem hindeuten könnte.

general_definition_en: An embryological structure found at the junction of the inferior vena cava and the right atrium, which, during gestation, functions to direct the flow of blood from the right atrium into the left atrium via the foramen ovale.
lay_definition_en: A basic valve in the heart that might not serve a purpose in adults.
lay_definition_de: Eine grundlegende Herzklappe, die bei Erwachsenen möglicherweise keine Funktion erfüllt.

general_definition_en: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects blood vessels that are smaller than arteries, i.e., arterioles, venules, and capilllaries. [HPO:probinson, PMID:9366584]
lay_definition_en: Blood vessel damage in the heart or brain that can lead to heart disease or strokes.
lay_definition_de: Schäden an den Blutgefäßen im Herzen oder im Gehirn, die zu Herzerkrankungen oder Schlaganfällen führen können.

general_definition_en: A disk-shaped valve component of a tilting disk mechanical heart valve.
lay_definition_en: Leaflet is the thin part of a heart valve made of tissue or flaps.
lay_definition_de: Ein Klappensegel ist der dünne Teil einer Herzklappe, der aus Gewebe oder Klappen besteht.

general_definition_en: The lower chamber of the heart located in the right side. It receives blood from the right atrium that is no longer oxygenated and it pumps it to the pulmonary artery.
lay_definition_en: One of the heart's four chambers.
lay_definition_de: Eine der vier Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: A congenital disorder of glycosylation sub-type caused by mutation(s) in the DPAGT1 gene, encoding UDP-N-acetylglucosamine--dolichyl-phosphate N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase. A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A tube put in the neck vein for quick fluid or medication delivery and blood flow checking.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der in die Halsvene eingeführt wird, um Flüssigkeiten oder Medikamente schnell zu verabreichen und den Blutfluss zu überprüfen.

general_definition_en: Inner layer of muscle of right ventricle, each intance of which is a band of muscle from some interventricular septum extending to some anterior papillary muscle.
lay_definition_en: A muscle in the heart that helps regulate heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Muskel im Herzen, der zur Regulierung des Herzschlags beiträgt.

general_definition_en: An abnormally large Eustachian valve (postnatally). The Eustachian valve is also known as the valve of the inferior vena cava, and is an embryologic remnant of the valve of the inferior vena cava. [PMID:12484622]
lay_definition_en: A basic heart valve believed to serve no purpose in grown-ups.
lay_definition_de: Eine einfache Herzklappe, von der man annimmt, dass sie bei Erwachsenen keine Funktion hat.

general_definition_en: A prolongation or process extending from a cell, e.g. a flagellum or axon. [GOC:jl, http://www.cogsci.princeton.edu/~wn/]
lay_definition_en: A specific point on the heart's surface used to locate an internal valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein bestimmter Punkt auf der Herzoberfläche, der zur Lokalisierung einer inneren Herzklappe dient.

general_definition_en: A device that substitutes for a heart valve. It may be composed of biological material (BIOPROSTHESIS) and/or synthetic material.
lay_definition_en: A type of replacement heart valve made from animal tissue.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art Herzklappenersatz aus tierischem Gewebe.

general_definition_en: The resistance to blood flow offered by the pulmonary vasculature, which is normally one sixth of SVR. The major determinant of PVR is pulmonary vessel constriction, most often caused by hypoxia and/or hypercardia. Prolonged elevated PVR can cause right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: Blood piling up in the lungs, making it difficult to breathe.
lay_definition_de: In der Lunge staut sich Blut an, was das Atmen erschwert.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery where a healthy blood vessel is used to create a new pathway around a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzoperation, bei der ein gesundes Blutgefäß verwendet wird, um einen neuen Weg um eine verstopfte Arterie herum zu schaffen.

general_definition_en: An arterial branch arising from the anterior cerebral artery. It includes the callosomarginal artery, frontopolar artery, medial orbitofrontal artery, pericallosal artery, and recurrent artery of Heubner.
lay_definition_en: An artery that supplies blood to the front part of the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie, die den vorderen Teil des Gehirns mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A chronic inflammatory process that affects the AORTA and its primary branches, such as the brachiocephalic artery (BRACHIOCEPHALIC TRUNK) and CAROTID ARTERIES. It results in progressive arterial stenosis, occlusion, and aneurysm formation. The pulse in the arm is hard to detect. Patients with aortitis syndrome often exhibit retinopathy. finding
lay_definition_en: Results that don't give a clear answer about a medical condition.
lay_definition_de: Befunde, die keine eindeutige Aussage über eine Erkrankung zulassen.

general_definition_en: Narrowing of the opening of one or more of the four valves of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Valvular means related to the tissues in the heart that control blood flow.
lay_definition_de: „Valvular“ bezieht sich auf das Gewebe im Herzen, das den Blutfluss reguliert.

general_definition_en: Flow in the opposite direction from normal, as the casting up of undigested food or gas from the stomach, or the backward flowing of blood into the heart, or between the chambers of the heart when a valve is incompetent.
lay_definition_en: Backward flow of blood caused by leaky heart valves.
lay_definition_de: Rückfluss von Blut aufgrund undichter Herzklappen.

general_definition_en: Formation of an infarct, which is NECROSIS in tissue due to local ISCHEMIA resulting from obstruction of BLOOD CIRCULATION, most commonly by a THROMBUS or EMBOLUS.
lay_definition_en: A spot of dead tissue due to a blockage in an artery by a blood clot or debris.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bereich mit abgestorbenem Gewebe aufgrund einer Verstopfung einer Arterie durch ein Blutgerinnsel oder Ablagerungen.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a device that helps control your heart rate and is implanted in your chest.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, Ihre Herzfrequenz zu regulieren, und in Ihre Brust implantiert wird.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall at the fourth intercostal space (between ribs 4 and 5) to the left of the sternal border. In small animals it corresponds to V2-V3 where it is placed at the 6th left intercostal space near the sternum. In large animals it is placed over the 6th rib at the level of the costochondral junction on the left side of the thorax.
lay_definition_en: A V2 is a vector that points to a specific spot on the chest wall.
lay_definition_de: Ein V2 ist ein Vektor, der auf eine bestimmte Stelle an der Brustwand zeigt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure or right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A condition where lung scarring leads to breathing difficulties and reduced oxygen flow in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der Vernarbungen in der Lunge zu Atembeschwerden und einer verminderten Sauerstoffzufuhr im Blut führen.

general_definition_en: Abnormal increase of resistance to blood flow within the hepatic PORTAL SYSTEM, frequently seen in LIVER CIRRHOSIS and conditions with obstruction of the PORTAL VEIN.
lay_definition_en: When blood pressure rises in the vein connecting the intestines and liver, it causes portal hypertension, commonly seen in liver diseases.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Blutdruck in der Vene, die den Darm mit der Leber verbindet, ansteigt, führt dies zu einer portalen Hypertonie, die häufig bei Lebererkrankungen auftritt.

general_definition_en: A developmental abnormality in which the spiral (aortopulmonary) septum failed to completely divide the TRUNCUS ARTERIOSUS into ASCENDING AORTA and PULMONARY ARTERY. This abnormal communication between the two major vessels usually lies above their respective valves (AORTIC VALVE; PULMONARY VALVE).
lay_definition_en: A condition where an unusual hole forms between the main body artery and the lung artery, leading to lung blood pressure increase and potential heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem sich ein ungewöhnliches Loch zwischen der Hauptarterie und der Lungenarterie bildet, was zu einem Anstieg des Lungenblutdrucks und möglicherweise zu Herzinsuffizienz führt.

general_definition_en: A unit of exposure to ionizing radiation in CGS system. One roentgen is the amount of gamma or x-rays required to produce ions resulting in a charge of 2.58E-4 coulombs/kilogram of air under standard conditions. - An electrocardiographic finding of the current of atrial contraction when they are depolarized. The initial portion of the P wave is largely a reflection of right atrial depolarization and the terminal portion reflects depolarization of the left atrium.
lay_definition_en: A peak on an EKG that can be linked to a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Eine Spitze im EKG, die mit einem Herzinfarkt in Verbindung gebracht werden kann.

general_definition_en: Having a severe and rapid onset of symptoms with short duration.
lay_definition_en: An acute heart attack is a very severe type of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein akuter Herzinfarkt ist eine sehr schwere Form des Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: Problem associated with the loss of the minimum amount of energy, voltage, or current needed to consistently stimulate the heart muscle.
lay_definition_en: A threshold in a pacemaker is a level set for optimal function.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schwellenwert in einem Herzschrittmacher ist ein Wert, der für eine optimale Funktion eingestellt wird.

general_definition_en: In surgery, the time a tissue, organ, or body part remains at body temperature after its blood supply has been reduced or cut off but before it is cooled or reconnected to a blood supply. time
lay_definition_en: The warm ischemia time is how long a body part stays without enough blood supply during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Die warme Ischämiezeit gibt an, wie lange ein Körperteil während einer Operation ohne ausreichende Blutversorgung bleibt.

general_definition_en: The anticipated length of a clinical trial measured as a unit of time.
lay_definition_en: The speed set for a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Die für einen Herzschrittmacher eingestellte Frequenz.

general_definition_en: A mechanical pump which also includes a control system and an energy supply. It receives blood from the left ventricle and delivers it to the aorta, thus helping the heart to pump sufficient blood to the body.
lay_definition_en: A device that helps weak hearts pump blood better.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das geschwächten Herzen hilft, das Blut besser zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: The left lower chamber of the heart that receives blood from the left atrium and pumps it through the aorta to the body.
lay_definition_en: A lower heart chamber.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzkammer.

general_definition_en: A bundle of nerve fibers crossing from one side to the other side of the brain or spinal cord.
lay_definition_en: Temporary stitches used to keep parts of the heart valve in place during heart surgery.
lay_definition_de: Vorübergehende Nähte, die dazu dienen, Teile der Herzklappe während einer Herzoperation an Ort und Stelle zu halten.

general_definition_en: A febrile disease occurring as a delayed sequela of infections with STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES. It is characterized by multiple focal inflammatory lesions of the connective tissue structures, such as the heart, blood vessels, and joints (POLYARTHRITIS) and brain, and by the presence of ASCHOFF BODIES in the myocardium and skin.
lay_definition_en: A bacterial disease causing fever and inflammation in the heart, blood vessels, and joints.
lay_definition_de: Eine bakterielle Erkrankung, die Fieber und Entzündungen im Herzen, in den Blutgefäßen und in den Gelenken verursacht.

general_definition_en: Virtuoso DR model
lay_definition_en: A super advanced kind of defibrillator.
lay_definition_de: Ein hochmoderner Defibrillator.

general_definition_en: The arterial trunk that arises from the abdominal aorta and after a short course divides into the left gastric, common hepatic and splenic arteries.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that carries blood to the belly organs.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das die Bauchorgane mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: The valve consisting of three cusps situated between the right atrium and right ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve that regulates blood flow in the heart and is the first one blood passes through upon entering.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert und die erste ist, die das Blut beim Eintritt durchströmt.

general_definition_en: The valve consisting of three cusps situated between the right atrium and right ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve that controls blood flow into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss ins Herz reguliert.

general_definition_en: A type of heart valve surgery that involves the repair, replacement, or reconstruction of the annulus of the MITRAL VALVE. It includes shortening the circumference of the annulus to improve valve closing capacity and reinforcing the annulus as a step in more complex valve repairs.
lay_definition_en: A type of surgery to fix a leaky heart valve by tightening or reinforcing the ring of tissue around the valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine Operationsmethode zur Behandlung einer undichten Herzklappe, bei der der Gewebering um die Klappe herum gestrafft oder verstärkt wird.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed with the purpose of replacing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. tricuspid valve with bioprosthetic, homograft or autograft valve.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to replace a heart valve that controls blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff zum Ersatz einer Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert.

general_definition_en: TRICUSPID
lay_definition_en: A heart valve called tricuspid controlling blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe namens Trikuspidalklappe, die den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: When your heart contracts and pushes blood out.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich dein Herz zusammenzieht und Blut ausstößt.

general_definition_en: A data type comprised of a text string that can be displayed or machine processed. The condition of being elevated.
lay_definition_en: A sign on a heart test that shows there may be a heart attack happening.
lay_definition_de: Ein Anzeichen bei einer Herzuntersuchung, das darauf hindeutet, dass möglicherweise gerade ein Herzinfarkt vorliegt.

general_definition_en: atrio caval
lay_definition_en: A place in the heart where the superior vena cava meets the right atrium.
lay_definition_de: Eine Stelle im Herzen, an der die Vena cava superior in den rechten Vorhof mündet.

general_definition_en: An autosomal dominant disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE with abnormal features in the heart, the eye, and the skeleton. Cardiovascular manifestations include MITRAL VALVE PROLAPSE, dilation of the AORTA, and aortic dissection. Other features include lens displacement (ectopia lentis), disproportioned long limbs and enlarged DURA MATER (dural ectasia). Marfan syndrome is associated with mutations in the gene encoding fibrillin, a major element of extracellular microfibrils of connective tissue.
lay_definition_en: A genetic condition that affects various parts of the body, making individuals with the condition tall and thin.
lay_definition_de: Eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, die verschiedene Körperteile betrifft und dazu führt, dass Betroffene groß und schlank sind.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive test usually done during the third trimester to check for fetal well being. It is performed using an external fetal heart rate monitor to assess the fetal heart rate response to fetal movements.
lay_definition_en: Checking how well your heart works when under pressure like during exercise or due to medication.
lay_definition_de: Überprüfung der Herzfunktion unter Belastung, beispielsweise beim Sport oder aufgrund von Medikamenteneinnahme.

general_definition_en: Recording of electric currents developed in the brain by means of electrodes applied to the scalp, to the surface of the brain, or placed within the substance of the brain.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks how the heart's electricity and rhythm is doing, also known as an ECG or EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität und der Rhythmus des Herzens überprüft werden; auch als EKG bekannt.

general_definition_en: The wire which connects a pacemaker or defibrillator to the ventricular tissue.
lay_definition_en: A wire in a pacemaker that detects signals in the bottom part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Elektrode in einem Herzschrittmacher, die Signale im unteren Teil des Herzens erfasst.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of episodic atrial fibrillation with abrupt onset and termination.
lay_definition_en: A paroxysm is a sudden disease flare-up.
lay_definition_de: Ein Anfall ist ein plötzliches Aufflammen einer Erkrankung.

general_definition_en: This gene may play a role in regulation of transcription. - A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A thin tube inserted through the heart and arteries to monitor health conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der durch das Herz und die Arterien eingeführt wird, um den Gesundheitszustand zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: OM-1
lay_definition_en: An OM-1 is a specialized artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine OM-1 ist eine spezielle Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: OM-2
lay_definition_en: A branch of a heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ast einer Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: A grading system for coronary blood flow based on the classification developed by the Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction Group. It classifies coronary blood flow into four classes based upon the angiographic appearance of the blood vessels. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: TIMI is a scale used to predict heart-related events like death.
lay_definition_de: TIMI ist eine Skala, mit der sich herzbedingte Ereignisse wie der Tod vorhersagen lassen.

general_definition_en: An arterial anastomosis in the palm of the hand, located distal to the deep palmar arch, and fed mainly by the ulnar artery, providing the principal blood supply to the common and proper digital arteries.
lay_definition_en: Arteries in your palm.
lay_definition_de: Arterien in der Handfläche.

general_definition_en: The percentage of the end-diastolic volume pumped out of the heart during SYSTOLE.
lay_definition_en: A measure of how well the heart pumps blood, used to diagnose heart failure, with a normal range of 50 to 70 percent.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie gut das Herz Blut pumpt; wird zur Diagnose von Herzinsuffizienz herangezogen; der Normalbereich liegt bei 50 bis 70 Prozent.

general_definition_en: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia that is characterized by uncoordinated extremely rapid firing of electrical impulses (400-600/min) in HEART VENTRICLES. Such asynchronous ventricular quivering or fibrillation prevents any effective cardiac output and results in unconsciousness (SYNCOPE). It is one of the major electrocardiographic patterns seen with CARDIAC ARREST.
lay_definition_en: A serious heart rhythm issue that messes with blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwerwiegende Herzrhythmusstörung, die den Blutfluss beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used. An imaging technique using a device which combines TOMOGRAPHY, EMISSION-COMPUTED, SINGLE-PHOTON and TOMOGRAPHY, X-RAY COMPUTED in the same session.
lay_definition_en: It's a picture showing how well your heart muscles are getting blood while your heart is beating fast.
lay_definition_de: Das Bild zeigt, wie gut Ihre Herzmuskeln mit Blut versorgt werden, während Ihr Herz schnell schlägt.

general_definition_en: An artery arising from the bifurcation of the left coronary artery that runs along the coronary grove with branches supplying the atria and ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that brings oxygen-rich blood to the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das den Herzmuskel mit sauerstoffreichem Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a pathological increase in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Severe high blood pressure that can cause damage to organs if left untreated.
lay_definition_de: Schwerer Bluthochdruck, der unbehandelt zu Organschäden führen kann.

general_definition_en: The terminus of the aortic root; the point at which the aorta attains a tubular configuration.
lay_definition_en: A ridge of cartilage between the heart and aorta.
lay_definition_de: Ein Knorpelwulst zwischen Herz und Aorta.

general_definition_en: A thin lining of closed cavities of the body, consisting of a single layer of squamous epithelial cells (MESOTHELIUM) resting on a thin layer of CONNECTIVE TISSUE, and covered with secreted clear fluid from blood and lymph vessels. Major serous membranes in the body include PERICARDIUM; PERITONEUM; and PLEURA.
lay_definition_en: The serosal is the outer covering of organs like the heart and lungs.
lay_definition_de: Die Serosa ist die äußere Hülle von Organen wie dem Herzen und der Lunge.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart defect characterized by the persistent opening of fetal DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS that connects the PULMONARY ARTERY to the descending aorta (AORTA, DESCENDING) allowing unoxygenated blood to bypass the lung and flow to the PLACENTA. Normally, the ductus is closed shortly after birth.
lay_definition_en: A PDA is a vessel that pumps blood from the heart to the whole body.
lay_definition_de: Ein PDA ist ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen in den gesamten Körper pumpt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic interval measured from the onset of the QRS complex to the offset of the QRS complex of a single beat utilizing one or more leads. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: QRSs are the three heart waves you can spot on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: QRS-Komplexe sind die drei Herzwellen, die man auf einem EKG erkennen kann.

general_definition_en: obtuse marginal
lay_definition_en: An artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: An acute or subacute reversible condition characterized by headaches, mental status changes, visual disturbances, and seizures associated with imaging findings of posterior leukoencephalopathy. It has been observed in association with hypertensive encephalopathy, eclampsia, and immunosuppressive and cytotoxic drug treatment.
lay_definition_en: A heart artery on the right side.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie auf der rechten Seite.

general_definition_en: An essential amino acid that is physiologically active in the L-form. - An electrocardiographic finding of the current of atrial contraction when they are depolarized. The initial portion of the P wave is largely a reflection of right atrial depolarization and the terminal portion reflects depolarization of the left atrium.
lay_definition_en: Changing a setting on a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Eine Einstellung am Herzschrittmacher ändern.

general_definition_en: The blood vessel that supplies the breast and the anterior chest wall with arterial blood. It is located in the chest wall.
lay_definition_en: A chest artery used to bypass blockages in the heart's blood supply.
lay_definition_de: Eine Brustarterie, die zur Umgehung von Verstopfungen in der Herzblutversorgung verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Intestinal lymph node located anterior to aorta.
lay_definition_en: Located in front of the main artery in the body.
lay_definition_de: Befindet sich vor der Hauptarterie des Körpers.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: Stress is like taking a snapshot of how well blood flows to your heart while it's beating quickly.
lay_definition_de: Stress ist so etwas wie eine Momentaufnahme davon, wie gut das Blut zu Ihrem Herzen fließt, während es schnell schlägt.

general_definition_en: COMPLEX
lay_definition_en: Three heart waves showing when the ventricles start to contract and push out blood seen in an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Drei Herzwellen, die im EKG zu sehen sind und anzeigen, wann die Herzkammern beginnen, sich zusammenzuziehen und Blut auszustoßen.

general_definition_en: An adverse event in a newborn characterized by non-sinus rhythm with an abnormally high heart rate for age.
lay_definition_en: A fast and irregular heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein schneller und unregelmäßiger Herzschlag.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart defect characterized by the persistent opening of fetal DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS that connects the PULMONARY ARTERY to the descending aorta (AORTA, DESCENDING) allowing unoxygenated blood to bypass the lung and flow to the PLACENTA. Normally, the ductus is closed shortly after birth.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition caused by issues during heart development.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, die durch Störungen während der Herzentwicklung verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: An electrical current applied to the HEART to terminate a CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA.
lay_definition_en: Using electricity to jump-start or restore the heart's normal beating.
lay_definition_de: Einsatz von elektrischem Strom, um das Herz anzuregen oder seinen normalen Rhythmus wiederherzustellen.

general_definition_en: None hammer
