lay_definition_en: A water hammer is like a strong pulse that suddenly weakens, often indicating a heart condition.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wasserschlag ist wie ein kräftiger Puls, der plötzlich nachlässt, was oft auf eine Herzerkrankung hindeutet.

general_definition_en: The measurement of the mean left arterial pressure, as measured by a catheter introduced into the distal pulmonary artery, is high.
lay_definition_en: A way to determine how effectively the left atrium of the heart is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um festzustellen, wie gut der linke Vorhof des Herzens funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A SI derived unit of pressure equivalent to one newton per square meter or 10 bars or to 1.45x10E-4 pounds per square inch.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure in the artery going from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck in der Arterie, die vom Herzen zur Lunge führt.

general_definition_en: The volume of blood in a ventricle after DIASTOLE.
lay_definition_en: End diastolic volume is the amount of blood in the heart ventricle right before it contracts.
lay_definition_de: Das enddiastolische Volumen ist die Blutmenge im Herzventrikel unmittelbar vor dessen Kontraktion.

general_definition_en: end systolic volume
lay_definition_en: The volume left in the heart after it pumps blood to the body.
lay_definition_de: Das Volumen, das im Herzen verbleibt, nachdem es Blut in den Körper gepumpt hat.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: It's the big blood vessel that takes oxygen-poor blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Es ist das große Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: A valve situated at the entrance to the pulmonary trunk from the right ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A valve in the heart that helps with blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss unterstützt.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
lay_definition_en: The pressure in your arteries when your heart takes a break between beats.
lay_definition_de: Der Druck in Ihren Arterien, wenn Ihr Herz zwischen zwei Schlägen eine Pause macht.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an increase in pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.
lay_definition_en: A type of high blood pressure that affects the lungs and heart, causing narrowed or blocked blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form des Bluthochdrucks, die die Lunge und das Herz beeinträchtigt und zu verengten oder verstopften Blutgefäßen führt.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: The term "biventricular" means having two chambers in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Begriff „biventrikulär“ bedeutet, dass das Herz zwei Kammern hat.

general_definition_en: A combination of congenital heart defects consisting of four key features including VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECTS; PULMONARY STENOSIS; RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY; and a dextro-positioned AORTA. In this condition, blood from both ventricles (oxygen-rich and oxygen-poor) is pumped into the body often causing CYANOSIS. of A combination of congenital heart defects consisting of three key features including ATRIAL SEPTAL DEFECTS; PULMONARY STENOSIS; and RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY.
lay_definition_en: A rare heart condition that is complex and has four different defects.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Herzerkrankung, die komplex ist und vier verschiedene Fehlbildungen aufweist.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A valve in the heart that helps with blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss unterstützt.

general_definition_en: Tissue congestion due to the obstruction of venous blood flow return.
lay_definition_en: Liver issues as a result of heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Leberprobleme infolge einer Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: The use of sophisticated methods and equipment to treat cardiopulmonary arrest. Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) includes the use of specialized equipment to maintain the airway, early defibrillation and pharmacological therapy.
lay_definition_en: Giving medicine or using technology to help someone breathe and stay alive in an emergency situation.
lay_definition_de: In einer Notsituation Medikamente verabreichen oder technische Hilfsmittel einsetzen, um jemandem das Atmen zu erleichtern und sein Leben zu retten.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: A tube inserted into a vein near the heart for medical treatment.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der zur medizinischen Behandlung in eine Vene in der Nähe des Herzens eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: common Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that gives blood to your pelvis and legs.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das das Becken und die Beine mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic recording in which one or more leads display extraneous signals which do not represent cardiac electrical activity. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Artifacts are things in test results that aren't actually present, which can lead to misinterpretation.
lay_definition_de: Artefakte sind Elemente in Testergebnissen, die in Wirklichkeit gar nicht vorhanden sind und zu Fehlinterpretationen führen können.

general_definition_en: leading
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker wire that guides the heart's rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmacherelektrode, die den Herzrhythmus steuert.

general_definition_en: The 10th cranial nerve. The vagus is a mixed nerve which contains somatic afferents (from skin in back of the ear and the external auditory meatus), visceral afferents (from the pharynx, larynx, thorax, and abdomen), parasympathetic efferents (to the thorax and abdomen), and efferents to striated muscle (of the larynx and pharynx).
lay_definition_en: A nerve that runs throughout the neck, chest, and belly, controlling important bodily functions like heart rate and digestion.
lay_definition_de: Ein Nerv, der sich durch den Hals, den Brustkorb und den Bauch zieht und wichtige Körperfunktionen wie Herzfrequenz und Verdauung steuert.

general_definition_en: In medicine, a small, abnormal patch of tissue on a body part or an organ. Plaques may also be a build-up of substances from a fluid, such as cholesterol in the blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Plaques are fatty deposits that stick to blood vessel walls and can lead to heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Plaques sind Fettablagerungen, die sich an den Wänden der Blutgefäße festsetzen und zu Herzerkrankungen führen können.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: An aneurysm is like a weak spot in a blood vessel that can swell up and burst, leading to dangerous bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Ein Aneurysma ist so etwas wie eine Schwachstelle in einem Blutgefäß, die sich ausdehnen und platzen kann, was zu gefährlichen Blutungen führt.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: A surgery that bypasses clogged heart vessels by adding a new vein to keep blood flowing.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem verstopfte Herzgefäße umgangen werden, indem eine neue Vene eingesetzt wird, um den Blutfluss aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: venae comitantes
lay_definition_en: A pair of veins that run alongside an artery to help blood return to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Venenpaar, das parallel zu einer Arterie verläuft und den Rückfluss des Blutes zum Herzen unterstützt.

general_definition_en: Thickening and loss of elasticity of the CORONARY ARTERIES, leading to progressive arterial insufficiency (CORONARY DISEASE).
lay_definition_en: Buildup of fat and inflammation in the arteries that can lead to heart attacks, strokes, and other health issues.
lay_definition_de: Fettablagerungen und Entzündungen in den Arterien, die zu Herzinfarkten, Schlaganfällen und anderen Gesundheitsproblemen führen können.

general_definition_en: A coronary artery that originates above the right coronary cusp and supplies blood predominantly to the right side of the heart. .
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that supplies oxygenated blood to the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das den Herzmuskel mit sauerstoffreichem Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A measurement of the backward flow of blood through the tricuspid valve during right ventricle contraction. It correlates with pulmonary artery systolic pressure at rest and with exercise. A tricuspid regurgitation velocity greater than or equal to 2.5 m/sec on echocardiography is a surrogate marker for pulmonary hypertension in adults with sickle cell disease.
lay_definition_en: Tricuspid regurgitant is a way to check if someone might have high blood pressure in their lungs, using a test called an echocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Eine Trikuspidalinsuffizienz ist ein Anzeichen dafür, dass bei einer Person möglicherweise ein erhöhter Blutdruck in der Lunge vorliegt. Dies lässt sich mithilfe einer Untersuchung namens Echokardiogramm feststellen.

general_definition_en: Avalide
lay_definition_en: Avalide is a medication for high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Avalide ist ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: An arrhythmia is when your heart beats differently than usual.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung liegt vor, wenn Ihr Herz anders als gewöhnlich schlägt.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: The main blood vessel carrying blood from the heart to the rest of the body.
lay_definition_de: Das Hauptblutgefäß, das das Blut vom Herzen in den Rest des Körpers transportiert.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: A link between an artery and a vein in the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene im Körper.

general_definition_en: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia that is characterized by uncoordinated extremely rapid firing of electrical impulses (400-600/min) in HEART VENTRICLES. Such asynchronous ventricular quivering or fibrillation prevents any effective cardiac output and results in unconsciousness (SYNCOPE). It is one of the major electrocardiographic patterns seen with CARDIAC ARREST.
lay_definition_en: A serious abnormal heartbeat that can affect blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwerwiegende Herzrhythmusstörung, die den Blutfluss beeinträchtigen kann.

general_definition_en: Apparatus that provides mechanical circulatory support during open-heart surgery, by passing the heart to facilitate surgery on the organ. The basic function of the machine is to oxygenate the body's venous supply of blood and then pump it back into the arterial system. The machine also provides intracardiac suction, filtration, and temperature control. Some of the more important components of these machines include pumps, oxygenators, temperature regulators, and filters. (UMDNS, 1999)
lay_definition_en: A machine that acts as the heart and lungs during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das während einer Operation die Funktion von Herz und Lunge übernimmt.

general_definition_en: A type of atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia (AVRT) where the accessory pathway is used for anterograde conduction and the atrioventricular node for retrograde conduction. []
lay_definition_en: AVRT is a type of fast heart rhythm that's not normal.
lay_definition_de: AVRT ist eine Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, bei der das Herz zu schnell schlägt.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: A joining of an artery and a vein by a surgeon, often used for dialysis.
lay_definition_de: Eine vom Chirurgen vorgenommene Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene, die häufig für die Dialyse genutzt wird.

general_definition_en: The study of the electrical activity and characteristics of the HEART; MYOCARDIUM; and CARDIOMYOCYTES.
lay_definition_en: Studying the rhythm of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Den Herzrhythmus untersuchen.

general_definition_en: A condition or state of the tumor with regards to its palpability status at a particular point in time.
lay_definition_en: You can feel the pulse in an artery, which shows that your heart is pumping and the artery is not blocked.
lay_definition_de: Man kann den Puls in einer Arterie spüren, was zeigt, dass das Herz schlägt und die Arterie nicht verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: Thickening and loss of elasticity of the walls of ARTERIES of all sizes. There are many forms classified by the types of lesions and arteries involved, such as ATHEROSCLEROSIS with fatty lesions in the ARTERIAL INTIMA of medium and large muscular arteries.
lay_definition_en: Arteriosclerotic: The buildup of fats and other substances on blood vessel walls that can cause blockages and potentially deadly complications.
lay_definition_de: Arteriosklerotisch: Die Ablagerung von Fetten und anderen Substanzen an den Wänden der Blutgefäße, die zu Verstopfungen und potenziell lebensbedrohlichen Komplikationen führen kann.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by prolonged exposure to excess levels of cortisol (HYDROCORTISONE) or other GLUCOCORTICOIDS from endogenous or exogenous sources. It is characterized by upper body OBESITY; OSTEOPOROSIS; HYPERTENSION; DIABETES MELLITUS; HIRSUTISM; AMENORRHEA; and excess body fluid. Endogenous Cushing syndrome or spontaneous hypercortisolism is divided into two groups, those due to an excess of ADRENOCORTICOTROPIN and those that are ACTH-independent.
lay_definition_en: Having too much of a certain hormone called cortisol in your body can lead to a condition known as Cushing syndrome.
lay_definition_de: Ein zu hoher Spiegel eines bestimmten Hormons namens Cortisol im Körper kann zu einer Erkrankung führen, die als Cushing-Syndrom bekannt ist.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive method that uses a CT scanner for capturing images of blood vessels and tissues. A CONTRAST MATERIAL is injected, which helps produce detailed images that aid in diagnosing VASCULAR DISEASES.
lay_definition_en: A test that uses imaging to see the blood vessels in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe bildgebender Verfahren die Blutgefäße im Gehirn dargestellt werden.

general_definition_en: The study of the heart, its physiology, and its functions.
lay_definition_en: Cardiology is the study and treatment of heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Die Kardiologie befasst sich mit der Erforschung und Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen.

general_definition_en: wide complex tachycardia
lay_definition_en: A fast heart rate with a wide QRS complex in the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine schnelle Herzfrequenz mit einem breiten QRS-Komplex im elektrischen hoạtungsmuster des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Rapid, irregular atrial contractions caused by a block of electrical impulse conduction in the right atrium and a reentrant wave front traveling up the inter-atrial septum and down the right atrial free wall or vice versa. Unlike ATRIAL FIBRILLATION which is caused by abnormal impulse generation, typical atrial flutter is caused by abnormal impulse conduction. As in atrial fibrillation, patients with atrial flutter cannot effectively pump blood into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES).
lay_definition_en: An abnormal heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzrhythmusstörung.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: Keep an eye on someone to see how they are progressing.
lay_definition_de: Behalte jemanden im Auge, um zu sehen, wie er oder sie vorankommt.

general_definition_en: A transient loss of consciousness and postural tone caused by diminished blood flow to the brain (i.e., BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Presyncope refers to the sensation of lightheadedness and loss of strength that precedes a syncopal event or accompanies an incomplete syncope. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp367-9) A transient loss of consciousness and postural tone caused by diminished blood flow to the brain (i.e., BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Presyncope refers to the sensation of lightheadedness and loss of strength that precedes a syncopal event or accompanies an incomplete syncope. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp367-9)
lay_definition_en: Syncopal episodes are brief moments when someone passes out.
lay_definition_de: Synkopen sind kurze Momente, in denen jemand das Bewusstsein verliert.

general_definition_en: Infections of the BRAIN caused by the protozoan TOXOPLASMA gondii that primarily arise in individuals with IMMUNOLOGIC DEFICIENCY SYNDROMES (see also AIDS-RELATED OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS). The infection may involve the brain diffusely or form discrete abscesses. Clinical manifestations include SEIZURES, altered mentation, headache, focal neurologic deficits, and INTRACRANIAL HYPERTENSION. (From Joynt, Clinical Neurology, 1998, Ch27, pp41-3)
lay_definition_en: A parasite-caused infection that can harm the brain and spinal cord.
lay_definition_de: Eine durch Parasiten verursachte Infektion, die das Gehirn und das Rückenmark schädigen kann.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A common medication that helps with pain relief and also thins blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein gängiges Medikament, das zur Schmerzlinderung beiträgt und zudem blutverdünnend wirkt.

general_definition_en: cardiac event recorder
lay_definition_en: A device that records the heart's electrical activity to help determine the cause of symptoms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens aufzeichnet, um die Ursache von Symptomen zu ermitteln.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: Your heart's beat that you can feel in different places in your body.
lay_definition_de: Dein Herzschlag, den du an verschiedenen Stellen deines Körpers spüren kannst.

general_definition_en: Cardiac electrical stimulators that apply brief high-voltage electroshocks to the HEART. These stimulators are used to restore normal rhythm and contractile function in hearts of patients who are experiencing VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION or ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) that is not accompanied by a palpable PULSE. Some defibrillators may also be used to correct certain noncritical dysrhythmias (called synchronized defibrillation or CARDIOVERSION), using relatively low-level discharges synchronized to the patient's ECG waveform. (UMDNS, 2003)
lay_definition_en: A fibrillator is a machine used to help fix a heart with a funky beat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Defibrillator ist ein Gerät, das dazu dient, einen unregelmäßigen Herzrhythmus wieder in Ordnung zu bringen.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs. Severe inability of the LIVER to perform its normal metabolic functions, as evidenced by severe JAUNDICE and abnormal serum levels of AMMONIA; BILIRUBIN; ALKALINE PHOSPHATASE; ASPARTATE AMINOTRANSFERASE; LACTATE DEHYDROGENASES; and albumin/globulin ratio. (Blakiston's Gould Medical Dictionary, 4th ed)
lay_definition_en: When heart failure symptoms worsen suddenly.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich die Symptome einer Herzinsuffizienz plötzlich verschlimmern.

general_definition_en: The hospital unit in which patients with acute cardiac disorders receive intensive care.
lay_definition_en: A special hospital wing for people with heart problems, where they receive round-the-clock monitoring and care.
lay_definition_de: Ein spezieller Krankenhausflügel für Menschen mit Herzerkrankungen, in dem sie rund um die Uhr überwacht und betreut werden.

general_definition_en: The study of the electrical activity and characteristics of the HEART; MYOCARDIUM; and CARDIOMYOCYTES.
lay_definition_en: Studying how the heart's electricity works.
lay_definition_de: Untersuchung der Funktionsweise der Herzströme.

general_definition_en: A type of surgical portasystemic shunt to reduce portal hypertension with associated complications of esophageal varices and ascites. It is performed percutaneously through the jugular vein and involves the creation of an intrahepatic shunt between the hepatic vein and portal vein. The channel is maintained by a metallic stent. The procedure can be performed in patients who have failed sclerotherapy and is an additional option to the surgical techniques of portocaval, mesocaval, and splenorenal shunts. It takes one to three hours to perform. (JAMA 1995;273(23):1824-30)
lay_definition_en: A front piece attached to a structure.
lay_definition_de: Ein an einer Konstruktion befestigtes Frontteil.

general_definition_en: LIMA
lay_definition_en: A chest artery used for bypassing blockages in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Brustarterie, die zur Umgehung von Verstopfungen im Herzen verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the terminal end of the left coronary artery between the angle formed by the anterior interventricular branch and the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery and supplies the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A diagonal is a type of artery that provides blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Diagonale ist eine Art von Arterie, die das Herz mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: An artery that arises from the left main coronary artery and is positioned between the left anterior descending coronary artery and the circumflex artery.
lay_definition_en: A smaller branch of the main heart artery found in certain individuals.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleinerer Ast der Hauptherzarterie, der bei bestimmten Personen vorkommt.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION in which the inferior wall of the heart is involved. It is often caused by occlusion of the right coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: Heart damage at the bottom of the left ventricle due to a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Herzschaden am Grund des linken Ventrikels aufgrund einer verstopften Arterie.

general_definition_en: PRESSURE of the BLOOD on the ARTERIES and other BLOOD VESSELS.
lay_definition_en: When your blood is being pushed too hard against your blood vessels, it's high blood pressure and can lead to serious health issues like heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Blut mit zu hohem Druck gegen Ihre Blutgefäße drückt, spricht man von Bluthochdruck, der zu schwerwiegenden Gesundheitsproblemen wie Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Ultrasonic recording of the size, motion, and composition of the heart and surrounding tissues using a transducer placed in the esophagus.
lay_definition_en: A TEE is a heart test that uses sound waves and involves a tube passing through your mouth and throat to create pictures of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine TEE ist eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der Schallwellen zum Einsatz kommen und ein Schlauch durch Mund und Rachen geführt wird, um Bilder vom Herzen zu erstellen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by inflammation of the muscle tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Heart inflammation causing swelling.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzentzündung, die zu einer Schwellung führt.

general_definition_en: A disorder of cardiac function caused by insufficient blood flow to the muscle tissue of the heart. The decreased blood flow may be due to narrowing of the coronary arteries (CORONARY ARTERY DISEASE), to obstruction by a thrombus (CORONARY THROMBOSIS), or less commonly, to diffuse narrowing of arterioles and other small vessels within the heart. Severe interruption of the blood supply to the myocardial tissue may result in necrosis of cardiac muscle (MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION).
lay_definition_en: Not enough oxygen reaching the heart due to a lack of blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung gelangt nicht genügend Sauerstoff zum Herzen.

general_definition_en: Any vein within the general circulation that transports blood back to the right atrium of the heart. inflammatory response syndrome
lay_definition_en: A serious condition with symptoms like high fever, rapid heart rate, fast breathing, and elevated white blood cell count, which can be due to various factors, not just a bacterial infection.
lay_definition_de: Ein schwerwiegender Zustand mit Symptomen wie hohem Fieber, schneller Herzfrequenz, schneller Atmung und erhöhten Leukozytenwerten, der auf verschiedene Ursachen zurückzuführen sein kann, nicht nur auf eine bakterielle Infektion.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of soluble vascular cell adhesion molecule 1 present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: The main vein that carries blood from the head back to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptvene, die das Blut vom Kopf zurück zum Herzen transportiert.

general_definition_en: A biochemical messenger and regulator, synthesized from the essential amino acid L-TRYPTOPHAN. In humans it is found primarily in the central nervous system, gastrointestinal tract, and blood platelets. Serotonin mediates several important physiological functions including neurotransmission, gastrointestinal motility, hemostasis, and cardiovascular integrity. Multiple receptor families (RECEPTORS, SEROTONIN) explain the broad physiological actions and distribution of this biochemical mediator.
lay_definition_en: A chemical messenger in the brain that helps regulate mood and emotions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Botenstoff im Gehirn, der zur Regulierung von Stimmung und Emotionen beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A line used to administer a substance into an artery
lay_definition_en: A thin tube inserted into an artery to check blood pressure and draw blood samples.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um den Blutdruck zu messen und Blutproben zu entnehmen.

general_definition_en: The external part of the cell wall and/or plasma membrane. [GOC:jl, GOC:mtg_sensu, GOC:sm] Recording of the moment-to-moment electromotive forces of the HEART as projected onto various sites on the body's surface, delineated as a scalar function of time. The recording is monitored by a tracing on slow moving chart paper or by observing it on a cardioscope, which is a CATHODE RAY TUBE DISPLAY.
lay_definition_en: A way to check the heart's activity using sensors on the skin's surface.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode zur Überwachung der Herzaktivität mithilfe von Sensoren auf der Hautoberfläche.

general_definition_en: Tumor that forms in the center of the adrenal gland (gland located above the kidney) that causes it to make too much adrenaline. Pheochromocytomas are usually benign (not cancer) but can cause high blood pressure, pounding headaches, heart palpitations, flushing of the face, nausea, and vomiting.
lay_definition_en: A tumor in the adrenal gland above the kidney.
lay_definition_de: Ein Tumor in der Nebenniere oberhalb der Niere.

general_definition_en: The volume of air remaining in the LUNGS at the end of a maximal expiration. Common abbreviation is RV.
lay_definition_en: Using a pacemaker to control an abnormal heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Einsatz eines Herzschrittmachers zur Regulierung eines unregelmäßigen Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive test usually done during the third trimester to check for fetal well being. It is performed using an external fetal heart rate monitor to assess the fetal heart rate response to fetal movements.
lay_definition_en: Stress testing is a way to check how well your heart functions when it's put under pressure, usually by exercise or medication.
lay_definition_de: Ein Belastungstest dient dazu, zu überprüfen, wie gut Ihr Herz funktioniert, wenn es einer Belastung ausgesetzt ist, in der Regel durch körperliche Betätigung oder Medikamente.

general_definition_en: A cylindrical piece of tissue, such as that resulting from a core biopsy. A heterogeneous group of proteolytic enzymes that convert PLASMINOGEN to FIBRINOLYSIN. They are concentrated in the lysosomes of most cells and in the vascular endothelium, particularly in the vessels of the microcirculation.
lay_definition_en: A substance that breaks down blood clots, often used to treat heart attacks and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wirkstoff, der Blutgerinnsel auflöst und häufig zur Behandlung von Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A mechanical pump which also includes a control system and an energy supply. It receives blood from the left ventricle and delivers it to the aorta, thus helping the heart to pump sufficient blood to the body.
lay_definition_en: A device that helps pump blood through the heart when it's weak or failing.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, Blut durch das Herz zu pumpen, wenn dieses geschwächt ist oder versagt.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps lower blood pressure, often known as ACE inhibitors.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt und häufig als ACE-Hemmer bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A higher than normal level of activity. Hyperactivity can be used to describe the increased action of a body function, such as hormone production, or behavior. A person who is hyperactive may seem to be always moving or fidgeting, impulsive, unable to concentrate, and talking too much. -
lay_definition_en: A state of having high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem hoher Blutdruck vorliegt.

general_definition_en: Food processed and manufactured for the nutritional health of children in their first year of life. The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A small dose of aspirin taken to prevent heart attacks.
lay_definition_de: Eine geringe Dosis Aspirin zur Vorbeugung von Herzinfarkten.

general_definition_en: A reflex initiated by a painful stimulus. - In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG). Equipment on which one may lie and sleep, especially as used to care for the hospital patient.
lay_definition_en: A bed that keeps a patient under constant observation with a machine to monitor oxygen and carbon dioxide levels in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bett, mit dem ein Patient mithilfe eines Geräts, das den Sauerstoff- und Kohlendioxidgehalt im Blut überwacht, ständig unter Beobachtung gehalten wird.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: PACs are erratic heartbeats caused by abnormal electrical signals.
lay_definition_de: PACs sind unregelmäßige Herzschläge, die durch abnormale elektrische Signale verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: a - Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: An irregular heartbeat that can make you feel tired and increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus, der zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: A malignant form of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia that is characterized by HEART RATE between 200 and 250 beats per minute, and QRS complexes with changing amplitude and twisting of the points. The term also describes the syndrome of tachycardia with prolonged ventricular repolarization, long QT intervals exceeding 500 milliseconds or BRADYCARDIA. Torsades de pointes may be self-limited or may progress to VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION.
lay_definition_en: A dangerous and rare type of abnormal heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine gefährliche und seltene Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: Ear-shaped appendage of either atrium of the heart. (Dorland, 28th ed)
lay_definition_en: A small ear-shaped sac attached to the upper left chamber of the heart that can lead to strokes if blood clots form inside.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner, ohrförmiger Sack, der an der linken Herzkammer ansetzt und zu Schlaganfällen führen kann, wenn sich darin Blutgerinnsel bilden.

general_definition_en: The valve consisting of three cusps situated between the right atrium and right ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve that controls blood flow into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die den Blutfluss ins Herz reguliert.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - A data type comprised of a text string that can be displayed or machine processed. - Evaluation of the interval from the end of ventricular depolarization to the onset of the T wave; it is usually isoelectric in normal subjects.
lay_definition_en: The heart is not getting enough blood flow during this type of heart activity.
lay_definition_de: Bei dieser Art von Herzaktivität wird das Herz nicht ausreichend durchblutet.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: A disorder that causes irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die Herzrhythmusstörungen verursacht.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of ventricular tachycardia greater than 30 seconds in duration.
lay_definition_en: A short burst of irregular heartbeats that only lasts for a brief period.
lay_definition_de: Eine kurze Phase mit unregelmäßigen Herzschlägen, die nur kurz anhält.

general_definition_en: Cancer that forms in the thyroid gland (an organ at the base of the throat that makes hormones that help control heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, and weight). Four main types of thyroid cancer are papillary, follicular, medullary, and anaplastic thyroid cancer. The four types are based on how the cancer cells look under a microscope.
lay_definition_en: A type of cancer that grows in the thyroid gland located in the neck.
lay_definition_de: Eine Krebsart, die in der Schilddrüse im Halsbereich entsteht.

general_definition_en: Cells that line the inner and outer surfaces of the body by forming cellular layers (EPITHELIUM) or masses. Epithelial cells lining the SKIN; the MOUTH; the NOSE; and the ANAL CANAL derive from ectoderm; those lining the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM and the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM derive from endoderm; others (CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM and LYMPHATIC SYSTEM) derive from mesoderm. Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Cells that form the covering for both internal and external body surfaces.
lay_definition_de: Zellen, die die Oberfläche sowohl im Inneren als auch außen am Körper bedecken.

general_definition_en: A condition is marked by extra fat around the abdomen, high levels of blood glucose (sugar) when not eating, high levels of triglycerides (a type of fat) in the blood, low levels of high-density lipoproteins (a type of protein that carries fats) in the blood, and high blood pressure. People with metabolic syndrome are at increased risk of diabetes mellitus and diseases of the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: A combination of health issues like high blood pressure and high blood sugar that can lead to heart disease and diabetes.
lay_definition_de: Eine Kombination aus Gesundheitsproblemen wie Bluthochdruck und hohem Blutzucker, die zu Herzerkrankungen und Diabetes führen können.

general_definition_en: The condition of being dilated or stretched. cardiomyopathy
lay_definition_en: In dilated cardiomyopathy, the heart is weak and enlarged, leading to poor blood pumping.
lay_definition_de: Bei der dilatativen Kardiomyopathie ist das Herz geschwächt und vergrößert, was zu einer verminderten Pumpfunktion führt.

general_definition_en: Remodulin
lay_definition_en: A medication used to manage high blood pressure in the lungs and heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck in der Lunge und im Herzen.

general_definition_en: The prototypical analgesic used in the treatment of mild to moderate pain. It has anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties and acts as an inhibitor of cyclooxygenase which results in the inhibition of the biosynthesis of prostaglandins. Aspirin also inhibits platelet aggregation and is used in the prevention of arterial and venous thrombosis. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p5)
lay_definition_en: A medication that eases pain, fever, inflammation, blood clotting, and can lower the risk of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das Schmerzen, Fieber und Entzündungen lindert, die Blutgerinnung hemmt und das Risiko eines Herzinfarkts senken kann.

general_definition_en: A usually autosomal dominant and less frequently autosomal recessive genetic disorder characterized by the presence of numerous cysts in the kidneys leading to end-stage renal failure. The autosomal dominant trait is associated with abnormalities on the short arm of chromosome 16. Symptoms in patients with the autosomal dominant trait usually appear at middle age and include abdominal pain, hematuria, and high blood pressure. Patients may develop brain aneurysms and liver cysts. Patients with the autosomal recessive trait present with progressive renal failure early in life and symptoms resulting from hepatic fibrosis. The autosomal recessive trait is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 6. Polycystic kidney disease may also result as a side effect in patients on renal dialysis.
lay_definition_en: Inherited kidney condition causing cysts to form and potentially damage the kidneys.
lay_definition_de: Eine vererbte Nierenerkrankung, bei der sich Zysten bilden, die die Nieren schädigen können.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: A small plastic tube placed in a large vein near the heart via the chest or neck.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner Kunststoffschlauch, der über die Brust oder den Hals in eine große Vene in der Nähe des Herzens eingeführt wird.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: The heart muscles beat irregularly.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzmuskeln schlagen unregelmäßig.

general_definition_en: The placement of an angioplasty guide wire, balloon, or other device (e.g. stent, atherectomy, brachytherapy, or thrombectomy catheter) into a native coronary artery or coronary artery bypass graft for the purpose of mechanical coronary revascularization.
lay_definition_en: A non-surgical procedure to open up narrowed or blocked heart arteries.
lay_definition_de: Ein nicht-chirurgisches Verfahren zur Erweiterung verengter oder verstopfter Herzarterien.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: A CVA, also known as a stroke, is a medical condition where blood flow to part of the brain is disrupted due to a blockage or rupture in a blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Ein zerebrovaskulärer Unfall (CVA), auch als Schlaganfall bekannt, ist eine Erkrankung, bei der die Durchblutung eines Teils des Gehirns aufgrund einer Verstopfung oder eines Risses in einem Blutgefäß unterbrochen wird.

general_definition_en: rapid Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Your heart's lower chambers beat too quickly in rapid ventricular response.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer schnellen ventrikulären Reaktion schlagen die unteren Herzkammern zu schnell.

general_definition_en: Ravasio
lay_definition_en: A medication to help with high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von erhöhtem Blutdruck in der Lunge.

general_definition_en: Cessation of heart beat or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. If it is treated within a few minutes, heart arrest can be reversed in most cases to normal cardiac rhythm and effective circulation.
lay_definition_en: Cardiac arrest is when the heart stops pumping blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzstillstand liegt vor, wenn das Herz aufhört, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Puncture and aspiration of fluid from the PERICARDIUM.
lay_definition_en: A procedure to drain fluid around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Eingriff zur Entnahme von Flüssigkeit aus dem Bereich um das Herz.

general_definition_en: The segment of the arterial system that includes the iliac artery and its origin from the aorta.
lay_definition_en: Connecting two big arteries to help blood flow better to the leg.
lay_definition_de: Zwei große Arterien werden miteinander verbunden, um die Durchblutung des Beins zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't shut properly, blood can flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, kann das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließen.

general_definition_en: a valve that controls blood flow between heart chambers
lay_definition_en: Mitral: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow the wrong way in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Mitral: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, wodurch es zu einem Rückfluss des Blutes im Herzen kommt.

general_definition_en: A benign vascular lesion characterized by the presence of a complex network of communicating arterial and venous vascular structures. MALFORMATION
lay_definition_en: A tangled mess of arteries and veins that a person is born with.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gewirr aus Arterien und Venen, mit dem ein Mensch geboren wird.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: CVAs refer to the valuation adjustment of a derivative contract based on the credit risk of the counterparty.
lay_definition_de: CVAs bezeichnen die Bewertungsanpassung eines Derivatkontrakts auf der Grundlage des Kreditrisikos der Gegenpartei.

general_definition_en: The artificial substitution of heart and lung action as indicated for HEART ARREST resulting from electric shock, DROWNING, respiratory arrest, or other causes. The two major components of cardiopulmonary resuscitation are artificial ventilation (RESPIRATION, ARTIFICIAL) and closed-chest CARDIAC MASSAGE.
lay_definition_en: Reviving someone who has stopped breathing or has no heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Wiederbelebung einer Person, die nicht mehr atmet oder keinen Herzschlag mehr hat.

general_definition_en: Thickening and loss of elasticity of the CORONARY ARTERIES, leading to progressive arterial insufficiency (CORONARY DISEASE).
lay_definition_en: A condition where blood vessels bringing blood to the heart get clogged or narrowed.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die Blutgefäße, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen, verstopft oder verengt sind.

general_definition_en: Severe cellulitis of the submaxillary space with secondary involvement of the perimandibular spaces. It usually results from infection in the lower molar area or from an infection following a penetrating injury to the MOUTH FLOOR.
lay_definition_en: A rare and serious skin infection that usually develops under the tongue following a tooth infection.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene und schwerwiegende Hautinfektion, die sich in der Regel nach einer Zahninfektion unter der Zunge entwickelt.

general_definition_en: A medical device that increases myocardial oxygen perfusion while at the same time increasing cardiac output. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: A long, skinny balloon that aids the heart in pumping more blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein langer, schmaler Ballon, der das Herz dabei unterstützt, mehr Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Functional KIDNEY FAILURE in patients with liver disease, usually LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL), and in the absence of intrinsic renal disease or kidney abnormality. It is characterized by intense renal vasculature constriction, reduced renal blood flow, OLIGURIA, and sodium retention.
lay_definition_en: When a person with severe liver damage experiences kidney failure.
lay_definition_de: Wenn bei einer Person mit schwerer Leberschädigung ein Nierenversagen auftritt.

general_definition_en: Expanded structures, usually green, of vascular plants, characteristically consisting of a bladelike expansion attached to a stem, and functioning as the principal organ of photosynthesis and transpiration. (American Heritage Dictionary, 2d ed)
lay_definition_en: Heaves are indicators that the heart's ventricles may have grown larger.
lay_definition_de: Herzstöße sind Anzeichen dafür, dass sich die Herzkammern möglicherweise vergrößert haben.

general_definition_en: U
lay_definition_en: A type of heart rhythm as seen on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Herzrhythmus, wie er im EKG zu erkennen ist.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: Describing something that involves both arteries and veins.
lay_definition_de: Bezeichnet etwas, das sowohl Arterien als auch Venen betrifft.

general_definition_en: An augmented unipolar electrocardiogram limb lead in which the positive (black) electrode is situated on the left thoracic limb and the negative electrode is a combination of the right thoracic limb (white) electrode and the left pelvic limb (red) electrode. Measures the electrical activity of the electrode on the left thoracic limb.
lay_definition_en: An electrode put on your left shoulder that checks electrical activity in the top left side of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Elektrode, die an Ihrer linken Schulter angebracht wird und die elektrische Aktivität im oberen linken Bereich Ihres Herzens misst.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: Extra heartbeat that starts in the lower chambers of the heart; also known as a skipped heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein zusätzlicher Herzschlag, der in den unteren Herzkammern entsteht; auch als Herzaussetzer bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: An artery arising from the bifurcation of the left coronary artery that runs along the coronary grove with branches supplying the atria and ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel around the heart that helps in supplying blood to it.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß rund um das Herz, das zur Blutversorgung des Herzens beiträgt.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve. regurgitation
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow back in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung zurück.

general_definition_en: Cardiac arrhythmias that are characterized by excessively slow HEART RATE, usually below 50 beats per minute in human adults. They can be classified broadly into SINOATRIAL NODE dysfunction and ATRIOVENTRICULAR BLOCK.
lay_definition_en: A slower than usual heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine langsamere Herzfrequenz als gewöhnlich.

general_definition_en: Recording of the moment-to-moment electromotive forces of the HEART as projected onto various sites on the body's surface, delineated as a scalar function of time. The recording is monitored by a tracing on slow moving chart paper or by observing it on a cardioscope, which is a CATHODE RAY TUBE DISPLAY.
lay_definition_en: A tool that records heart data by checking electrical activity and rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das Herzdaten aufzeichnet, indem es die elektrische Aktivität und den Rhythmus des Herzens misst.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the T wave appears increased in amplitude and cresting at a point.
lay_definition_en: The T wave shows when the heart's ventricle is recharging.
lay_definition_de: Die T-Welle zeigt an, wann sich die Herzkammer wieder mit Strom auflädt.

general_definition_en: V1
lay_definition_en: A specific mark found on an ECG/EKG test.
lay_definition_de: Ein spezifisches Merkmal, das bei einer EKG-Untersuchung festgestellt wurde.

general_definition_en: TMR
lay_definition_en: A procedure that improves blood flow in a weak heart and can help with severe angina.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, das die Durchblutung bei Herzinsuffizienz verbessert und bei schwerer Angina pectoris Linderung verschaffen kann.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving the CAROTID ARTERIES, including the common, internal, and external carotid arteries. ATHEROSCLEROSIS and TRAUMA are relatively frequent causes of carotid artery pathology.
lay_definition_en: A condition where buildup of plaque in the carotid arteries can affect blood flow to the head and neck.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem Ablagerungen in den Halsschlagadern die Durchblutung von Kopf und Hals beeinträchtigen können.

general_definition_en: A protein found in bacteria and eukaryotic mitochondria which delivers aminoacyl-tRNA's to the A site of the ribosome. The aminoacyl-tRNA is first bound to a complex of elongation factor Tu containing a molecule of bound GTP. The resulting complex is then bound to the 70S initiation complex. Simultaneously the GTP is hydrolyzed and a Tu-GDP complex is released from the 70S ribosome. The Tu-GTP complex is regenerated from the Tu-GDP complex by the Ts elongation factor and GTP.
lay_definition_en: A measure of how well the heart pumps blood and can diagnose heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie gut das Herz Blut pumpt, und ein Indikator für Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Surgical construction of an opening or window in the pericardium. It is often called subxiphoid pericardial window technique.
lay_definition_en: A surgical procedure to drain excess fluid from the sac surrounding the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Ableitung von überschüssiger Flüssigkeit aus dem das Herz umgebenden Beutel.

general_definition_en: surgical material Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: Fixing a blood vessel using surgery.
lay_definition_de: Die chirurgische Behandlung eines Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: SA-AG A data type comprised of a numerator quantity divided by a denominator quantity.
lay_definition_en: A test to check for liver damage and high blood pressure in the veins of the liver.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung zur Feststellung von Leberschäden und erhöhtem Blutdruck in den Lebervenen.

general_definition_en: Air-filled spaces located within the bones around the NASAL CAVITY. They are extensions of the nasal cavity and lined by the ciliated NASAL MUCOSA. Each sinus is named for the cranial bone in which it is located, such as the ETHMOID SINUS; the FRONTAL SINUS; the MAXILLARY SINUS; and the SPHENOID SINUS. A condition caused by dysfunctions related to the SINOATRIAL NODE including impulse generation (CARDIAC SINUS ARREST) and impulse conduction (SINOATRIAL EXIT BLOCK). It is characterized by persistent BRADYCARDIA, chronic ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, and failure to resume sinus rhythm following CARDIOVERSION. This syndrome can be congenital or acquired, particularly after surgical correction for heart defects.

lay_definition_de: LVOT bezeichnet einen Teil des Herzens, der als linker Ventrikel bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: Infection with the protozoan parasite TRYPANOSOMA CRUZI, a form of TRYPANOSOMIASIS endemic in Central and South America. It is named after the Brazilian physician Carlos Chagas, who discovered the parasite. Infection by the parasite (positive serologic result only) is distinguished from the clinical manifestations that develop years later, such as destruction of PARASYMPATHETIC GANGLIA; CHAGAS CARDIOMYOPATHY; and dysfunction of the ESOPHAGUS or COLON.
lay_definition_en: A disease caused by a bug in tropical areas that can affect the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine durch ein Insekt in tropischen Gebieten verursachte Krankheit, die das Herz befallen kann.

general_definition_en: The innermost layer of the heart, comprised of endothelial cells.
lay_definition_en: The inside of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Innere des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The symptom of paroxysmal pain consequent to MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA usually of distinctive character, location and radiation. It is thought to be provoked by a transient stressful situation during which the oxygen requirements of the MYOCARDIUM exceed that supplied by the CORONARY CIRCULATION.
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle pain-related.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit Herzmuskelschmerzen.

general_definition_en: A syndrome associated with damage to the spinal cord above the mid thoracic level (see SPINAL CORD INJURIES) characterized by a marked increase in the sympathetic response to minor stimuli such as bladder or rectal distention. Manifestations include HYPERTENSION; TACHYCARDIA (or reflex bradycardia); FEVER; FLUSHING; and HYPERHIDROSIS. Extreme hypertension may be associated with a STROKE. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp538 and 1232; J Spinal Cord Med 1997;20(3):355-60)
lay_definition_en: A condition causing a sudden rise in blood pressure, often seen in individuals with spinal cord injuries.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, der einen plötzlichen Blutdruckanstieg verursacht und häufig bei Menschen mit Rückenmarksverletzungen auftritt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which two premature ventricular complexes occur sequentially. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Abnormal heartbeats that begin in the lower chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Herzrhythmusstörungen, die in den unteren Herzkammern entstehen.

general_definition_en: At an angle; having an oblique or slanted direction.
lay_definition_en: A diagonal artery is one of the branches of the left anterior descending artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine diagonale Arterie ist einer der Äste der linken vorderen absteigenden Arterie im Herzen.

general_definition_en: diagonal artery
lay_definition_en: An artery that supplies blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie, die das Herz mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: pacing

lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher regelt Ihre Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: Contak Renewal
lay_definition_en: A device that helps treat heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das bei der Behandlung von Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: Insignia Entra

lay_definition_de: Insignia Entra ist ein Herzschrittmachertyp.

general_definition_en: A term that refers to individual anatomic parts of the heart or the vessels.
lay_definition_en: The cardiovascular system is all about the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Beim Herz-Kreislauf-System dreht sich alles um das Herz und die Blutgefäße.

general_definition_en: Branch of right coronary artery which runs over the anterior part of conus arteriosus and supplies the pulmonary conus and the upper part of right ventricle. medullaris
lay_definition_en: The bottom part of the spinal cord.
lay_definition_de: Der untere Teil des Rückenmarks.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that carries oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: In surgery, the cooling of a tissue, organ, or body part after its blood supply has been reduced or cut off. This can occur while the organ is still in the body or after it is removed from the body if the organ is to be used for transplantation.
lay_definition_en: Keeping a body part cold after blood flow stops.
lay_definition_de: Ein Körperteil nach dem Aussetzen der Durchblutung kühl halten.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to widen a narrow blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Erweiterung eines verengten Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: serial cardiac enzymes
lay_definition_en: A test that checks if someone's heart is damaged.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, mit dem geprüft wird, ob das Herz einer Person geschädigt ist.

general_definition_en: regular A measurement of degree, speed, or frequency relative to time. and An electrocardiographic finding in which the cardiac rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: How steady and consistent your heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Wie gleichmäßig und beständig dein Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: The recurrent, measured movements (rhythm) of a beating heart.
lay_definition_en: Your heart's regular thumping.
lay_definition_de: Das regelmäßige Klopfen deines Herzens.

general_definition_en: Human LMNA wild-type allele is located within 1q22 and is approximately 25 kb in length. This allele, which encodes prelamin-A/C protein, plays a role in nuclear stability and chromatin structure. Mutations in the LMNA gene are associated with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, type 2B1, Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome, Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy, Malouf syndrome, autosomal dominant familial partial lipodystrophy type 2, lethal restrictive dermopathy, autosomal dominant limb girdle muscular dystrophy 1B and autosomal dominant dilated cardiomyopathy 1A..
lay_definition_en: The FPL is a muscle in your arm that helps bend your thumb.
lay_definition_de: Der FPL ist ein Muskel im Arm, der dabei hilft, den Daumen zu beugen.

general_definition_en: A type of surgical portasystemic shunt to reduce portal hypertension with associated complications of esophageal varices and ascites. It is performed percutaneously through the jugular vein and involves the creation of an intrahepatic shunt between the hepatic vein and portal vein. The channel is maintained by a metallic stent. The procedure can be performed in patients who have failed sclerotherapy and is an additional option to the surgical techniques of portocaval, mesocaval, and splenorenal shunts. It takes one to three hours to perform. (JAMA 1995;273(23):1824-30)
lay_definition_en: A medical test that checks if a hormone issue is due to the pituitary gland looping in venom samples.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Test, mit dem überprüft wird, ob eine Hormonstörung auf eine Fehlfunktion der Hypophyse zurückzuführen ist, indem Giftproben untersucht werden.

general_definition_en: A trace element with the atomic symbol B, atomic number 5, and atomic weight [10.806; 10.821]. Boron-10, an isotope of boron, is used as a neutron absorber in BORON NEUTRON CAPTURE THERAPY. - A recombinant version of the cardiac neurohormone, human B-type natriuretic peptide (hBNP) produced by the ventricular myocardium. Nesiritide binds to natriuretic peptide receptors on vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells, through which it triggers guanylate cyclase dependent signal transduction resulting in increase of intracellular concentrations of cGMP. This leads to smooth muscle cell relaxation causing arterial and venous dilatation.
lay_definition_en: A blood test that measures heart function, specifically indicating heart failure when BNP levels rise.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest zur Messung der Herzfunktion, der insbesondere bei einem Anstieg der BNP-Werte auf eine Herzinsuffizienz hinweist.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles, characterized by a progressively lengthening PR interval prior to the block of an atrial impulse. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A Wenckebach cycle on an ECG indicates a specific type of heart rhythm issue.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wenckebach-Zyklus im EKG weist auf eine bestimmte Art von Herzrhythmusstörung hin.

general_definition_en: An abnormality in which the cardiac ventricles depolarize too early as a result of an abnormality of cardiac conduction pathways such as an accessory pathway. [HPO:probinson]
lay_definition_en: The heart beats too fast because the lower chambers contract too early.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz schlägt zu schnell, weil sich die unteren Herzkammern zu früh zusammenziehen.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to create a detour around a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Herzoperation zur Schaffung einer Umgehung einer verstopften Arterie.

general_definition_en: The portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta and extending to the DIAPHRAGM, eventually connecting to the ABDOMINAL AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The section of the main artery that travels downwards through the chest.
lay_definition_de: Der Abschnitt der Hauptschlagader, der nach unten durch den Brustkorb verläuft.

general_definition_en: Within an artery (blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to tissues and organs in the body). Works about studies performed to evaluate the safety of diagnostic, therapeutic, or prophylactic drugs, devices, or techniques in healthy subjects and to determine the safe dosage range (if appropriate). These tests also are used to determine pharmacologic and pharmacokinetic properties (toxicity, metabolism, absorption, elimination, and preferred route of administration). They involve a small number of persons and usually last about 1 year. This concept includes phase I studies conducted both in the U.S. and in other countries.
lay_definition_en: A stage in a CT scan when the contrast is primarily in the arteries, not yet reaching the organs for better visibility.
lay_definition_de: Eine Phase während einer CT-Untersuchung, in der sich das Kontrastmittel hauptsächlich in den Arterien befindet und die Organe noch nicht erreicht hat, um eine bessere Sichtbarkeit zu gewährleisten.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A group of cells in the heart that regulates heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gruppe von Zellen im Herzen, die die Herzfrequenz reguliert.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta which prevents backflow into the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A part in the heart that controls blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Herzens, der den Blutfluss steuert.

general_definition_en: A fibrous membrane that attaches to, and provides support for, the aortic valve leaflets. VALVE
lay_definition_en: The aortic valve is a flap of tissue in the heart that helps blood flow into the body's largest artery.
lay_definition_de: Die Aortenklappe ist eine Gewebeklappe im Herzen, die den Blutfluss in die größte Arterie des Körpers unterstützt.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries. STENOSIS
lay_definition_en: Narrowing of the major artery leaving the heart.
lay_definition_de: Verengung der Hauptarterie, die vom Herzen ausgeht.

general_definition_en: MITRAL Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve problem where blood leaks backwards instead of flowing forward.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappenfehlfunktion, bei der das Blut zurückfließt, anstatt vorwärts zu fließen.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left atrium and left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A bicuspid is a type of heart valve with two flaps instead of the usual three.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bikuspidalklappe ist eine Herzklappe, die zwei Klappenblätter statt der üblichen drei aufweist.

general_definition_en: The junction of the upper and lower lips at the corner of the mouth.
lay_definition_en: A bicommissural valve in the heart has only two flaps instead of the usual three.
lay_definition_de: Eine bikommissurale Herzklappe hat nur zwei Klappensegel statt der üblichen drei.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left ventricle and the ascending aorta which prevents backflow into the left ventricle. INSUFFICIENCY
lay_definition_en: When the aortic valve doesn't close properly and blood flows in the wrong direction in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Aortenklappe nicht richtig schließt und das Blut im Herzen in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: A fibrous membrane that attaches to, and provides support for, the aortic valve leaflets.
lay_definition_en: The aortic valve is key in ensuring blood flows out of the heart in one direction into the body's largest artery.
lay_definition_de: Die Aortenklappe spielt eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, dass das Blut in einer Richtung aus dem Herzen in die größte Arterie des Körpers fließt.

general_definition_en: A layer of epithelium that lines the heart, blood vessels (ENDOTHELIUM, VASCULAR), lymph vessels (ENDOTHELIUM, LYMPHATIC), and the serous cavities of the body.
lay_definition_en: Endothelial means the inner layer of a tissue or organ.
lay_definition_de: „Endothel“ bezeichnet die innere Schicht eines Gewebes oder Organs.

general_definition_en: Biocor porcine valve
lay_definition_en: A biocor porcine valve is a pig heart valve used to replace a damaged or diseased aortic or mitral valve in the human heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Biocor-Schweineklappe ist eine Herzklappe vom Schwein, die zum Ersatz einer beschädigten oder erkrankten Aorten- oder Mitralklappe im menschlichen Herzen verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Leaf of cardiac valve which has as its parts the anterior, and posterior leaflets that is attached to the chorda tendinea of left ventricle and to the frbrous ring of mitral valve.
lay_definition_en: Leaflets are thin pieces that make up a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Die Klappensegel sind dünne Blättchen, aus denen eine Herzklappe besteht.

general_definition_en: Narrowing below the PULMONARY VALVE or well below it in the infundibuluar chamber where the pulmonary artery originates, usually caused by a defective VENTRICULAR SEPTUM or presence of fibrous tissues. It is characterized by restricted blood outflow from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the PULMONARY ARTERY, exertional fatigue, DYSPNEA, and chest discomfort.
lay_definition_en: A part that provides support and anchoring for heart valves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil, das den Herzklappen Halt und Verankerung bietet.

general_definition_en: Removal of tissue with electrical current delivered via electrodes positioned at the distal end of a catheter. Energy sources are commonly direct current (DC-shock) or alternating current at radiofrequencies (usually 750 kHz). The technique is used most often to ablate the AV junction and/or accessory pathways in order to interrupt AV conduction and produce AV block in the treatment of various tachyarrhythmias.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure that fixes certain irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff zur Behandlung bestimmter Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: A measure of how effectively the heart pumps blood, often used to diagnose heart failure, with a normal range of 50-70 percent.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effektiv das Herz Blut pumpt; wird häufig zur Diagnose von Herzinsuffizienz herangezogen, wobei der Normalbereich bei 50 bis 70 Prozent liegt.

general_definition_en: Exerting influence or producing an effect. The act or operation of holding, suturing, or fastening in a fixed position. A device consisting of moving parts designed to perform a function.
lay_definition_en: A way to secure pacemaker leads in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode zur Fixierung von Herzschrittmacherelektroden im Herzen.

general_definition_en: Any factor that defines a system and determines (or limits) its performance.
lay_definition_en: Measures of how well the body is functioning, like heart rate.

lay_definition_de: Die Stimulationsfrequenz ist ein Maß dafür, wie effizient ein Herzschrittmacher und das Herz zusammenarbeiten.

lay_definition_de: Die Stimulation ist eine Methode, um zu überprüfen, wie gut ein Herzschrittmacher funktioniert.

lay_definition_en: A type of heart activity shown on an electrocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Herzaktivität, die im Elektrokardiogramm dargestellt wird.

general_definition_en: Radiographic visualization of the aorta and its branches by injection of contrast media, using percutaneous puncture or catheterization procedures.

lay_definition_de: Ein Aortogramm ist eine Röntgenaufnahme, die die größte Arterie des Körpers darstellt.

general_definition_en: A saline solution used to force an agent from tubing and peripheral veins into the central blood volume. A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A thin tube used to inject dye quickly into blood vessels for better imaging.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, mit dem Kontrastmittel schnell in die Blutgefäße injiziert wird, um eine bessere Bildgebung zu ermöglichen.

general_definition_en: Surgical venous shunt between the portal and systemic circulation to effect decompression of the portal circulation. It is performed primarily in the treatment of bleeding esophageal varices resulting from portal hypertension. Types of shunt include portacaval, splenorenal, mesocaval, splenocaval, left gastric-caval (coronary-caval), portarenal, umbilicorenal, and umbilicocaval. Anterior gradient protein 3 homolog (166 aa, ~19 kDa) is encoded by the human AGR3 gene. This protein may involved in the regulation of cilia motion.
lay_definition_en: Difference in blood pressure between two blood vessels, often elevated in liver disease.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruckunterschied zwischen zwei Blutgefäßen, der bei Lebererkrankungen häufig erhöht ist.

lay_definition_en: The time gap between two consecutive R waves in an EKG.

general_definition_en: An image of the heart produced by ultrasonography.
lay_definition_en: A heart picture using sound waves.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzbild mithilfe von Schallwellen.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: Stress is when your heart is put to the test by exercising or using medication to see how it performs under pressure.
lay_definition_de: Unter Belastung versteht man, wenn das Herz durch körperliche Belastung oder den Einsatz von Medikamenten auf die Probe gestellt wird, um zu sehen, wie es unter Druck funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A technique that utilizes a wire attached to the fetal scalp to monitor fetal heart rate. The wire detects fetal cardiac electrical activity to determine the baseline fetal heart rate and variability. breathhold
