lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um durch Atemstillstand schnell MRT-Bilder von sich bewegenden Organen wie dem Herzen aufzunehmen.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: A pulse is a brief burst of energy or vibration.
lay_definition_de: Ein Impuls ist ein kurzer Energie- oder Schwingungsstoß.

general_definition_en: A bipolar electrocardiogram limb lead which records the voltage between the positive electrode near the apex of the heart (located in the ICS of left 5-6 rib close to the sternum) and the negative electrode behind the right ear near the right mastoid process. (CDISC) diffusion - The relative importance granted to something.

lay_definition_de: Eine spezielle Art der MRT-Untersuchung, die detaillierte Bilder der inneren Strukturen des Körpers liefert.

general_definition_en: Problem associated with the increased rate of change in temperature, pressure, or other variables as a function of distance, time, etc. echo

lay_definition_de: Eine Technik, die bei einer MRT-Untersuchung eingesetzt wird, um Bilder aus dem Körperinneren aufzunehmen.

general_definition_en: A bipolar electrocardiogram limb lead which records the voltage between the positive electrode near the apex of the heart (located in the ICS of left 5-6 rib close to the sternum) and the negative electrode behind the right ear near the right mastoid process. (CDISC) sections

lay_definition_de: Eine Querschnittsdarstellung, die das Innere des Körpers zeigt.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that transports oxygen-poor blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: It is a word used to show the standard blood pressure level of a person.
lay_definition_de: Dieser Begriff wird verwendet, um den normalen Blutdruckwert einer Person anzugeben.

general_definition_en: A radiopharmaceutical consisting of tetrofosmin, composed of two bidentate diphosphine ligands chelating the metastable radioisotope technetium Tc-99 (99mTc), with potential imaging activity upon SPECT (single photon emission computed tomography). Upon administration, technetium Tc 99m tetrofosmin is preferentially taken up by, and accumulates in, myocardial cells. Upon imaging, myocardial cells can be visualized and changes in ischemia and/or perfusion can be detected.
lay_definition_en: A liquid drug containing radioactive material used for lung scans.
lay_definition_de: Ein flüssiges Arzneimittel, das radioaktives Material enthält und für Lungenuntersuchungen verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: A radiopharmaceutical consisting of tetrofosmin, composed of two bidentate diphosphine ligands chelating the metastable radioisotope technetium Tc-99 (99mTc), with potential imaging activity upon SPECT (single photon emission computed tomography). Upon administration, technetium Tc 99m tetrofosmin is preferentially taken up by, and accumulates in, myocardial cells. Upon imaging, myocardial cells can be visualized and changes in ischemia and/or perfusion can be detected.
lay_definition_en: A radioactive substance used in medical imaging tests.
lay_definition_de: Ein radioaktiver Stoff, der bei bildgebenden medizinischen Untersuchungen zum Einsatz kommt.

general_definition_en: fast spin echo T2
lay_definition_en: A technique in MRI that produces detailed images quickly.
lay_definition_de: Eine Technik in der MRT, mit der sich schnell detaillierte Bilder erstellen lassen.

general_definition_en: Cells that line the inner and outer surfaces of the body by forming cellular layers (EPITHELIUM) or masses. Epithelial cells lining the SKIN; the MOUTH; the NOSE; and the ANAL CANAL derive from ectoderm; those lining the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM and the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM derive from endoderm; others (CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM and LYMPHATIC SYSTEM) derive from mesoderm. Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Cells that form the skin and linings of body surfaces.
lay_definition_de: Zellen, aus denen die Haut und die Auskleidungen der Körperoberflächen bestehen.

general_definition_en: A carboxyl-containing angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor with antihypertensive activity. As a prodrug, benazepril is metabolized to its active form benazeprilat. Benazeprilat competitively binds to and inhibits ACE, thereby blocking the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II. This prevents the potent vasoconstrictive actions of angiotensin II resulting in vasodilation. Benazeprilat also decreases angiotensin II-induced aldosterone secretion by the adrenal cortex, which leads to an increase in sodium excretion and subsequently increases water outflow.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps improve blood circulation and reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung und zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

lay_definition_de: Eine visuelle Darstellung des Aufbaus des Herzens.

general_definition_en: An imprecise term referring to dementia associated with CEREBROVASCULAR DISORDERS, including CEREBRAL INFARCTION (single or multiple), and conditions associated with chronic BRAIN ISCHEMIA. Diffuse, cortical, and subcortical subtypes have been described. (From Gerontol Geriatr 1998 Feb;31(1):36-44)
lay_definition_en: Vascular dementia is a type of memory loss caused by damage to the brain from strokes.
lay_definition_de: Die vaskuläre Demenz ist eine Form des Gedächtnisverlusts, die durch Schädigungen des Gehirns infolge von Schlaganfällen verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates in the sinus node.
lay_definition_en: When your heart is beating faster than normal, it's called tachycardia.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz schneller als normal schlägt, spricht man von Tachykardie.

general_definition_en: paroxymal A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates above the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: Fast heart rate that comes and goes unpredictably.
lay_definition_de: Eine schnelle Herzfrequenz, die unvorhersehbar auftritt und wieder verschwindet.

general_definition_en: The dimension of the physical universe which, at a given place, orders the sequence of events. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed) -
lay_definition_en: The time it takes for the heart's ventricle to recharge shown on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Die Zeit, die der Herzventrikel benötigt, um sich wieder aufzuladen, wie sie im EKG dargestellt wird.

general_definition_en: An augmented unipolar electrocardiogram limb lead in which the positive (red) electrode is situated on the left pelvic limb and the negative electrode is a combination of the right thoracic limb (white) electrode and the left thoracic limb (black) electrode. Measures the electrical activity of the electrode on the left pelvic limb.
lay_definition_en: An electrical signal recorded during a heart test to track heart activity.
lay_definition_de: Ein elektrisches Signal, das während einer Herzuntersuchung aufgezeichnet wird, um die Herzaktivität zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding that represents depolarization of the ventricular myocardium. Normally the ventricles are activated simultaneously.
lay_definition_en: The QRS is the electrical activity pattern of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das QRS ist das Muster der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: A pulse ox is a device that checks the oxygen level in your blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Pulsoximeter ist ein Gerät, das den Sauerstoffgehalt im Blut misst.

lay_definition_en: Heart rate: How fast your heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Herzfrequenz: Wie schnell Ihr Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
lay_definition_en: Assisting with breathing by providing extra oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Unterstützung der Atmung durch die Zufuhr von zusätzlichem Sauerstoff.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Bottom number of blood pressure reading when the heart is resting.
lay_definition_de: Der untere Wert des Blutdruckmesswerts im Ruhezustand des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG. [DDD:dbrown, HPO:probinson]
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm disorder known as RBBB.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung, die als RBBB bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: To possess every necessary or normal part or component or step; having come or been brought to a conclusion. heart block
lay_definition_en: Heart rhythm issue caused by an electrical problem in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Herzrhythmusstörung, die durch eine elektrische Störung im Herzen verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: A condition that is characterized by episodes of fainting (SYNCOPE) and varying degree of ventricular arrhythmia as indicated by the prolonged QT interval. The inherited forms are caused by mutation of genes encoding cardiac ion channel proteins. The two major forms are ROMANO-WARD SYNDROME and JERVELL-LANGE NIELSEN SYNDROME.
lay_definition_en: A condition where your heart has irregular and dangerous rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der Ihr Herz unregelmäßige und gefährliche Rhythmen aufweist.

general_definition_en: In an individual with a right-dominant heart, the arterial branch that arises from the distal right coronary artery between the acute marginal artery and the first right posterolateral segment. It supplies the inferior apex of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel that transports blood from the heart to the entire body.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen in den gesamten Körper transportiert.

general_definition_en: A face that is short (HP:0011219) and narrow (HP:0000275). [HP:probinson] - Any of the tubular vessels conveying the blood (arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, and veins). A hypoperfusion of the BLOOD through an organ or tissue caused by a PATHOLOGIC CONSTRICTION or obstruction of its BLOOD VESSELS, or an absence of BLOOD CIRCULATION.
lay_definition_en: When small arteries in the heart get damaged, it's a type of heart disease that can also raise the risk of strokes in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Wenn kleine Arterien im Herzen geschädigt werden, handelt es sich um eine Herzerkrankung, die auch das Risiko für Schlaganfälle im Gehirn erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: fem - This gene may be involved in both transcriptional repression and protein ubiquitination.
lay_definition_en: Fem-pop is bypass surgery that treats a blocked artery in the leg by creating a detour with another blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Fem-Pop ist ein Bypass-Eingriff, bei dem eine verstopfte Arterie im Bein behandelt wird, indem mit einem anderen Blutgefäß eine Umgehung geschaffen wird.

general_definition_en: mid cab
lay_definition_en: A less invasive surgery for heart disease that doesn't require the chest to be opened up.
lay_definition_de: Ein minimalinvasiver Eingriff bei Herzerkrankungen, bei dem der Brustkorb nicht geöffnet werden muss.

general_definition_en: Insufficiency of arterial or venous blood supply to the spleen due to emboli, thrombi, vascular torsion, or pressure that produces a macroscopic area of necrosis. (From Stedman, 25th ed)
lay_definition_en: Small areas of dead tissue due to a lack of blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Kleine Bereiche mit abgestorbenem Gewebe aufgrund mangelnder Durchblutung.

general_definition_en: The external part of the cell wall and/or plasma membrane. [GOC:jl, GOC:mtg_sensu, GOC:sm] Recording of the moment-to-moment electromotive forces of the HEART as projected onto various sites on the body's surface, delineated as a scalar function of time. The recording is monitored by a tracing on slow moving chart paper or by observing it on a cardioscope, which is a CATHODE RAY TUBE DISPLAY.
lay_definition_en: A way to check heart activity using electrodes on the skin.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode zur Überprüfung der Herzaktivität mithilfe von Elektroden auf der Haut.

general_definition_en: Recording of the moment-to-moment electromotive forces of the HEART as projected onto various sites on the body's surface, delineated as a scalar function of time. The recording is monitored by a tracing on slow moving chart paper or by observing it on a cardioscope, which is a CATHODE RAY TUBE DISPLAY.
lay_definition_en: A test that records the heart's electrical activity and rhythm. Also known as ECG or EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität und der Rhythmus des Herzens aufgezeichnet werden. Auch als ECG oder EKG bekannt.

general_definition_en: ekg
lay_definition_en: A test that checks the electrical activity of your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der die elektrische Aktivität Ihres Herzens überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: first degree
lay_definition_en: First degree is a type of mild heart disease with slight changes in the heart's electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Ein Block ersten Grades ist eine Form einer leichten Herzerkrankung, bei der es zu geringfügigen Veränderungen der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens kommt.

general_definition_en: Arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.
lay_definition_en: A big artery in your belly that supplies blood to your digestive system.
lay_definition_de: Eine große Arterie im Bauchraum, die das Verdauungssystem mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A period of time that it takes for Earth to make a complete revolution around the sun, approximately 365 days; a specific one year period. - Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: A-Fib is when your heartbeat is funky and can make you tired or cause strokes.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern ist der Herzrhythmus unregelmäßig, was zu Müdigkeit führen oder einen Schlaganfall auslösen kann.

general_definition_en: The lower portion of the BRAIN STEM. It is inferior to the PONS and anterior to the CEREBELLUM. Medulla oblongata serves as a relay station between the brain and the spinal cord, and contains centers for regulating respiratory, vasomotor, cardiac, and reflex activities.
lay_definition_en: A part of the brain that controls important automatic body functions like breathing.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Gehirns, der wichtige automatische Körperfunktionen wie die Atmung steuert.

general_definition_en: Region of heart which has as its parts the left atrium and left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: Heart failure where the left side of the heart is weakened and doesn't pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Herzinsuffizienz, bei der die linke Herzhälfte geschwächt ist und das Blut nicht mehr ausreichend pumpen kann.

general_definition_en: vs
lay_definition_en: VS are numbers that tell you how well your body is functioning, like blood pressure and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Vitalwerte sind Zahlen, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert, wie zum Beispiel Blutdruck und Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: Boston Scientific 's Genus of coniferous yew trees or shrubs, several species of which have medicinal uses. Notable is the Pacific yew, Taxus brevifolia, which is used to make the anti-neoplastic drug taxol (PACLITAXEL). - eluting
lay_definition_en: A Boston Scientific's Taxus drug-eluting stent is a specialized metal tube inserted into a blocked artery to maintain its openness.
lay_definition_de: Ein medikamentenbeschichteter Taxus-Stent von Boston Scientific ist ein spezielles Metallröhrchen, das in eine verstopfte Arterie eingesetzt wird, um deren Durchgängigkeit zu gewährleisten.

general_definition_en: Branch of anterior interventricular branch of left coronary artery which arises from the terminal end of the left coronary artery between the angle formed by the anterior interventricular branch and the circumflex branch of the left coronary artery and supplies the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A diagonal is a slanted line or connection between two non-adjacent corners or points.
lay_definition_de: Eine Diagonale ist eine schräge Linie oder Verbindung zwischen zwei nicht benachbarten Ecken oder Punkten.

general_definition_en: Cosgrove annuloplasty band
lay_definition_en: A Cosgrove annuloplasty band is a device brand used in heart surgery to change the size of a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Cosgrove-Annuloplastieband ist ein Produkt, das in der Herzchirurgie eingesetzt wird, um die Größe einer Herzklappe zu verändern.

general_definition_en: supraannular
lay_definition_en: Above the base of a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Oberhalb der Basis einer Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Heart disease which occurs as a result of a primary pulmonary disease. Cor pulmonale most often manifests as right ventricular hypertrophy; it can also lead to right ventricular failure.
lay_definition_en: When your heart gets sick because of your lung problem, it's called cor pulmonale.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz aufgrund Ihrer Lungenerkrankung erkrankt, spricht man von einem Cor pulmonale.

general_definition_en: The time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the cardiac cycle as corrected with a non-specified correction formula.
lay_definition_en: QTc is a measurement on a heart test that shows how long it takes for the heart to recharge between beats.
lay_definition_de: Der QTc-Wert ist ein Messwert aus einem Herzuntersuchungstest, der angibt, wie lange das Herz zwischen zwei Herzschlägen braucht, um sich wieder aufzuladen.

general_definition_en: Disease or damage involving the SCIATIC NERVE, which divides into the PERONEAL NERVE and TIBIAL NERVE (see also PERONEAL NEUROPATHIES and TIBIAL NEUROPATHY). Clinical manifestations may include SCIATICA or pain localized to the hip, PARESIS or PARALYSIS of posterior thigh muscles and muscles innervated by the peroneal and tibial nerves, and sensory loss involving the lateral and posterior thigh, posterior and lateral leg, and sole of the foot. The sciatic nerve may be affected by trauma; ISCHEMIA; COLLAGEN DISEASES; and other conditions. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1363)
lay_definition_en: This nerve can cause pain or numbness if compressed by certain spinal issues.
lay_definition_de: Dieser Nerv kann Schmerzen oder Taubheitsgefühle verursachen, wenn er durch bestimmte Wirbelsäulenprobleme eingeklemmt wird.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive test usually done during the third trimester to check for fetal well being. It is performed using an external fetal heart rate monitor to assess the fetal heart rate response to fetal movements.
lay_definition_en: A stress test checks how well your heart functions under pressure from activities or medication.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem Belastungstest wird geprüft, wie gut Ihr Herz unter Belastung durch körperliche Aktivitäten oder Medikamente funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The left lower chamber of the heart that receives blood from the left atrium and pumps it through the aorta to the body.
lay_definition_en: A ventricle is a bottom part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzkammer ist der untere Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A synthetic lipid-lowering agent. Atorvastatin competitively inhibits hepatic hydroxymethyl-glutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the enzyme which catalyzes the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a key step in cholesterol synthesis. Atorvastatin also increases the number of LDL receptors on hepatic cell surfaces to enhance uptake and catabolism of LDL and reduces LDL production and the number of LDL particles. This agent lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels and modulates immune responses by suppressing MHC II (major histocompatibility complex II) on interferon gamma-stimulated, antigen-presenting cells such as human vascular endothelial cells. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce levels of cholesterol in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, den Cholesterinspiegel im Blut zu senken.

general_definition_en: A synthetic lipid-lowering agent. Atorvastatin competitively inhibits hepatic hydroxymethyl-glutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, the enzyme which catalyzes the conversion of HMG-CoA to mevalonate, a key step in cholesterol synthesis. Atorvastatin also increases the number of LDL receptors on hepatic cell surfaces to enhance uptake and catabolism of LDL and reduces LDL production and the number of LDL particles. This agent lowers plasma cholesterol and lipoprotein levels and modulates immune responses by suppressing MHC II (major histocompatibility complex II) on interferon gamma-stimulated, antigen-presenting cells such as human vascular endothelial cells. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: Atorvastatin is a medication that helps reduce both good and bad fats in the blood to lower cholesterol levels.
lay_definition_de: Atorvastatin ist ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, sowohl die „guten“ als auch die „schlechten“ Fette im Blut zu senken und so den Cholesterinspiegel zu senken.

general_definition_en: A ticlopidine analog and platelet purinergic P2Y receptor antagonist that inhibits adenosine diphosphate-mediated PLATELET AGGREGATION. It is used to prevent THROMBOEMBOLISM in patients with ARTERIAL OCCLUSIVE DISEASES; MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; STROKE; or ATRIAL FIBRILLATION.
lay_definition_en: Medication that stops blood clots and reduces heart disease and stroke risks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Bildung von Blutgerinnseln verhindert und das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: A disorder of neuromuscular transmission characterized by fatigable weakness of cranial and skeletal muscles with elevated titers of ACETYLCHOLINE RECEPTORS or muscle-specific receptor tyrosine kinase (MuSK) autoantibodies. Clinical manifestations may include ocular muscle weakness (fluctuating, asymmetric, external ophthalmoplegia; diplopia; ptosis; and weakness of eye closure) and extraocular fatigable weakness of facial, bulbar, respiratory, and proximal limb muscles. The disease may remain limited to the ocular muscles (ocular myasthenia). THYMOMA is commonly associated with this condition.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps prevent blood clots and reduces the chances of heart disease and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt und das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: The celiac artery is a big blood vessel that brings blood to the organs in the belly.
lay_definition_de: Die Zöliakiearterie ist ein großes Blutgefäß, das die Organe im Bauchraum mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heart block is when your heart beats too slowly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzblock liegt vor, wenn das Herz zu langsam schlägt.

general_definition_en: Double-layered inflatable suits which, when inflated, exert pressure on the lower part of the wearer's body. The suits are used to improve or stabilize the circulatory state, i.e., to prevent hypotension, control hemorrhage, and regulate blood pressure. The suits are also used by pilots under positive acceleration.
lay_definition_en: Something that can be pumped up with air.
lay_definition_de: Etwas, das man mit Luft aufpumpen kann.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by dysfunctions related to the SINOATRIAL NODE including impulse generation (CARDIAC SINUS ARREST) and impulse conduction (SINOATRIAL EXIT BLOCK). It is characterized by persistent BRADYCARDIA, chronic ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, and failure to resume sinus rhythm following CARDIOVERSION. This syndrome can be congenital or acquired, particularly after surgical correction for heart defects.
lay_definition_en: When the heart's natural pacemaker, the sinus node, malfunctions, it leads to a disorder called sick sinus node syndrome that affects the heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der natürliche Schrittmacher des Herzens, der Sinusknoten, nicht richtig funktioniert, führt dies zu einer Erkrankung namens Sinusknotensyndrom, die den Herzrhythmus beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site at which the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall level with lead V5 at the left midaxillary line. None
lay_definition_en: A bone found in the neck.
lay_definition_de: Ein Knochen, der im Nacken gefunden wurde.

general_definition_en: a valve that controls blood flow between heart chambers commissurotomy
lay_definition_en: A surgery to fix a problem with the heart's mitral valve and improve blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Operation zur Behebung eines Problems mit der Mitralklappe des Herzens und zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung.

general_definition_en: Consisting of or involving two parts or components, often in pairs. - Organ chamber which consists of a wall that surrounds the cavity of a cardiac atrium or ventricle. An electrocardiographic assessment of the rate of firing of a an artificial, mechanical pacemaker.
lay_definition_en: A dual-chamber AV pacemaker is a device that helps regulate the heart rhythm by sending electrical signals to both the top and bottom chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zweikammer-AV-Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, den Herzrhythmus zu regulieren, indem es elektrische Signale sowohl an die obere als auch an die untere Herzkammer sendet.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart. - The small mass of modified cardiac muscle fibers located at the junction of the superior vena cava (VENA CAVA, SUPERIOR) and right atrium. Contraction impulses probably start in this node, spread over the atrium (HEART ATRIUM) and are then transmitted by the atrioventricular bundle (BUNDLE OF HIS) to the ventricle (HEART VENTRICLE).
lay_definition_en: A special group of cells that help regulate the heart's rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine spezielle Zellgruppe, die zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Capoten
lay_definition_en: Medication used for high blood pressure or heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck oder Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A widely used non-cardioselective beta-adrenergic antagonist. Propranolol has been used for MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; ARRHYTHMIA; ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; HYPERTHYROIDISM; MIGRAINE; PHEOCHROMOCYTOMA; and ANXIETY but adverse effects instigate replacement by newer drugs.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and lowering blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und zur Senkung des Blutdrucks hilft.

general_definition_en: An artery arising from the right ventricle of the heart that bifurcates into the left and right pulmonary arteries. PRESSURE
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure in the artery taking blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck in der Arterie, die das Blut vom Herzen zu den Lungen transportiert.

general_definition_en: The hollow, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood. FAILURE
lay_definition_en: Heart failure is when your heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Von Herzinsuffizienz spricht man, wenn das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, Blut effektiv zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A face that is short (HP:0011219) and narrow (HP:0000275). [HP:probinson] VESSEL ISCHEMIC
lay_definition_en: Small vessel ischemic : A condition where small arteries in the heart are injured, leading to heart disease or increased risk of strokes in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Ischämie der kleinen Gefäße: Ein Zustand, bei dem kleine Arterien im Herzen geschädigt sind, was zu einer Herzerkrankung oder einem erhöhten Risiko für Schlaganfälle im Gehirn führt.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
lay_definition_en: A major blood vessel that transports oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: R-wave sensing
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker setting that detects R-waves.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmachereinstellung, die R-Wellen erkennt.

general_definition_en: A direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: Hydralazine is a medication that helps with chest pain, high blood pressure, and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Hydralazin ist ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: A potassium sparing diuretic that acts by antagonism of aldosterone in the distal renal tubules. It is used mainly in the treatment of refractory edema in patients with congestive heart failure, nephrotic syndrome, or hepatic cirrhosis. Its effects on the endocrine system are utilized in the treatments of hirsutism and acne but they can lead to adverse effects. (From Martindale, The Extra Pharmacopoeia, 30th ed, p827)
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower blood pressure and manage potassium levels in the blood while also reducing fluid retention in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks und zur Regulierung des Kaliumspiegels im Blut beiträgt und gleichzeitig die Flüssigkeitsansammlung im Körper verringert.

general_definition_en: A thiazide diuretic often considered the prototypical member of this class. It reduces the reabsorption of electrolytes from the renal tubules. This results in increased excretion of water and electrolytes, including sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium. It is used in the treatment of several disorders including edema, hypertension, diabetes insipidus, and hypoparathyroidism.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps decrease body fluid, often used for high blood pressure and swelling.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das zur Verringerung der Körperflüssigkeit beiträgt und häufig bei Bluthochdruck und Ödemen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: a valve that controls blood flow between heart chambers
lay_definition_en: A door-like valve in the heart that separates its left chambers.
lay_definition_de: Eine klappenartige Struktur im Herzen, die die linken Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: Localized reduction of blood flow to brain tissue due to arterial obstruction or systemic hypoperfusion. This frequently occurs in conjunction with brain hypoxia (HYPOXIA, BRAIN). Prolonged ischemia is associated with BRAIN INFARCTION.
lay_definition_en: Ischemia is when there's a lack of blood flow due to blocked blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Ischämie spricht man, wenn aufgrund verstopfter Blutgefäße die Durchblutung nicht mehr ausreichend gewährleistet ist.

general_definition_en: No
lay_definition_en: A measure of how efficiently the heart's left ventricle pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effizient der linke Ventrikel des Herzens Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: No
lay_definition_en: A way to check how effectively your heart's left ventricle pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um zu überprüfen, wie effektiv die linke Herzkammer Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: A bulge or ballooning in the wall of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A test for checking how well your heart is pumping - LV Wall.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test zur Überprüfung der Pumpleistung Ihres Herzens – LV-Wall.

general_definition_en: A surgical procedure during which the blood supply to an organ or tissue is interrupted and then later reestablished.
lay_definition_en: Ischemia means a lack of blood flow to an organ or tissue causing side effects or harm.
lay_definition_de: Unter Ischämie versteht man eine Durchblutungsstörung eines Organs oder Gewebes, die zu Nebenwirkungen oder Schäden führt.

lay_definition_en: How well the heart's left ventricle pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Wie gut die linke Herzkammer Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: on
lay_definition_en: A measure of how effectively the heart's left ventricle pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effektiv die linke Herzkammer Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: #NAME?
lay_definition_en: A sudden and serious issue with the heart, like a heart attack or severe chest pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches und schwerwiegendes Herzproblem, wie beispielsweise ein Herzinfarkt oder starke Brustschmerzen.

general_definition_en: device which makes prolonged electrocardiographic recordings on a portable tape recorder (Holter-type system) or solid-state device ("real-time" system), while the patient undergoes normal daily activities; useful in the diagnosis and management of intermittent cardiac arrhythmias and transient myocardial ischemia.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks your heartbeat and watches for any irregularities.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der Ihr Herzschlag gemessen und auf Unregelmäßigkeiten überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: CARDIOLITE
lay_definition_en: A substance used in tests to check for heart disease in patients.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz, die bei Untersuchungen zur Feststellung von Herzerkrankungen bei Patienten verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the ABDOMINAL AORTA which gives rise to the visceral, the parietal, and the terminal (iliac) branches below the aortic hiatus at the diaphragm. ANEURYSM
lay_definition_en: A weakened area in the main blood vessel of the abdomen that can burst and lead to dangerous internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine geschwächte Stelle im Hauptblutgefäß des Bauchraums, die reißen und zu gefährlichen inneren Blutungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: In medicine, a small, abnormal patch of tissue on a body part or an organ. Plaques may also be a build-up of substances from a fluid, such as cholesterol in the blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Plaque is a buildup of fat and waxy substances that can lead to heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Plaque ist eine Ablagerung aus Fett und wachsartigen Substanzen, die zu Herzerkrankungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: The hydrochloride salt form of isoproterenol, a synthetic catechol compound and potent beta adrenergic agonist with peripheral vasodilator, bronchodilator, and cardiac stimulating properties. general_definition_en:
What is type 2 diabetes?

If you have diabetes, your blood sugar levels are too high. With type 2 diabetes, this happens because your body does not make enough insulin, or it does not use insulin well (this is called insulin resistance). If you are at risk for type 2 diabetes, you might be able to prevent or delay developing it.

Who is at risk for type 2 diabetes?

Many Americans are at risk for type 2 diabetes. Your chances of getting it depend on a combination of risk factors such as your genes and lifestyle. The risk factors include

  • Having prediabetes, which means you have blood sugar levels that are higher than normal but not high enough to be called diabetes
  • Being overweight or having obesity
  • Being age 45 or older
  • A family history of diabetes
  • Being African American, Alaska Native, American Indian, Asian American, Hispanic/Latino, Native Hawaiian, or Pacific Islander
  • Having high blood pressure
  • Having a low level of HDL (good) cholesterol or a high level of triglycerides
  • A history of diabetes in pregnancy
  • Having given birth to a baby weighing 9 pounds or more
  • An inactive lifestyle
  • A history of heart disease or stroke
  • Having depression
  • Having polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
  • Having acanthosis nigricans, a skin condition in which your skin becomes dark and thick, especially around your neck or armpits
  • Smoking

How can I prevent or delay getting type 2 diabetes?

If you are at risk for diabetes, you may be able to prevent or delay getting it. Most of the things that you need to do involve having a healthier lifestyle. So if you make these changes, you will get other health benefits as well. You may lower your risk of other diseases, and you will probably feel better and have more energy. The changes are

  • Losing weight and keeping it off. Weight control is an important part of diabetes prevention. You may be able to prevent or delay diabetes by losing 5 to 10 percent of your current weight. For example, if you weigh 200 pounds, your goal would be to lose between 10 to 20 pounds. And once you lose the weight, it is important that you don't gain it back.
  • Following a healthy eating plan. It is important to reduce the amount of calories you eat and drink each day, so you can lose weight and keep it off. To do that, your diet should include smaller portions and less fat and sugar. You should also eat a variety of foods from each food group, including plenty of whole grains, fruits, and vegetables. It's also a good idea to limit red meat, and avoid processed meats.
  • Get regular exercise. Exercise has many health benefits, including helping you to lose weight and lower your blood sugar levels. These both lower your risk of type 2 diabetes. Try to get at least 30 minutes of physical activity 5 days a week. If you have not been active, talk with your health care professional to figure out which types of exercise are best for you. You can start slowly and work up to your goal.
  • Don't smoke. Smoking can contribute to insulin resistance, which can lead to type 2 diabetes. If you already smoke, try to quit.
  • Talk to your health care provider to see whether there is anything else you can do to delay or to prevent type 2 diabetes. If you are at high risk, your provider may suggest that you take one of a few types of diabetes medicines.

lay_definition_de: Ein Programm, das Menschen mit Herzproblemen dabei helfen soll, gesünder zu werden.

lay_definition_en: A connection between an artery and a vein.
lay_definition_de: Eine Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving any of the various HEART VALVES and the associated structures (PAPILLARY MUSCLES and CHORDAE TENDINEAE).
lay_definition_en: Problem with heart valves causing issues with blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Probleme mit den Herzklappen, die zu Durchblutungsstörungen im Herzen führen.

lay_definition_de: Plötzliche Atembeschwerden, die nachts auftreten, das Atmen erschweren und Husten auslösen.

lay_definition_en: Things you can change to lower the risk of having a stroke.

lay_definition_de: Schilddrüsenhormone sind von der Schilddrüse gebildete Botenstoffe, die die Herzfrequenz, den Blutdruck, die Körpertemperatur und das Gewicht regulieren.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to the myocardium. infarctions

Associated conditions include OBESITY; ACROMEGALY; MYXEDEMA; micrognathia; MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY; adenotonsilar dystrophy; and NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES. lay_definition_de: Eine künstliche Herzklappe.

lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, wodurch Blut zurück ins Herz fließt.

lay_definition_en: A pulseless person's heart has stopped.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Person ohne Puls hat das Herz aufgehört zu schlagen.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft, indem es bestimmte Botenstoffe blockiert.

general_definition_en: Syncope following a quick change in position from lying down to standing. [HPO:probinson] Abnormally low BLOOD PRESSURE that can result in inadequate blood flow to the brain and other vital organs. Common symptom is DIZZINESS but greater negative impacts on the body occur when there is prolonged depravation of oxygen and nutrients.
lay_definition_en: When you stand up quickly and feel lightheaded because your blood pressure drops, that's orthostatic hypotension.
lay_definition_de: Wenn man schnell aufsteht und sich schwindelig fühlt, weil der Blutdruck abfällt, spricht man von orthostatischer Hypotonie.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the ventricular rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A consistent beat of the heart's lower chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein gleichmäßiger Rhythmus der unteren Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: Inflammation of the PERICARDIUM that is characterized by the fibrous scarring and adhesion of both serous layers, the VISCERAL PERICARDIUM and the PARIETAL PERICARDIUM leading to the loss of pericardial cavity. The thickened pericardium severely restricts cardiac filling. Clinical signs include FATIGUE, muscle wasting, and WEIGHT LOSS.
lay_definition_en: When your lungs' tiny airways get blocked because they're inflamed.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die winzigen Atemwege in Ihrer Lunge durch eine Entzündung verstopft sind.

general_definition_en: A transition where a cardiac endothelial cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell. Endocardial cells (specialized endothelial cells that line the heart) undergo EndMT, and give rise to mesenchymal cells necessary for proper heart development. EndMT, specifically generates valve progenitor cells that give rise to the mitral and tricuspid valves. EndMT also contributes to endocardial cushion formation, as well as to generation of cardiac fibroblasts and smooth muscle cells, but not cardiac myocytes. [GOC:BHF, GOC:nc, PMID:16162442, PMID:26053665]
lay_definition_en: OMT is when a healthcare provider manually moves your muscles and joints to help with healing and pain relief.
lay_definition_de: Bei der OMT bewegt ein Gesundheitsfachkraft Ihre Muskeln und Gelenke manuell, um die Heilung zu fördern und Schmerzen zu lindern.

lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat low levels of red blood cells in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung eines niedrigen Gehalts an roten Blutkörperchen im Körper.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by prolonged exposure to excess levels of cortisol (HYDROCORTISONE) or other GLUCOCORTICOIDS from endogenous or exogenous sources. It is characterized by upper body OBESITY; OSTEOPOROSIS; HYPERTENSION; DIABETES MELLITUS; HIRSUTISM; AMENORRHEA; and excess body fluid. Endogenous Cushing syndrome or spontaneous hypercortisolism is divided into two groups, those due to an excess of ADRENOCORTICOTROPIN and those that are ACTH-independent.

lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die durch einen Überschuss des Steroids Cortisol im Körper verursacht wird.

lay_definition_de: Ein chordaler SAM ist ein bei einer Untersuchung festgestelltes Herzproblem, das auf eine bestimmte Herzerkrankung hindeuten könnte.

general_definition_en: Oils high in unsaturated fats extracted from the bodies of fish or fish parts, especially the LIVER. Those from the liver are usually high in VITAMIN A. The oils are used as DIETARY SUPPLEMENTS. They are also used in soaps and detergents and as protective coatings. fatty
lay_definition_en: Good fats in fish oil that reduce the risk of heart disease by decreasing triglyceride levels.
lay_definition_de: Die in Fischöl enthaltenen gesunden Fette senken das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen, indem sie den Triglyceridspiegel senken.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM including the HEART; the BLOOD VESSELS; or the PERICARDIUM.
lay_definition_en: A condition that impacts the heart or blood vessels.

lay_definition_en: A medication used to reduce pain, fever, inflammation, blood clotting, and heart attack risk.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Linderung von Schmerzen, Fieber und Entzündungen sowie zur Verringerung der Blutgerinnung und des Herzinfarktrisikos.

general_definition_en: A group of cardiac arrhythmias in which the cardiac contractions are not initiated at the SINOATRIAL NODE. They include both atrial and ventricular premature beats, and are also known as extra or ectopic heartbeats. Their frequency is increased in heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: A skipped or extra heartbeat in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein ausgelassener oder zusätzlicher Herzschlag.

lay_definition_en: Medication that helps prevent blood clots and reduces the chances of heart disease and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt und das Risiko für Herzerkrankungen und Schlaganfälle senkt.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: Being confused, disoriented, and not able to think or remember clearly.
lay_definition_de: Verwirrt und desorientiert sein und nicht in der Lage sein, klar zu denken oder sich klar zu erinnern.

lay_definition_en: A small branch of the heart artery found in certain individuals.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner Ast der Herzarterie, der bei bestimmten Personen vorkommt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close correctly and blood leaks back into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt und Blut zurück ins Herz fließt.

lay_definition_en: Pulmonary hypertension is when the blood pressure in the lungs is higher than normal.

The respiratory pauses may induce HYPERCAPNIA or HYPOXIA. Cardiac arrhythmias and elevation of systemic and pulmonary arterial pressures may occur. Frequent partial arousals occur throughout sleep, resulting in relative SLEEP DEPRIVATION and daytime tiredness. Associated conditions include OBESITY; ACROMEGALY; MYXEDEMA; micrognathia; MYOTONIC DYSTROPHY; adenotonsilar dystrophy; and NEUROMUSCULAR DISEASES. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p395)
lay_definition_en: When your airways get blocked while you sleep, causing disruptions in your sleep and other issues.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich Ihre Atemwege im Schlaf verengen, was zu Schlafstörungen und anderen Problemen führt.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood as usual in congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzinsuffizienz hat das Herz Schwierigkeiten, das Blut wie gewohnt zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A procedure involving an electronic device that delivers electrical stimulation to the heart to treat bradycardia. (ACC) revision
lay_definition_en: Fixing a heart device when it's not working properly.
lay_definition_de: Reparatur eines Herzgeräts, wenn es nicht richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure or right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: Pulmonary fibrosis is a sickness that causes scarring of lung tissue.
lay_definition_de: Die Lungenfibrose ist eine Erkrankung, die zu einer Vernarbung des Lungengewebes führt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: Problem with a heart valve that makes blood flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappenfehlfunktion, bei der das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: A PAC is a certified physician assistant who works under a doctor's supervision.
lay_definition_de: Ein PAC ist ein zertifizierter Arztassistent, der unter der Aufsicht eines Arztes arbeitet.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: The heart struggles to pump blood throughout the body in CHF.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Herzinsuffizienz (CHF) hat das Herz Mühe, Blut durch den Körper zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: The standard deviations of the sample in a frequency distribution, obtained by dividing the standard deviation by the square root of the total number of cases in the frequency distribution.
lay_definition_en: A sound heard inside the body from blood flowing through a narrowed vessel or irregular heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Geräusch, das im Körper zu hören ist und durch den Blutfluss durch ein verengtes Gefäß oder eine unregelmäßige Herzklappe entsteht.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of homocysteine amino acid present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: Homocysteine is a natural amino acid that can cause health issues like blood clots and heart disease if levels are too high.
lay_definition_de: Homocystein ist eine natürliche Aminosäure, die bei zu hohen Werten gesundheitliche Probleme wie Blutgerinnsel und Herzerkrankungen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: AV means a connection between an artery and a vein.
lay_definition_de: AV bezeichnet eine Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene.

general_definition_en: The area covering the terminal portion of ESOPHAGUS and the beginning of STOMACH at the cardiac orifice.
lay_definition_en: Related to the stomach and the esophagus.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf den Magen und die Speiseröhre.

general_definition_en: systolic ejection
lay_definition_en: A sound heard from blood flowing through a narrowed vessel or irregular heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Geräusch, das entsteht, wenn Blut durch ein verengtes Gefäß oder eine unregelmäßige Herzklappe fließt.

general_definition_en: Albumin protein in urine samples, which is a marker for kidney dysfunction. Persistently elevated concentrations of albumin in the urine can be diagnostic for kidney damage caused by diabetes, high blood pressure, heart failure, cirrhosis, or lupus.
lay_definition_en: A protein made by your liver that helps carry substances around your body and maintains fluid levels in your bloodstream.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, das von Ihrer Leber gebildet wird und dabei hilft, Stoffe im Körper zu transportieren und den Flüssigkeitshaushalt im Blutkreislauf aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart. DISEASE
lay_definition_en: Heart disease caused by clogged arteries that supply blood to the heart, which can be deadly if left untreated.
lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankungen, die durch verstopfte Arterien verursacht werden, welche das Herz mit Blut versorgen; diese können tödlich verlaufen, wenn sie nicht behandelt werden.

general_definition_en: The branch of the right coronary artery that supplies blood to the right ventricular wall.
lay_definition_en: The right ventricle is a part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Ventrikel ist ein Teil des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Administration of a substance through the dermal layer of the skin into the systemic circulation by diffusion.
lay_definition_en: A device that controls heart rate in emergencies by sticking to the skin.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das in Notfällen die Herzfrequenz reguliert, indem es auf die Haut geklebt wird.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: A big blood vessel in the chest that sends blood to the chest, head, neck, shoulder, and arms.
lay_definition_de: Ein großes Blutgefäß in der Brust, das die Brust, den Kopf, den Hals, die Schultern und die Arme mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: ARTERY
lay_definition_en: An artery is a blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to all areas of the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie ist ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen in alle Bereiche des Körpers transportiert.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart defect characterized by the persistent opening of fetal DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS that connects the PULMONARY ARTERY to the descending aorta (AORTA, DESCENDING) allowing unoxygenated blood to bypass the lung and flow to the PLACENTA. Normally, the ductus is closed shortly after birth.
lay_definition_en: A heart defect where a blood vessel doesn't close after birth like it should.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzfehler, bei dem sich ein Blutgefäß nach der Geburt nicht wie vorgesehen schließt.

general_definition_en: Either of two arteries (left or right) that have a high degree of variability in their origin from the aorta and that give rise to numerous branches.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that comes from the aorta and provides blood to the diaphragm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das von der Aorta abzweigt und das Zwerchfell mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: The significant impairment of gas exchange within the lungs resulting in hypoxia, hypercarbia, or both, to the extent that organ tissue perfusion is severely compromised. Causes include chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, emphysema, acute respiratory distress syndrome, pneumonia, pulmonary edema, pneumothorax, and congestive heart failure. Treatment requires intubation and mechanical ventilation until the time the lungs recover sufficient function.
lay_definition_en: When your lungs are not working properly, it's called respiratory insufficiency.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihre Lungen nicht richtig funktionieren, spricht man von einer Ateminsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: When someone is really out of it and can't think straight.
lay_definition_de: Wenn jemand völlig neben sich steht und nicht mehr klar denken kann.

general_definition_en: A congenital disorder of glycosylation sub-type caused by mutation(s) in the DPAGT1 gene, encoding UDP-N-acetylglucosamine--dolichyl-phosphate N-acetylglucosaminephosphotransferase. A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A tube placed in a neck blood vessel for quick fluid delivery and blood flow measurement.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der in ein Blutgefäß am Hals eingeführt wird, um Flüssigkeit schnell zuzuführen und den Blutfluss zu messen.

general_definition_en: A coronary artery that originates above the right coronary cusp and supplies blood predominantly to the right side of the heart.
lay_definition_en: One of the blood vessels on the right side of the heart that gives blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eines der Blutgefäße auf der rechten Seite des Herzens, das das Herz mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A coronary artery that originates above the right coronary cusp and supplies blood predominantly to the right side of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The right coronary artery is a blood vessel that brings blood to the heart's right side.
lay_definition_de: Die rechte Koronararterie ist ein Blutgefäß, das die rechte Herzhälfte mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Arteries that give blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Arterien, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: A surgical procedure to place a stent within a vessel.
lay_definition_en: Inserting a tube to keep a blocked artery or duct open.
lay_definition_de: Einführen eines Schlauchs, um eine verstopfte Arterie oder einen verstopften Gang offen zu halten.

general_definition_en: common The vessels carrying blood away from the heart.
lay_definition_en: These are the blood vessels that bring oxygenated blood to the head and neck.
lay_definition_de: Das sind die Blutgefäße, die den Kopf und den Hals mit sauerstoffreichem Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: The measurement of the mean left arterial pressure, as measured by a catheter introduced into the distal pulmonary artery, is high.
lay_definition_en: A way to check how well the heart's left atrium is working.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode, um zu überprüfen, wie gut der linke Vorhof des Herzens funktioniert.

general_definition_en: Blood pressure within the left atrium. It is commonly measured indirectly by a pulmonary capillary wedge pressure.
lay_definition_en: The pressure of blood in the right atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck im rechten Vorhof des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The organ of hearing located on the right side of the head. ATRIAL
lay_definition_en: Part of the right side of the heart where blood from the body and head enters.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil der rechten Herzhälfte, in den das Blut aus dem Körper und dem Kopf einströmt.

general_definition_en: ATRIAL ENLARGEMENT
lay_definition_en: The heart's top chamber getting bigger is called atrial enlargement.
lay_definition_de: Die Vergrößerung der oberen Herzkammer wird als Vorhofvergrößerung bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: Radiographic visualization of the aorta and its branches by injection of contrast media, using percutaneous puncture or catheterization procedures.
lay_definition_en: An aortogram is like an x-ray of the biggest artery in your body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Aortogramm ist so etwas wie eine Röntgenaufnahme der größten Arterie Ihres Körpers.

general_definition_en: An autosomal dominant disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE with abnormal features in the heart, the eye, and the skeleton. Cardiovascular manifestations include MITRAL VALVE PROLAPSE, dilation of the AORTA, and aortic dissection. Other features include lens displacement (ectopia lentis), disproportioned long limbs and enlarged DURA MATER (dural ectasia). Marfan syndrome is associated with mutations in the gene encoding fibrillin, a major element of extracellular microfibrils of connective tissue.
lay_definition_en: A genetic condition that affects various parts of the body like the heart, eyes, and bones, making affected individuals tall and thin.
lay_definition_de: Eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, die verschiedene Körperteile wie Herz, Augen und Knochen betrifft und dazu führt, dass die Betroffenen groß und schlank sind.

general_definition_en: An abnormal balloon- or sac-like dilatation in the wall of AORTA.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in the main heart blood vessel through the chest that can tear and lead to internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbeulung des Hauptherzblutgefäßes durch die Brustwand, die reißen und zu inneren Blutungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Surgical construction of an opening or window in the pericardium. It is often called subxiphoid pericardial window technique.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to create an opening in the layer around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Schaffung einer Öffnung in der Herzhülle.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES; VEINS; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.
lay_definition_en: Small brain strokes caused by clogged arteries, common in older individuals.
lay_definition_de: Kleine Hirnschläge, die durch verstopfte Arterien verursacht werden und häufig bei älteren Menschen auftreten.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the cardiac rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Rhythm is a constant beat or movement of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Rhythmus ist ein gleichmäßiger Schlag oder eine gleichmäßige Bewegung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A febrile disease occurring as a delayed sequela of infections with STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES. It is characterized by multiple focal inflammatory lesions of the connective tissue structures, such as the heart, blood vessels, and joints (POLYARTHRITIS) and brain, and by the presence of ASCHOFF BODIES in the myocardium and skin.
lay_definition_en: It's a sickness caused by bacteria with symptoms like fever and swollen heart, blood vessels, and joints.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine durch Bakterien verursachte Erkrankung mit Symptomen wie Fieber sowie Schwellungen des Herzens, der Blutgefäße und der Gelenke.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used. - Any mutation that occurs in response to inducing agents, including radiation, viral infection, and a broad variety of mutagenic chemicals. A form of bronchial disorder with three distinct components: airway hyper-responsiveness (RESPIRATORY HYPERSENSITIVITY), airway INFLAMMATION, and intermittent AIRWAY OBSTRUCTION. It is characterized by spasmodic contraction of airway smooth muscle, WHEEZING, and dyspnea (DYSPNEA, PAROXYSMAL).
lay_definition_en: It's when someone has trouble breathing, coughing, or wheezing when they exercise.
lay_definition_de: Das ist der Fall, wenn jemand bei körperlicher Anstrengung Atembeschwerden, Husten oder pfeifendes Atmen hat.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve. regurgitations
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close right, allowing blood to go the wrong way.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, sodass Blut in die falsche Richtung fließen kann.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb.
lay_definition_en: Symptoms related to blood flow issues in the arteries located under the collarbone.
lay_definition_de: Symptome im Zusammenhang mit Durchblutungsstörungen in den Arterien unterhalb des Schlüsselbeins.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: A change in your heartbeat rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Veränderung Ihres Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: Pulse is a measure of body heat that shows if someone has a fever or sickness.
lay_definition_de: Der Puls ist ein Maß für die Körperwärme, das anzeigt, ob jemand Fieber hat oder krank ist.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: Systolic has to do with breathing or the lungs and airways.
lay_definition_de: Der systolische Wert steht im Zusammenhang mit der Atmung bzw. den Lungen und den Atemwegen.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The pressure of blood in the arteries when the heart beats is known as systolic.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck in den Arterien beim Herzschlag wird als systolischer Blutdruck bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure when your heart is relaxed.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck, wenn sich das Herz in Ruhe befindet.

general_definition_en: The blood pressure in the pulmonary artery during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The pressure in your arteries when your heart pumps blood.
lay_definition_de: Der Druck in Ihren Arterien, wenn Ihr Herz Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: Mean Merriam-Webster: The pressure that is characteristic of the arterial pulse and represents the difference between diastolic and systolic blood pressures of the heart cycle
lay_definition_en: A person's average blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Der durchschnittliche Blutdruck einer Person.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: A protein that shows up in the blood when someone's heart isn't doing well.
lay_definition_de: Ein Protein, das im Blut nachweisbar ist, wenn das Herz nicht richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: Fatty acid esters of cholesterol which constitute about two-thirds of the cholesterol in the plasma. The accumulation of cholesterol esters in the arterial intima is a characteristic feature of atherosclerosis.
lay_definition_en: Cholesterol is a type of fat found in the blood that can come from the liver or specific foods such as eggs and milk, and high levels can lead to heart-related issues.
lay_definition_de: Cholesterin ist eine Art von Fett, das im Blut vorkommt und entweder von der Leber gebildet wird oder aus bestimmten Lebensmitteln wie Eiern und Milch stammt; hohe Cholesterinwerte können zu Herzproblemen führen.

general_definition_en: A transferase that catalyzes formation of PHOSPHOCREATINE from ATP + CREATINE. The reaction stores ATP energy as phosphocreatine. Three cytoplasmic ISOENZYMES have been identified in human tissues: the MM type from SKELETAL MUSCLE, the MB type from myocardial tissue and the BB type from nervous tissue as well as a mitochondrial isoenzyme. Macro-creatine kinase refers to creatine kinase complexed with other serum proteins. - A compound consisting of dark green crystals or crystalline powder, having a bronze-like luster. Solutions in water or alcohol have a deep blue color. Methylene blue is used as a bacteriologic stain and as an indicator. It inhibits GUANYLATE CYCLASE, and has been used to treat cyanide poisoning and to lower levels of METHEMOGLOBIN.
lay_definition_en: A test to determine if someone has had a heart attack by measuring a specific enzyme in the blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, mit dem durch die Messung eines bestimmten Enzyms im Blut festgestellt werden kann, ob jemand einen Herzinfarkt hatte.

general_definition_en: A TROPONIN complex subunit that inhibits ACTOMYOSIN ATPASE activity thereby disrupting ACTIN and MYOSIN interaction. There are three troponin I subtypes: troponin I1, I2 and I3. Troponin I3 is cardiac-specific whereas troponin I1 and I2 are skeletal subtypes. Troponin I3 is a BIOMARKER for damaged or injured CARDIAC MYOCYTES and mutations in troponin I3 gene are associated with FAMILIAL HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY.
lay_definition_en: Troponin is a protein found in the heart that indicates potential heart damage.
lay_definition_de: Troponin ist ein Protein, das im Herzen vorkommt und auf eine mögliche Herzschädigung hinweist.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
lay_definition_en: A blood pressure measurement taken when the heart muscle contracts.
lay_definition_de: Eine Blutdruckmessung, die während der Kontraktion des Herzmuskels durchgeführt wird.

general_definition_en: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: Diastolic BP is the blood pressure when the heart is at rest.
lay_definition_de: Der diastolische Blutdruck ist der Blutdruck, wenn sich das Herz in Ruhe befindet.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Atrial fib is when your heart beats irregularly, which can make you tired and more likely to have a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern schlägt Ihr Herz unregelmäßig, was zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: A problem with one of the heart valves where it doesn't close right and blood goes the wrong way.
lay_definition_de: Ein Problem mit einer der Herzklappen, bei dem diese nicht richtig schließt und das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in the signal transduction processes that are involved in pregnancy. The time interval between the start of the P wave and the beginning of the QRS complex in the cardiac cycle.
lay_definition_en: A section of the heartbeat cycle as shown on an ECG, usually lasting between 120 to 200 milliseconds.
lay_definition_de: Ein Abschnitt des Herzschlagzyklus, wie er im EKG dargestellt wird, der in der Regel zwischen 120 und 200 Millisekunden dauert.

general_definition_en: A nuclear imaging procedure, using the radionuclide Thallium, that shows whether the heart muscle is receiving adequate blood supply under stress and/or rest conditions.
lay_definition_en: A heart scan that checks how well your heart muscle is functioning, commonly performed for patients with specific heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der die Funktionsfähigkeit Ihres Herzmuskels überprüft wird und die üblicherweise bei Patienten mit bestimmten Herzerkrankungen durchgeführt wird.

general_definition_en: Abnormally high systolic blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure, not good.
lay_definition_de: Hoher Blutdruck – das ist nicht gut.

general_definition_en: A business structure used in Europe and Canada, in which shareholder responsibility for company debt is limited to the amount he/she has invested in the company.
lay_definition_en: A major artery of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine der Hauptarterien des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that provides oxygenated blood to the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das den Herzmuskel mit sauerstoffreichem Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: An autosomal disorder of the peripheral and autonomic nervous systems limited to individuals of Ashkenazic Jewish descent. Clinical manifestations are present at birth and include diminished lacrimation, defective thermoregulation, orthostatic hypotension (HYPOTENSION, ORTHOSTATIC), fixed pupils, excessive SWEATING, loss of pain and temperature sensation, and absent reflexes. Pathologic features include reduced numbers of small diameter peripheral nerve fibers and autonomic ganglion neurons. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1348; Nat Genet 1993;4(2):160-4)
lay_definition_en: A condition that messes with the nerves controlling automatic bodily functions.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die die Nerven beeinträchtigt, die die automatischen Körperfunktionen steuern.

general_definition_en: ARTERIOPORTAL
lay_definition_en: Blood moves between different parts of the liver, which can lead to certain health issues like high blood pressure in the liver.
lay_definition_de: Das Blut zirkuliert zwischen verschiedenen Teilen der Leber, was zu bestimmten Gesundheitsproblemen wie beispielsweise hohem Blutdruck in der Leber führen kann.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Arteries that bring blood to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Arterien, die das Herz mit Blut versorgen.

general_definition_en: Functional KIDNEY FAILURE in patients with liver disease, usually LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL), and in the absence of intrinsic renal disease or kidney abnormality. It is characterized by intense renal vasculature constriction, reduced renal blood flow, OLIGURIA, and sodium retention.
lay_definition_en: When the kidneys stop working in someone with serious liver issues.
lay_definition_de: Wenn bei einer Person mit schweren Leberproblemen die Nieren versagen.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: Describing a connection between an artery and a vein.
lay_definition_de: Beschreibung einer Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene.

general_definition_en: Application of a life support system that circulates the blood through an oxygenating system, which may consist of a pump, a membrane oxygenator, and a heat exchanger. Examples of its use are to assist victims of SMOKE INHALATION INJURY; RESPIRATORY FAILURE; and CARDIAC FAILURE.
lay_definition_en: A machine that helps a person breathe and pumps blood when their lungs and heart are not working properly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das einem Menschen beim Atmen hilft und das Blut pumpt, wenn seine Lunge und sein Herz nicht richtig funktionieren.

general_definition_en: The main artery of the thigh, a continuation of the external iliac artery.
lay_definition_en: The big blood vessel in the leg that carries blood from the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das große Blutgefäß im Bein, das Blut vom Herzen abtransportiert.

general_definition_en: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomical sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
lay_definition_en: How fast your heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Wie schnell dein Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates above the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A very fast heartbeat due to a problem in the heart's upper chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein sehr schneller Herzschlag aufgrund einer Störung in den oberen Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Enlarged spaces in the brain may be caused by fluid buildup or tissue shrinkage.
lay_definition_de: Vergrößerte Räume im Gehirn können durch Flüssigkeitsansammlungen oder Gewebeschwund verursacht werden.

general_definition_en: An opening located in the septum primum that allows blood to flow directly between the right and left atrium, and which serves as a precursor to the interatrial septum.
lay_definition_en: A section of the heart that connects two chambers.

It is marked by reduced diastolic volume of either or both ventricles but normal or nearly normal systolic function. It may be idiopathic or associated with other diseases (ENDOMYOCARDIAL FIBROSIS or AMYLOIDOSIS) causing interstitial fibrosis.
lay_definition_en: Having an oversized heart from birth.

lay_definition_de: Verhärtung und Verstopfung der Arterien durch Fettablagerungen und Entzündungen, was zu Herzinfarkt, Schlaganfall und anderen Gesundheitsproblemen führen kann.
