Clinical features include multiple, small lobar CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; cerebral ischemia (BRAIN ISCHEMIA); and CEREBRAL INFARCTION. Cerebral amyloid angiopathy is unrelated to generalized AMYLOIDOSIS. Amyloidogenic peptides in this condition are nearly always the same ones found in ALZHEIMER DISEASE. (from Kumar: Robbins and Cotran: Pathologic Basis of Disease, 7th ed., 2005)

Some defibrillators may also be used to correct certain noncritical dysrhythmias (called synchronized defibrillation or CARDIOVERSION), using relatively low-level discharges synchronized to the patient's ECG waveform. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: When someone is really confused and can't think straight.

Autonomic dysfunction may be associated with HYPOTHALAMIC DISEASES; BRAIN STEM disorders; SPINAL CORD DISEASES; and PERIPHERAL NERVOUS SYSTEM DISEASES. Manifestations include impairments of vegetative functions including the maintenance of BLOOD PRESSURE; HEART RATE; pupil function; SWEATING; REPRODUCTIVE AND URINARY PHYSIOLOGY; and DIGESTION.

general_definition_en: Abnormal increase of resistance to blood flow within the hepatic PORTAL SYSTEM, frequently seen in LIVER CIRRHOSIS and conditions with obstruction of the PORTAL VEIN.
lay_definition_en: When the blood vessels in the liver get too backed up, it causes high pressure in the portal vein.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich das Blut in den Blutgefäßen der Leber zu stark staut, führt dies zu einem erhöhten Druck in der Pfortader.

general_definition_en: Surgical venous shunt between the portal and systemic circulation to effect decompression of the portal circulation. It is performed primarily in the treatment of bleeding esophageal varices resulting from portal hypertension. Types of shunt include portacaval, splenorenal, mesocaval, splenocaval, left gastric-caval (coronary-caval), portarenal, umbilicorenal, and umbilicocaval. GRADIENT
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure difference between two veins, often indicating liver disease.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruckunterschied zwischen zwei Venen, der häufig auf eine Lebererkrankung hindeutet.

general_definition_en: A congenital abnormality of the eye caused by incomplete regression of the tunica vasculosa lentis, which is the vascular structure that nourishes the crystalline lens in utero.
lay_definition_en: A device implanted to manage abnormal heart rhythms and slow heart rates over a prolonged period.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das implantiert wird, um Herzrhythmusstörungen und eine langsame Herzfrequenz über einen längeren Zeitraum zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Pletal
lay_definition_en: Pletal is a medication that helps treat heart disease and prevent blood clots, reducing the risk of heart attack and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Pletal ist ein Medikament, das bei der Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen hilft und der Bildung von Blutgerinnseln vorbeugt, wodurch das Risiko für Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle gesenkt wird.

general_definition_en: A volatile vasodilator which relieves ANGINA PECTORIS by stimulating GUANYLATE CYCLASE and lowering cytosolic calcium. It is also sometimes used for TOCOLYSIS and explosives.
lay_definition_en: A tube inserted through the nose into the stomach for feeding, medication, or removing stomach contents.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der durch die Nase in den Magen eingeführt wird, um den Patienten zu ernähren, ihm Medikamente zu verabreichen oder Mageninhalt abzusaugen.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure that helps diagnose and treat heart conditions by inserting a tube into an artery and guiding it to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinisches Verfahren, das bei der Diagnose und Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen hilft, indem ein Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt und bis zum Herzen vorgeschoben wird.

general_definition_en: A meshwork-like substance found within the extracellular space and in association with the basement membrane of the cell surface. It promotes cellular proliferation and provides a supporting structure to which cells or cell lysates in culture dishes adhere.
lay_definition_en: A group of heart conditions that affect the left ventricle's functioning.
lay_definition_de: Eine Gruppe von Herzerkrankungen, die die Funktion des linken Ventrikels beeinträchtigen.

general_definition_en: Any benzothiadiazide derivative or other thiazide-like agent with diuretic and anti-hypertensive activity. Thiazide diuretics inhibit the sodium-chloride transporter in the distal tubule in the kidneys, thereby suppressing sodium and chloride reabsorption from the distal convoluted tubules (DCT) and increasing the excretion of sodium, chloride, potassium and water. In addition, thiazide diuretics decrease excretion of calcium and uric acid. These agents cause vasodilation possibly by activating calcium-activated potassium channels in vascular smooth muscle and inhibiting various carbonic anhydrases in vascular tissue.
lay_definition_en: A type of medicine that helps to lower blood pressure by reducing the volume of blood in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das den Blutdruck senkt, indem es das Blutvolumen im Körper verringert.

general_definition_en: An involuntary movement or exercise of function in a part, excited in response to a stimulus applied to the periphery and transmitted to the brain or spinal cord. - In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG). The act, by a healthcare worker, of monitoring an identified subject and recording signs, symptoms, or behavior.
lay_definition_en: A bed monitored by a machine that checks oxygen and carbon dioxide levels in a patient.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bett, das von einem Gerät überwacht wird, das den Sauerstoff- und Kohlendioxidgehalt im Blut des Patienten misst.

general_definition_en: Capture Fix Novus
lay_definition_en: Capture Fix Novus is a type of medical device that helps regulate heart rhythms called a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Capture Fix Novus ist ein medizinisches Gerät, das zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus dient und als Herzschrittmacher bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by prolonged exposure to excess levels of cortisol (HYDROCORTISONE) or other GLUCOCORTICOIDS from endogenous or exogenous sources. It is characterized by upper body OBESITY; OSTEOPOROSIS; HYPERTENSION; DIABETES MELLITUS; HIRSUTISM; AMENORRHEA; and excess body fluid. Endogenous Cushing syndrome or spontaneous hypercortisolism is divided into two groups, those due to an excess of ADRENOCORTICOTROPIN and those that are ACTH-independent.
lay_definition_en: A condition caused by an excess of the hormone cortisol in the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die durch einen Überschuss des Hormons Cortisol im Körper verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: Swelling due to excessive accumulation of fluid under the skin defined by a persistent indentation when pressure is applied to the swollen area. Causes include systemic conditions (e.g., heart failure, liver failure, or kidney failure) and local conditions affecting the extremities.
lay_definition_en: Swelling caused by trapped fluid in tissues where pressed skin leaves a temporary pit.
lay_definition_de: Schwellung, die durch in Geweben eingeschlossene Flüssigkeit verursacht wird und bei der auf die Haut ausgeübter Druck eine vorübergehende Vertiefung hinterlässt.

general_definition_en: A measurement of the median number of cycles of contraction and subsequent relaxation of the heart, usually expressed as beats per minute, obtained from a set of measurements of the heart rate.
lay_definition_en: Heart rate is how quickly or slowly your heart is beating.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell oder langsam Ihr Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: Veins in the neck which drain the brain, face, and neck into the brachiocephalic or subclavian veins. The blood pressure in the VEINS. It is usually measured to assess the filling PRESSURE to the HEART VENTRICLE.
lay_definition_en: The jugular venous pressure measures how well the heart is pumping blood by checking the pressure in a big vein in the neck that takes blood back to the heart after it has been around the head, brain, face, and neck.
lay_definition_de: Der juguläre Venendruck gibt Aufschluss darüber, wie gut das Herz Blut pumpt. Dazu wird der Druck in einer großen Vene im Hals gemessen, die das Blut zum Herzen zurückführt, nachdem es den Kopf, das Gehirn, das Gesicht und den Hals durchströmt hat.

general_definition_en: The signs of life that may be monitored or measured, namely pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, and blood pressure. signs--
lay_definition_en: Signs that show how well the body is working, like blood pressure and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Anzeichen, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut der Körper funktioniert, wie zum Beispiel Blutdruck und Herzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: PRESSURE of the BLOOD on the ARTERIES and other BLOOD VESSELS.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure is when the force of blood against the walls of your arteries is too strong.
lay_definition_de: Von Bluthochdruck spricht man, wenn der Druck, den das Blut auf die Wände Ihrer Arterien ausübt, zu hoch ist.

general_definition_en: The signs of life that may be monitored or measured, namely pulse rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, and blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Signs that show how well your body is functioning, like blood pressure, heart rate, breathing rate, and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Anzeichen, die Aufschluss darüber geben, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert, wie beispielsweise Blutdruck, Herzfrequenz, Atemfrequenz und Körpertemperatur.

general_definition_en: Electrocardiogram
lay_definition_en: A test that shows how your heart is beating using electrodes on your chest.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe von Elektroden auf Ihrer Brust festgestellt wird, wie Ihr Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: How well a pacemaker is keeping the heart's ventricles in rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Wie gut ein Herzschrittmacher den Rhythmus der Herzkammern aufrechterhält.

general_definition_en: Located around the heart or relating to or affecting the pericardium.
lay_definition_en: Around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Rund um das Herz.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A condition where the electrical signal from the upper to lower chambers of the heart is slowed or interrupted, affecting the heart's rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die Weiterleitung des elektrischen Signals von den oberen in die unteren Herzkammern verlangsamt oder unterbrochen wird, was den Herzrhythmus beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: lower rate limit
lay_definition_en: The slowest speed at which a pacemaker makes your heart beat.
lay_definition_de: Die niedrigste Frequenz, mit der ein Herzschrittmacher Ihr Herz schlagen lässt.

general_definition_en: To lower the temperature of something. - Devices or pieces of equipment placed in or around the mouth or attached to instruments to protect the external or internal tissues of the mouth and the teeth.
lay_definition_en: Cool Guard catheters help cool the body by pumping cool saline into a central vein, which can be helpful in emergencies like cardiac arrest.
lay_definition_de: Cool-Guard-Katheter tragen zur Kühlung des Körpers bei, indem sie kühle Kochsalzlösung in eine zentrale Vene pumpen, was in Notfällen wie einem Herzstillstand hilfreich sein kann.

lay_definition_en: NQWMI is a certain kind of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: NQWMI ist eine bestimmte Form des Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: The gluconate salt form of quinidine, an alkaloid with antimalarial and antiarrhythmic (Class la) properties. Quinidine gluconate exerts its anti-malarial activity by acting primarily as an intra-erythrocytic schizonticide through association with the hemepolymer (hemozoin) in the acidic food vacuole of the parasite thereby preventing further polymerization by heme polymerase enzyme. This results in accumulation of toxic heme and death of the parasite. Quinidine gluconate exerts its antiarrhythmic effects by depressing the flow of sodium ions into cells during phase 0 of the cardiac action potential, thereby slowing the impulse conduction through the atrioventricular (AV) node, reducing the maximal rate of phase 0 depolarization and prolonging the refractory period. Quinidine gluconate also reduces the slope of phase 4 depolarization in Purkinje-fibres resulting in slowed conduction and reduced automaticity in the heart.
lay_definition_en: A drug for treating heart rhythm issues or malaria infection.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen oder Malaria.

general_definition_en: A fulminating disease of neonates in which there is extensive mucosal ulceration, pseudomembrane formation, submucosal hemorrhage, and necrosis usually of the right colon, cecum, terminal ileum, and appendix, possibly due to perinatal intestinal ischemia and bacterial invasion. Progression can lead to necrosis, perforation and/or scarring of the intestinal tract.
lay_definition_en: NEC is a term that I'm not familiar with.
lay_definition_de: NEC ist ein Begriff, der mir nicht geläufig ist.

general_definition_en: Branch of the common carotid artery which supplies the exterior of the head, the face, and the greater part of the neck.
lay_definition_en: Major blood vessels bringing oxygenated blood from the heart to the brain.
lay_definition_de: Wichtige Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen zum Gehirn transportieren.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of pathologic Q waves in leads V3 and V4, which is suggestive of myocardial infarction of the anterior wall of the left ventricle. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: The front part of your body.
lay_definition_de: Der vordere Teil Ihres Körpers.

general_definition_en: An ultrasonic examination of the fetus in the late first trimester to measure the clear space at the back of the fetal neck to assess risk of genetic or cardiac abnormalities.
lay_definition_en: When a doctor presses on a spot on your body and you don't feel any pain.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein Arzt auf eine Stelle an Ihrem Körper drückt und Sie dabei keinen Schmerz verspüren.

general_definition_en: A pulse that beats at irregular intervals. Deviations from the normal process; e.g. delayed, difficult, profuse, scanty, unusual bleeding, etc.
lay_definition_en: Heartbeat that doesn't follow a regular pattern due to issues in the top chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Herzschlag, der aufgrund von Störungen in den oberen Herzkammern keinem regelmäßigen Rhythmus folgt.

general_definition_en: late peaking
lay_definition_en: A late heart murmur that may indicate a heart valve problem called mitral regurgitation.
lay_definition_de: Ein spätes Herzgeräusch, das auf ein Herzklappenproblem hinweisen kann, das als Mitralinsuffizienz bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A finding associated with a patient with defined or presumed cardiac disease with marked limitation of physical activity. They are comfortable at rest. Less than ordinary activity causes fatigue, palpitation, or dyspnea. (from The Criteria Committee of the New York Heart Association. Nomenclature and Criteria for Diagnosis of Diseases of the Heart and Great Vessels. 9th ed. Boston, Mass: Little, Brown & Co; 1994:253-256.)
lay_definition_en: New York Class III means having moderate to severe heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Die New-York-Klasse III bezeichnet eine mittelschwere bis schwere Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to connect a vein to the heart to help the blood flow when a blood vessel is blocked.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff, bei dem eine Vene mit dem Herzen verbunden wird, um den Blutfluss wiederherzustellen, wenn ein Blutgefäß verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: Absence of the orifice between the RIGHT ATRIUM and RIGHT VENTRICLE, with the presence of an atrial defect through which all the systemic venous return reaches the left heart. As a result, there is left ventricular hypertrophy (HYPERTROPHY, LEFT VENTRICULAR) because the right ventricle is absent or not functional.
lay_definition_en: A condition where one of the heart valves is missing or not developed properly.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem eine der Herzklappen fehlt oder nicht richtig ausgebildet ist.

general_definition_en: Any of the irregularly shaped spaces of the iridocorneal angle within the trabecular reticulum that communicate with the sinus venosus sclera.
lay_definition_en: A Fontana is a type of heart surgery for children with only one heart ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Eine Fontana-Operation ist eine Art von Herzoperation für Kinder, die nur eine Herzkammer haben.

general_definition_en: An autosomal dominant disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE with abnormal features in the heart, the eye, and the skeleton. Cardiovascular manifestations include MITRAL VALVE PROLAPSE, dilation of the AORTA, and aortic dissection. Other features include lens displacement (ectopia lentis), disproportioned long limbs and enlarged DURA MATER (dural ectasia). Marfan syndrome is associated with mutations in the gene encoding fibrillin, a major element of extracellular microfibrils of connective tissue.
lay_definition_en: A genetic disorder that affects various body tissues and causes individuals to be tall and slender.
lay_definition_de: Eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, die verschiedene Körpergewebe betrifft und dazu führt, dass die Betroffenen groß und schlank sind.

general_definition_en: Below the aorta.
lay_definition_en: Situated beneath the aortic valve.
lay_definition_de: Befindet sich unterhalb der Aortenklappe.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by dysfunctions related to the SINOATRIAL NODE including impulse generation (CARDIAC SINUS ARREST) and impulse conduction (SINOATRIAL EXIT BLOCK). It is characterized by persistent BRADYCARDIA, chronic ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, and failure to resume sinus rhythm following CARDIOVERSION. This syndrome can be congenital or acquired, particularly after surgical correction for heart defects.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the heart's natural pacemaker, the sinus node, malfunctions, leading to heart rhythm issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der der natürliche Schrittmacher des Herzens, der Sinusknoten, nicht richtig funktioniert, was zu Herzrhythmusstörungen führt.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart.
lay_definition_en: Destroying heart tissue to fix abnormal heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Zerstörung von Herzgewebe zur Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an increase in pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.
lay_definition_en: Pulmonary Hypertension is when someone has high blood pressure specifically in their lungs.
lay_definition_de: Von pulmonaler Hypertonie spricht man, wenn jemand speziell in der Lunge unter hohem Blutdruck leidet.

general_definition_en: A small medical device generating electrical impulses which is programmed to detect and treat cardiac arrhythmias by delivering electrical energy when indicated.
lay_definition_en: A device implanted in the body that corrects irregular heart rhythms with a small electric shock.
lay_definition_de: Ein im Körper implantiertes Gerät, das Herzrhythmusstörungen durch einen leichten Stromstoß korrigiert.

general_definition_en: hypertensive cardiomyopathy
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle gets thicker because it's been working too hard against high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzmuskel verdickt sich, weil er aufgrund des hohen Blutdrucks zu stark beansprucht wurde.

general_definition_en: The valve between the left atrium and left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the mitral valve in the heart narrows due to blockages.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der sich die Mitralklappe im Herzen aufgrund von Verengungen verengt.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes of the KIDNEY or its component tissues.
lay_definition_en: Kidney damage from high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Nierenschäden durch Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to create new pathways for blood flow to the heart when the original arteries are blocked.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff zur Schaffung neuer Blutbahnen zum Herzen, wenn die ursprünglichen Arterien verstopft sind.

general_definition_en: The hollow tube filled with cerebrospinal fluid that begins in the inferior portion of the fourth ventricle and runs the entire length of the spinal.
lay_definition_en: A small amount of a substance that alters heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature.
lay_definition_de: Eine geringe Menge einer Substanz, die Herzfrequenz, Blutdruck und Körpertemperatur beeinflusst.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed with the purpose of replacing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. mitral valve with bioprosthetic, homograft or autograft valve.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery to replace the valve that controls blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzoperation zum Ersatz der Klappe, die den Blutfluss im Herzen reguliert.

general_definition_en: Stroke caused by lacunar infarction or other small vessel diseases of the brain. It features hemiparesis (see PARESIS), hemisensory, or hemisensory motor loss. A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: A lacunar CVA is a type of stroke that occurs when a small artery deep in the brain is blocked.
lay_definition_de: Ein lakunärer Schlaganfall ist eine Form des Schlaganfalls, die auftritt, wenn eine kleine Arterie tief im Gehirn verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: A valve situated at the entrance to the pulmonary trunk from the right ventricle.
lay_definition_en: The pulmonary valve is a heart valve that helps blood flow properly.
lay_definition_de: Die Pulmonalklappe ist eine Herzklappe, die für einen reibungslosen Blutfluss sorgt.

general_definition_en: A muscle located close to the trunk of the body. atrial fibrillation
lay_definition_en: A kind of irregular heart rhythm near the top chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Herzrhythmusstörung im Bereich der oberen Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: Heart beating in an abnormal pattern.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz schlägt in einem ungewöhnlichen Rhythmus.

general_definition_en: A usually autosomal dominant and less frequently autosomal recessive genetic disorder characterized by the presence of numerous cysts in the kidneys leading to end-stage renal failure. The autosomal dominant trait is associated with abnormalities on the short arm of chromosome 16. Symptoms in patients with the autosomal dominant trait usually appear at middle age and include abdominal pain, hematuria, and high blood pressure. Patients may develop brain aneurysms and liver cysts. Patients with the autosomal recessive trait present with progressive renal failure early in life and symptoms resulting from hepatic fibrosis. The autosomal recessive trait is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 6. Polycystic kidney disease may also result as a side effect in patients on renal dialysis.
lay_definition_en: It's a genetic disease that creates fluid-filled sacs in your kidneys, affecting them in different ways and potentially leading to serious kidney issues.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine genetisch bedingte Erkrankung, bei der sich in den Nieren mit Flüssigkeit gefüllte Bläschen bilden, die die Nieren auf unterschiedliche Weise beeinträchtigen und möglicherweise zu schwerwiegenden Nierenproblemen führen können.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A bunch of tangled blood vessels that mess up blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gewirr aus verflochtenen Blutgefäßen, das den Blutfluss behindert.

general_definition_en: Paradoxal A - Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: Paradoxal A-fib is a weird heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Paradoxes Vorhofflimmern ist ein ungewöhnlicher Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a long standing and persistent uncoordinated atrial myocardium activation due to multiple reentry circuits with consequent deterioration of atrial mechanical function. Instead of intermittently contracting, the atria quiver continuously in a chaotic pattern, causing a totally irregular, often tachycardia ventricular rate. On the ECG it is characterized by the replacement of consistent P waves by rapid oscillations or fibrillatory waves that vary in size, shape, and timing, associated with an irregular, frequently rapid ventricular response when atrioventricular conduction is intact.
lay_definition_en: Irregular heart rhythm causing fatigue and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Herzrhythmusstörungen, die zu Müdigkeit und Schlaganfällen führen.

general_definition_en: A potent anti-arrhythmia agent, effective in a wide range of ventricular and atrial ARRHYTHMIAS and TACHYCARDIAS.
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps slow down extremely fast heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das hilft, einen extrem schnellen Herzschlag zu verlangsamen.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to a node, any bulge or swelling of an anatomical structure or part.
lay_definition_en: A method for treating atrial fibrillation by applying heat to a specific passage in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Behandlung von Vorhofflimmern durch die Zufuhr von Wärme an eine bestimmte Stelle im Herzen.

general_definition_en: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial CAROTID ARTERIES and the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the CIRCLE OF WILLIS. Cerebral angiogram shows the puff-of-smoke (moyamoya) collaterals at the base of the brain. It is characterized by endothelial HYPERPLASIA and FIBROSIS with thickening of arterial walls. This disease primarily affects children but can also occur in adults.
lay_definition_en: A rare disease where arteries at the base of the brain are blocked, leading to the formation of tiny blood vessels to bypass the blockage.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Erkrankung, bei der Arterien an der Basis des Gehirns verstopft sind, was zur Bildung winziger Blutgefäße führt, die die Verstopfung umgehen.

general_definition_en: Dye and chemical solution stains for medical purposes are mixtures of synthetic or natural dyes or nondye chemicals in solutions used in staining cells and tissues for diagnostic histopathology, cytopathology, or hematology. - A rare congenital hypoplastic anemia that usually presents early in infancy. The disease is characterized by a moderate to severe macrocytic anemia, occasional neutropenia or thrombocytosis, a normocellular bone marrow with erythroid hypoplasia, and an increased risk of developing leukemia. (Curr Opin Hematol 2000 Mar;7(2):85-94) A disorder characterized by a reduction in the amount of hemoglobin in 100 ml of blood. Signs and symptoms of anemia may include pallor of the skin and mucous membranes, shortness of breath, palpitations of the heart, soft systolic murmurs, lethargy, and fatigability.
lay_definition_en: A disorder where the body doesn't make enough red blood cells, resulting in anemia, usually occurring in infancy.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der der Körper nicht genügend rote Blutkörperchen bildet, was zu einer Anämie führt; sie tritt in der Regel im Säuglingsalter auf.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: When the heart muscle is weakened, leading to decreased blood pump, due to coronary artery disease.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Herzmuskel aufgrund einer koronaren Herzkrankheit geschwächt ist, was zu einer verminderten Pumpleistung führt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by excessive levels of thyroid hormone in the body. Common causes include an overactive thyroid gland or thyroid hormone overdose.
lay_definition_en: The thyroid gland in the neck becomes too active, causing symptoms like fast heart rate and weight loss.
lay_definition_de: Die Schilddrüse im Hals arbeitet zu stark, was zu Symptomen wie Herzrasen und Gewichtsverlust führt.

general_definition_en: A hypermetabolic syndrome caused by excess THYROID HORMONES which may come from endogenous or exogenous sources. The endogenous source of hormone may be thyroid HYPERPLASIA; THYROID NEOPLASMS; or hormone-producing extrathyroidal tissue. Thyrotoxicosis is characterized by NERVOUSNESS; TACHYCARDIA; FATIGUE; WEIGHT LOSS; heat intolerance; and excessive SWEATING.
lay_definition_en: Having an excessive amount of thyroid hormone in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein zu hoher Gehalt an Schilddrüsenhormonen im Körper.

general_definition_en: Natural hormones secreted by the THYROID GLAND, such as THYROXINE, and their synthetic analogs.

The presence of a double bond in the fatty acid chain changes the shape of the side group, and alters membrane fluidity when present in phospholipids. Polyunsaturated fatty acids in the diet such as omega-3 fatty acids from fish oil may have a positive influence on health, reducing cardiovascular disease and cancer. The double bonds in polyunsaturated fats cannot proceed directly through beta-oxidation to generate energy. Beta-oxidation will proceed normally through the first few rounds with a polyunsaturated fat, up until the point where the beta-oxidation enzymes encounter the first double bond. The enzymes of beta-oxidation are unable to act on substrates containing a double bond between the beta and gamma carbons. To solve this problem, the enzyme enoyl-CoA isomerase moves the first double bond to a position that the beta oxidation enzymes can act on, one carbon closer to the end of the alkyl chain. Beta-oxidation can then proceed for one cycle and part of the next, until it encounters the next double bond, which usually starts at an even-numbered carbon. A reductase then reduces the fatty acid, leaving a trans-3 double bond in mammals. The enzyme 3,2 enoyl-CoA isomerase moves this double bond closer to the end of the fatty acid chain, where the fatty acid can serve as a substrate for the normal beta-oxidation enzymes to continue beta-oxidation to completion. (This definition may be outdated - see the DesignNote.)

The oils are used as DIETARY SUPPLEMENTS. They are also used in soaps and detergents and as protective coatings. Eating trans fat increases blood cholesterol levels and the risk of heart disease.
lay_definition_en: Good fats found in fish oil that help reduce triglycerides and can prevent heart-related issues.
lay_definition_de: Gute Fette, die in Fischöl enthalten sind und dazu beitragen, die Triglyceridwerte zu senken sowie Herzproblemen vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: A benzothiazepine derivative with vasodilating action due to its antagonism of the actions of CALCIUM ion on membrane functions.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps control high blood pressure and irregular heart rhythms.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, Bluthochdruck und Herzrhythmusstörungen zu kontrollieren.

general_definition_en: The study of the heart, its physiology, and its functions.
lay_definition_en: Cardiology is a medical field that deals with issues related to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Kardiologie ist ein medizinisches Fachgebiet, das sich mit Erkrankungen des Herzens befasst.

general_definition_en: Sudden onset of shortness of breath that causes one to awaken coughing or wheezing; it may be associated with congestive heart failure or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
lay_definition_en: Episodes of intense breathing difficulty and coughing that usually happen during the night, disrupting sleep and causing fear.
lay_definition_de: Episoden mit starken Atembeschwerden und Husten, die meist nachts auftreten, den Schlaf stören und Angst auslösen.

general_definition_en: An acute organic mental disorder induced by cessation or reduction in chronic alcohol consumption. Clinical characteristics include CONFUSION; DELUSIONS; vivid HALLUCINATIONS; TREMOR; agitation; insomnia; and signs of autonomic hyperactivity (e.g., elevated blood pressure and heart rate, dilated pupils, and diaphoresis). This condition may occasionally be fatal. It was formerly called delirium tremens. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1175)
lay_definition_en: When heavy drinkers quit alcohol, they may experience a mental condition with symptoms like tremors and confusion known as DTs.
lay_definition_de: Wenn starke Trinker mit dem Alkohol aufhören, kann es zu einem psychischen Zustand mit Symptomen wie Zittern und Verwirrung kommen, der als „DTs“ bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of ventricular tachycardia greater than 30 seconds in duration.
lay_definition_en: A fast heart rate that lasts longer than 30 seconds.
lay_definition_de: Eine erhöhte Herzfrequenz, die länger als 30 Sekunden anhält.

general_definition_en: QR axis
lay_definition_en: It's a way to show how electricity moves through the heart on an ECG.
lay_definition_de: Auf diese Weise lässt sich zeigen, wie sich der Strom im Herzen auf einem EKG ausbreitet.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion.
lay_definition_en: A surgery where a new route is created to go around a blocked blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem ein neuer Weg geschaffen wird, um ein verstopftes Blutgefäß zu umgehen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by inflammation of the muscle tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle disease caused by a viral infection.
lay_definition_de: Eine durch eine Virusinfektion verursachte Herzmuskelerkrankung.

general_definition_en: An arterial segment arising from the abdominal aorta that supplies blood to the abdominal organs, other structures, genitalia and the lower limbs. The aortic branches include terminal branches called the common iliac arteries, the celiac artery, the superior mesenteric artery, the inferior mesenteric artery, the renal arteries, the suprarenal arteries, the testicular (internal spermatic) arteries, the ovarian arteries, the inferior phrenic arteries, lumbar arteries and the middle sacral artery.
lay_definition_en: The main artery in your body that runs through your belly and supplies blood to your stomach and lower body.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptarterie in Ihrem Körper, die durch Ihren Bauch verläuft und Ihren Magen sowie Ihren Unterkörper mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A finding of an increase in the jugular venous pressure, as measured by the height of the mean jugular venous waveform above the right atrium.
lay_definition_en: JVP is like a gauge for the heart's pumping ability based on the blood flow in the neck vein.
lay_definition_de: Der JVP ist so etwas wie ein Maß für die Pumpkraft des Herzens, das auf dem Blutfluss in der Halsvene basiert.

general_definition_en: rhythem strip
lay_definition_en: A rhythm strip is data from a heart's EKG exam.
lay_definition_de: Ein Rhythmusstreifen ist eine Aufzeichnung aus einer EKG-Untersuchung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a tachycardia which does not originate in the ventricles or His Purkinje system. There is an abnormally high heart rate and QRS complexes are typically narrow, but aberration or preexcitation may be present. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Short bursts of abnormal heartbeats lasting less than 30 seconds.
lay_definition_de: Kurze Episoden von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die weniger als 30 Sekunden dauern.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally rapid heart rate with its origin in the sinus node. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: The heart beats faster than normal when you're not doing anything.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz schlägt schneller als normal, wenn man gerade nichts tut.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL
lay_definition_en: Myocardial means the muscles in the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Myokard“ bezeichnet die Herzmuskulatur.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL PERFUSION An imaging technique using a device which combines TOMOGRAPHY, EMISSION-COMPUTED, SINGLE-PHOTON and TOMOGRAPHY, X-RAY COMPUTED in the same session.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks how well your heart is working by scanning the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der durch eine Abtastung des Herzmuskels überprüft wird, wie gut Ihr Herz funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The chloride salt form of thallium-201, a cyclotron produced isotope use in diagnostic imaging. Thallous chloride TI-201 accumulates in myocardial cells and other tissues in an analogous way as potassium, and can be evaluated as a function of blood flow. By scintigraphic means, areas with decreased blood flow, consisting of ischemic cells, can be visualized due to decreased uptake of TI-201 in contrast to areas with normal blood flow.
lay_definition_en: A radioactive substance used for certain medical tests to check heart function.
lay_definition_de: Ein radioaktiver Stoff, der bei bestimmten medizinischen Untersuchungen zur Überprüfung der Herzfunktion verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: The creation and display of functional images showing where the blood is flowing into the MYOCARDIUM by following over time the distribution of tracers injected into the blood stream. lay_definition_en: A heart scan to see how well the heart muscle is functioning.

lay_definition_de: Eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der die Funktionsfähigkeit des Herzmuskels überprüft wird; sie wird häufig bei Patienten mit bestimmten Herzerkrankungen durchgeführt.

general_definition_en: The usual amount of blood that is forced from the heart ventricle to produce cardiac output. Quantitatively, the ejection fraction is considered between 50% to 70%.
lay_definition_en: Ejection fraction measure taken when not exercising.
lay_definition_de: Die Ejektionsfraktion wird im Ruhezustand gemessen.

general_definition_en: The creation and display of functional images showing where the blood is flowing into the MYOCARDIUM by following over time the distribution of tracers injected into the blood stream.
lay_definition_en: A heart scan that checks how well the heart muscle functions, often done for people with heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzuntersuchung, bei der die Funktion des Herzmuskels überprüft wird; sie wird häufig bei Menschen mit Herzproblemen durchgeführt.

lay_definition_en: Challenging the heart during physical activity or with medication to observe its function.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz während körperlicher Aktivität oder durch die Einnahme von Medikamenten belasten, um seine Funktion zu beobachten.

lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der eine Substanz in den Blutkreislauf injiziert wird, um deren Verlauf durch die Herzgefäße zu verfolgen und so die Herzfunktion zu überprüfen.

general_definition_en: Qualified medical professionals who specialize in preventing and treating disorders of the heart and CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.

lay_definition_de: Ein Kardiologe ist ein Arzt, der sich mit Herzproblemen befasst.

lay_definition_de: Adenosin ist ein Medikament, das bei Herzbelastungstests eingesetzt wird, um die Herzleistung zu steigern.

lay_definition_de: Wenn die unteren Herzkammern sehr schnell schlagen, spricht man von einer ventrikulären Tachykardie.

lay_definition_en: How well the main part of the heart pumps blood.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: A heart attack.

lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Formen der Herzinsuffizienz.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und zur Verringerung von Schwellungen, auch bekannt als Lasix.

lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das anzeigt, wie viel Sauerstoff sich in Ihrem Blut befindet.

This agent binds to mu-opioid receptors with a high affinity, and a lesser degree to kappa- and gamma-opioid receptors.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Verabreichung alle 30 Minuten eine Opioid-Überdosis rückgängig machen kann.

lay_definition_de: Ein Schlauch, der durch die Nase in den Magen eingeführt wird, um Nahrung zuzuführen oder Substanzen zu entfernen.

lay_definition_de: Ein Riss in der größten Arterie des Körpers, der Aorta, was einen schweren medizinischen Notfall darstellt.

Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. lay_definition_de: Als „Aufschläge“ bezeichnet man die schnellen und gleichmäßigen Schläge, die man am Hals spürt, wenn man seinen Puls misst.

lay_definition_de: Ein zusätzliches Herzgeräusch, das auf Herzprobleme hindeuten könnte.

lay_definition_en: A ventricular device is a device implanted in the body to help regulate the heart's rhythm by giving it a shock.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das in den Körper implantiert wird, um den Herzrhythmus durch die Abgabe eines Stromimpulses zu regulieren.

lay_definition_de: Bei einer Endokarditis entzündet sich die Innenseite des Herzens infolge einer Infektion.

general_definition_en: TRICUSPID A measurement of the backward flow of blood through the tricuspid valve during right ventricle contraction. It correlates with pulmonary artery systolic pressure at rest and with exercise. A tricuspid regurgitation velocity greater than or equal to 2.5 m/sec on echocardiography is a surrogate marker for pulmonary hypertension in adults with sickle cell disease.
lay_definition_en: A measurement from an echocardiogram that helps determine if someone might have high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Messwert aus einem Echokardiogramm, anhand dessen festgestellt werden kann, ob bei einer Person möglicherweise ein erhöhter Blutdruck in der Lunge vorliegt.

lay_definition_en: A drug that is used for heart disease treatment.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen eingesetzt wird.

This may be caused by emboli from the CAROTID ARTERY (usually in association with CAROTID STENOSIS) and other locations that enter the central RETINAL ARTERY. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p245)

lay_definition_en: Results that do not provide specific information to identify a particular condition.
lay_definition_de: Befunde, die keine konkreten Hinweise auf eine bestimmte Erkrankung liefern.

general_definition_en: The main artery of the thigh, a continuation of the external iliac artery.
lay_definition_en: Big blood vessel in the thigh that brings blood from the heart to the leg.
lay_definition_de: Große Blutader im Oberschenkel, die Blut vom Herzen zum Bein transportiert.

general_definition_en: A syndrome associated with damage to the spinal cord above the mid thoracic level (see SPINAL CORD INJURIES) characterized by a marked increase in the sympathetic response to minor stimuli such as bladder or rectal distention. Manifestations include HYPERTENSION; TACHYCARDIA (or reflex bradycardia); FEVER; FLUSHING; and HYPERHIDROSIS. Extreme hypertension may be associated with a STROKE. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp538 and 1232; J Spinal Cord Med 1997;20(3):355-60)
lay_definition_en: Hyperreflexic means having stronger reflex responses due to a nerve disease.
lay_definition_de: „Hyperreflexisch“ bedeutet, dass aufgrund einer Nervenerkrankung stärkere Reflexreaktionen auftreten.

general_definition_en: A spectrum of pathological conditions of impaired blood flow in the brain. They can involve vessels (ARTERIES or VEINS) in the CEREBRUM, the CEREBELLUM, and the BRAIN STEM. Major categories include INTRACRANIAL ARTERIOVENOUS MALFORMATIONS; BRAIN ISCHEMIA; CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; and others.
lay_definition_en: When blood vessels in the brain get blocked, it causes problems like strokes or other brain-related issues.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Blutgefäße im Gehirn verstopft sind, führt dies zu Problemen wie Schlaganfällen oder anderen Erkrankungen des Gehirns.

general_definition_en: An endocrine disorder characterized by excessive production of aldosterone by the adrenal glands. Causes include adrenal gland adenoma and adrenal gland hyperplasia. The overproduction of aldosterone results in sodium and water retention and hypokalemia. Patients present with high blood pressure, muscle weakness, and headache.
lay_definition_en: Primary hypoaldosteronism is when the adrenal gland is damaged, often from infection, injury, autoimmune diseases, or genetic issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein primärer Hypoaldosteronismus liegt vor, wenn die Nebenniere geschädigt ist, häufig aufgrund einer Infektion, einer Verletzung, einer Autoimmunerkrankung oder genetischer Ursachen.

general_definition_en: A non-selective beta-adrenergic antagonist with a long half-life, used in cardiovascular disease to treat arrhythmias, angina pectoris, and hypertension. Nadolol is also used for MIGRAINE DISORDERS and for tremor.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with high blood pressure, heart pain, and irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Bluthochdruck, Herzschmerzen und Herzrhythmusstörungen hilft.

general_definition_en: A recording of cardiac electrical activity during stress or exercise.
lay_definition_en: A way to record the heart's electrical activity using stickers on the skin.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode zur Aufzeichnung der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens mithilfe von Aufklebern auf der Haut.

general_definition_en: A form of CARDIAC MUSCLE disease, characterized by left and/or right ventricular hypertrophy (HYPERTROPHY, LEFT VENTRICULAR; HYPERTROPHY, RIGHT VENTRICULAR), frequent asymmetrical involvement of the HEART SEPTUM, and normal or reduced left ventricular volume. Risk factors include HYPERTENSION; AORTIC STENOSIS; and gene MUTATION; (FAMILIAL HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY).
lay_definition_en: A condition where a portion of the heart muscle becomes abnormally thick, potentially leading to heart dysfunction.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem sich ein Teil des Herzmuskels ungewöhnlich verdickt, was möglicherweise zu einer Herzfunktionsstörung führen kann.

general_definition_en: a valve that controls blood flow between heart chambers
lay_definition_en: A condition where there's a problem with one of the heart valves due to the accumulation of plaque-like material.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der aufgrund der Ablagerung von plakkähnlichem Material eine Herzklappe beeinträchtigt ist.
