lay_definition_en: Deciding whether to revive a patient if their heart or breathing stops.
lay_definition_de: Die Entscheidung, ob ein Patient wiederbelebt werden soll, wenn sein Herz stehen bleibt oder er nicht mehr atmet.

lay_definition_en: The first number measures a person's systolic pressure, while the second number measures the diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_de: Die erste Zahl gibt den systolischen Blutdruck an, die zweite den diastolischen Blutdruck.

lay_definition_en: The blood pressure numbers that represent the pressure in the arteries - systolic pressure over diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_de: Die Blutdruckwerte, die den Druck in den Arterien angeben – systolischer Druck über diastolischem Druck.

general_definition_en: A long-acting dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker. It is effective in the treatment of ANGINA PECTORIS and HYPERTENSION.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps lower high blood pressure and prevent blood clots.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken und Blutgerinnseln vorzubeugen.

general_definition_en: The introduction of a substance to the mouth or into the gastrointestinal tract by the way of the mouth, usually for systemic action. It is the most common, convenient, and usually the safest and least expensive route of drug administration, but it uses the most complicated pathway to the tissues and bioavailability varies. The disadvantages of method are hepatic first pass metabolism and enzymatic degradation of the drug within the gastrointestinal tract. This prohibits oral administration of certain classes of drugs especially peptides and proteins.
lay_definition_en: Medication to manage high blood pressure and reduce swelling, also known as Lasix.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck und zur Verringerung von Schwellungen, auch bekannt als Lasix.

ann_text_de_old: B – Natriuretisches Peptid vom Typ B
general_definition_en: A trace element with the atomic symbol B, atomic number 5, and atomic weight [10.806; 10.821]. Boron-10, an isotope of boron, is used as a neutron absorber in BORON NEUTRON CAPTURE THERAPY. - A recombinant version of the cardiac neurohormone, human B-type natriuretic peptide (hBNP) produced by the ventricular myocardium. Nesiritide binds to natriuretic peptide receptors on vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells, through which it triggers guanylate cyclase dependent signal transduction resulting in increase of intracellular concentrations of cGMP. This leads to smooth muscle cell relaxation causing arterial and venous dilatation.
lay_definition_en: A blood test that measures heart function by checking levels of BNP in the blood, typically elevated in congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest, bei dem die Herzfunktion anhand des BNP-Spiegels im Blut gemessen wird, der bei einer Herzinsuffizienz in der Regel erhöht ist.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of angiotensin converting enzyme present in a sample. Inhibitors
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps reduce high blood pressure, commonly referred to as ACE inhibitors.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt und gemeinhin als ACE-Hemmer bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in the regulation of apoptosis.
lay_definition_en: Medication for high blood pressure and swelling, also known as Lasix.
lay_definition_de: Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Ödeme, auch bekannt als Lasix.

general_definition_en: Every eight hours.
lay_definition_en: A diuretic medication that helps the body get rid of excess water and is used to address high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein harntreibendes Medikament, das dem Körper hilft, überschüssiges Wasser auszuscheiden, und zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A specified quantity of a therapeutic agent to which an individual can be exposed to or was exposed to, during a one-day period. In the clinical study protocol, the label and other documentation the type of daily dose must be specified.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: subQ
lay_definition_en: A drug used for heart conditions like chest pain and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzerkrankungen wie Brustschmerzen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: The median time period between the recording of a Q wave on ECG and the onset of the aortic blood pressure pulse as determined over a number of cardiac cycles during a given interval of time.
lay_definition_en: A component that assists in the proper functioning of the heart and other bodily systems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bestandteil, der zur ordnungsgemäßen Funktion des Herzens und anderer Körpersysteme beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Topically
lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps lower high blood pressure when applied to the skin.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei Anwendung auf der Haut zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: The insertion of drugs into the rectum, usually for confused or incompetent patients, like children, infants, and the very old or comatose.
lay_definition_en: a medicine for chest pain, high blood pressure, and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel gegen Brustschmerzen, Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A quantitative measurement of the amount of potassium present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: K is a specific speed setting used for a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: K ist eine bestimmte Frequenzeinstellung, die bei Herzschrittmachern verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed on the heart or blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Surgery on blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Chirurgie an Blutgefäßen.

general_definition_en: Tenormin
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure and chest pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Brustschmerzen.

general_definition_en: Apresoline
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure and heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Flat cell that looks like a fish scale under a microscope. These cells cover inside and outside surfaces of the body. They are found in the tissues that form the surface of the skin, the lining of the hollow organs of the body (such as the bladder, kidney, and uterus), and the passages of the respiratory and digestive tracts. Cells that line the inner and outer surfaces of the body by forming cellular layers (EPITHELIUM) or masses. Epithelial cells lining the SKIN; the MOUTH; the NOSE; and the ANAL CANAL derive from ectoderm; those lining the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM and the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM derive from endoderm; others (CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM and LYMPHATIC SYSTEM) derive from mesoderm. Epithelial cells can be classified mainly by cell shape and function into squamous, glandular and transitional epithelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Thin, flat cells that are found in various parts of the body.
lay_definition_de: Dünne, flache Zellen, die in verschiedenen Teilen des Körpers vorkommen.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES. DIAMETER
lay_definition_en: The size of one part of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Größe eines Teils des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The part of a tooth from the neck to the apex, embedded in the alveolar process and covered with cementum. A root may be single or divided into several branches, usually identified by their relative position, e.g., lingual root or buccal root. Single-rooted teeth include mandibular first and second premolars and the maxillary second premolar teeth. The maxillary first premolar has two roots in most cases. Maxillary molars have three roots. (Jablonski, Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p690)
lay_definition_en: Where the heart's major blood vessel connects to the aorta.
lay_definition_de: Die Stelle, an der das Hauptblutgefäß des Herzens in die Aorta mündet.

general_definition_en: The left ventricular volume calculated as the difference between the epicardium delimited volume and the left ventricular chamber volume. POSTERIOR WALL
lay_definition_en: The LV posterior wall is a measurement taken during an echocardiogram, which, if abnormal, may suggest an enlarged heart.
lay_definition_de: Die hintere LV-Wand ist ein Messwert, der bei einer Echokardiographie ermittelt wird und bei einer Abweichung von der Norm auf eine Herzvergrößerung hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: A chemotherapy regimen consisting of etoposide and mitoxantrone that may be used in the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
lay_definition_en: The mitral valve.
lay_definition_de: Die Mitralklappe.

ann_text_de_old: Dicke der hinteren Wand des linken Ventrikels
ann_text_de: Dicke der hinteren Wand des linken Ventrikels
general_definition_en: The left ventricular volume calculated as the difference between the epicardium delimited volume and the left ventricular chamber volume. POSTERIOR WALL THICKNESS
lay_definition_en: It's a measurement during a heart ultrasound that can show if the back wall of the heart is too thick, possibly signaling a larger heart.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Messung im Rahmen einer Herzultraschalluntersuchung, die Aufschluss darüber geben kann, ob die Rückwand des Herzens zu dick ist, was möglicherweise auf ein vergrößertes Herz hindeuten könnte.

general_definition_en: The fraction of the left ventricle diastolic dimension that is lost during systole; the measurement is calculated using the following formula: (end-diastolic dimension - end-systolic dimension) / end-diastolic dimension; the quotient is then multiplied by one hundred to be expressed as a percent.
lay_definition_en: A unit of measurement that equals half an inch.
lay_definition_de: Eine Maßeinheit, die einem halben Zoll entspricht.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: Sounds of blood moving in the heart that can suggest health problems.
lay_definition_de: Geräusche, die durch den Blutfluss im Herzen entstehen und auf gesundheitliche Probleme hindeuten können.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving the CAROTID ARTERIES, including the common, internal, and external carotid arteries. ATHEROSCLEROSIS and TRAUMA are relatively frequent causes of carotid artery pathology.
lay_definition_en: A condition where plaque accumulates in the carotid arteries, affecting blood flow to the head and neck.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der sich Plaque in den Halsschlagadern ansammelt und dadurch die Durchblutung von Kopf und Hals beeinträchtigt wird.

general_definition_en: A procedure to open an occluded coronary artery, performed by percutaneous introduction of a catheter into a peripheral (usually femoral) artery which is directed in a retrograde fashion to reach the diseased coronary artery.
lay_definition_en: Using a small balloon to open up a blocked blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Mit einem kleinen Ballon ein verstopftes Blutgefäß öffnen.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart. ARTERIES
lay_definition_en: The big blood vessel that takes oxygen-poor blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Das große Blutgefäß, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: troponosis
lay_definition_en: A high level of troponin in the blood that might not necessarily indicate a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein hoher Troponin-Spiegel im Blut, der nicht unbedingt auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeuten muss.

general_definition_en: Heart failure caused by abnormal myocardial relaxation during DIASTOLE leading to defective cardiac filling.
lay_definition_en: When the heart's lower chamber has trouble filling with blood, causing less blood to be pumped out to the body.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die untere Herzkammer Schwierigkeiten hat, sich mit Blut zu füllen, wodurch weniger Blut in den Körper gepumpt wird.

general_definition_en: Interacting selectively and non-covalently with catecholamine. [GOC:TermGenie]
lay_definition_en: A substance, either in medication or naturally produced in the body, that can boost heart rate, blood pressure, and blood sugar levels.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz, die entweder in Medikamenten enthalten ist oder vom Körper auf natürliche Weise gebildet wird und die Herzfrequenz, den Blutdruck und den Blutzuckerspiegel erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: This SDTM class captures the observations resulting from planned evaluations to address specific tests or questions such as laboratory tests, ECG testing, and questions listed on questionnaires.
lay_definition_en: Specific signs that point to a certain area not functioning properly due to brain or nerve damage.
lay_definition_de: Spezifische Anzeichen, die darauf hindeuten, dass ein bestimmter Bereich aufgrund einer Schädigung des Gehirns oder der Nerven nicht richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: Pathological outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of any blood vessel (ARTERIES or VEINS) or the heart (HEART ANEURYSM). It indicates a thin and weakened area in the wall which may later rupture. Aneurysms are classified by location, etiology, or other characteristics. dilitation
lay_definition_en: A bulging blood-filled spot in an artery wall, which can be risky if it bursts.
lay_definition_de: Eine blutgefüllte Ausbuchtung in einer Arterienwand, die gefährlich werden kann, wenn sie reißt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia without cardiac electrical activity. Typically, this is accompanied by cessation of the pumping function of the heart.
lay_definition_en: When your heart stops beating.
lay_definition_de: Wenn dein Herz aufhört zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: A courtesy title for a man.
lay_definition_en: When your heart valve shuts improperly, making blood go the wrong way, it's called Mr.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich die Mitralklappe nicht richtig schließt und dadurch Blut zurückfließt, spricht man von einer Mitralinsuffizienz.

lay_definition_en: Heart rate is how fast your heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell Ihr Herz schlägt.

lay_definition_en: Heart rate is how fast the heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzfrequenz gibt an, wie schnell das Herz schlägt.

general_definition_en: Functional KIDNEY FAILURE in patients with liver disease, usually LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL), and in the absence of intrinsic renal disease or kidney abnormality. It is characterized by intense renal vasculature constriction, reduced renal blood flow, OLIGURIA, and sodium retention.
lay_definition_en: When someone with serious liver damage experiences kidney failure.
lay_definition_de: Wenn bei einer Person mit schwerer Leberschädigung ein Nierenversagen auftritt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by irritation to the layers of the pericardium (the protective sac around the heart).
lay_definition_en: Pain, redness, and swelling around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Schmerzen, Rötungen und Schwellungen im Bereich des Herzens.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by irritation to the layers of the pericardium (the protective sac around the heart).
lay_definition_en: Pain, redness, and swelling around the heart due to a viral infection.
lay_definition_de: Schmerzen, Rötungen und Schwellungen im Bereich des Herzens aufgrund einer Virusinfektion.

general_definition_en: Cardiac valve which has as its parts the leaf of cardiac valve that separates the atrium from the ventricle.
lay_definition_en: It's related to the upper and lower heart chambers.
lay_definition_de: Es steht im Zusammenhang mit der oberen und der unteren Herzkammer.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve. VALVE STENOSIS
lay_definition_en: Aortic valve stenosis is when the heart valve leading from the heart to the rest of the body doesn't open and close properly, possibly resulting in blood leakage.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Aortenklappenstenose öffnet und schließt sich die Herzklappe, die vom Herzen zum restlichen Körper führt, nicht richtig, was möglicherweise zu einem Blutrückfluss führen kann.

general_definition_en: tricupid
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly and lets blood flow back into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt und Blut zurück ins Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: tricupid
lay_definition_en: A heart valve that helps control blood flow in the heart and is the first one encountered by blood entering the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die zur Regulierung des Blutflusses im Herzen beiträgt und die erste ist, auf die das in das Herz einströmende Blut trifft.

general_definition_en: Physio
lay_definition_en: A device used to fix a leaky heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät zur Behandlung einer undichten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed for the purpose of repairing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. heart valve.
lay_definition_en: Fixing a broken heart valve through surgery.
lay_definition_de: Die chirurgische Behandlung einer defekten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Alfieri
lay_definition_en: A surgical procedure to fix a leaky heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Korrektur einer undichten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving any of the various HEART VALVES and the associated structures (PAPILLARY MUSCLES and CHORDAE TENDINEAE).
lay_definition_en: Valve disorders are issues with the heart valves that affect the blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Klappenerkrankungen sind Störungen der Herzklappen, die den Blutfluss im Herzen beeinträchtigen.

general_definition_en: A product of COMPLEMENT ACTIVATION cascade, regardless of the pathways, that forms transmembrane channels causing disruption of the target CELL MEMBRANE and cell lysis. It is formed by the sequential assembly of terminal complement components (COMPLEMENT C5B; COMPLEMENT C6; COMPLEMENT C7; COMPLEMENT C8; and COMPLEMENT C9) into the target membrane. The resultant C5b-8-poly-C9 is the "membrane attack complex" or MAC.
lay_definition_en: Heart condition that damages the mitral valve.
lay_definition_de: Herzerkrankung, die die Mitralklappe schädigt.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: When the flap between heart chambers doesn't close correctly, blood flows backward in the heart - Mitral regurgitation.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich die Klappe zwischen den Herzkammern nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut im Herzen zurück – Mitralklappeninsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A heart disorder characterized by a defect in mitral valve structure or function.
lay_definition_en: When the mitral valve in the heart is floppy and doesn't close properly, it's called mitral valve prolapse.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Mitralklappe im Herzen schlaff ist und nicht richtig schließt, spricht man von einem Mitralklappenprolaps.

general_definition_en: a valve that controls blood flow between heart chambers
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, it can make blood flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, kann dies dazu führen, dass das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: Mitral annular calcification (MAC) results from progressive calcium deposition along and beneath the mitral valve annulus. [HPO:probinson, PMID:23587525]
lay_definition_en: A condition where there is calcium buildup in the ring around the mitral valve of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der es zu Kalkablagerungen im Ring um die Mitralklappe des Herzens kommt.

general_definition_en: q
lay_definition_en: The electrical activity in the heart can become irregular after a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Nach einem Herzinfarkt kann es zu Unregelmäßigkeiten in der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens kommen.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - Q- wave MI
lay_definition_en: A non-Q-wave MI is a specific type of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Nicht-Q-Wellen-Myokardinfarkt ist eine bestimmte Form des Herzinfarkts.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: The atrium is where blood flows into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Im Vorhof fließt das Blut ins Herz.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When the tricuspid valve in the heart doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich die Trikuspidalklappe im Herzen nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung.

general_definition_en: Either of the two principal arteries on both sides of the neck that supply blood to the head and neck; each divides into two branches, the internal carotid artery and the external carotid artery.
lay_definition_en: One of the main blood vessels that deliver oxygen-rich blood from the heart to the head through the neck.
lay_definition_de: Eines der wichtigsten Blutgefäße, das sauerstoffreiches Blut vom Herzen über den Hals zum Kopf transportiert.

general_definition_en: The pathologic narrowing of the orifice of the TRICUSPID VALVE. This hinders the emptying of RIGHT ATRIUM leading to elevated right atrial pressure and systemic venous congestion. Tricuspid valve stenosis is almost always due to RHEUMATIC FEVER. INSUFFICIENCY
lay_definition_en: The tricuspid valve in the heart doesn't close properly causing blood to flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Die Trikuspidalklappe im Herzen schließt nicht richtig, wodurch das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes or diseases where cerebral MICROVESSELS show abnormalities. They are often associated with aging, hypertension and risk factors for lacunar infarcts (see LACUNAR INFARCTION); LEUKOARAIOSIS; and CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the tiny blood vessels in the heart or brain are damaged, leading to heart or brain issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der die winzigen Blutgefäße im Herzen oder im Gehirn geschädigt sind, was zu Herz- oder Gehirnproblemen führt.

general_definition_en: ATRIAL
lay_definition_en: The term atrial refers to the top chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Begriff „Vorhof“ bezieht sich auf die oberen Kammern des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Describing a hollow space within an organ or body part.
lay_definition_de: Bezeichnet einen Hohlraum innerhalb eines Organs oder Körperteils.

general_definition_en: Brain dysfunction or damage resulting from sustained MALIGNANT HYPERTENSION. When BLOOD PRESSURE exceeds the limits of cerebral autoregulation, cerebral blood flow is impaired (BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Clinical manifestations include HEADACHE; NAUSEA; VOMITING; SEIZURES; altered mental status (in some cases progressing to COMA); PAPILLEDEMA; and RETINAL HEMORRHAGE.
lay_definition_en: A condition where high pressure in the liver's blood vessels causes changes in the large intestine lining.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der erhöhter Druck in den Blutgefäßen der Leber zu Veränderungen der Dickdarmschleimhaut führt.

general_definition_en: VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle on one side becomes thickened.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzmuskel auf einer Seite verdickt sich.

general_definition_en: Located within a ventricle of the brain or heart.
lay_definition_en: Related to the insides of the heart or brain.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz oder das Gehirn betreffend.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which the cardiac rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A steady beat that our heart follows.
lay_definition_de: Ein gleichmäßiger Rhythmus, dem unser Herz folgt.

general_definition_en: Pathological condition characterized by the backflow of blood from the ASCENDING AORTA back into the LEFT VENTRICLE, leading to regurgitation. It is caused by diseases of the AORTIC VALVE or its surrounding tissue (aortic root).
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, blood can flow backward in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, kann das Blut in die falsche Richtung zurückfließen.

general_definition_en: tricuspid jet
lay_definition_en: A tricuspid jet is a test done using ultrasound to check for high blood pressure in the lung's artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Trikuspidalstrahl ist eine Untersuchung mittels Ultraschall, mit der ein erhöhter Blutdruck in der Lungenarterie festgestellt werden kann.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES; VEINS; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.
lay_definition_en: Microvascular disease is when tiny blood vessels like capillaries are harmed.
lay_definition_de: Von einer mikrovaskulären Erkrankung spricht man, wenn winzige Blutgefäße wie Kapillaren geschädigt sind.

general_definition_en: A phospholipid-stabilized suspension composed of microbubbles containing the gas perfluorobutane (perflubutane, PFB) with an outer layer of hydrogenated egg phosphatidylserine (HEPS), which can be used as an ultrasound imaging contrast agent. Upon administration, the PFB microbubbles enhance echo differences between various tissues, which enhances the visualization of images during ultrasound. In particular, the PFB microbubbles seem to preferentially target the reticuloendothelial system (RES); they are taken up by macrophages in the spleen and liver (Kupffer cells), and are taken up in lymph nodes. This may aid in the detection and diagnosis of cancer and liver disease, and may improve imaging of the lymphatic and vascular systems. The microbubbles provide increased stability during ultrasound imaging. contrast
lay_definition_en: A substance used to improve the clarity of medical imaging scans by injecting or ingesting it.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wirkstoff, der durch Injektion oder Einnahme zur Verbesserung der Bildschärfe bei medizinischen Bildgebungsverfahren eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: An alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that has both central and peripheral nervous system effects. Its primary clinical use is as an antihypertensive agent.
lay_definition_en: A medication to reduce high blood pressure levels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Senkung eines hohen Blutdrucks.

general_definition_en: Lotrel
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A methylene-substituted bisphosphonate. Medronic acid has affinity for and adheres to the surface of hydroxyapatite crystals in the bone matrix. This agent accumulates at sites of osteoid mineralization and can be used, complexed with radioisotopes such as technetium 99m, in bone imaging.
lay_definition_en: Medtronic En is a specific type of pacemaker made by a certain company.
lay_definition_de: Medtronic En ist ein bestimmter Herzschrittmachertyp, der von einem bestimmten Unternehmen hergestellt wird.

general_definition_en: A long-acting dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker. It is effective in the treatment of ANGINA PECTORIS and HYPERTENSION.
lay_definition_en: Amlodopine is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure and can also be known as Norvasc.
lay_definition_de: Amlodopin ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt und auch unter dem Namen Norvasc bekannt ist.

general_definition_en: brand name of an antibiotic A carbamate derivative used as an alcohol deterrent. It is a relatively nontoxic substance when administered alone, but markedly alters the intermediary metabolism of alcohol. When alcohol is ingested after administration of disulfiram, blood acetaldehyde concentrations are increased, followed by flushing, systemic vasodilation, respiratory difficulties, nausea, hypotension, and other symptoms (acetaldehyde syndrome). It acts by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase.
lay_definition_en: Medication to treat bacterial infections.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung bakterieller Infektionen.

general_definition_en: The autophagy process which begins when chaperones and co-chaperones recognize a target motif and unfold the substrate protein. The proteins are then transported to the lysosome where they are degraded. [GOC:pad, GOC:PARL, PMID:22743996, PMID:23434281]
lay_definition_en: Medicine-coated aspirin that helps prevent blood clotting, heart attacks, and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Mit einem Wirkstoff überzogenes Aspirin, das dazu beiträgt, Blutgerinnsel, Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle zu verhindern.

general_definition_en: brand name of a high blood pressure medication
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure, heart failure, or heart attack recovery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, Herzinsuffizienz oder zur Genesung nach einem Herzinfarkt.

general_definition_en: An orally active nonpeptide triazole-derived antagonist of angiotensin (AT) II with antihypertensive properties. Valsartan selectively and competitively blocks the binding of angiotensin II to the AT1 subtype receptor in vascular smooth muscle and the adrenal gland, preventing AT II-mediated vasoconstriction, aldosterone synthesis and secretion, and renal reabsorption of sodium, and resulting in vasodilation, increased excretion of sodium and water, a reduction in plasma volume, and a reduction in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: The hydrochloride salt form of quinapril, a prodrug and non-sulfhydryl angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor with antihypertensive activity. Quinapril is hydrolized into its active form quinaprilat, which binds to and inhibits ACE, thereby blocking the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II. This abolishes the potent vasoconstrictive actions of angiotensin II and leads to vasodilatation. Quinapril also causes a decrease in angiotensin II-induced aldosterone secretion by the adrenal cortex, thereby promoting diuresis and natriuresis, and increases bradykinin levels.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with increasing blood circulation and reducing high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Durchblutung fördert und Bluthochdruck senkt.

general_definition_en: The autophagy process which begins when chaperones and co-chaperones recognize a target motif and unfold the substrate protein. The proteins are then transported to the lysosome where they are degraded. [GOC:pad, GOC:PARL, PMID:22743996, PMID:23434281]
lay_definition_en: Aspirin with a protective coating to help prevent blood clotting, heart attacks, and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Aspirin mit einer Schutzhülle, das dazu beiträgt, Blutgerinnsel, Herzinfarkte und Schlaganfälle zu verhindern.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in the regulation of apoptosis.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower excess fluid in the body, often used for conditions like heart failure and liver disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, und häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz und Lebererkrankungen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: swizzle
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with high blood pressure and heart conditions by relaxing the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Bluthochdruck und Herzerkrankungen hilft, indem es das Herz und die Blutgefäße entspannt.

general_definition_en: Lotensin
lay_definition_en: Medication for high blood pressure that belongs to a class called ACE Inhibitors.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, das zur Klasse der sogenannten ACE-Hemmer gehört.

general_definition_en: Vasotec
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps improve blood circulation and reduces high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das die Durchblutung fördert und hohen Blutdruck senkt.

general_definition_en: Uroxatrol
lay_definition_en: Uroxatrol is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Uroxatrol ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A carboxyl-containing angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor with antihypertensive activity. As a prodrug, benazepril is metabolized to its active form benazeprilat. Benazeprilat competitively binds to and inhibits ACE, thereby blocking the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II. This prevents the potent vasoconstrictive actions of angiotensin II resulting in vasodilation. Benazeprilat also decreases angiotensin II-induced aldosterone secretion by the adrenal cortex, which leads to an increase in sodium excretion and subsequently increases water outflow.
lay_definition_en: Benazepril is a medication that helps improve blood flow and reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Benazepril ist ein Medikament, das zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung und zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A quinoline and tetrazole derivative that acts as a phosphodiesterase type 3 inhibitor, with anti-platelet and vasodilating activity. It is used in the treatment of PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASES; ISCHEMIC HEART DISEASE; and in the prevention of stroke.
lay_definition_en: Cilostazol is a medication used to improve blood flow and is commonly prescribed for conditions like peripheral artery disease.
lay_definition_de: Cilostazol ist ein Medikament zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung und wird häufig bei Erkrankungen wie der peripheren arteriellen Verschlusskrankheit verschrieben.

general_definition_en: A drug used to treat high blood pressure and certain heart problems. It is also being studied in the prevention and treatment of side effects caused by some anticancer drugs. Carvedilol phosphate blocks certain receptors on nerve cells and causes blood vessels to dilate (widen). It is a type of antihypertensive agent and a type of antianginal agent.
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure and heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck und Herzprobleme.

general_definition_en: Adalat
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain or high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen oder Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: A drug used to treat urinary problems caused by an enlarged prostate. It is also used to treat high blood pressure and is being studied in the treatment of other conditions. Terazosin relaxes muscle tissue in blood vessels and in the prostate. It is a type of alpha blocker.
lay_definition_en: Prazosin is a medication commonly used to treat high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Prazosin ist ein Medikament, das häufig zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: abnormally diminished amount of cholesterol in the blood.
lay_definition_en: Having a lot of cholesterol in your blood, which is a type of fat, increases the chances of having a heart attack or stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein hoher Cholesterinspiegel im Blut – Cholesterin ist eine Art von Fett – erhöht das Risiko für einen Herzinfarkt oder einen Schlaganfall.

general_definition_en: mi
lay_definition_en: A heart attack occurs when the heart muscle dies due to lack of oxygen.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt tritt auf, wenn der Herzmuskel aufgrund von Sauerstoffmangel abstirbt.

general_definition_en: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated without an invasive procedure using the following formula: diastolic pressure plus 1/3 of the pulse pressure, where pulse pressure is systolic pressure - diastolic pressure.
lay_definition_en: A MAP is the average blood pressure of a person.
lay_definition_de: Der MAP ist der durchschnittliche Blutdruck einer Person.

general_definition_en: A condition caused by dysfunctions related to the SINOATRIAL NODE including impulse generation (CARDIAC SINUS ARREST) and impulse conduction (SINOATRIAL EXIT BLOCK). It is characterized by persistent BRADYCARDIA, chronic ATRIAL FIBRILLATION, and failure to resume sinus rhythm following CARDIOVERSION. This syndrome can be congenital or acquired, particularly after surgical correction for heart defects.
lay_definition_en: The SSS is when the heart's rhythm is messed up because the sinus node isn���t working right.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem SSS ist der Herzrhythmus gestört, weil der Sinusknoten nicht richtig funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The pressure within the left ventricle following the completion of diastolic filling, just prior to systole.
lay_definition_en: The blood pressure inside the heart's ventricle that can show if someone might have heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck im Herzkammer, der Aufschluss darüber geben kann, ob jemand möglicherweise Herzprobleme hat.

general_definition_en: A chronic inflammatory connective tissue disease marked by skin rashes, joint pain and swelling, inflammation of the kidneys, inflammation of the fibrous tissue surrounding the heart (i.e., the pericardium), as well as other problems. Not all affected individuals display all of these problems.
lay_definition_en: Being at high risk for blood clots, stroke, and heart attacks due to specific antibodies in the body.
lay_definition_de: Aufgrund bestimmter Antikörper im Körper besteht ein hohes Risiko für Blutgerinnsel, Schlaganfälle und Herzinfarkte.

general_definition_en: Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: The major arteries that bring blood to your pelvis and legs.
lay_definition_de: Die großen Arterien, die das Blut in das Becken und in die Beine leiten.

general_definition_en: Reconstruction or repair of a blood vessel, which includes the widening of a pathological narrowing of an artery or vein by the removal of atheromatous plaque material and/or the endothelial lining as well, or by dilatation (BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY) to compress an ATHEROMA. Except for ENDARTERECTOMY, usually these procedures are performed via catheterization as minimally invasive ENDOVASCULAR PROCEDURES.
lay_definition_en: Fixing a narrow blood vessel with surgery.
lay_definition_de: Operative Behandlung eines verengten Blutgefäßes.

general_definition_en: Having to do with the heart.
lay_definition_en: When someone has cardiac, their heart gets too big.
lay_definition_de: Wenn jemand an einer Herzvergrößerung leidet, wird sein Herz zu groß.

general_definition_en: The time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the cardiac cycle.
lay_definition_en: A measurement used in heart imaging tests.
lay_definition_de: Ein Messwert, der bei bildgebenden Untersuchungen des Herzens verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: Waterston 's groove
lay_definition_en: A deep groove on the heart surface that helps surgeons gain access to the left atrium during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Eine tiefe Rille auf der Herzoberfläche, die Chirurgen während der Operation den Zugang zum linken Vorhof erleichtert.

general_definition_en: A procedure involving a mechanical pump which receives blood from the right ventricle and delivers it to the pulmonary artery. (ACC)
lay_definition_en: A device that helps a weak heart pump blood better.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das einem geschwächten Herzen hilft, das Blut besser zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: hypervolumic
lay_definition_en: Having too much blood volume can strain the heart and cause heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein zu hohes Blutvolumen kann das Herz überlasten und zu Herzinsuffizienz führen.

general_definition_en: Localized or diffuse reduction in blood flow through the vertebrobasilar arterial system, which supplies the BRAIN STEM; CEREBELLUM; OCCIPITAL LOBE; medial TEMPORAL LOBE; and THALAMUS. Characteristic clinical features include SYNCOPE; lightheadedness; visual disturbances; and VERTIGO. BRAIN STEM INFARCTIONS or other BRAIN INFARCTION may be associated.
lay_definition_en: When blood flow to the back part of your brain isn't good.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Durchblutung des hinteren Teils Ihres Gehirns nicht ausreichend ist.

general_definition_en: Radiography of the ventricular system of the brain after injection of air or other contrast medium directly into the cerebral ventricles. It is used also for x-ray computed tomography of the cerebral ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A ventriculogram is a special X-ray image of the heart or brain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ventrikulogramm ist eine spezielle Röntgenaufnahme des Herzens oder des Gehirns.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: A measurement of how big one part of the heart is.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie groß ein bestimmter Teil des Herzens ist.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: A thin tube inserted into a vein in the upper chest or neck that goes near the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der in eine Vene im oberen Brustbereich oder am Hals eingeführt wird und bis in die Nähe des Herzens reicht.

general_definition_en: The main artery of the thigh, a continuation of the external iliac artery.
lay_definition_en: The main blood vessel in the thigh that takes blood from the heart to the leg.
lay_definition_de: Das Hauptblutgefäß im Oberschenkel, das das Blut vom Herzen zum Bein transportiert.

general_definition_en: Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: A major artery that supplies blood to the pelvis and legs.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Arterie, die das Becken und die Beine mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A tube extending from the middle ear to the outer ear. Either of two large arteries originating from the abdominal aorta; they supply blood to the pelvis, abdominal wall and legs.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel in the lower belly and leg that supplies blood to the skin and muscles.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß im Unterbauch und im Bein, das die Haut und die Muskeln mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic procedure in which a catheter is guided into the right heart, where pressures may be measured and radiocontrast material may be injected to visualize blood flow in and around the right heart.
lay_definition_en: It's a procedure to check and fix heart problems involving inserting a tube into an artery and guiding it to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein Verfahren zur Untersuchung und Behandlung von Herzproblemen, bei dem ein Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt und bis zum Herzen vorgeschoben wird.

general_definition_en: A principal artery that originates in the aorta. It supplies blood to the muscular tissue of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Blood vessels that give the heart its necessary blood supply.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße, die das Herz mit der notwendigen Blutversorgung versorgen.

general_definition_en: A SI derived unit of electric potential and electromotive force, equal to the difference of electric potential between two points on a conducting wire carrying a constant current of one ampere when the power dissipated between the points is one watt, equivalent to the potential difference across a resistance of one ohm when one ampere of current flows through it. -
lay_definition_en: Information derived from a heart monitoring test called an electrocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: Informationen, die aus einer Herzuntersuchung namens Elektrokardiogramm gewonnen werden.

general_definition_en: An insulated electrical conductor designed to connect to an electrical device.
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker wire is called LEADS.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzschrittmacher-Elektrode wird als „LEADS“ bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps to decrease high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: Pertaining to the back or upper surface of the body; opposite of ventral. PEDIS
lay_definition_en: An artery that runs along the top of your foot, where you can feel for the pulse near the middle of your foot.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie, die entlang der Fußoberseite verläuft und an der man den Puls etwa in der Mitte des Fußes ertasten kann.

general_definition_en: Welch - Allen In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A Welch Allen monitor is a screen that shows a patient's vital signs.
lay_definition_de: Ein Welch-Allen-Monitor ist ein Bildschirm, auf dem die Vitalparameter eines Patienten angezeigt werden.

general_definition_en: A species of facultatively anaerobic, Gram negative, coccobacilli shaped bacteria assigned to the phylum Proteobacteria. This species is urease, catalase and oxidase positive, porphyrin negative and requires both X and V factors to grow in culture. H. haemolyticus is normally nonpathogenic but may cause disease in immunocompromised patients.
lay_definition_en: A type of bacteria often present in the mouth that can sometimes lead to heart valve infections.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die häufig im Mund vorkommt und manchmal zu Herzklappenentzündungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of an inversion of the T wave from the expected axis.
lay_definition_en: A sign found in an EKG heart test.
lay_definition_de: Ein Befund, der bei einer EKG-Untersuchung festgestellt wurde.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: Troponin I is a protein released in the blood when the heart muscle is damaged.
lay_definition_de: Troponin I ist ein Protein, das bei einer Schädigung des Herzmuskels ins Blut freigesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: VERITY ADx XL
lay_definition_en: A certain brand and type of pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Eine bestimmte Marke und ein bestimmter Typ von Herzschrittmacher.

general_definition_en: A blood vessel in the heart which returns coronary blood to the right atrium.
lay_definition_en: A big vein that's made by smaller veins joining together to collect blood from the heart muscle.
lay_definition_de: Eine große Vene, die aus dem Zusammenfluss kleinerer Venen entsteht und das Blut aus dem Herzmuskel aufnimmt.

general_definition_en: A short vein that collects about two thirds of the venous blood from the MYOCARDIUM and drains into the RIGHT ATRIUM. Coronary sinus, normally located between the LEFT ATRIUM and LEFT VENTRICLE on the posterior surface of the heart, can serve as an anatomical reference for cardiac procedures.
lay_definition_en: Where the heart's blood-carrying veins come together.
lay_definition_de: Dort, wo die blutführenden Adern des Herzens zusammenlaufen.

general_definition_en: Tissue derived from the heart valves that allow blood flow through the heart.
lay_definition_en: The heart valve is like a door in the heart that opens and closes to let blood flow through.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzklappe ist wie eine Tür im Herzen, die sich öffnet und schließt, damit das Blut hindurchfließen kann.

general_definition_en: A species of facultatively anaerobic, Gram positive, cocci shaped bacteria in the phylum Firmicutes. This species is positive for gallate degradation, esculin hydrolysis and Lancefield group D and negative for catalase, hemolysis, growth in 6.5% NaCl and pyrrolidonylarylamidase. It can ferment cellobiose, fructose, galactose, glucose, lactose, maltose, mannose, melibiose and trehalose but not ribose or sorbitol. S. gallolyticus is commensal in the human alimentary tract and is a pathogen that can cause septicemia and endocarditis.
lay_definition_en: A bacteria that can cause urinary tract infections and inflammation in the brain, spine, and heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bakterium, das Harnwegsinfektionen sowie Entzündungen im Gehirn, in der Wirbelsäule und im Herzen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: Postoperative hemorrhage from an endovascular AORTIC ANEURYSM repaired with endoluminal placement of stent grafts (BLOOD VESSEL PROSTHESIS IMPLANTATION). It is associated with pressurization, expansion, and eventual rupture of the aneurysm.
lay_definition_en: Endoleaks are a complication that can happen after surgery to fix blood vessel damage.
lay_definition_de: Endoleckagen sind eine Komplikation, die nach einer Operation zur Behebung von Gefäßschäden auftreten kann.

general_definition_en: Stage III includes: IIIA: (T3, N0, M0); IIIB: (T4, N0, M0). T3: Tumor with direct invasion into any of the following: lung, brachiocephalic vein, superior vena cava, phrenic nerve, chest wall, or extrapericardial pulmonary artery or veins. T4: Tumor with invasion into any of the following: aorta (ascending, arch, or descending), arch vessels, intrapericardial pulmonary artery, myocardium, trachea, esophagus. N0: No regional lymph node metastasis. M0: No distant metastasis. (AJCC 8th ed.)
lay_definition_en: The cancer has spread beyond the thymus to the surrounding fat or chest lining.
lay_definition_de: Der Krebs hat sich über den Thymus hinaus auf das umliegende Fettgewebe oder die Brustfellhaut ausgebreitet.
