lay_definition_en: A medicine that helps control high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das bei der Kontrolle von Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: A form of heart block in which the electrical stimulation of HEART VENTRICLES is interrupted at either one of the branches of BUNDLE OF HIS thus preventing the simultaneous depolarization of the two ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A bundle-block is a situation where electrical signals to one side of the heart are delayed or blocked.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bündelblock liegt vor, wenn elektrische Signale an einer Seite des Herzens verzögert oder blockiert werden.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a slightly widened QRS duration (typically less than 120 ms) with leftward frontal plane QRS axis and typically small Q waves in leads I and aVL. (CDISC) - Interrupt the normal function of; hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of; stop from happening or developing; interfere with or prevent the reception of signals; impede the movement of.
lay_definition_en: A condition in the heart where electrical signals do not spread correctly in a certain area, seen on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der sich elektrische Signale in einem bestimmten Bereich nicht korrekt ausbreiten, was im EKG erkennbar ist.

general_definition_en: Formation of an infarct, which is NECROSIS in tissue due to local ISCHEMIA resulting from obstruction of BLOOD CIRCULATION, most commonly by a THROMBUS or EMBOLUS.
lay_definition_en: When the tissue at the back of your brain doesn't get enough blood and dies.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Gewebe im hinteren Teil Ihres Gehirns nicht ausreichend durchblutet wird und abstirbt.

general_definition_en: The maximum amount of force that can be generated in one maximal muscle contraction or the maximum amount of weight that can be cycled through one repetition of a particular movement or exercise. heart rate
lay_definition_en: The fastest heart rate a person should reach during exercise.
lay_definition_de: Die höchste Herzfrequenz, die eine Person beim Sport erreichen sollte.

general_definition_en: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial CAROTID ARTERIES and the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the CIRCLE OF WILLIS. Cerebral angiogram shows the puff-of-smoke (moyamoya) collaterals at the base of the brain. It is characterized by endothelial HYPERPLASIA and FIBROSIS with thickening of arterial walls. This disease primarily affects children but can also occur in adults.
lay_definition_en: A rare disease where tiny blood vessels form to bypass blocked arteries at the base of the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Erkrankung, bei der sich winzige Blutgefäße bilden, um verstopfte Arterien an der Hirnbasis zu umgehen.

general_definition_en: Pathological processes involving any of the BLOOD VESSELS in the cardiac or peripheral circulation. They include diseases of ARTERIES; VEINS; and rest of the vasculature system in the body.
lay_definition_en: A term used to describe any health issue with veins or arteries.
lay_definition_de: Ein Begriff, der verwendet wird, um jegliche gesundheitlichen Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Venen oder Arterien zu beschreiben.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation. kick
lay_definition_en: When the upper part of the heart squeezes, it gives an extra push to blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich der obere Teil des Herzens zusammenzieht, verleiht dies dem Blutfluss einen zusätzlichen Schub.

general_definition_en: reverberation
lay_definition_en: When sound waves bounce back and forth between surfaces in ultrasound imaging, creating a repeating echo effect.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Schallwellen bei der Ultraschallbildgebung zwischen Oberflächen hin und her reflektiert werden, entsteht ein sich wiederholender Echoeffekt.

general_definition_en: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling. Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: When the heart struggles to fill up with blood, resulting in less blood being pumped out to the body.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, sich mit Blut zu füllen, was dazu führt, dass weniger Blut in den Körper gepumpt wird.

general_definition_en: A condition associated with VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECT and other congenital heart defects that allow the mixing of pulmonary and systemic circulation, increase blood flow into the lung, and subsequent responses to low oxygen in blood. This complex is characterized by progressive PULMONARY HYPERTENSION; HYPERTROPHY of the RIGHT VENTRICLE; CYANOSIS; and ERYTHROCYTOSIS.
lay_definition_en: Eisenmenger syndrome is when a heart defect leads to high pressure in the lungs, limiting oxygen to the body and causing thickening of the heart wall.
lay_definition_de: Beim Eisenmenger-Syndrom führt ein Herzfehler zu erhöhtem Druck in der Lunge, wodurch die Sauerstoffversorgung des Körpers eingeschränkt wird und es zu einer Verdickung der Herzwand kommt.

general_definition_en: At an angle; having an oblique or slanted direction.
lay_definition_en: One of the branches of a heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ast einer Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: Antibodies which react with the individual structural determinants (idiotopes) on the variable region of other antibodies. - An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally rapid heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist. pacing
lay_definition_en: Sending small electric shocks to slow down a fast heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Durch leichte Stromstöße wird eine zu hohe Herzfrequenz verlangsamt.

general_definition_en: A standard and widely accepted diagnostic test used to identify patients who have a vasodepressive and/or cardioinhibitory response as a cause of syncope. (From Braunwald, Heart Disease, 7th ed)
lay_definition_en: A test where you lie on a table that tilts up vertically to detect reasons for low blood pressure or fainting.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der man auf einem Tisch liegt, der senkrecht nach oben gekippt wird, um Ursachen für niedrigen Blutdruck oder Ohnmacht festzustellen.

general_definition_en: Abnormal protrusion or billowing of one or both of the leaflets of MITRAL VALVE into the LEFT ATRIUM during SYSTOLE. This allows the backflow of blood into left atrium leading to MITRAL VALVE INSUFFICIENCY; SYSTOLIC MURMURS; or CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the mitral valve doesn't close properly because its flaps are floppy.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der die Mitralklappe nicht richtig schließt, weil ihre Segel schlaff sind.

general_definition_en: The dimension of the physical universe which, at a given place, orders the sequence of events. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)
lay_definition_en: The time the heart's ventricle recharges.
lay_definition_de: Die Zeit, in der sich die Herzkammer wieder auffüllt.

general_definition_en: Wall of cardiac chamber that surrounds the cavity of an atrium. SEPTUM
lay_definition_en: Atrial septum is the wall dividing the upper chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Das Vorhofseptum ist die Wand, die die oberen Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: A bulging blood vessel that can burst and lead to dangerous internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Ein aufgeblähtes Blutgefäß, das reißen und zu gefährlichen inneren Blutungen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Catapres
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure called Catapres.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck namens Catapres.

lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Decrease in the size of a cell, tissue, organ, or multiple organs, associated with a variety of pathological conditions such as abnormal cellular changes, ischemia, malnutrition, or hormonal changes.
lay_definition_en: Atrophied means a decrease in size or wasting away of part of the body.
lay_definition_de: „Atrophiert“ bedeutet eine Verkleinerung oder ein Schwund eines Körperteils.

general_definition_en: An expandable hollow tube that is advanced into an obstructed or narrow coronary artery to restore blood flow to the heart. bypasses
lay_definition_en: A surgery to create new pathways for blood flow around blocked arteries in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem neue Blutbahnen um verstopfte Herzarterien herum geschaffen werden.

general_definition_en: An imaging technique using compounds labelled with short-lived positron-emitting radionuclides (such as carbon-11, nitrogen-13, oxygen-15 and fluorine-18) to measure cell metabolism. It has been useful in study of soft tissues such as CANCER; CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM; and brain. SINGLE-PHOTON EMISSION-COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY is closely related to positron emission tomography, but uses isotopes with longer half-lives and resolution is lower.
lay_definition_en: Tubes for air going into the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Luftwege, über die Luft in die Lunge gelangt.

general_definition_en: INFERIOR Arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.
lay_definition_en: A big artery in your belly that provides blood to parts of your lower intestine.
lay_definition_de: Eine große Arterie im Bauchraum, die Teile des unteren Darms mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: The lobe of the right lung that lies above the oblique and horizontal fissures and includes the apical, posterior and anterior bronchopulmonary segments; in the left lung, the lobe lies above the oblique fissure and contains the apicoposterior, anterior, superior lingular and inferior lingular segments. Arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.
lay_definition_en: A big important artery in the belly.
lay_definition_de: Eine große, wichtige Arterie im Bauchraum.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which two premature ventricular complexes occur sequentially. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: An irregular heart rhythm caused by the lower chambers beating too fast.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzrhythmusstörung, die dadurch verursacht wird, dass die Herzkammern zu schnell schlagen.

general_definition_en: ARRHYTHMIAS
lay_definition_en: Irregularities with how our heart beats.
lay_definition_de: Unregelmäßigkeiten im Herzrhythmus.

general_definition_en: An autogenous transplantation that does not entirely sever the topographic object from the donor spot, at least until it is united at the recipient spot of the A congenital cardiovascular malformation in which the AORTA arises entirely from the RIGHT VENTRICLE, and the PULMONARY ARTERY arises from the LEFT VENTRICLE. Consequently, the pulmonary and the systemic circulations are parallel and not sequential, so that the venous return from the peripheral circulation is re-circulated by the right ventricle via aorta to the systemic circulation without being oxygenated in the lungs. This is a potentially lethal form of heart disease in newborns and infants.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the two main arteries leaving the heart are swapped at birth.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die beiden Hauptarterien, die vom Herzen ausgehen, bei der Geburt vertauscht sind.

general_definition_en: A muscle located close to the trunk of the body. atrial
lay_definition_en: A type of irregular heartbeat that originates in the upper chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die ihren Ursprung in den oberen Herzkammern hat.

general_definition_en: fast ventricular response
lay_definition_en: The heart's lower chambers beating too quickly.
lay_definition_de: Die unteren Herzkammern schlagen zu schnell.

general_definition_en: The organ of hearing located on the right side of the head. VENTRICLE
lay_definition_en: Right ventricle is one of the heart's four chambers.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Ventrikel ist eine der vier Herzkammern.

general_definition_en: The wire which connects a pacemaker or defibrillator to the ventricular tissue. To give support or aid to; help; to be associated with as an assistant or helper. DEVICE
lay_definition_en: A device that pumps blood to assist individuals with weak hearts.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das Blut pumpt, um Menschen mit Herzschwäche zu unterstützen.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: A stress test is a medical scan that checks how your heart functions during rest or exercise by monitoring blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Belastungstest ist eine medizinische Untersuchung, bei der durch die Überwachung des Blutflusses überprüft wird, wie Ihr Herz in Ruhe oder unter Belastung funktioniert.

general_definition_en: The segment of the arterial system that includes the popliteal artery and its origin from the femoral artery.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to treat a block in the main leg artery by creating a bypass using another artery.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff zur Behandlung einer Verstopfung der Hauptbeinarterie durch die Anlage eines Bypasses unter Verwendung einer anderen Arterie.

general_definition_en: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the ankle. [] - Comparison of the BLOOD PRESSURE between the BRACHIAL ARTERY and the POSTERIOR TIBIAL ARTERY. It is a predictor of PERIPHERAL ARTERIAL DISEASE.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks for poor blood flow to the arms and legs.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, mit der eine Durchblutungsstörung in den Armen und Beinen festgestellt wird.

general_definition_en: Procedures using an electrically heated wire or scalpel to treat hemorrhage (e.g., bleeding ulcers) and to ablate tumors, mucosal lesions, and refractory arrhythmias. It is different from ELECTROSURGERY which is used more for cutting tissue than destroying and in which the patient is part of the electric circuit.
lay_definition_en: A medical technique that uses electricity to cauterize and stop bleeding in blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinisches Verfahren, bei dem mithilfe von Strom Blutgefäße verödet und Blutungen gestillt werden.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - Surrounding like a crown (especially of the blood vessels surrounding the heart). LEAFLET
lay_definition_en: One of the three flaps that form the aortic valve in the heart, but is not related to coronary arteries.
lay_definition_de: Eine der drei Klappen, die die Aortenklappe im Herzen bilden, die jedoch nichts mit den Koronararterien zu tun hat.

general_definition_en: A membrane on the vitreal surface of the retina resulting from the proliferation of one or more of three retinal elements: (1) fibrous astrocytes; (2) fibrocytes; and (3) retinal pigment epithelial cells. Localized epiretinal membranes may occur at the posterior pole of the eye without clinical signs or may cause marked loss of vision as a result of covering, distorting, or detaching the fovea centralis. Epiretinal membranes may cause vascular leakage and secondary retinal edema. In younger individuals some membranes appear to be developmental in origin and occur in otherwise normal eyes. The majority occur in association with retinal holes, ocular concussions, retinal inflammation, or after ocular surgery. (Newell, Ophthalmology: Principles and Concepts, 7th ed, p291) heme
lay_definition_en: Bleeding in front of the eye's retina that can be seen during an eye exam and may indicate other health issues.
lay_definition_de: Blutungen vor der Netzhaut des Auges, die bei einer Augenuntersuchung festgestellt werden können und auf andere gesundheitliche Probleme hinweisen können.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of complete failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles. This is manifested on the ECG by disassociation of atrial and ventricular rhythms. The atrial rate must be faster than the ventricular rate. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Heart rhythm problem where the heart beats too slowly.
lay_definition_de: Herzrhythmusstörung, bei der das Herz zu langsam schlägt.

general_definition_en: A nonspecific hypersensitivity reaction caused by TRAUMA to the PERICARDIUM, often following PERICARDIOTOMY. It is characterized by PERICARDIAL EFFUSION; high titers of anti-heart antibodies; low-grade FEVER; LETHARGY; loss of APPETITE; or ABDOMINAL PAIN.
lay_definition_en: Inflammation around the heart after surgery in the area.
lay_definition_de: Entzündung im Bereich des Herzens nach einem chirurgischen Eingriff in dieser Region.

general_definition_en: Functional KIDNEY FAILURE in patients with liver disease, usually LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL), and in the absence of intrinsic renal disease or kidney abnormality. It is characterized by intense renal vasculature constriction, reduced renal blood flow, OLIGURIA, and sodium retention.
lay_definition_en: It's a medical term for issues affecting both the kidneys and liver.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um einen medizinischen Begriff für Erkrankungen, die sowohl die Nieren als auch die Leber betreffen.

general_definition_en: Any disturbances of the normal rhythmic beating of the heart or MYOCARDIAL CONTRACTION. Cardiac arrhythmias can be classified by the abnormalities in HEART RATE, disorders of electrical impulse generation, or impulse conduction.
lay_definition_en: It's when your heart beats in a weird way.
lay_definition_de: Das ist, wenn dein Herz auf seltsame Weise schlägt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a sudden drop of the blood pressure, bradycardia, and peripheral vasodilation that may lead to loss of consciousness. It results from an increase in the stimulation of the vagus nerve.
lay_definition_en: Sudden blood pressure drop-related.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit einem plötzlichen Blutdruckabfall.

general_definition_en: Transcription Repressor/Corepressor Gene encodes Transcriptional Repressor/Corepressor, proteins that can regulate transcription by binding to the operator and causing repression. (from Glick: Glossary of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology)
lay_definition_en: Medication used to manage chest pain, heart rhythm issues, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: Narrowing of the passage through the MITRAL VALVE due to FIBROSIS, and CALCINOSIS in the leaflets and chordal areas. This elevates the left atrial pressure which, in turn, raises pulmonary venous and capillary pressure leading to bouts of DYSPNEA and TACHYCARDIA during physical exertion. RHEUMATIC FEVER is its primary cause.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the valve is blocked due to plaque-like buildup.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der die Herzklappe durch plaqueartige Ablagerungen verstopft ist.

general_definition_en: The transfer of information from one source to another. gradient
lay_definition_en: A measure of pressure difference between the heart's chambers, indicating how well the mitral valve functions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß für den Druckunterschied zwischen den Herzkammern, das Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie gut die Mitralklappe funktioniert.

general_definition_en: An adrenergic beta-antagonist that is used in the treatment of life-threatening arrhythmias.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps control heart rhythm and reduce chest pain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, den Herzrhythmus zu regulieren und Brustschmerzen zu lindern.

general_definition_en: Agents that control agitated psychotic behavior, alleviate acute psychotic states, reduce psychotic symptoms, and exert a quieting effect. They are used in SCHIZOPHRENIA; senile dementia; transient psychosis following surgery; or MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; etc. These drugs are often referred to as neuroleptics alluding to the tendency to produce neurological side effects, but not all antipsychotics are likely to produce such effects. Many of these drugs may also be effective against nausea, emesis, and pruritus.
lay_definition_en: Drugs used to treat certain mental disorders.
lay_definition_de: Arzneimittel zur Behandlung bestimmter psychischer Störungen.

general_definition_en: A hypoperfusion of the BLOOD through an organ or tissue caused by a PATHOLOGIC CONSTRICTION or obstruction of its BLOOD VESSELS, or an absence of BLOOD CIRCULATION.
lay_definition_en: Inferior and side of the heart wall not getting enough blood.
lay_definition_de: Der untere und seitliche Bereich der Herzwand werden nicht ausreichend durchblutet.

general_definition_en: exertional angina
lay_definition_en: Chest pain that happens during physical activity or stress, but goes away when you rest.
lay_definition_de: Brustschmerzen, die bei körperlicher Anstrengung oder unter Stress auftreten, aber in Ruhe wieder verschwinden.

general_definition_en: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia that is characterized by uncoordinated extremely rapid firing of electrical impulses (400-600/min) in HEART VENTRICLES. Such asynchronous ventricular quivering or fibrillation prevents any effective cardiac output and results in unconsciousness (SYNCOPE). It is one of the major electrocardiographic patterns seen with CARDIAC ARREST.
lay_definition_en: A type of irregular heartbeat that can disrupt blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die den Blutfluss beeinträchtigen kann.

general_definition_en: Cardiac manifestation of systemic rheumatological conditions, such as RHEUMATIC FEVER. Rheumatic heart disease can involve any part the heart, most often the HEART VALVES and the ENDOCARDIUM.
lay_definition_en: Heart damage caused by a certain untreated infection.
lay_definition_de: Herzschaden, verursacht durch eine bestimmte unbehandelte Infektion.

general_definition_en: Cardiac manifestation of systemic rheumatological conditions, such as RHEUMATIC FEVER. Rheumatic heart disease can involve any part the heart, most often the HEART VALVES and the ENDOCARDIUM.
lay_definition_en: Heart damage caused by a certain untreated infection.
lay_definition_de: Herzschaden, verursacht durch eine bestimmte unbehandelte Infektion.

general_definition_en: Persistently high systemic arterial BLOOD PRESSURE. Based on multiple readings (BLOOD PRESSURE DETERMINATION), hypertension is currently defined as when SYSTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently greater than 140 mm Hg or when DIASTOLIC PRESSURE is consistently 90 mm Hg or more.
lay_definition_en: A condition that raises blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die zu einem Anstieg des Blutdrucks in der Lunge führt.

general_definition_en: A species of gram-positive bacteria in the STREPTOCOCCUS MILLERI GROUP. It is commonly found in the oropharynx flora and has a proclivity for abscess formation, most characteristically in the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM and LIVER.
lay_definition_en: A type of bacteria commonly found in the mouth, intestines, and skin that can lead to endocarditis when it causes infection.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die häufig im Mund, im Darm und auf der Haut vorkommt und zu einer Endokarditis führen kann, wenn sie eine Infektion auslöst.

general_definition_en: pseudosyncopal A transient loss of consciousness and postural tone caused by diminished blood flow to the brain (i.e., BRAIN ISCHEMIA). Presyncope refers to the sensation of lightheadedness and loss of strength that precedes a syncopal event or accompanies an incomplete syncope. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp367-9)
lay_definition_en: Briefly passing out for a short period of time.
lay_definition_de: Für kurze Zeit das Bewusstsein verlieren.

general_definition_en: Condition where a primary dysfunction of either heart or kidney results in failure of the other organ (e.g., HEART FAILURE with worsening RENAL INSUFFICIENCY).
lay_definition_en: When the heart and kidneys have a disease that impacts them both.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Herz und Nieren an einer Erkrankung leiden, die beide Organe betrifft.

general_definition_en: Complete closure of the normally patent lumen of the blood vessels which carry blood away from the heart.
lay_definition_en: When an artery gets clogged and blood can't flow through it.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Arterie verstopft ist und das Blut nicht mehr durch sie fließen kann.

general_definition_en: Heart failure accompanied by EDEMA, such as swelling of the legs and ankles and congestion in the lungs.
lay_definition_en: When the heart struggles to pump blood effectively.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, Blut effektiv zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an increase in pressure within the pulmonary circulation due to lung or heart disorder.
lay_definition_en: A condition that leads to high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die zu hohem Blutdruck in der Lunge führt.

general_definition_en: aortobifem
lay_definition_en: Aortobifem: a graft connecting the aorta to the femoral arteries to help with peripheral arterial disease.
lay_definition_de: Aortobifem: ein Transplantat, das die Aorta mit den Oberschenkelarterien verbindet, um bei peripherer arterieller Verschlusskrankheit Abhilfe zu schaffen.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: A word that describes something related to both an artery and a vein.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wort, das etwas beschreibt, das sowohl mit einer Arterie als auch mit einer Vene zu tun hat.

general_definition_en: A standard and widely accepted diagnostic test used to identify patients who have a vasodepressive and/or cardioinhibitory response as a cause of syncope. (From Braunwald, Heart Disease, 7th ed)
lay_definition_en: A tilt table is a test that checks for causes of low blood pressure or fainting by moving the patient from a lying to a standing position.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem Kipptisch-Test werden die Ursachen für niedrigen Blutdruck oder Ohnmacht untersucht, indem der Patient von der liegenden in die stehende Position gebracht wird.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in development and estrogen metabolism. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: Medication that lowers estrogen levels, which can be beneficial in treating certain forms of breast cancer.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die den Östrogenspiegel senken und bei der Behandlung bestimmter Formen von Brustkrebs von Nutzen sein können.

general_definition_en: A measurement of degree, speed, or frequency relative to time. - Groups that serve as a standard for comparison in experimental studies. They are similar in relevant characteristics to the experimental group but do not receive the experimental intervention.
lay_definition_en: Controlling the speed at which the heart beats, especially helpful in conditions like atrial fibrillation.
lay_definition_de: Regulierung der Herzfrequenz, was insbesondere bei Erkrankungen wie Vorhofflimmern hilfreich ist.

general_definition_en: A study using radioisotope tagged blood components and a nuclear scanning machine to monitor the blood flow to the myocardium during or immediately following exercise.
lay_definition_en: A test that looks at how well blood flows to your heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der geprüft wird, wie gut das Blut zum Herzen fließt.

general_definition_en: An octapeptide that is a potent but labile vasoconstrictor. It is produced from angiotensin I after the removal of two amino acids at the C-terminal by ANGIOTENSIN CONVERTING ENZYME. The amino acid in position 5 varies in different species. To block VASOCONSTRICTION and HYPERTENSION effect of angiotensin II, patients are often treated with ACE INHIBITORS or with ANGIOTENSIN II TYPE 1 RECEPTOR BLOCKERS. converting A pharmacological agent that inhibits the catalytic activity of an enzyme.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps increase blood flow and reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, die Durchblutung zu fördern und hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A dialect of the Niger-Congo Akan language spoken by the Ashanti people in southern and central Ghana.
lay_definition_en: A piece of info from a heart test called an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Information aus einer Herzuntersuchung, die als EKG bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: Electrical stimulation of the heart by artificial pacemaker leads placed at sites in the RIGHT ATRIUM and both HEART VENTRICLES to treat various cardiac conduction disturbances which interfere with the timing of contraction of the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A device that helps both sides of the heart pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das beiden Herzkammern dabei hilft, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Nitropaste
lay_definition_en: A cream that helps with chest pain from angina.
lay_definition_de: Eine Salbe, die bei Brustschmerzen aufgrund einer Angina hilft.

general_definition_en: ef
lay_definition_en: A way to measure how effectively the heart pumps blood, which helps diagnose heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Eine Methode zur Messung der Pumpkraft des Herzens, die bei der Diagnose von Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: Cardiac electrical stimulators that apply brief high-voltage electroshocks to the HEART. These stimulators are used to restore normal rhythm and contractile function in hearts of patients who are experiencing VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION or ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) that is not accompanied by a palpable PULSE. Some defibrillators may also be used to correct certain noncritical dysrhythmias (called synchronized defibrillation or CARDIOVERSION), using relatively low-level discharges synchronized to the patient's ECG waveform. (UMDNS, 2003)
lay_definition_en: A cardiovert is when a jolt of electricity is used to reset the heart's rhythm back to normal.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Kardioversion wird ein elektrischer Impuls eingesetzt, um den Herzrhythmus wieder zu normalisieren.

general_definition_en: Type-2 angiotensin II receptor (363 aa, ~41 kDa) is encoded by the human AGTR2 gene. This protein is involved in signal transduction, apoptosis, and the regulation of blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: A drug used for high blood pressure, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and post-heart attack care.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck, Herzinsuffizienz, chronischer Nierenerkrankung und zur Nachsorge nach einem Herzinfarkt.

general_definition_en: An octapeptide that is a potent but labile vasoconstrictor. It is produced from angiotensin I after the removal of two amino acids at the C-terminal by ANGIOTENSIN CONVERTING ENZYME. The amino acid in position 5 varies in different species. To block VASOCONSTRICTION and HYPERTENSION effect of angiotensin II, patients are often treated with ACE INHIBITORS or with ANGIOTENSIN II TYPE 1 RECEPTOR BLOCKERS. - Heat- and storage-stable plasma protein that is activated by tissue thromboplastin to form factor VIIa in the extrinsic pathway of blood coagulation. The activated form then catalyzes the activation of factor X to factor Xa. Acts on many phenolic esters. The reactions of EC 3.1.8.1 aryldialkylphosphatase, were previously attributed to this enzyme. [EC 3.1.1.2 created 1961, modified 1989] (from IUBMB Enzyme Nomenclature).
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps to lower blood pressure, usually referred to as ACE inhibitors.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt und üblicherweise als ACE-Hemmer bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure or right heart failure.
lay_definition_en: A lung disease that leads to lung scarring.

general_definition_en: The gluconate salt form of quinidine, an alkaloid with antimalarial and antiarrhythmic (Class la) properties. Quinidine gluconate exerts its anti-malarial activity by acting primarily as an intra-erythrocytic schizonticide through association with the hemepolymer (hemozoin) in the acidic food vacuole of the parasite thereby preventing further polymerization by heme polymerase enzyme. This results in accumulation of toxic heme and death of the parasite. Quinidine gluconate exerts its antiarrhythmic effects by depressing the flow of sodium ions into cells during phase 0 of the cardiac action potential, thereby slowing the impulse conduction through the atrioventricular (AV) node, reducing the maximal rate of phase 0 depolarization and prolonging the refractory period. Quinidine gluconate also reduces the slope of phase 4 depolarization in Purkinje-fibres resulting in slowed conduction and reduced automaticity in the heart.

lay_definition_de: Behandlung einer Herzrhythmusstörung durch Anpassung der an das Herz gesendeten elektrischen Signale.

general_definition_en: Abnormal communication most commonly seen between two internal organs, or between an internal organ and the surface of the body. An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally rapid heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Fast heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Schneller Herzschlag.

general_definition_en: A substance used to make drugs that are used to treat several heart conditions, including congestive heart failure. Digitalis is made from the dried leaves of Digitalis purpurea (common foxglove) plants. It is a type of cardiac glycoside.
lay_definition_en: A medication made from dried foxglove leaves used to help with certain heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel aus getrockneten Fingerhutblättern, das bei bestimmten Herzproblemen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: A situation in which the level of living of an individual, family, or group is below the standard of the community. It is often related to a specific income level. An electrocardiographic finding where the amplitude of the R wave becomes greater than the amplitude of the S wave in the QRS complex at an unusually early point in the precordial leads, usually in leads V1 or V2. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: An EKG pattern indicating a possible heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein EKG-Befund, der auf einen möglichen Herzinfarkt hindeutet.

general_definition_en: Transfer of an organized electrical impulse across the heart to coordinate the contraction of cardiac muscles. The process begins with generation of an action potential (in the sinoatrial node (SA) in humans) and ends with a change in the rate, frequency, or extent of the contraction of the heart muscles. [GOC:dph]
lay_definition_en: Heart having a slow or off-balance rhythm in its electrical activity.
lay_definition_de: Herz, dessen elektrische Aktivität einen langsamen oder unregelmäßigen Rhythmus aufweist.

general_definition_en: Abnormal communication most commonly seen between two internal organs, or between an internal organ and the surface of the body.
lay_definition_en: Sinus: A fast and consistent heart rate of 100 beats per minute or higher while at rest.
lay_definition_de: Sinusrhythmus: Eine schnelle und gleichmäßige Herzfrequenz von 100 Schlägen pro Minute oder mehr im Ruhezustand.

general_definition_en: A form of ventricular pre-excitation characterized by a short PR interval and a long QRS interval with a delta wave. In this syndrome, atrial impulses are abnormally conducted to the HEART VENTRICLES via an ACCESSORY CONDUCTING PATHWAY that is located between the wall of the right or left atria and the ventricles, also known as a BUNDLE OF KENT. The inherited form can be caused by mutation of PRKAG2 gene encoding a gamma-2 regulatory subunit of AMP-activated protein kinase.
lay_definition_en: WPW is when there's an extra electrical pathway in the heart causing a fast heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Bei WPW liegt ein zusätzlicher elektrischer Leitungsweg im Herzen vor, der einen schnellen Herzschlag verursacht.

general_definition_en: A disorder affecting the conduction system that sends electrical signals in the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: Problem with the heart's electrical activity where part of the heart's cycle is delayed.
lay_definition_de: Störung der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens, bei der ein Teil des Herzzyklus verzögert ist.

general_definition_en: A non-metal element that has the atomic symbol P, atomic number 15, and atomic weight 31. It is an essential element that takes part in a broad variety of biochemical reactions. - A unit of exposure to ionizing radiation in CGS system. One roentgen is the amount of gamma or x-rays required to produce ions resulting in a charge of 2.58E-4 coulombs/kilogram of air under standard conditions.
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart's cycle detected in an ECG, usually lasting between 120 and 200 milliseconds.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Herzzyklus, der im EKG erfasst wird und in der Regel zwischen 120 und 200 Millisekunden dauert.

general_definition_en: A non-essential amino acid present abundantly throughout the body and is involved in many metabolic processes. It is synthesized from GLUTAMIC ACID and AMMONIA. It is the principal carrier of NITROGEN in the body and is an important energy source for many cells.
lay_definition_en: The electrical activity in the heart, which can be irregular after a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens, die nach einem Herzinfarkt unregelmäßig sein kann.

general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature atrial contractions or beats caused by signals originating from ectopic atrial sites. The ectopic signals may or may not conduct to the HEART VENTRICLES. Atrial premature complexes are characterized by premature P waves on ECG which are different in configuration from the P waves generated by the normal pacemaker complex in the SINOATRIAL NODE.
lay_definition_en: When your heart beats too fast, skipping the usual starting point.
lay_definition_de: Wenn dein Herz zu schnell schlägt und dabei den üblichen Startpunkt überspringt.

general_definition_en: V7
lay_definition_en: V7 is a specific mark on an ECG/EKG test results.
lay_definition_de: V7 ist eine bestimmte Markierung in den Ergebnissen einer EKG-Untersuchung.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic tracing demonstrating frequent premature atrial contractions that exceed an acceptable, predetermined threshold. Different thresholds may apply to different patient populations.
lay_definition_en: When the top part of your heart beats too soon.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der obere Teil Ihres Herzens zu früh schlägt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a rhythm which originates in the AV junction and results in a normal heart rate. It is characterized by retrograde P waves which may be obscured by or may follow the QRS complexes. The QRS complexes may be narrow or may demonstrate aberration. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A heartbeat that starts at the junction of the atria and ventricles rather than the usual SA node.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschlag, der nicht wie üblich am Sinusknoten, sondern an der Verbindungsstelle zwischen Vorhöfen und Herzkammern seinen Ursprung hat.

general_definition_en: A spectrum of pathological conditions of impaired blood flow in the brain. They can involve vessels (ARTERIES or VEINS) in the CEREBRUM, the CEREBELLUM, and the BRAIN STEM. Major categories include INTRACRANIAL ARTERIOVENOUS MALFORMATIONS; BRAIN ISCHEMIA; CEREBRAL HEMORRHAGE; and others.
lay_definition_en: A cerebrovascular event is when part of your brain doesn't get enough blood, which can harm brain tissue and lead to a stroke.
lay_definition_de: Ein zerebrovaskuläres Ereignis liegt vor, wenn ein Teil Ihres Gehirns nicht ausreichend durchblutet wird, was das Hirngewebe schädigen und zu einem Schlaganfall führen kann.

general_definition_en: The time it take to eject blood from the left ventricle. Measurement begins when the aortic valve opens and ends when the aortic valve closes.
lay_definition_en: How well the heart pumps blood as a diagnostic measure for heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Die Pumpfunktion des Herzens als diagnostisches Kriterium für Herzinsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: A tremor present when the limbs are active, either when outstretched in a certain position or throughout a voluntary movement. [HPO:curators]
lay_definition_en: An overactive thyroid causing symptoms like rapid heart rate and weight loss.
lay_definition_de: Eine Überfunktion der Schilddrüse, die Symptome wie Herzrasen und Gewichtsverlust verursacht.

lay_definition_en: The Q-Tc interval is an estimate of the heart's electrical cycle at a standard heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Das Q-Tc-Intervall ist ein Maß für den elektrischen Zyklus des Herzens bei einer Standardherzfrequenz.

general_definition_en: A non-essential amino acid present abundantly throughout the body and is involved in many metabolic processes. It is synthesized from GLUTAMIC ACID and AMMONIA. It is the principal carrier of NITROGEN in the body and is an important energy source for many cells.
lay_definition_en: Q is the heart's electrical activity, which can be irregular in a person who has had a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Q bezeichnet die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens, die bei einer Person, die einen Herzinfarkt erlitten hat, unregelmäßig sein kann.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: Abnormal blood flow in the heart that can cause complications, especially if severe.
lay_definition_de: Eine Durchblutungsstörung im Herzen, die zu Komplikationen führen kann, insbesondere wenn sie schwerwiegend ist.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where one of the heart valves doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der eine der Herzklappen nicht richtig schließt, wodurch das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt.

general_definition_en: ventricular irritability
lay_definition_en: The heart's ventricles are sending irregular electrical signals.
lay_definition_de: Die Herzkammern senden unregelmäßige elektrische Signale aus.

general_definition_en: ; The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: The aortic is a condition where the main artery leaving the heart becomes narrower.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Aortenstenose handelt es sich um eine Erkrankung, bei der sich die Hauptarterie, die vom Herzen ausgeht, verengt.

general_definition_en: / The pathologic narrowing of the orifice of the TRICUSPID VALVE. This hinders the emptying of RIGHT ATRIUM leading to elevated right atrial pressure and systemic venous congestion. Tricuspid valve stenosis is almost always due to RHEUMATIC FEVER.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where one of the heart valves narrows, impacting blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der sich eine der Herzklappen verengt, was den Blutfluss beeinträchtigt.

general_definition_en: An unusual congenital abnormality in which the aorta or aortic branches encircle the trachea and esophagus. Signs and symptoms include difficulty swallowing and eating, persistent cough, noisy breathing, and acid reflex.
lay_definition_en: When blood vessels are affected and cause congestion in the nose.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Blutgefäße betroffen sind und zu einer Verstopfung der Nase führen.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: When the mitral valve in your heart doesn't close properly, it lets blood leak backwards.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Mitralklappe in Ihrem Herzen nicht richtig schließt, fließt Blut zurück.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow back into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, wodurch Blut zurück ins Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: The time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the cardiac cycle.
lay_definition_en: A normal part of the heart's activity cycle.
lay_definition_de: Ein normaler Teil des Herzzyklus.

general_definition_en: A conduction block of the right branch of the bundle of His. This manifests as a prolongation of the QRS complex (greater than 0.12 s) with delayed activation of the right ventricle and terminal delay on the EKG. [DDD:dbrown, HPO:probinson]
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm disorder that involves a delayed electrical signal in the heart's right ventricle.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusstörung, bei der es zu einer Verzögerung des elektrischen Signals im rechten Ventrikel des Herzens kommt.

general_definition_en: The portion of the aorta that emerges from the left ventricle and precedes the aortic arch.
lay_definition_en: A rebuilt first part of the aorta using a new blood vessel.
lay_definition_de: Ein mit einem neuen Blutgefäß wiederhergestellter erster Abschnitt der Aorta.

general_definition_en: Hardening of the KIDNEY due to infiltration by fibrous connective tissue (FIBROSIS), usually caused by renovascular diseases or chronic HYPERTENSION. Nephrosclerosis leads to renal ISCHEMIA.
lay_definition_en: Kidney hardening often linked to high blood pressure and renal arteriole issues, can be either harmless or severe.
lay_definition_de: Eine Nierenverkalkung, die häufig mit Bluthochdruck und Problemen der Nierenarteriolen in Verbindung steht, kann entweder harmlos oder schwerwiegend sein.

general_definition_en: An autosomal disorder of the peripheral and autonomic nervous systems limited to individuals of Ashkenazic Jewish descent. Clinical manifestations are present at birth and include diminished lacrimation, defective thermoregulation, orthostatic hypotension (HYPOTENSION, ORTHOSTATIC), fixed pupils, excessive SWEATING, loss of pain and temperature sensation, and absent reflexes. Pathologic features include reduced numbers of small diameter peripheral nerve fibers and autonomic ganglion neurons. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p1348; Nat Genet 1993;4(2):160-4)
lay_definition_en: A condition where the body's automatic functions like heart rate and digestion are disrupted.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem die automatischen Körperfunktionen wie Herzfrequenz und Verdauung gestört sind.

general_definition_en: Islands in the Gulf of Guinea, just north of the Equator, and west of Gabon. -
lay_definition_en: An EKG signal indicating a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein EKG-Signal, das auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeutet.

general_definition_en: An enzyme that speeds up the formation of substances that cause inflammation and pain. It may also cause tumor cells to grow. Some tumors have high levels of COX-2 and blocking its activity may reduce tumor growth. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps reduce pain and inflammation in the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das Schmerzen und Entzündungen im Körper lindert.

general_definition_en: Excessive accumulation of cerebrospinal fluid within the cranium which may be associated with dilation of cerebral ventricles, INTRACRANIAL HYPERTENSION; HEADACHE; lethargy; URINARY INCONTINENCE; and ATAXIA.
lay_definition_en: When fluid builds up around the brain over time, but the pressure remains normal, it can affect brain function and potentially lead to brain damage.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich im Laufe der Zeit Flüssigkeit um das Gehirn herum ansammelt, der Druck jedoch normal bleibt, kann dies die Gehirnfunktion beeinträchtigen und möglicherweise zu Hirnschäden führen.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in the regulation of apoptosis.
lay_definition_en: A kind of medicine used to treat chest pain, control abnormal heart rhythms, and lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Brustschmerzen, zur Regulierung von Herzrhythmusstörungen und zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A nonspecific symptom of hearing disorder characterized by the sensation of buzzing, ringing, clicking, pulsations, and other noises in the ear. Objective tinnitus refers to noises generated from within the ear or adjacent structures that can be heard by other individuals. The term subjective tinnitus is used when the sound is audible only to the affected individual. Tinnitus may occur as a manifestation of COCHLEAR DISEASES; VESTIBULOCOCHLEAR NERVE DISEASES; INTRACRANIAL HYPERTENSION; CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA; and other conditions. , A device used to detect airborne odors, gases, flavors, volatile substances or vapors. , and A funnel-shaped fibromuscular tube that conducts food to the ESOPHAGUS, and air to the LARYNX and LUNGS. It is located posterior to the NASAL CAVITY; ORAL CAVITY; and LARYNX, and extends from the SKULL BASE to the inferior border of the CRICOID CARTILAGE anteriorly and to the inferior border of the C6 vertebra posteriorly. It is divided into the NASOPHARYNX; OROPHARYNX; and HYPOPHARYNX (laryngopharynx).
lay_definition_en: Specialists who focus on medical issues related to the ears, nose, and throat.
lay_definition_de: Fachärzte, die sich auf medizinische Probleme im Bereich Hals, Nase und Ohren spezialisiert haben.

general_definition_en: Extravasation of blood into the arterial wall following a tear in the intima and leading to separation of the layers of the wall.
lay_definition_en: Dissection is when there's a tear in an artery.
lay_definition_de: Von einer Dissektion spricht man, wenn eine Arterie gerissen ist.

general_definition_en: A syndrome in the elderly characterized by proximal joint and muscle pain, high erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and a self-limiting course. Pain is usually accompanied by evidence of an inflammatory reaction. Women are affected twice as commonly as men and Caucasians more frequently than other groups. The condition is frequently associated with GIANT CELL ARTERITIS and some theories pose the possibility that the two diseases arise from a single etiology or even that they are the same entity.
lay_definition_en: It's a system that uses electricity to control your heart rate and rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein System, das mithilfe von Strom Ihre Herzfrequenz und Ihren Herzrhythmus steuert.

general_definition_en: An abnormally rapid ventricular rhythm usually in excess of 150 beats per minute. It is generated within the ventricle below the BUNDLE OF HIS, either as autonomic impulse formation or reentrant impulse conduction. Depending on the etiology, onset of ventricular tachycardia can be paroxysmal (sudden) or nonparoxysmal, its wide QRS complexes can be uniform or polymorphic, and the ventricular beating may be independent of the atrial beating (AV dissociation).
lay_definition_en: An irregular heart rhythm caused by the lower chambers beating too fast.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzrhythmusstörung, die dadurch verursacht wird, dass die Herzkammern zu schnell schlagen.

general_definition_en: CARPENTIER - A genus of small, straight gram-negative rods which are facultatively anaerobic, chemoorganotrophic, and usually motile by peritrichous flagella. Members of this genus are usually found in the intestines of cold-blooded animals and in fresh water. They are pathogenic for eels, CATFISHES, and other animals and are rare opportunistic pathogens for humans. (From Bergey's Manual of Determinative Bacteriology, 9th ed) PHYSIO - Any doughnut-shaped device.
lay_definition_en: A tool for fixing a leaky heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Instrument zur Reparatur einer undichten Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A dihydropyridine calcium antagonist with positive inotropic effects. It lowers blood pressure by reducing peripheral vascular resistance through a highly selective action on smooth muscle in arteriolar resistance vessels.
lay_definition_en: It's a medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: brand name of an antibiotic A carbamate derivative used as an alcohol deterrent. It is a relatively nontoxic substance when administered alone, but markedly alters the intermediary metabolism of alcohol. When alcohol is ingested after administration of disulfiram, blood acetaldehyde concentrations are increased, followed by flushing, systemic vasodilation, respiratory difficulties, nausea, hypotension, and other symptoms (acetaldehyde syndrome). It acts by inhibiting aldehyde dehydrogenase.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to treat certain bacterial infections.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung bestimmter bakterieller Infektionen.

general_definition_en: procardia
lay_definition_en: Procardia is a medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Procardia ist ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck beiträgt.

general_definition_en: A local anesthetic and cardiac depressant used as an antiarrhythmia agent. Its actions are more intense and its effects more prolonged than those of PROCAINE but its duration of action is shorter than that of BUPIVACAINE or PRILOCAINE.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to fix irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament zur Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen.

lay_definition_en: A type of medication used to lower high blood pressure and treat certain heart conditions by relaxing the heart and blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung von Bluthochdruck und zur Behandlung bestimmter Herzerkrankungen eingesetzt wird, indem es das Herz und die Blutgefäße entspannt.

lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythms, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: catapres
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

lay_definition_de: Den Konsum salziger Lebensmittel reduzieren, um Bluthochdruck in den Griff zu bekommen.

lay_definition_de: Ein winziges Gerät, das bei Menschen mit langsamem Herzschlag dabei hilft, den Herzrhythmus zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: A cylindrical piece of tissue, such as that resulting from a core biopsy. plasmogen
lay_definition_en: An enzyme that helps break down blood clots in heart attack and stroke treatment.
lay_definition_de: Ein Enzym, das bei der Behandlung von Herzinfarkten und Schlaganfällen zur Auflösung von Blutgerinnseln beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Surgical therapy of ischemic coronary artery disease achieved by grafting a section of saphenous vein, internal mammary artery, or other substitute between the aorta and the obstructed coronary artery distal to the obstructive lesion. Graft
lay_definition_en: Surgery to create a detour around a clogged heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Operative Maßnahme zur Schaffung einer Umgehung einer verstopften Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: Soft sounds in your heart caused by blood flowing, which can sometimes signal health issues.
lay_definition_de: Leise Geräusche im Herzen, die durch den Blutfluss verursacht werden und manchmal auf gesundheitliche Probleme hindeuten können.

lay_definition_en: A medical code for atrial fibrillation.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Code für Vorhofflimmern.

general_definition_en: A salt that is comprised of a hydrogen and chloride ion that can be linked to a base form of a drug making it water-soluble. (NCI)
lay_definition_en: A medication for high blood pressure also known as Diovan or valsartan.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament gegen Bluthochdruck, auch bekannt als Diovan oder Valsartan.

general_definition_en: A subject domain utilized for the submission of information encompassing and representing data, vocabulary or records related to organ measurement.
lay_definition_en: It's a heart artery called "oblique marginal."
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Herzarterie, die als „oblique marginal“ bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: An ultrasonic examination of the fetus in the late first trimester to measure the clear space at the back of the fetal neck to assess risk of genetic or cardiac abnormalities. The removal of secretions, gas or fluid from hollow or tubular organs or cavities by means of a tube and a device that acts on negative pressure.
lay_definition_en: Removing phlegm from the windpipe by inserting a tube through the nose.
lay_definition_de: Entfernung von Schleim aus der Luftröhre durch Einführen eines Schlauchs durch die Nase.

general_definition_en: Functional KIDNEY FAILURE in patients with liver disease, usually LIVER CIRRHOSIS or portal hypertension (HYPERTENSION, PORTAL), and in the absence of intrinsic renal disease or kidney abnormality. It is characterized by intense renal vasculature constriction, reduced renal blood flow, OLIGURIA, and sodium retention.
lay_definition_en: When the kidneys stop working because the liver is severely damaged.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Nieren versagen, weil die Leber schwer geschädigt ist.

general_definition_en: A diet which contains very little sodium chloride. It is prescribed by some for hypertension and for edematous states. (Dorland, 27th ed)
lay_definition_en: Cutting back on how much salt you consume.
lay_definition_de: Die Salzaufnahme reduzieren.

general_definition_en: A type of fat that has certain chemical properties and is usually found in processed foods such as baked goods, snack foods, fried foods, shortening, margarine, and certain vegetable oils. Eating trans fat increases blood cholesterol levels and the risk of heart disease.
lay_definition_en: A bad type of fat found in processed foods that can be harmful to your health.
lay_definition_de: Eine ungesunde Art von Fett, die in verarbeiteten Lebensmitteln vorkommt und gesundheitsschädlich sein kann.

general_definition_en: A muscarinic antagonist used as an antispasmodic and in urinary incontinence. It has little effect on glandular secretion or the cardiovascular system. It does have some local anesthetic properties and is used in gastrointestinal, biliary, and urinary tract spasms.
lay_definition_en: Dicyclomine is a medicine that helps with digestive issues.
lay_definition_de: Dicyclomin ist ein Arzneimittel, das bei Verdauungsproblemen hilft.

general_definition_en: U waves
lay_definition_en: U waves are small waves on an EKG that show a certain type of heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: U-Wellen sind kleine Wellen im EKG, die eine bestimmte Art von Herzrhythmus anzeigen.

general_definition_en: The dimension of the physical universe which, at a given place, orders the sequence of events. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed) - An electrocardiographic finding of a small hump following the T wave occurring during the final phase of Purkinje repolarization.
lay_definition_en: The T-wave on an EKG shows when the heart's ventricles are recharging.
lay_definition_de: Die T-Welle im EKG zeigt an, wann sich die Herzkammern wieder mit Strom aufladen.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart. - An event or action that occurs successively after another. A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A device that helps control the heart rate by sending electrical signals to both the atria and ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, die Herzfrequenz zu regulieren, indem es elektrische Signale sowohl an die Vorhöfe als auch an die Herzkammern sendet.

general_definition_en: A data type comprised of a text string that can be displayed or machine processed.
lay_definition_en: ST refers to the readings on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: ST bezieht sich auf die Messwerte in einem EKG.

general_definition_en: Striated muscle cells found in the heart. They are derived from cardiac myoblasts (MYOBLASTS, CARDIAC).
lay_definition_en: A myocyte is a type of cell that has vitamin C or ascorbic acid.
lay_definition_de: Ein Myozyt ist eine Zellart, die Vitamin C bzw. Ascorbinsäure enthält.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving any of the various HEART VALVES and the associated structures (PAPILLARY MUSCLES and CHORDAE TENDINEAE).
lay_definition_en: When one or more heart valves are not functioning properly, it causes valvular heart disease as the valves regulate blood flow in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine oder mehrere Herzklappen nicht richtig funktionieren, kommt es zu einer Herzklappenerkrankung, da die Klappen den Blutfluss im Herzen regulieren.

general_definition_en: The significant impairment of gas exchange within the lungs resulting in hypoxia, hypercarbia, or both, to the extent that organ tissue perfusion is severely compromised. Causes include chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, emphysema, acute respiratory distress syndrome, pneumonia, pulmonary edema, pneumothorax, and congestive heart failure. general_definition_en: A type of cardiac arrhythmia with premature contractions of the HEART VENTRICLES. It is characterized by the premature QRS complex on ECG that is of abnormal shape and great duration (generally >129 msec). It is the most common form of all cardiac arrhythmias. Premature ventricular complexes have no clinical significance except in concurrence with heart diseases.
lay_definition_en: A premature heart beat not from the normal electrical system.
lay_definition_de: Ein vorzeitiger Herzschlag, der nicht vom normalen elektrischen Leitungssystem ausgeht.

general_definition_en: The study of the electrical activity and characteristics of the HEART; MYOCARDIUM; and CARDIOMYOCYTES.
lay_definition_en: Electrophysiological is about diagnosing and treating problems with heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: In der Elektrophysiologie geht es um die Diagnose und Behandlung von Herzrhythmusstörungen.

general_definition_en: Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help the heart by reducing heart rate and blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die das Herz entlasten, indem sie die Herzfrequenz und den Blutdruck senken.
