lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt, bei dem im Elektrokardiogramm keine bestimmten Veränderungen zu erkennen sind.

general_definition_en: aberrantly conductive complexes
lay_definition_en: Abnormal heart readings on an EKG test.
lay_definition_de: Auffällige Herzwerte bei einer EKG-Untersuchung.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in which there are variations in the shape, amplitude, or direction of the T wave from one beat to the next.
lay_definition_en: When your heart recharges on an EKG trace.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich Ihr Herz auf einer EKG-Kurve erholt.

general_definition_en: Shock resulting from diminution of cardiac output in heart disease.
lay_definition_en: When the heart can't pump enough blood due to a severe heart attack, it's called cardiogenic shock.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz aufgrund eines schweren Herzinfarkts nicht mehr genug Blut pumpen kann, spricht man von einem kardiogenen Schock.

general_definition_en: A nonspecific hypersensitivity reaction caused by TRAUMA to the PERICARDIUM, often following PERICARDIOTOMY. It is characterized by PERICARDIAL EFFUSION; high titers of anti-heart antibodies; low-grade FEVER; LETHARGY; loss of APPETITE; or ABDOMINAL PAIN.
lay_definition_en: After a heart surgery that involves cutting into the heart.
lay_definition_de: Nach einer Herzoperation, bei der ein Schnitt am Herzen vorgenommen wird.

general_definition_en: A condition characterized by recurring episodes of fluid leaking from capillaries into extra-vascular compartments causing hematocrit to rise precipitously. If not treated, generalized vascular leak can lead to generalized EDEMA; SHOCK; cardiovascular collapse; and MULTIPLE ORGAN FAILURE.
lay_definition_en: Life-saving steps for treating serious heart and brain emergencies.
lay_definition_de: Lebensrettende Maßnahmen zur Behandlung schwerwiegender Herz- und Hirnnotfälle.

general_definition_en: The volume of BLOOD passing through the HEART per unit of time. It is usually expressed as liters (volume) per minute so as not to be confused with STROKE VOLUME (volume per beat).
lay_definition_en: The amount of blood your heart pumps every minute.
lay_definition_de: Die Blutmenge, die Ihr Herz pro Minute pumpt.

general_definition_en: The measure of an individual's cardiac output as divided by their body surface area (CI= CO/BSA). This calculation is a useful function to determine an individual's cardiac performance in relation to their body size, providing an overview of global cardiovascular function.
lay_definition_en: A number that tells you how well your heart is doing.
lay_definition_de: Ein Wert, der Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie gut es Ihrem Herzen geht.

general_definition_en: Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: A sound heard during a heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Geräusch, das während eines Herzschlags zu hören ist.

general_definition_en: The hollow, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood.
lay_definition_en: A heart procedure that uses a thin tube inserted into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzverfahren, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Catheters inserted into various locations within the heart for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure involving inserting a thin tube into an artery to diagnose and treat heart conditions.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein dünner Schlauch in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Herzerkrankungen zu diagnostizieren und zu behandeln.

general_definition_en: Abnormally rapid heartbeat, usually with a HEART RATE above 100 beats per minute for adults. Tachycardia accompanied by disturbance in the cardiac depolarization (cardiac arrhythmia) is called tachyarrhythmia.
lay_definition_en: The rapid heartbeats in the lower chambers of the heart are called ventricular tachycardia.
lay_definition_de: Die schnellen Herzschläge in den unteren Herzkammern werden als ventrikuläre Tachykardie bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: This gene plays a role in extracellular signal transduction that is coupled to transcriptional responses. - Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help the heart beat slower and with less force.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die dazu beitragen, dass das Herz langsamer und mit geringerer Kraft schlägt.

general_definition_en: One of four chambers of the heart, which receives blood from the pulmonary veins and pumps blood through the mitral valve into the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: It's one of the sections of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Es ist einer der Bereiche des Herzens.

general_definition_en: TRICUSPID
lay_definition_en: One of the parts of a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil einer Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: A developmental abnormality in which the spiral (aortopulmonary) septum failed to completely divide the TRUNCUS ARTERIOSUS into ASCENDING AORTA and PULMONARY ARTERY. This abnormal communication between the two major vessels usually lies above their respective valves (AORTIC VALVE; PULMONARY VALVE).
lay_definition_en: Place in the chest where lymph nodes can be found.
lay_definition_de: An der Stelle im Brustkorb, an der sich Lymphknoten befinden.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall at the fourth intercostal space (between ribs 4 and 5) to the left of the sternal border. In small animals it corresponds to V2-V3 where it is placed at the 6th left intercostal space near the sternum. In large animals it is placed over the 6th rib at the level of the costochondral junction on the left side of the thorax.
lay_definition_en: The maxillary nerve is the second part of the trigeminal nerve.
lay_definition_de: Der Nervus maxillaris ist der zweite Ast des Nervus trigeminus.

general_definition_en: A surgical procedure in which the doctor creates a new pathway for the flow of body fluids.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to create a different blood flow path.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff zur Schaffung eines alternativen Blutflussweges.

general_definition_en: A febrile disease occurring as a delayed sequela of infections with STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES. It is characterized by multiple focal inflammatory lesions of the connective tissue structures, such as the heart, blood vessels, and joints (POLYARTHRITIS) and brain, and by the presence of ASCHOFF BODIES in the myocardium and skin.
lay_definition_en: A bacterial illness that causes fever and swelling in the heart, blood vessels, and joints.
lay_definition_de: Eine bakterielle Erkrankung, die Fieber und Schwellungen im Herzen, in den Blutgefäßen und in den Gelenken verursacht.

general_definition_en: A species of facultatively anaerobic, Gram negative, coccobacilli shaped bacteria assigned to the phylum Proteobacteria. This species is oxidase, urease and porphyrin positive, can grow in culture with V factor alone, and requires putrescines for growth in culture. H. parainfluenzae is a commensal organism of the oral cavity and pharynx but may become pathogenic in immunocompromised individuals or individuals with underlying disease, being a causative agent of endocarditis.
lay_definition_en: A type of bacteria that can lead to lung infections and infections around the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die zu Lungeninfektionen und Infektionen im Bereich des Gehirns führen kann.

general_definition_en: The tartrate salt form of brimonidine, an imidazole derivative and a selective alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonist. Upon ocular administration, brimonidine tartrate acts on the blood vessels causing them to constrict which leads to a decrease in the production of aqueous humor. Brimonidine tartrate also enhances the outflow of aqueous humor. This drug is used in the treatment of glaucoma to reduce intraocular pressure. a kind of chemical substance
lay_definition_en: A medication that can be used to treat facial redness or eye hypertension.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel, das zur Behandlung von Gesichtsrötungen oder erhöhtem Augeninnendruck eingesetzt werden kann.

general_definition_en: An ADENOMA of the ZONA GLOMERULOSA that produces ALDOSTERONE and HYPERALDOSTERONISM.
lay_definition_en: A hormonal issue where the adrenal gland produces too much aldosterone, causing high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Eine hormonelle Störung, bei der die Nebenniere zu viel Aldosteron produziert, was zu Bluthochdruck führt.

general_definition_en: The term refers to the treatment that was performed in the effort to cure the neoplastic disease before (prior) the current or being currently planned treatment regimen or given clinical event. Primary treatment is usually surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation therapy, or combination of some or all modalities listed above.
lay_definition_en: A medical condition causing high blood pressure due to excess aldosterone release from the adrenal gland.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die aufgrund einer übermäßigen Aldosteronausschüttung aus der Nebenniere zu Bluthochdruck führt.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by fluid collection within the pericardial sac, usually due to inflammation.
lay_definition_en: Fluid accumulation around the heart.
lay_definition_de: Flüssigkeitsansammlung um das Herz herum.

general_definition_en: The part of the brain that connects the CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES with the SPINAL CORD. It consists of the MESENCEPHALON; PONS; and MEDULLA OBLONGATA.
lay_definition_en: The part of the brain that controls basic bodily functions like breathing and heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Der Teil des Gehirns, der grundlegende Körperfunktionen wie Atmung und Herzfrequenz steuert.

general_definition_en: N-terminal fragment brain natriuretic protein (76 aa, ~9 kDa) is encoded by the human NPPB gene. This protein is a marker for cardiac failure.
lay_definition_en: BNP is a substance produced by the heart that indicates how well the heart is functioning.
lay_definition_de: BNP ist ein vom Herzen gebildeter Stoff, der Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie gut das Herz funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A localized bulging or dilatation in the muscle wall of a heart (MYOCARDIUM), usually in the LEFT VENTRICLE. Blood-filled aneurysms are dangerous because they may burst. Fibrous aneurysms interfere with the heart function through the loss of contractility. True aneurysm is bound by the vessel wall or cardiac wall. False aneurysms are HEMATOMA caused by myocardial rupture.
lay_definition_en: A bulge in a blood vessel that can rupture and cause serious internal bleeding.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ausbuchtung in einem Blutgefäß, die reißen und schwere innere Blutungen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: Radionuclide ventriculography where scintigraphic data is acquired during repeated cardiac cycles at specific times in the cycle, using an electrocardiographic synchronizer or gating device. Analysis of right ventricular function is difficult with this technique; that is best evaluated by first-pass ventriculography (VENTRICULOGRAPHY, FIRST-PASS).
lay_definition_en: A test that measures how much blood is in the heart at different times during each heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, mit dem gemessen wird, wie viel Blut sich zu verschiedenen Zeitpunkten während jedes Herzschlags im Herzen befindet.

general_definition_en: A genetically modified Salmonella bacterium that is injected into the tumor. It is being studied for its ability to shrink solid tumors.
lay_definition_en: A blood test that measures heart function, with higher levels indicating heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest zur Messung der Herzfunktion, wobei erhöhte Werte auf eine Herzinsuffizienz hinweisen.

general_definition_en: Electrical stimulation of the heart by artificial pacemaker leads placed at sites in the RIGHT ATRIUM and both HEART VENTRICLES to treat various cardiac conduction disturbances which interfere with the timing of contraction of the ventricles. Automatic, mechanical, and apparently undirected behavior which is outside of conscious control. IMPLANTABLE Cardiac electrical stimulators that apply brief high-voltage electroshocks to the HEART. These stimulators are used to restore normal rhythm and contractile function in hearts of patients who are experiencing VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION or ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) that is not accompanied by a palpable PULSE. Some defibrillators may also be used to correct certain noncritical dysrhythmias (called synchronized defibrillation or CARDIOVERSION), using relatively low-level discharges synchronized to the patient's ECG waveform. (UMDNS, 2003) -
lay_definition_en: A device in your body that can correct irregular heartbeats by delivering a mild shock.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät in Ihrem Körper, das Herzrhythmusstörungen durch einen leichten Stromstoß korrigieren kann.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Having two parts in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Zwei Teile im Herzen haben.

general_definition_en: A capillary hemangioma of the skin, presenting as a red papular lesion. - A disorder caused by hemizygous microdeletion of about 28 genes on chromosome 7q11.23, including the ELASTIN gene. Clinical manifestations include SUPRAVALVULAR AORTIC STENOSIS; MENTAL RETARDATION; elfin facies; impaired visuospatial constructive abilities; and transient HYPERCALCEMIA in infancy. The condition affects both sexes, with onset at birth or in early infancy.
lay_definition_en: A rare condition where lung cartilage does not develop properly.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Erkrankung, bei der sich der Lungenknorpel nicht richtig entwickelt.

general_definition_en: A congenital anomaly caused by the failed development of TRUNCUS ARTERIOSUS into separate AORTA and PULMONARY ARTERY. It is characterized by a single arterial trunk that forms the outlet for both HEART VENTRICLES and gives rise to the systemic, pulmonary, and coronary arteries. It is always accompanied by a ventricular septal defect.
lay_definition_en: A PTA is a procedure where a balloon is inflated inside a clogged artery to help blood flow better.
lay_definition_de: Eine PTA ist ein Verfahren, bei dem ein Ballon in einer verstopften Arterie aufgeblasen wird, um den Blutfluss zu verbessern.

general_definition_en: Beta naturetic
lay_definition_en: A blood test that checks heart function by measuring BNP levels.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest, bei dem die Herzfunktion anhand der BNP-Werte überprüft wird.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in cardiac homeostasis.
lay_definition_en: A blood test that checks how well the heart is functioning, with higher levels indicating congestive heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest, mit dem die Herzfunktion überprüft wird; erhöhte Werte deuten auf eine Herzinsuffizienz hin.

general_definition_en: A fibrous membrane that attaches to, and provides support for, the tricuspid valve leaflets.
lay_definition_en: A spot in the chest where the tricuspid valve sits in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Stelle im Brustkorb, an der sich die Trikuspidalklappe im Herzen befindet.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site at which the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall level with lead V5 at the left midaxillary line.
lay_definition_en: A bone in the neck.
lay_definition_de: Ein Knochen im Nacken.

general_definition_en: The continuation of the subclavian artery; it distributes over the upper limb, axilla, chest and shoulder.
lay_definition_en: An artery in your shoulder that provides blood to your arm and chest.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie in Ihrer Schulter, die Ihren Arm und Ihren Brustkorb mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker is a device that helps regulate the heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher ist ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, den Herzschlag zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: The blood vessel that supplies the breast and the anterior chest wall with arterial blood. It is located in the chest wall.
lay_definition_en: An artery in the chest that bypasses a blockage in a heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arterie im Brustkorb, die eine Verengung in einer Herzarterie umgeht.

general_definition_en: Diversion of the flow of blood from the entrance of the right atrium directly to the aorta (or femoral artery) via an oxygenator thus bypassing both the heart and lungs.
lay_definition_en: A medical procedure to create a new pathway for blood flow around a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein neuer Blutweg um eine verstopfte Arterie herum geschaffen wird.

general_definition_en: A study using radioisotope tagged blood components and a nuclear scanning machine to monitor the blood flow to the myocardium during or immediately following exercise.
lay_definition_en: A test to see how well your heart's blood flow is working.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, um festzustellen, wie gut die Durchblutung Ihres Herzens funktioniert.

general_definition_en: An essential amino acid that is required for the production of HISTAMINE. - Modified cardiac muscle fibers composing the terminal portion of the heart conduction system.
lay_definition_en: A condition affecting the heart's electrical signaling system.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die das elektrische Leitungssystem des Herzens betrifft.

general_definition_en: The vessels carrying blood away from the heart. Measurement of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the blood.
lay_definition_en: Testing oxygen and carbon dioxide levels in your arteries.
lay_definition_de: Messung des Sauerstoff- und Kohlendioxidgehalts in Ihren Arterien.

general_definition_en: MADIT Unexpected rapid natural death due to cardiovascular collapse within one hour of initial symptoms. It is usually caused by the worsening of existing heart diseases. The sudden onset of symptoms, such as CHEST PAIN and CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS, particularly VENTRICULAR TACHYCARDIA, can lead to the loss of consciousness and cardiac arrest followed by biological death. (from Braunwald's Heart Disease: A Textbook of Cardiovascular Medicine, 7th ed., 2005) - Unlawful act of taking property.
lay_definition_en: A research project that looked at whether a device correcting an irregular heart rhythm actually worked.
lay_definition_de: Ein Forschungsprojekt, in dem untersucht wurde, ob ein Gerät zur Korrektur eines unregelmäßigen Herzrhythmus tatsächlich funktionierte.

general_definition_en: Electrical stimulation of the heart by artificial pacemaker leads placed at sites in the RIGHT ATRIUM and both HEART VENTRICLES to treat various cardiac conduction disturbances which interfere with the timing of contraction of the ventricles.
lay_definition_en: A device that helps regulate and correct an irregular heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, einen unregelmäßigen Herzrhythmus zu regulieren und zu korrigieren.

lay_definition_en: A cluster of cells that regulates heart rate.

lay_definition_de: Durch eine unbehandelte Infektion verursachte Herzschädigung.

general_definition_en: A species of gram-positive, coccoid bacteria isolated from skin lesions, blood, inflammatory exudates, and the upper respiratory tract of humans. It is a group A hemolytic Streptococcus that can cause SCARLET FEVER and RHEUMATIC FEVER.
lay_definition_en: A type of bacteria that can lead to heart valve infections.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die zu Herzklappeninfektionen führen kann.

lay_definition_en: A heart artery located towards the front left side.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzarterie, die sich vorne links befindet.

general_definition_en: CIRCUNFLEX
lay_definition_en: A circunflex refers to a type of curved heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Circunflex bezeichnet eine Art gekrümmter Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: Restoration of blood supply to tissue which is ischemic due to decrease in normal blood supply. The decrease may result from any source including atherosclerotic obstruction, narrowing of the artery, or surgical clamping. It is primarily a procedure for treating infarction or other ischemia, by enabling viable ischemic tissue to recover, thus limiting further necrosis. However, it is thought that reperfusion can itself further damage the ischemic tissue, causing REPERFUSION INJURY.
lay_definition_en: Reperfusion is when blood flow returns back to a tissue or organ.
lay_definition_de: Von Reperfusion spricht man, wenn die Durchblutung eines Gewebes oder Organs wiederhergestellt wird.

general_definition_en: A recombinant version of the cardiac neurohormone, human B-type natriuretic peptide (hBNP) produced by the ventricular myocardium. Nesiritide binds to natriuretic peptide receptors on vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells, through which it triggers guanylate cyclase dependent signal transduction resulting in increase of intracellular concentrations of cGMP. This leads to smooth muscle cell relaxation causing arterial and venous dilatation.
lay_definition_en: A blood test that checks how well your heart is functioning by measuring the level of B-type natriuretic peptide.
lay_definition_de: Ein Bluttest, bei dem anhand des Spiegels des B-Typ-natriuretischen Peptids überprüft wird, wie gut Ihr Herz funktioniert.

lay_definition_en: Indicators of how well your body is functioning like blood pressure, heart rate, breathing rate and temperature.
lay_definition_de: Indikatoren dafür, wie gut Ihr Körper funktioniert, wie beispielsweise Blutdruck, Herzfrequenz, Atemfrequenz und Körpertemperatur.

lay_definition_en: Blood pressure is the pressure of blood on artery walls when the heart pumps.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck ist der Druck, den das Blut auf die Arterienwände ausübt, wenn das Herz pumpt.

lay_definition_en: Blood pressure is the push from the heart on your artery walls.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck ist der Druck, den das Herz auf die Arterienwände ausübt.

general_definition_en: Precordial pain at rest, which may precede a MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION. renal
lay_definition_en: A term that describes how well the kidneys are functioning.
lay_definition_de: Ein Begriff, der angibt, wie gut die Nieren funktionieren.

Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help slow down heart rate and lower blood pressure to assist the heart in pumping blood more efficiently.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die dazu beitragen, die Herzfrequenz zu verlangsamen und den Blutdruck zu senken, damit das Herz das Blut effizienter pumpen kann.

general_definition_en: A class of drugs that act by inhibition of sodium influx through cell membranes. Blockade of sodium channels slows the rate and amplitude of initial rapid depolarization, reduces cell excitability, and reduces conduction velocity.
lay_definition_en: Medications that help reduce high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Medikamente, die helfen, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart. This gene is involved in cytokine signaling and maturation.
lay_definition_en: Special cells in the heart that help regulate heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Spezielle Zellen im Herzen, die zur Regulierung des Herzschlags beitragen.

general_definition_en: A pathological constriction that can occur above (supravalvular stenosis), below (subvalvular stenosis), or at the AORTIC VALVE. It is characterized by restricted outflow from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the AORTA. Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. lay_definition_en: A murmur is the noise you can hear when the largest artery near the heart is narrowed.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzgeräusch ist das Geräusch, das man hört, wenn die größte Arterie in der Nähe des Herzens verengt ist.

general_definition_en: Nodal myocyte which consists of the transitional and purkinje myocytes of the atrioventricular node
lay_definition_en: Atrioventricular node: Special cells in the heart that regulate heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Atrioventrikulärer Knoten: Spezielle Zellen im Herzen, die die Herzfrequenz regulieren.

general_definition_en: An insulated electrical conductor designed to connect to an electrical device.
lay_definition_en: A lead is like a wire used for a pacemaker.
lay_definition_de: Eine Elektrode ist wie ein Draht, der bei einem Herzschrittmacher verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: The direct continuation of the brachial trunk, originating at the bifurcation of the brachial artery opposite the neck of the radius. Its branches may be divided into three groups corresponding to the three regions in which the vessel is situated, the forearm, wrist, and hand.
lay_definition_en: It's the big blood vessel in your arm that pumps blood to your hand and you can feel your pulse by touching it on your wrist.
lay_definition_de: Das ist die große Blutader in deinem Arm, die Blut in deine Hand pumpt, und du kannst deinen Puls fühlen, wenn du sie am Handgelenk berührst.

general_definition_en: The portion of the aorta that emerges from the left ventricle and precedes the aortic arch.
lay_definition_en: The starting point of the main artery connected to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der Ausgangspunkt der Hauptarterie, die mit dem Herzen verbunden ist.

general_definition_en: The muscle tissue of the HEART. It is composed of striated, involuntary muscle cells (MYOCYTES, CARDIAC) connected to form the contractile pump to generate blood flow.
lay_definition_en: Within the heart's muscle tissue.
lay_definition_de: Im Herzmuskelgewebe.

general_definition_en: In a place or position that is higher. - A disorder characterized by a dysrhythmia with a heart rate greater than 100 beats per minute that originates distal to the bundle of His.
lay_definition_en: A super-fast heart rate caused by upper heart chamber electrical malfunction.
lay_definition_de: Eine extrem schnelle Herzfrequenz, die durch eine elektrische Fehlfunktion der oberen Herzkammer verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: Atrial refers to a type of irregular heartbeat that can make you feel tired and increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Unter „Atrial“ versteht man eine Form von Herzrhythmusstörungen, die zu Müdigkeit führen und das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: A blood vessel in the heart which returns coronary blood to the right atrium. ARTERIES

general_definition_en: A methylxanthine naturally occurring in some beverages and also used as a pharmacological agent. Caffeine's most notable pharmacological effect is as a central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness and producing agitation. It also relaxes SMOOTH MUSCLE, stimulates CARDIAC MUSCLE, stimulates DIURESIS, and appears to be useful in the treatment of some types of headache. Several cellular actions of caffeine have been observed, but it is not entirely clear how each contributes to its pharmacological profile. Among the most important are inhibition of cyclic nucleotide PHOSPHODIESTERASES, antagonism of ADENOSINE RECEPTORS, and modulation of intracellular calcium handling.
lay_definition_en: A substance in tea and coffee that speeds up your heart and helps you stay awake.

Ephedra may cause high blood pressure, increased heart rate, or death if used with certain drugs, and may reduce the effects of certain drugs used to treat cancer and other diseases. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has banned the sale of dietary supplements that contain ephedra. The scientific name is Ephedra sinica.
