lay_definition_en: A sudden heart attack with unstable angina due to blocked blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzlicher Herzinfarkt mit instabiler Angina pectoris aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: Sudden brain damage caused by a lack of blood flow, resulting in loss of brain function.
lay_definition_de: Plötzliche Hirnschädigung aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung, die zu einem Verlust der Hirnfunktion führt.

general_definition_en: Life-threatening respiratory failure that develops rapidly. Causes include injury, sepsis, drug overdose, and pancreatitis. It manifests with dyspnea and cyanosis and may lead to cardiovascular shock.
lay_definition_en: When fluid collects in the lungs, making it harder to breathe and potentially fatal.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich Flüssigkeit in der Lunge ansammelt, erschwert dies das Atmen und kann lebensbedrohlich sein.

general_definition_en: Non-therapeutic positive end-expiratory pressure occurring frequently in patients with severe airway obstruction. It can appear with or without the administration of external positive end-expiratory pressure (POSITIVE-PRESSURE RESPIRATION). It presents an important load on the inspiratory muscles which are operating at a mechanical disadvantage due to hyperinflation. Auto-PEEP may cause profound hypotension that should be treated by intravascular volume expansion, increasing the time for expiration, and/or changing from assist mode to intermittent mandatory ventilation mode. (From Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 12th ed, p1127)
lay_definition_en: It's when air gets trapped in your lungs because you can't fully exhale, making it hard to breathe when using a ventilator.
lay_definition_de: Das tritt auf, wenn Luft in der Lunge eingeschlossen wird, weil man nicht vollständig ausatmen kann, was das Atmen bei der Verwendung eines Beatmungsgeräts erschwert.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by irritation to the layers of the pericardium (the protective sac around the heart).
lay_definition_en: Inflammation of the sac surrounding the heart that causes redness, pain, and swelling, typically lasting less than six weeks.
lay_definition_de: Entzündung des Herzbeutels, die zu Rötungen, Schmerzen und Schwellungen führt und in der Regel weniger als sechs Wochen andauert.

general_definition_en: A class of agents that act by selectively inhibiting angiotensin II receptor activation in the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system. Angiotensin II receptor antagonists bind to and block the activation of angiotensin II type 1 (AT1) receptors, thereby reducing production and secretion of aldosterone, amongst other actions. The combined effects result in reduction of blood pressure. Although this class of agents is also used in diabetic nephropathy (kidney damage due to diabetes) and congestive heart failure, it is primarily used for the treatment of hypertension in cases where the patient is intolerant of ACE inhibitor therapy.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps lower blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Senkung des Blutdrucks beiträgt.

general_definition_en: NON-Q-WAVE MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION
lay_definition_en: A non-Q-wave heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt ohne Q-Welle.

general_definition_en: Having a severe and rapid onset of symptoms with short duration. CORONARY SYNDROME
lay_definition_en: The sudden blockage of blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die plötzliche Unterbrechung der Blutversorgung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Controlled physical activity which is performed in order to allow assessment of physiological functions, particularly cardiovascular and pulmonary, but also aerobic capacity. Maximal (most intense) exercise is usually required but submaximal exercise is also used.
lay_definition_en: A test that shows how well blood flows into the heart during physical activity.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, die Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie gut das Blut während körperlicher Aktivität ins Herz fließt.

general_definition_en: Portal htn
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure in a vein that carries blood from the gut to the liver, commonly seen in liver diseases.
lay_definition_de: Erhöhter Blutdruck in einer Vene, die Blut vom Darm zur Leber transportiert; tritt häufig bei Lebererkrankungen auf.

general_definition_en: The main trunk of the systemic arteries.
lay_definition_en: Deals with the aorta, the body's main artery.
lay_definition_de: Befasst sich mit der Aorta, der Hauptarterie des Körpers.

general_definition_en: Human TMEM173 wild-type allele is located in the vicinity of 5q31.2 and is approximately 7 kb in length. This allele, which encodes stimulator of interferon genes protein, is involved in both signaling and immunity.
lay_definition_en: A heart valve problem where blood flows the wrong way due to it not closing properly.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappenfehlfunktion, bei der das Blut in die falsche Richtung fließt, weil die Klappe nicht richtig schließt.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL PERFUSION IMAGES
lay_definition_en: Images of the heart that help determine how well the heart muscle is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Aufnahmen des Herzens, anhand derer sich feststellen lässt, wie gut der Herzmuskel funktioniert.

general_definition_en: One of the minor protein components of skeletal and cardiac muscles. It functions as the calcium-binding component in a complex with BETA-TROPOMYOSIN; ACTIN; and MYOSIN and confers calcium sensitivity to the cross-linked actin and myosin filaments. Troponin itself is a complex of three regulatory proteins (TROPONIN C; TROPONIN I; and TROPONIN T).
lay_definition_en: Troponins are proteins that indicate muscle damage through blood tests.
lay_definition_de: Troponine sind Proteine, die mittels Blutuntersuchungen auf Muskelschäden hinweisen.

general_definition_en: An arterial segment arising from the abdominal aorta that supplies blood to the abdominal organs, other structures, genitalia and the lower limbs. The aortic branches include terminal branches called the common iliac arteries, the celiac artery, the superior mesenteric artery, the inferior mesenteric artery, the renal arteries, the suprarenal arteries, the testicular (internal spermatic) arteries, the ovarian arteries, the inferior phrenic arteries, lumbar arteries and the middle sacral artery.
lay_definition_en: The main artery in your belly that carries blood to your lower body.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptarterie in Ihrem Bauch, die Blut in Ihren Unterkörper transportiert.

general_definition_en: Of, or pertaining to, the liver and jugular vein.
lay_definition_en: Blood vessels in the neck can expand for various reasons, like heart disease - that's hepatojugular.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße im Hals können sich aus verschiedenen Gründen erweitern, beispielsweise aufgrund einer Herzerkrankung – das wird als hepatojuguläre Erweiterung bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: An arterial segment arising from the abdominal aorta that supplies blood to the abdominal organs, other structures, genitalia and the lower limbs. The aortic branches include terminal branches called the common iliac arteries, the celiac artery, the superior mesenteric artery, the inferior mesenteric artery, the renal arteries, the suprarenal arteries, the testicular (internal spermatic) arteries, the ovarian arteries, the inferior phrenic arteries, lumbar arteries and the middle sacral artery.
lay_definition_en: The big artery in your belly that carries blood to your belly and legs.
lay_definition_de: Die große Arterie in deinem Bauch, die Blut in deinen Bauch und deine Beine transportiert.

general_definition_en: This gene is involved in multiple signal transduction pathways. - Inflammation of the ENDOCARDIUM caused by BACTERIA that entered the bloodstream. The strains of bacteria vary with predisposing factors, such as CONGENITAL HEART DEFECTS; HEART VALVE DISEASES; HEART VALVE PROSTHESIS IMPLANTATION; or intravenous drug use.
lay_definition_en: An enzyme that can help study blood cells.
lay_definition_de: Ein Enzym, das bei der Untersuchung von Blutzellen helfen kann.

general_definition_en: A pathological constriction that can occur above (supravalvular stenosis), below (subvalvular stenosis), or at the AORTIC VALVE. It is characterized by restricted outflow from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the AORTA. Heart sounds caused by vibrations resulting from the flow of blood through the heart. Heart murmurs can be examined by HEART AUSCULTATION, and analyzed by their intensity (6 grades), duration, timing (systolic, diastolic, or continuous), location, transmission, and quality (musical, vibratory, blowing, etc).
lay_definition_en: A sound heard when there is narrowing in the largest artery near the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Geräusch, das zu hören ist, wenn es in der größten Arterie in der Nähe des Herzens zu einer Verengung kommt.

general_definition_en: transthroacic echo
lay_definition_en: A heart picture taken using ultrasound from outside the body.
lay_definition_de: Eine Ultraschallaufnahme des Herzens, die von außerhalb des Körpers aufgenommen wurde.

general_definition_en: A standard and widely accepted diagnostic test used to identify patients who have a vasodepressive and/or cardioinhibitory response as a cause of syncope. (From Braunwald, Heart Disease, 7th ed) - A piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs, or any object of a similar appearance.
lay_definition_en: A test where you lay on a table that tilts to see why you might have low blood pressure or fainting spells.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der Sie auf einem sich neigenden Tisch liegen, um festzustellen, warum Sie unter niedrigem Blutdruck oder Ohnmachtsanfällen leiden könnten.

general_definition_en: OM-3
lay_definition_en: A branch of a heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Ast einer Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: atrially paced
lay_definition_en: Atrially paced means the heart rhythm is controlled by a pacemaker with no natural atrial activity.
lay_definition_de: „Atrial stimuliert“ bedeutet, dass der Herzrhythmus durch einen Schrittmacher gesteuert wird und keine natürliche Vorhofaktivität vorliegt.

general_definition_en: pulmoanry
lay_definition_en: The pulmonary artery takes oxygen-poor blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Die Lungenarterie transportiert sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Having a heart rate that is slower than usual.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzfrequenz, die langsamer ist als gewöhnlich.

general_definition_en: The dilatation of the aortic wall behind each of the cusps of the aortic valve. neck
lay_definition_en: The aortic neck is a widened section of the aorta above an abdominal aortic aneurysm.
lay_definition_de: Der Aortenhals ist ein erweiterter Abschnitt der Aorta oberhalb eines Bauchaortenaneurysmas.

general_definition_en: A study using radioisotope tagged blood components and a nuclear scanning machine to monitor the blood flow to the myocardium during or immediately following exercise.
lay_definition_en: A test that checks how blood flows through the heart muscle during rest and activity using imaging.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe bildgebender Verfahren überprüft wird, wie das Blut im Herzmuskel in Ruhe und bei Belastung fließt.

general_definition_en: The area covering the terminal portion of ESOPHAGUS and the beginning of STOMACH at the cardiac orifice.
lay_definition_en: It's about the tube that links your mouth and stomach.
lay_definition_de: Es geht um den Schlauch, der deinen Mund mit deinem Magen verbindet.

general_definition_en: HRA
lay_definition_en: A reading location on an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Eine Messstelle am EKG.

general_definition_en: transpulmonary
lay_definition_en: Transpulmonary means related to blood pressure in the lung artery, which can show if there's a heart issue.
lay_definition_de: „Transpulmonal“ bezieht sich auf den Blutdruck in der Lungenarterie, der Aufschluss darüber geben kann, ob ein Herzproblem vorliegt.

general_definition_en: A congenital heart malformation characterised by incomplete separation of the truncus arteriosus and the aorticopulmonary trunk, resulting in communication between the aorta and pulmonary trunk.
lay_definition_en: A rare condition where an abnormal hole forms between two major arteries in the body, leading to high blood pressure in the lungs and potential heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Erkrankung, bei der sich zwischen zwei großen Arterien im Körper ein abnormales Loch bildet, was zu hohem Blutdruck in der Lunge und möglicherweise zu Herzversagen führt.

general_definition_en: cavotricuspid isthmus
lay_definition_en: The cavotricuspid isthmus is a section of the heart's right atrium.
lay_definition_de: Der cavotricuspidale Isthmus ist ein Abschnitt des rechten Vorhofs des Herzens.

general_definition_en: duodeca catheter
lay_definition_en: A type of catheter used to check heart problems like atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Katheter, der zur Untersuchung von Herzproblemen wie Vorhofflimmern und Vorhofflattern verwendet wird.

general_definition_en: A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A small tube inserted into a vein that goes into the chest and is used to deliver medication slowly over an extended period.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleiner Schlauch, der in eine Vene eingeführt wird, die bis in den Brustkorb reicht, und dazu dient, Medikamente über einen längeren Zeitraum hinweg langsam zu verabreichen.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb. pacemaker
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker placed under the collarbone.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzschrittmacher, der unter dem Schlüsselbein implantiert wurde.

general_definition_en: Removal of tissue with electrical current delivered via electrodes positioned at the distal end of a catheter. Energy sources are commonly direct current (DC-shock) or alternating current at radiofrequencies (usually 750 kHz). The technique is used most often to ablate the AV junction and/or accessory pathways in order to interrupt AV conduction and produce AV block in the treatment of various tachyarrhythmias.
lay_definition_en: A tool that makes small scars in the heart to stop abnormal electrical signals.
lay_definition_de: Ein Instrument, das kleine Narben im Herzen hinterlässt, um abnormale elektrische Signale zu unterbinden.

general_definition_en:
Deciduous mandibular left second molar tooth; Universal designation K; ISO designation 75

-
lay_definition_en: A surgical procedure to fix a leaky heart valve and address tricuspid regurgitation.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Korrektur einer undichten Herzklappe und zur Behandlung einer Trikuspidalklappeninsuffizienz.

general_definition_en: The time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave in the cardiac cycle as corrected with a non-specified correction formula.
lay_definition_en: QTC is a medical term describing a specific time interval seen on an echocardiogram.
lay_definition_de: QTC ist ein medizinischer Begriff, der ein bestimmtes Zeitintervall beschreibt, das im Echokardiogramm zu erkennen ist.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - Of or pertaining to the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: A non-Q wave myocardial infarction is a certain kind of heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Myokardinfarkt ohne Q-Welle ist eine bestimmte Art von Herzinfarkt.

general_definition_en: Pathological conditions involving the HEART including its structural and functional abnormalities.
lay_definition_en: A condition that changes the way your heart is built.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die den Aufbau Ihres Herzens verändert.

general_definition_en: Procedures using an electrically heated wire or scalpel to treat hemorrhage (e.g., bleeding ulcers) and to ablate tumors, mucosal lesions, and refractory arrhythmias. It is different from ELECTROSURGERY which is used more for cutting tissue than destroying and in which the patient is part of the electric circuit.
lay_definition_en: A process that uses electricity to burn and eliminate tissue.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren, bei dem Gewebe mithilfe von elektrischem Strom verödet und entfernt wird.

general_definition_en: The portion of the aorta following the aortic arch passing into the chest and abdomen creating the thoracic and abdominal segments.
lay_definition_en: Descending aortic: The area of the main artery as it travels through the chest.
lay_definition_de: Aorta descendens: Der Abschnitt der Hauptschlagader, der durch den Brustkorb verläuft.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: One of the main blood vessels that carries oxygen-poor blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Eines der wichtigsten Blutgefäße, das sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: A procedure of surgical placement of a catheter, which lumen is usually occupied by a trocar, into the central vein (internal jugular, subclavian, and femoral often used) or veins, to provide vascular access for measurement of hemodynamic variables that cannot be measured accurately by noninvasive means. It also can be used to deliver medications that were too potent or too toxic to be administered through peripheral access, for parenteral nutrition delivery; and for placing wires and pulmonary artery catheters. Central veins are usually cannulated percutaneously. The procedure is associated with many adverse events and has to be performed or supervised by an experienced physician.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure in the main veins returning blood to the heart, indicating how well the heart is functioning.
lay_definition_de: Der Blutdruck in den Hauptvenen, die das Blut zum Herzen zurückführen, gibt Aufschluss darüber, wie gut das Herz funktioniert.

general_definition_en: A species of facultatively anaerobic, Gram negative, coccobacilli shaped bacteria assigned to the phylum Proteobacteria. This species is oxidase, urease and porphyrin positive, can grow in culture with V factor alone, and requires putrescines for growth in culture. H. parainfluenzae is a commensal organism of the oral cavity and pharynx but may become pathogenic in immunocompromised individuals or individuals with underlying disease, being a causative agent of endocarditis.
lay_definition_en: A type of bacteria that can cause lung and brain infections.
lay_definition_de: Eine Bakterienart, die Infektionen der Lunge und des Gehirns verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: The curved section of the aorta between the ascending and the descending tracts. The brachiocephalic, left common carotid and left subclavian arteries branch from the aorta at this section.
lay_definition_en: Pictures of the aortic arch taken with X-ray technology.
lay_definition_de: Mit Röntgentechnik aufgenommene Bilder des Aortenbogens.

general_definition_en: MC3 ring
lay_definition_en: A medical device used to fix a heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medizinprodukt zur Reparatur einer Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: Developmental abnormalities in any portion of the VENTRICULAR SEPTUM resulting in abnormal communications between the two lower chambers of the heart. Classification of ventricular septal defects is based on location of the communication, such as perimembranous, inlet, outlet (infundibular), central muscular, marginal muscular, or apical muscular defect.
lay_definition_en: A VSD is a heart defect caused by an abnormal connection between the lower chambers of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein VSD ist ein Herzfehler, der durch eine abnormale Verbindung zwischen den unteren Herzkammern verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: This structure includes the thin muscular atrial septum between the two HEART ATRIA, and the thick muscular ventricular septum between the two HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: A wall inside the heart that divides the upper chambers and usually closes up after birth.
lay_definition_de: Eine Wand im Herzen, die die oberen Herzkammern voneinander trennt und sich in der Regel nach der Geburt schließt.

general_definition_en: The property of being measured and described using two orthogonal directions. Ultrasonic recording of the size, motion, and composition of the heart and surrounding tissues. The standard approach is transthoracic.
lay_definition_en: A heart imaging procedure using sound waves to create pictures without inserting anything into the body.
lay_definition_de: Ein Verfahren zur Bildgebung des Herzens, bei dem mithilfe von Schallwellen Bilder erzeugt werden, ohne dass etwas in den Körper eingeführt werden muss.

general_definition_en: Prucka
lay_definition_en: Prucka is a system for recording and analyzing heart electrical activity during an EKG.
lay_definition_de: Prucka ist ein System zur Aufzeichnung und Analyse der elektrischen Herzaktivität während eines EKGs.

general_definition_en: The dimension of the physical universe which, at a given place, orders the sequence of events. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed) - An electrocardiographic finding of the current of atrial contraction when they are depolarized. The initial portion of the P wave is largely a reflection of right atrial depolarization and the terminal portion reflects depolarization of the left atrium.
lay_definition_en: A change in the heart's electrical activity that can indicate potential heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Veränderung der elektrischen Aktivität des Herzens, die auf mögliche Herzprobleme hindeuten kann.

general_definition_en: narrow complex tachycardia
lay_definition_en: A fast heartbeat with a specific part being shorter than normal.
lay_definition_de: Ein schneller Herzschlag, bei dem ein bestimmter Abschnitt kürzer ist als normal.

general_definition_en: SEMS
lay_definition_en: Sound of blood flowing through a narrowed blood vessel or irregular heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Geräusch von Blut, das durch ein verengtes Blutgefäß oder eine unregelmäßige Herzklappe fließt.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart. An electrocardiographic finding in which the atrial rhythm is controlled by an electrical impulse from an artificial cardiac pacemaker. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: When the heart beats at regular intervals with the AV node controlling the pace.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz in regelmäßigen Abständen schlägt und der AV-Knoten den Rhythmus steuert.

general_definition_en: Enlargement of the RIGHT VENTRICLE of the heart. This increase in ventricular mass is often attributed to PULMONARY HYPERTENSION and is a contributor to cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
lay_definition_en: When the muscles around the right ventricle of the heart become too big, it can cause heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Wenn die Muskeln rund um die rechte Herzkammer zu stark anwachsen, kann dies zu Herzproblemen führen.

general_definition_en: Increase in size of the left atrium. []
lay_definition_en: When part of the heart is bigger than usual and can cause heart failure and stroke.
lay_definition_de: Wenn ein Teil des Herzens größer als normal ist und dies zu Herzinsuffizienz und Schlaganfall führen kann.

general_definition_en: The median time period between the recording of a Q wave on ECG and the onset of the aortic blood pressure pulse as determined over a number of cardiac cycles during a given interval of time.
lay_definition_en: A medication that helps with chest pain, heart rhythm abnormalities, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck hilft.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the RIGHT VENTRICLE into the RIGHT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the TRICUSPID VALVE.
lay_definition_en: When the tricuspid valve in the heart doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich die Trikuspidalklappe im Herzen nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung.

general_definition_en: IV
lay_definition_en: A medication used for chest pain, abnormal heart rhythms, and high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Brustschmerzen, Herzrhythmusstörungen und Bluthochdruck.

general_definition_en: A selective adrenergic beta-1 blocking agent that is commonly used to treat ANGINA PECTORIS; HYPERTENSION; and CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS.
lay_definition_en: A small dose of medicine.
lay_definition_de: Eine kleine Dosis Medizin.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by failure of the left ventricle to produce adequate output.
lay_definition_en: The heart's main chamber isn't working properly.
lay_definition_de: Die Hauptkammer des Herzens funktioniert nicht richtig.

ann_text_de_old: Klasse der New York Heart Association
ann_text_de: Klasse der New York Heart Association
general_definition_en: A finding associated with a patient with defined or presumed cardiac disease with inability to carry on any physical activity without discomfort. Symptoms are present even at rest or minimal exertion. (from The Criteria Committee of the New York Heart Association. Nomenclature and Criteria for Diagnosis of Diseases of the Heart and Great Vessels. 9th ed. Boston, Mass: Little, Brown & Co; 1994:253-256.) Class
lay_definition_en: A stage indicating moderate to severe heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Stadium, das auf eine mittelschwere bis schwere Herzinsuffizienz hinweist.

general_definition_en: A dosing unit equal to the amount of active ingredient(s) contained in one actuation of a pumping device. A class of drugs whose main indications are the treatment of hypertension and heart failure. They exert their hemodynamic effect mainly by inhibiting the renin-angiotensin system. They also modulate sympathetic nervous system activity and increase prostaglandin synthesis. They cause mainly vasodilation and mild natriuresis without affecting heart rate and contractility.
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps decrease the amount of acid in your stomach.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, die Säuremenge im Magen zu verringern.

general_definition_en: Revatio
lay_definition_en: Revatio is a medication for treating high blood pressure in the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Revatio ist ein Arzneimittel zur Behandlung von Bluthochdruck in der Lunge.

general_definition_en: The muscular structure separating the right and the left lower chambers (HEART VENTRICLES) of the heart. The ventricular septum consists of a very small membranous portion just beneath the AORTIC VALVE, and a large thick muscular portion consisting of three sections including the inlet septum, the trabecular septum, and the outlet septum.
lay_definition_en: The wall that divides the bottom parts of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Wand, die die unteren Teile des Herzens voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: The left main coronary artery (LMCA) is absent and the left anterior descending (LAD) and left circumflex (LCX) arteries arise from separate but adjacent ostia in the left sinus of Valsava. []
lay_definition_en: A significant blockage in the main blood vessel that provides blood to the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine erhebliche Verstopfung des Hauptblutgefäßes, das das Gehirn mit Blut versorgt.

lay_definition_en: A drug that helps fix irregular heartbeats and certain types of heart failure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das bei Herzrhythmusstörungen und bestimmten Formen der Herzinsuffizienz hilft.

general_definition_en: II
lay_definition_en: An EKG lead is a way to monitor the electrical activity of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine EKG-Ableitung dient dazu, die elektrische Aktivität des Herzens zu überwachen.

general_definition_en: Formation of an infarct, which is NECROSIS in tissue due to local ISCHEMIA resulting from obstruction of BLOOD CIRCULATION, most commonly by a THROMBUS or EMBOLUS.
lay_definition_en: A reinfarction is when there is a new occurrence of damaged tissue due to blocked blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Reinfarkt liegt vor, wenn aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung erneut Gewebeschäden auftreten.

general_definition_en: The condition of being elevated.
lay_definition_en: On a heart test, ST elevation shows something's wrong, which could mean a heart attack happening.
lay_definition_de: Bei einem Herz-EKG deutet eine ST-Hebung darauf hin, dass etwas nicht in Ordnung ist, was auf einen Herzinfarkt hindeuten könnte.

general_definition_en: An isoenzyme complex comprised of a heterodimer of creatine kinase M-type and B-type.
lay_definition_en: An enzyme that shows if someone had a heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Enzym, das anzeigt, ob jemand einen Herzinfarkt hatte.

general_definition_en: The accumulation of amyloid protein in the heart. Cardiac amyloidosis is irreversible and may lead to conductive dysfunction as well as heart failure secondary to restrictive cardiomyopathy.
lay_definition_en: A condition where protein plaques called amyloid accumulate in the heart muscle, making it harder for the heart to pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der sich sogenannte Amyloid-Plaques im Herzmuskel ansammeln, wodurch das Herz Schwierigkeiten hat, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: Inflammation of both the PERICARDIUM and the PLEURA.
lay_definition_en: It's something that involves both the lining of the lungs and the heart.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Erkrankung, die sowohl die Lungenauskleidung als auch das Herz betrifft.

general_definition_en: Blocking of a blood vessel by CHOLESTEROL-rich atheromatous deposits, generally occurring in the flow from a large artery to small arterial branches. It is also called arterial-arterial embolization or atheroembolism which may be spontaneous or iatrogenic. Patients with spontaneous atheroembolism often have painful, cyanotic digits of acute onset.
lay_definition_en: Atheromatous means having a waxy buildup inside your blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: „Atheromatös“ bedeutet, dass sich in den Blutgefäßen wachsartige Ablagerungen bilden.

general_definition_en: The curved section of the aorta between the ascending and the descending tracts. The brachiocephalic, left common carotid and left subclavian arteries branch from the aorta at this section.
lay_definition_en: The part of the aorta above the heart that curves between the ascending and descending aorta.
lay_definition_de: Der Abschnitt der Aorta oberhalb des Herzens, der sich zwischen der aufsteigenden und der absteigenden Aorta krümmt.

general_definition_en: Supramaximal stress test
lay_definition_en: A test to see how much energy your body can make without relying on oxygen, like a quick and intense sprint.
lay_definition_de: Ein Test, um festzustellen, wie viel Energie Ihr Körper ohne Sauerstoffzufuhr produzieren kann, beispielsweise bei einem kurzen, intensiven Sprint.

general_definition_en: The presence of an aortic valve with one instead of the normal three cusps (flaps). [HPO:probinson, PMID:18480095, PMID:20329493]
lay_definition_en: The bicuspid aortic valve has only two flaps instead of three in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die bicuspide Aortenklappe hat nur zwei Klappensegel statt der üblichen drei im Herzen.

general_definition_en: A form of CARDIAC MUSCLE disease, characterized by left and/or right ventricular hypertrophy (HYPERTROPHY, LEFT VENTRICULAR; HYPERTROPHY, RIGHT VENTRICULAR), frequent asymmetrical involvement of the HEART SEPTUM, and normal or reduced left ventricular volume. Risk factors include HYPERTENSION; AORTIC STENOSIS; and gene MUTATION; (FAMILIAL HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY).
lay_definition_en: When the heart muscle gets thicker than it should be, it's called hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, which can often be managed and allow for a normal life.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Herzmuskel dicker wird, als er sein sollte, spricht man von einer hypertrophen obstruktiven Kardiomyopathie, die oft gut behandelt werden kann und ein normales Leben ermöglicht.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the right ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: Blood pressure caused by the right side of the heart.
lay_definition_de: Blutdruck, der durch die rechte Herzhälfte verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: Radiographic visualization of the aorta and its branches by injection of contrast media, using percutaneous puncture or catheterization procedures.
lay_definition_en: Looking at the aorta using ultrasound or MRI.
lay_definition_de: Untersuchung der Aorta mittels Ultraschall oder MRT.

general_definition_en: cont
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps reduce excess fluid in the body often seen in conditions like heart failure and kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, wie sie häufig bei Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz und Nierenerkrankungen auftritt.

general_definition_en: lasix
lay_definition_en: A medication made from foxglove leaves used for certain heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ein Arzneimittel aus Fingerhutblättern, das bei bestimmten Herzproblemen eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: will
lay_definition_en: A drug that helps to lessen excess fluid in the body caused by conditions like heart failure, liver disease, or kidney disease.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dabei hilft, überschüssige Flüssigkeit im Körper abzubauen, die durch Erkrankungen wie Herzinsuffizienz, Leber- oder Nierenerkrankungen verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: airway
lay_definition_en: A pacemaker wire placed into the airway.
lay_definition_de: Ein in die Atemwege eingeführter Schrittmacher-Draht.

general_definition_en: Albumin protein in urine samples, which is a marker for kidney dysfunction. Persistently elevated concentrations of albumin in the urine can be diagnostic for kidney damage caused by diabetes, high blood pressure, heart failure, cirrhosis, or lupus.
lay_definition_en: Blood protein leaking due to swelling causing albuminemia.
lay_definition_de: Durch Schwellungen bedingter Austritt von Blutproteinen, der zu einer Albuminämie führt.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive method that uses a CT scanner for capturing images of blood vessels and tissues. A CONTRAST MATERIAL is injected, which helps produce detailed images that aid in diagnosing VASCULAR DISEASES.
lay_definition_en: A test that uses imaging to capture pictures of the blood vessels in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Untersuchung, bei der mithilfe bildgebender Verfahren Aufnahmen der Blutgefäße im Gehirn erstellt werden.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION in which the anterior wall of the heart is involved. Anterior wall myocardial infarction is often caused by occlusion of the left anterior descending coronary artery. It can be categorized as anteroseptal or anterolateral wall myocardial infarction. COMMUNICATING ARTERY
lay_definition_en: A brain blood vessel linking left and right anterior cerebral arteries.
lay_definition_de: Ein Hirngefäß, das die linke und die rechte vordere Hirnarterie miteinander verbindet.

general_definition_en: Provision of diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders affecting the heart
lay_definition_en: Heart doctor.
lay_definition_de: Herzspezialist.

general_definition_en: insufficient blood supply to a body part
lay_definition_en: Ischemic means when the heart muscle becomes weak and pumps less blood due to coronary artery disease.
lay_definition_de: „Ischämisch“ bedeutet, dass der Herzmuskel aufgrund einer koronaren Herzkrankheit geschwächt ist und weniger Blut pumpt.

general_definition_en: Glioma derived from EPENDYMOGLIAL CELLS that tend to present as malignant intracranial tumors in children and as benign intraspinal neoplasms in adults. It may arise from any level of the ventricular system or central canal of the spinal cord. Intracranial ependymomas most frequently originate in the FOURTH VENTRICLE and histologically are densely cellular tumors which may contain ependymal tubules and perivascular pseudorosettes. Spinal ependymomas are usually benign papillary or myxopapillary tumors. (From DeVita et al., Principles and Practice of Oncology, 5th ed, p2018; Escourolle et al., Manual of Basic Neuropathology, 2nd ed, pp28-9)
lay_definition_en: A type of brain tumor that starts in cells lining spaces in the spinal cord and brain.
lay_definition_de: Eine Art von Hirntumor, der in den Zellen entsteht, die die Hohlräume im Rückenmark und im Gehirn auskleiden.

general_definition_en: Of or relating to a ventricle (of the heart or brain).
lay_definition_en: Bleeding in the brain between ventricles.
lay_definition_de: Blutung im Gehirn zwischen den Ventrikeln.

general_definition_en: An expandable hollow tube that is advanced into an obstructed or narrow coronary artery to restore blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_en: A medical process where a tube is inserted into a heart artery to remove a blockage.
lay_definition_de: Ein medizinischer Eingriff, bei dem ein Katheter in eine Herzarterie eingeführt wird, um eine Verstopfung zu beseitigen.

general_definition_en: Excision of the apical portion of a tooth through an opening made in the overlying labial, buccal, or palatal alveolar bone. (Dorland, 28th ed)
lay_definition_en: Root is a surgery that fixes the aortic section near the heart.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Root-Operation wird der Abschnitt der Aorta in der Nähe des Herzens repariert.

general_definition_en: One of two equal parts; a quantity corresponding to one half of the whole. - arch shaped bony structure of the foot
lay_definition_en: Hemi-arch is heart surgery that replaces part of the aortic arch without replacing the arch vessels.
lay_definition_de: Bei einer Hemi-Bogen-Operation wird ein Teil des Aortenbogens ersetzt, ohne die Bogengefäße zu ersetzen.

general_definition_en: The opening of the left coronary artery at its origin.
lay_definition_en: A major heart artery.
lay_definition_de: Eine wichtige Herzarterie.

general_definition_en: Three individuals derived from three FETUSES that were fertilized at or about the same time, developed in the UTERUS simultaneously, and born to the same mother. - Any of the tubular vessels conveying the blood (arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, and veins).
lay_definition_en: A severe type of heart disease where the three main blood vessels supplying the heart are blocked.
lay_definition_de: Eine schwere Form der Herzerkrankung, bei der die drei Hauptblutgefäße, die das Herz versorgen, verstopft sind.

general_definition_en: To travel upward. None
lay_definition_en: The ascending aorta is the part of an artery that goes up.
lay_definition_de: Die aufsteigende Aorta ist der Teil einer Arterie, der nach oben verläuft.

general_definition_en:
Dual purpose. Defined purposes based on species and breed

- Organ chamber which consists of a wall that surrounds the cavity of a cardiac atrium or ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A device that uses two leads in the heart to imitate the normal heart's action.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das mithilfe von zwei Elektroden im Herzen die normale Herzfunktion nachahmt.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: Keeping an eye on someone for a period to see how they are doing.
lay_definition_de: Jemanden über einen bestimmten Zeitraum hinweg im Auge behalten, um zu sehen, wie es ihm geht.

general_definition_en: Implantable devices which continuously monitor the electrical activity of the heart and automatically detect and terminate ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) and VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. They consist of an impulse generator, batteries, and electrodes.
lay_definition_en: A defibrillator is a tool that corrects irregular heartbeats.
lay_definition_de: Ein Defibrillator ist ein Gerät, das Herzrhythmusstörungen behebt.

general_definition_en: A non-invasive test usually done during the third trimester to check for fetal well being. It is performed using an external fetal heart rate monitor to assess the fetal heart rate response to fetal movements.
lay_definition_en: Testing how well your heart works when it's under pressure from working out or medication.
lay_definition_de: Untersuchung der Herzfunktion unter Belastung, beispielsweise durch sportliche Betätigung oder die Einnahme von Medikamenten.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - A disorder characterized by gross necrosis of the myocardium; this is due to an interruption of blood supply to the area.
lay_definition_en: A heart attack that is not caused by a blocked artery.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt, der nicht durch eine verstopfte Arterie verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: The hollow, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood.
lay_definition_en: When the heart tissue is harmed due to a lack of oxygen from blocked blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herzgewebe durch Sauerstoffmangel infolge einer Durchblutungsstörung geschädigt wird.

general_definition_en: The portion of the descending aorta proceeding from the arch of the aorta and extending to the DIAPHRAGM, eventually connecting to the ABDOMINAL AORTA.
lay_definition_en: The descending thoracic aortic is the part of the main blood vessel that runs down through the chest.
lay_definition_de: Die absteigende Brustaorta ist der Abschnitt des Hauptblutgefäßes, der durch den Brustkorb nach unten verläuft.

general_definition_en: Agents used for the treatment or prevention of cardiac arrhythmias. They may affect the polarization-repolarization phase of the action potential, its excitability or refractoriness, or impulse conduction or membrane responsiveness within cardiac fibers. Anti-arrhythmia agents are often classed into four main groups according to their mechanism of action: sodium channel blockade, beta-adrenergic blockade, repolarization prolongation, or calcium channel blockade.
lay_definition_en: Antiarrhythmic - a medication that helps maintain a normal heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Antiarrhythmikum – ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, einen normalen Herzrhythmus aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: Cessation of breathing and/or cardiac function.
lay_definition_en: Related to the functioning of the heart and lungs.
lay_definition_de: Im Zusammenhang mit der Funktion von Herz und Lunge.

general_definition_en: Hypertensive
lay_definition_en: Having high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Unter Bluthochdruck leiden.

general_definition_en: The curved section of the aorta between the ascending and the descending tracts. The brachiocephalic, left common carotid and left subclavian arteries branch from the aorta at this section.
lay_definition_en: Check the health of the aorta.
lay_definition_de: Überprüfen Sie den Zustand der Aorta.

general_definition_en: hemiarch
lay_definition_en: A heart surgery that replaces part of the aortic arch but not the vessels connected to it.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzoperation, bei der ein Teil des Aortenbogens ersetzt wird, nicht jedoch die daran angeschlossenen Gefäße.

general_definition_en: hemiarch replacement
lay_definition_en: A heart valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe.

general_definition_en: The direct continuation of the brachial trunk, originating at the bifurcation of the brachial artery opposite the neck of the radius. Its branches may be divided into three groups corresponding to the three regions in which the vessel is situated, the forearm, wrist, and hand. ARTERY
lay_definition_en: The radial artery is the main blood vessel in your forearm that carries blood to your hand, and you can feel your pulse there.
lay_definition_de: Die Radialarterie ist das wichtigste Blutgefäß im Unterarm, das die Hand mit Blut versorgt, und dort kann man den Puls fühlen.

general_definition_en: A condition represents a patient's diagnosed and self-reported health conditions and diseases. The patient's medical history and current state may both be represented. - A unit of electric current, one of the seven base units of the International System of Units (Systeme International d'Unites, SI). It is that constant current which, if maintained in two straight parallel conductors of infinite length and zero diameter separated by one meter in a vacuum, would produce between these conductors a force equal to 2x10E7 newton per meter of length. This is dependent upon the definitions of the meter, kilogram, and second. One ampere represents 6.24 x 10E18 unit electric charge carriers, such as electrons, passing a specified fixed point in one second.
lay_definition_en: The patient's heart has stopped in a condition of cardiac arrest.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz des Patienten hat im Zustand eines Herzstillstands aufgehört zu schlagen.

general_definition_en: A gas which liquefies at 1.013 bar at a temperature below -150 degrees C.
lay_definition_en: A condition where the heart can't pump enough blood due to a severe heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem das Herz aufgrund eines schweren Herzinfarkts nicht mehr genug Blut pumpen kann.

ann_text_de_old: Ersatz der Aortenklappe durch eine Gewebeklappe
general_definition_en: A valve made of animal tissues or harvested from human cadavers and used to replace the aortic valve in patients with aortic valve stenosis or regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to swap out a damaged heart valve with a new one made of tissue from humans, cows, or pigs.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff, bei dem eine beschädigte Herzklappe durch eine neue ersetzt wird, die aus menschlichem, Rinder- oder Schweinegewebe hergestellt wurde.

general_definition_en: Surgical excision (total or partial) of a portion of the pericardium. Pericardiotomy refers to incision of the pericardium.
lay_definition_en: Removing all or part of the membrane surrounding the heart.
lay_definition_de: Entfernung der das Herz umgebenden Membran, entweder vollständig oder teilweise.

general_definition_en: A mechanical pump which also includes a control system and an energy supply. It receives blood from the left ventricle and delivers it to the aorta, thus helping the heart to pump sufficient blood to the body. A surgical procedure that places something in the human body.
lay_definition_en: A device that helps pump blood in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, das Blut im Herzen zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: An operation in which a term denies or inverts the meaning of another term or construction. - ischemic cardiomyopathy
lay_definition_en: Heart not working well, not due to a heart attack or blockages.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz funktioniert nicht richtig, was jedoch nicht auf einen Herzinfarkt oder Verstopfungen zurückzuführen ist.

general_definition_en: Surgery performed with the purpose of replacing a degenerated, calcified, malformed, dysfunctional, etc. mitral valve with bioprosthetic, homograft or autograft valve.
lay_definition_en: Heart surgery that replaces a dysfunctional valve in the heart to regulate blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzoperation, bei der eine defekte Herzklappe ersetzt wird, um den Blutfluss zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: Abnormally rapid heartbeat, usually with a HEART RATE above 100 beats per minute for adults. Tachycardia accompanied by disturbance in the cardiac depolarization (cardiac arrhythmia) is called tachyarrhythmia. - Cardiac arrhythmias that are characterized by excessively slow HEART RATE, usually below 50 beats per minute in human adults. They can be classified broadly into SINOATRIAL NODE dysfunction and ATRIOVENTRICULAR BLOCK. syndrome
lay_definition_en: A condition where the heart alternates between beating too fast and too slow, commonly found in people with atrial fibrillation.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zustand, bei dem das Herz abwechselnd zu schnell und zu langsam schlägt; dies tritt häufig bei Menschen mit Vorhofflimmern auf.

general_definition_en: Provision of diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders affecting the heart
lay_definition_en: Doctors who specialize in treating heart problems.
lay_definition_de: Ärzte, die sich auf die Behandlung von Herzproblemen spezialisiert haben.

general_definition_en: The study of the heart, its physiology, and its functions.
lay_definition_en: Specialized medical care for heart issues.
lay_definition_de: Fachärztliche Versorgung bei Herzproblemen.

general_definition_en: insufficient blood supply to a body part CARDIOMYOPATHY
lay_definition_en: When your heart muscle gets weak and can't pump as much blood due to narrowing of the arteries.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herzmuskel schwächer wird und aufgrund einer Verengung der Arterien nicht mehr so viel Blut pumpen kann.

general_definition_en: The study of the electrical activity and characteristics of the HEART; MYOCARDIUM; and CARDIOMYOCYTES. STUDY
lay_definition_en: A heart rhythm study.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzrhythmusuntersuchung.

general_definition_en: A small nodular mass of specialized muscle fibers located in the interatrial septum near the opening of the coronary sinus. It gives rise to the atrioventricular bundle of the conduction system of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A cluster of cells that helps regulate heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Ein Zellcluster, das zur Regulierung des Herzrhythmus beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Electrical stimulation of the heart by artificial pacemaker leads placed at sites in the RIGHT ATRIUM and both HEART VENTRICLES to treat various cardiac conduction disturbances which interfere with the timing of contraction of the ventricles. IMPLANTABLE Cardiac electrical stimulators that apply brief high-voltage electroshocks to the HEART. These stimulators are used to restore normal rhythm and contractile function in hearts of patients who are experiencing VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION or ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) that is not accompanied by a palpable PULSE. Some defibrillators may also be used to correct certain noncritical dysrhythmias (called synchronized defibrillation or CARDIOVERSION), using relatively low-level discharges synchronized to the patient's ECG waveform. (UMDNS, 2003) - Implantable devices which continuously monitor the electrical activity of the heart and automatically detect and terminate ventricular tachycardia (TACHYCARDIA, VENTRICULAR) and VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION. They consist of an impulse generator, batteries, and electrodes.
lay_definition_en: A device inserted into the body to correct irregular heart rhythms with electric shocks.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das in den Körper eingesetzt wird, um Herzrhythmusstörungen durch elektrische Impulse zu korrigieren.

general_definition_en: Of or pertaining to the myocardium.
lay_definition_en: A bruise on the heart muscle caused by various traumatic events like car accidents or CPR.
lay_definition_de: Eine Prellung des Herzmuskels, die durch verschiedene traumatische Ereignisse wie Autounfälle oder eine Herz-Lungen-Wiederbelebung verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: A combination of two synthetic agents with central nervous system stimulant activity. Both agents are non-catecholamine, sympathomimetic agents that elevate blood pressure and cause bronchodilation. These agents are commonly abused psychostimulant drugs that induce psychologic dependence manifested by elevated mood, increased wakefulness, concentration, physical performance and a feeling of well-being. Tolerance to various effects develops unequally, so that tachycardia and enhanced alertness diminish while psychotoxic effects (hallucinations and delusions) may occur. (NCI04)
lay_definition_en: Amphetamines are drugs that make you stay awake, suppress your appetite, and feel happy.
lay_definition_de: Amphetamine sind Drogen, die einen wach halten, den Appetit zügeln und ein Glücksgefühl hervorrufen.

general_definition_en: ICD-9-CM
lay_definition_en: A condition that impacts a person's ability to move effectively.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, die die Fähigkeit einer Person beeinträchtigt, sich effektiv zu bewegen.

general_definition_en: Period of contraction of the HEART, especially of the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: Related to the area under the armpit where lymph nodes are found.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich auf den Bereich unter der Achselhöhle, in dem sich Lymphknoten befinden.

general_definition_en: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: The baseline pressure in the arteries during the heart's resting phase.
lay_definition_de: Der Grunddruck in den Arterien während der Ruhephase des Herzens.

general_definition_en: b - Drugs that bind to but do not activate beta-adrenergic receptors thereby blocking the actions of beta-adrenergic agonists. Adrenergic beta-antagonists are used for treatment of hypertension, cardiac arrhythmias, angina pectoris, glaucoma, migraine headaches, and anxiety.
lay_definition_en: Medication that helps lower high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das hilft, hohen Blutdruck zu senken.

general_definition_en: A group of pathological conditions characterized by sudden, non-convulsive loss of neurological function due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA or INTRACRANIAL HEMORRHAGES. Stroke is classified by the type of tissue NECROSIS, such as the anatomic location, vasculature involved, etiology, age of the affected individual, and hemorrhagic vs. non-hemorrhagic nature. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp777-810)
lay_definition_en: A stroke is when blood flow to part of the brain is interrupted, causing damage.
lay_definition_de: Ein Schlaganfall liegt vor, wenn die Blutversorgung eines Teils des Gehirns unterbrochen wird, was zu Schäden führt.

general_definition_en: Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle beating irregularly.
lay_definition_de: Der Herzmuskel schlägt unregelmäßig.

general_definition_en: Anomalous origin of one pulmonary artery from the ascending aorta with the contralateral pulmonary artery arising from the right ventricle. [DDD:dbrown, PMID:2590592]
lay_definition_en: A rare heart condition where only one blood vessel emerges from both ventricles instead of the usual two.
lay_definition_de: Eine seltene Herzerkrankung, bei der aus beiden Herzkammern nur ein Blutgefäß austritt statt der üblichen zwei.

general_definition_en: Narrowing of the passage through the MITRAL VALVE due to FIBROSIS, and CALCINOSIS in the leaflets and chordal areas. This elevates the left atrial pressure which, in turn, raises pulmonary venous and capillary pressure leading to bouts of DYSPNEA and TACHYCARDIA during physical exertion. RHEUMATIC FEVER is its primary cause.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where one of the valves becomes narrow due to blockage.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der sich eine der Herzklappen aufgrund einer Verengung verengt.

general_definition_en: The small mass of modified cardiac muscle fibers located at the junction of the superior vena cava (VENA CAVA, SUPERIOR) and right atrium. Contraction impulses probably start in this node, spread over the atrium (HEART ATRIUM) and are then transmitted by the atrioventricular bundle (BUNDLE OF HIS) to the ventricle (HEART VENTRICLE).
lay_definition_en: A small group of heart cells that regulate heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine kleine Gruppe von Herzzellen, die die Herzfrequenz regulieren.

general_definition_en: A condition that is characterized by the presence of generalized edema. Causes include congestive heart failure, liver failure, renal failure, and severe malnutrition.
lay_definition_en: Anasarca means extreme swelling usually caused by different health issues.
lay_definition_de: Anasarka bezeichnet eine extreme Schwellung, die in der Regel durch verschiedene gesundheitliche Probleme verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic recording in which one or more leads display extraneous signals which do not represent cardiac electrical activity. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Artifactual means something that appears in a test result but isn't actually present, possibly leading to inaccurate interpretations.
lay_definition_de: „Artefakt“ bezeichnet etwas, das in einem Testergebnis auftaucht, aber tatsächlich nicht vorhanden ist, was möglicherweise zu ungenauen Interpretationen führen kann.

general_definition_en: Treatment that combines chemotherapy with radiation therapy. Chemoradiation can be concurrent or sequential.
lay_definition_en: A treatment that uses a pacemaker to help the heart maintain a proper rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Eine Behandlung, bei der ein Herzschrittmacher eingesetzt wird, um dem Herzen zu helfen, einen regelmäßigen Rhythmus aufrechtzuerhalten.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic recording in which one or more leads display extraneous signals which do not represent cardiac electrical activity. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: Artifacts: Things that mess up a test by showing something that's not actually there.
lay_definition_de: Artefakte: Phänomene, die einen Test verfälschen, indem sie etwas anzeigen, das eigentlich gar nicht vorhanden ist.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by an increase in intrapericardial pressure due to the collection of blood or fluid in the pericardium.
lay_definition_en: A buildup of fluid around the heart that squeezes it.
lay_definition_de: Eine Flüssigkeitsansammlung um das Herz herum, die Druck auf das Herz ausübt.

general_definition_en: A valve situated at the entrance to the pulmonary trunk from the right ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A valve in the heart that helps regulate blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzklappe, die zur Regulierung des Blutflusses beiträgt.

general_definition_en: Deposition of calcium into the blood vessel structures. Excessive calcification of the vessels are associated with ATHEROSCLEROTIC PLAQUES formation particularly after MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION (see MONCKEBERG MEDIAL CALCIFIC SCLEROSIS) and chronic kidney diseases which in turn increase VASCULAR STIFFNESS.
lay_definition_en: Buildup of hard minerals in blood vessels, often a sign of atherosclerosis.
lay_definition_de: Ablagerung von harten Mineralien in den Blutgefäßen, häufig ein Anzeichen für Arteriosklerose.

general_definition_en: microvascular ischemia
lay_definition_en: Changes in small blood vessels in the brain that can harm white matter.
lay_definition_de: Veränderungen in den kleinen Blutgefäßen des Gehirns, die die weiße Substanz schädigen können.

general_definition_en: Softening or loss of brain tissue following CEREBRAL INFARCTION; cerebral ischemia (see BRAIN ISCHEMIA), infection, CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA, or other injury. The term is often used during gross pathologic inspection to describe blurred cortical margins and decreased consistency of brain tissue following infarction. Multicystic encephalomalacia refers to the formation of multiple cystic cavities of various sizes in the cerebral cortex of neonates and infants following injury, most notably perinatal hypoxia-ischemic events. (From Davis et al., Textbook of Neuropathology, 2nd ed, p665; J Neuropathol Exp Neurol, 1995 Mar;54(2):268-75)
lay_definition_en: Brain tissue that has turned soft due to bleeding or disease.
lay_definition_de: Gehirngewebe, das aufgrund einer Blutung oder einer Erkrankung weich geworden ist.

lay_definition_en: The patient's heart has stopped beating, and they are in cardiac arrest.
lay_definition_de: Das Herz des Patienten hat aufgehört zu schlagen, und er befindet sich im Herzstillstand.

lay_definition_de: Das Perikard ist die Schutzhülle um das Herz.

general_definition_en: Blood pressure within AORTA

lay_definition_de: Die Kraft, mit der das Blut gegen die Wände der Hauptarterie im Körper drückt.

Not all affected individuals display all of these problems.
lay_definition_en: A chronic condition where the immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own tissues.
lay_definition_de: Eine chronische Erkrankung, bei der das Immunsystem fälschlicherweise das körpereigene Gewebe angreift.

lay_definition_de: „Verkalkung“ bedeutet, dass sich in den Herzarterien verhärtete Fettablagerungen ansammeln, die zu Herzerkrankungen führen können.

general_definition_en: arteriial

lay_definition_de: Arterie – ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen wegtransportiert.

general_definition_en: sino - Shaped like a tube; of or pertaining to a tubule.
lay_definition_en: A ridge of cartilage between the heart and aorta.
lay_definition_de: Ein Knorpelwulst zwischen Herz und Aorta.

lay_definition_en: A specific look from a kidney ultrasound.
lay_definition_de: Ein typisches Befundbild bei einer Nierenultraschalluntersuchung.

general_definition_en: Artery arising from the brachiocephalic trunk on the right side and from the arch of the aorta on the left side. It distributes to the neck, thoracic wall, spinal cord, brain, meninges, and upper limb. The vessels carrying blood away from the CAPILLARY BEDS.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel in charge of transporting blood from body tissues to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Die Subklaviavenen sind Blutgefäße, die Blut aus dem Körpergewebe zum Herzen transportieren.

lay_definition_de: Die Vena subclavia sind Blutgefäße, die Blut aus dem Körpergewebe zum Herzen transportieren.

general_definition_en: The curve formed by the row of TEETH in their normal position in the JAW. The inferior dental arch is formed by the mandibular teeth, and the superior dental arch by the maxillary teeth.
lay_definition_en: The arched portion of the aorta above the heart.
lay_definition_de: Der bogenförmige Abschnitt der Aorta oberhalb des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The area covering the terminal portion of ESOPHAGUS and the beginning of STOMACH at the cardiac orifice. mucosal junction
lay_definition_en: Where the food pipe meets the stomach.
lay_definition_de: Dort, wo die Speiseröhre in den Magen mündet.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed on the anterior chest wall at the fourth intercostal space (between ribs 4 and 5) to the left of the sternal border. In small animals it corresponds to V2-V3 where it is placed at the 6th left intercostal space near the sternum. In large animals it is placed over the 6th rib at the level of the costochondral junction on the left side of the thorax. - 3
lay_definition_en: A specific spot in your neck where your spine is located.
lay_definition_de: Eine bestimmte Stelle im Nacken, an der sich die Wirbelsäule befindet.

general_definition_en: Solutions which, upon administration, will temporarily arrest cardiac activity. They are used in the performance of heart surgery.
lay_definition_en: A special liquid that stops and shields the heart during surgery.
lay_definition_de: Eine spezielle Flüssigkeit, die das Herz während einer Operation stilllegt und schützt.

general_definition_en: An artery arising from the axillary artery that supplies the mammary gland and chest muscles.
lay_definition_en: Arteries in the chest used for heart bypass surgery.
lay_definition_de: Arterien im Brustbereich, die für Herzbypass-Operationen verwendet werden.

general_definition_en: A diagnostic technique that incorporates the measurement of molecular diffusion (such as water or metabolites) for tissue assessment by MRI. The degree of molecular movement can be measured by changes of apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) with time, as reflected by tissue microstructure. Diffusion MRI has been used to study BRAIN ISCHEMIA and tumor response to treatment.
lay_definition_en: Diffusion weighted imaging: An imaging method that provides detailed images of the inside of the body.
lay_definition_de: Diffusionsgewichtete Bildgebung: Ein bildgebendes Verfahren, das detaillierte Aufnahmen des Körperinneren liefert.

general_definition_en: The arterial blood vessels supplying the CEREBRUM. watershed
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that supplies blood to the brain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das das Gehirn mit Blut versorgt.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding in leads V1 or V2 of an initial R wave duration greater than or equal to 40 ms, R wave greater than S wave, and upright T wave, which is suggestive of myocardial infarction of the posterior wall of the left ventricle. Evidence of inferior or lateral myocardial infarction is usually also present. (CDISC) Acute renal failure with resolution of manifestations. [HPO:probinson] ENCEPHALOPATHY SYNDROME
lay_definition_en: A sudden collection of symptoms like seizures and headaches caused by brain swelling often linked with high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Ein plötzliches Auftreten von Symptomen wie Krampfanfällen und Kopfschmerzen, die durch eine Hirnschwellung verursacht werden und häufig mit Bluthochdruck in Verbindung stehen.

general_definition_en: The short wide vessel arising from the conus arteriosus of the right ventricle and conveying unaerated blood to the lungs.
lay_definition_en: Blood tubes that carry oxygen-low blood from the heart to the lungs.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffarmes Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportieren.

general_definition_en: The time period between dawn and noon. - A saline solution used to force an agent from tubing and peripheral veins into the central blood volume. A hollow tube with a balloon or sail tip that is advanced into the pulmonary artery to measure right heart pressure and cardiac output, and enable mixed venous blood sampling.
lay_definition_en: A slim tube that goes into an artery to take x-rays of it.
lay_definition_de: Ein dünner Schlauch, der in eine Arterie eingeführt wird, um Röntgenaufnahmen davon zu machen.

general_definition_en: A Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). In such case, blood cannot be effectively pumped into the lower chambers of the heart (HEART VENTRICLES). It is caused by abnormal impulse generation.
lay_definition_en: A-Fib is when your heart rhythm goes wonky and it can make you tired or increase the risk of strokes.
lay_definition_de: Bei Vorhofflimmern kommt es zu Unregelmäßigkeiten im Herzrhythmus, was zu Müdigkeit führen oder das Schlaganfallrisiko erhöhen kann.

general_definition_en: A form of computed tomography (CT) in which images are taken during three distinct timing points (phases) following the injection of contrast material: arterial, venous, and delayed. This form of CT imaging is most commonly used to image hepatic lesions. Doppler
lay_definition_en: Using ultrasound to take pictures of the heart and blood vessels and measure blood flow without inserting anything into the body.
lay_definition_de: Mithilfe von Ultraschall werden Bilder vom Herzen und den Blutgefäßen aufgenommen und der Blutfluss gemessen, ohne dass etwas in den Körper eingeführt werden muss.

general_definition_en: The pathologic narrowing of the orifice of the PULMONARY VALVE. This lesion restricts blood outflow from the RIGHT VENTRICLE to the PULMONARY ARTERY. When the trileaflet valve is fused into an imperforate membrane, the blockage is complete.
lay_definition_en: A heart condition where the valve between the heart and lungs is narrow, making blood flow sluggish.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, bei der die Klappe zwischen Herz und Lunge verengt ist, wodurch der Blutfluss verlangsamt wird.

general_definition_en: An opening located in the septum primum that allows blood to flow directly between the right and left atrium, and which serves as a precursor to the interatrial septum.
lay_definition_en: A part of the heart that opens between two chambers.
lay_definition_de: Ein Teil des Herzens, der sich zwischen zwei Kammern öffnet.

general_definition_en: Developmental abnormalities in any portion of the ATRIAL SEPTUM resulting in abnormal communications between the two upper chambers of the heart. Classification of atrial septal defects is based on location of the communication and types of incomplete fusion of atrial septa with the ENDOCARDIAL CUSHIONS in the fetal heart. They include ostium primum, ostium secundum, sinus venosus, and coronary sinus defects.
lay_definition_en: A tiny gap in the heart tissue that separates the top chambers.
lay_definition_de: Eine winzige Öffnung im Herzgewebe, die die oberen Herzkammern voneinander trennt.

general_definition_en: CAVOATRIAL
lay_definition_en: A cavoatrial is where the superior vena cava connects to the right atrium in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Als Cavoatrial bezeichnet man die Stelle, an der die obere Hohlvene mit dem rechten Vorhof des Herzens verbunden ist.

general_definition_en: An expandable hollow tube that is advanced into an obstructed or narrow coronary artery to restore blood flow to the heart.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to create new pathways for blood flow to the heart when the regular arteries are blocked.
lay_definition_de: Operativer Eingriff zur Schaffung neuer Blutbahnen zum Herzen, wenn die normalen Arterien verstopft sind.

general_definition_en: To cease by degrees; decrease; diminish. - A device designed to facilitate the movement of a fluid.
lay_definition_en: A technique for coronary bypasses that doesn't require a heart-lung machine.
lay_definition_de: Eine Technik für Koronarbypässe, bei der keine Herz-Lungen-Maschine erforderlich ist.

general_definition_en: obtuse
lay_definition_en: An obtuse is a major artery in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Eine Arteria obtusa ist eine Hauptarterie des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Imaging plane with the transducer at the left sternal border oriented along the short axis of the left ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A heart image showing both lower chambers.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzdarstellung, auf der beide Herzkammern zu sehen sind.

general_definition_en: A vascular anomaly that is a collection of tortuous BLOOD VESSELS and connective tissue. This tumor-like mass with the large vascular space is filled with blood and usually appears as a strawberry-like lesion in the subcutaneous areas of the face, extremities, or other regions of the body including the central nervous system. Branch of the common carotid artery which supplies the anterior part of the brain, the eye and its appendages, the forehead and nose.
lay_definition_en: Part of the carotid artery that goes through a specific area in the brain.
lay_definition_de: Ein Abschnitt der Halsschlagader, der durch einen bestimmten Bereich des Gehirns verläuft.

general_definition_en: An extra-anatomic method of surgical revascularization in which the AXILLARY ARTERY is anastomosed to FEMORAL ARTERY.
lay_definition_en: A surgery to improve blood flow to the legs, feet, and toes.
lay_definition_de: Ein chirurgischer Eingriff zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung der Beine, Füße und Zehen.

general_definition_en: The continuation of the subclavian artery; it distributes over the upper limb, axilla, chest and shoulder. - BIFEMORAL ARTERIAL
lay_definition_en: Surgery to improve blood flow to the legs, feet, and toes.
lay_definition_de: Operative Eingriffe zur Verbesserung der Durchblutung der Beine, Füße und Zehen.

general_definition_en: A device that substitutes for a heart valve. It may be composed of biological material (BIOPROSTHESIS) and/or synthetic material.
lay_definition_en: A prosthetic mitral valve is an artificial heart implant used to replace a malfunctioning natural valve.
lay_definition_de: Eine Mitralklappenprothese ist ein künstliches Herzimplantat, das zum Ersatz einer nicht mehr ordnungsgemäß funktionierenden natürlichen Herzklappe eingesetzt wird.

general_definition_en: The lower right and left chambers of the heart. The right ventricle pumps venous BLOOD into the LUNGS and the left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood into the systemic arterial circulation.
lay_definition_en: Thickening and enlargement of the heart's main pumping chamber.
lay_definition_de: Verdickung und Vergrößerung der Hauptpumpkammer des Herzens.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: When a heart valve doesn't close properly, causing blood to flow in the wrong direction.
lay_definition_de: Wenn eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, fließt das Blut in die falsche Richtung.

general_definition_en: An abnormal direct communication between an artery and a vein without passing through the CAPILLARIES. An A-V fistula usually leads to the formation of a dilated sac-like connection, arteriovenous aneurysm. The locations and size of the shunts determine the degree of effects on the cardiovascular functions such as BLOOD PRESSURE and HEART RATE.
lay_definition_en: It's a link between an artery and a vein.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Verbindung zwischen einer Arterie und einer Vene.

general_definition_en: A blood group related both to the ABO and P systems that includes several different antigens found in most people on erythrocytes, in milk, and in saliva. The antibodies react only at low temperatures. /
lay_definition_en: A soft heart murmur is when there is a gentle sound heard in the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein leises Herzgeräusch liegt vor, wenn ein sanftes Geräusch im Herzen zu hören ist.

general_definition_en: A unipolar electrocardiogram lead site; the electrode is placed at the fourth intercostal space on the anterior chest wall (between ribs 4 and 5) to the right of the sternal border. In small animals, it is placed at the right fifth intercostal space near the sternum. -
lay_definition_en: The first two bones in your neck.
lay_definition_de: Die ersten beiden Halswirbel.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of a tachycardia which does not originate in the ventricles or His Purkinje system. There is an abnormally high heart rate and QRS complexes are typically narrow, but aberration or preexcitation may be present. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A type of quick abnormal heartbeat.
lay_definition_de: Eine Form von schnellem Herzrhythmusstörung.

general_definition_en: The left ventricular volume calculated as the difference between the epicardium delimited volume and the left ventricular chamber volume.
lay_definition_en: When the heart squeezes and pumps blood into the arteries.
lay_definition_de: Wenn das Herz sich zusammenzieht und Blut in die Arterien pumpt.

general_definition_en: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
lay_definition_en: The top number in a blood pressure reading that shows how hard the heart is working.
lay_definition_de: Der obere Wert bei einer Blutdruckmessung, der angibt, wie stark das Herz arbeitet.

general_definition_en: Used with organs and diseases for disordered function in disease states.
lay_definition_en: A measure of how effectively the heart pumps blood, used to diagnose heart failure, with a normal range of 50-70 percent.
lay_definition_de: Ein Maß dafür, wie effektiv das Herz Blut pumpt; dient zur Diagnose einer Herzinsuffizienz, wobei der Normalbereich bei 50–70 Prozent liegt.

general_definition_en: The movement and the forces involved in the movement of the blood through the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.
lay_definition_en: Refers to how blood moves through the body.
lay_definition_de: Bezieht sich darauf, wie sich das Blut durch den Körper bewegt.

general_definition_en: MYOCARDIAL SARCOIDOSIS
lay_definition_en: It's a condition that affects the heart muscles.
lay_definition_de: Es handelt sich um eine Erkrankung, die die Herzmuskulatur betrifft.

general_definition_en: A group of diseases in which the dominant feature is the involvement of the CARDIAC MUSCLE itself. Cardiomyopathies are classified according to their predominant pathophysiological features (DILATED CARDIOMYOPATHY; HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY; RESTRICTIVE CARDIOMYOPATHY) or their etiological/pathological factors (CARDIOMYOPATHY, ALCOHOLIC; ENDOCARDIAL FIBROELASTOSIS).
lay_definition_en: Heart muscle disease that makes it difficult for the heart to pump blood.
lay_definition_de: Eine Herzerkrankung, die es dem Herzen erschwert, Blut zu pumpen.

general_definition_en: HEPATIC CONGESTION
lay_definition_en: When the liver gets clogged up with blood due to heart failure, it can lead to liver damage known as cirrhosis.
lay_definition_de: Wenn sich aufgrund einer Herzinsuffizienz Blut in der Leber staut, kann dies zu einer Leberschädigung führen, die als Leberzirrhose bezeichnet wird.

general_definition_en: A fibrous membrane that attaches to, and provides support for, the tricuspid valve leaflets. Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
