lay_definition_en: A problem where a heart valve doesn't close correctly, allowing blood to flow backward.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erkrankung, bei der eine Herzklappe nicht richtig schließt, sodass Blut zurückfließen kann.

general_definition_en: An acute or subacute reversible condition characterized by headaches, mental status changes, visual disturbances, and seizures associated with imaging findings of posterior leukoencephalopathy. It has been observed in association with hypertensive encephalopathy, eclampsia, and immunosuppressive and cytotoxic drug treatment.
lay_definition_en: Ictal Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome (PRES) is a condition marked by a sudden grouping of symptoms like seizures and headaches caused by brain swelling and commonly linked to high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: Das iktale reversible Enzephalopathie-Syndrom (PRES) ist eine Erkrankung, die durch ein plötzliches Auftreten einer Reihe von Symptomen wie Krampfanfälle und Kopfschmerzen gekennzeichnet ist, die durch eine Schwellung des Gehirns verursacht werden und häufig mit Bluthochdruck in Verbindung stehen.

general_definition_en: Hyeprtensive
lay_definition_en: Hypertensive means having high blood pressure.
lay_definition_de: „Hypertensiv“ bedeutet, hohen Blutdruck zu haben.

general_definition_en: Tumor that forms in the center of the adrenal gland (gland located above the kidney) that causes it to make too much adrenaline. Pheochromocytomas are usually benign (not cancer) but can cause high blood pressure, pounding headaches, heart palpitations, flushing of the face, nausea, and vomiting.
lay_definition_en: A tumor that grows in the adrenal gland, located above the kidney.
lay_definition_de: Ein Tumor, der in der Nebenniere wächst, die oberhalb der Niere liegt.

general_definition_en: A usually autosomal dominant and less frequently autosomal recessive genetic disorder characterized by the presence of numerous cysts in the kidneys leading to end-stage renal failure. The autosomal dominant trait is associated with abnormalities on the short arm of chromosome 16. Symptoms in patients with the autosomal dominant trait usually appear at middle age and include abdominal pain, hematuria, and high blood pressure. Patients may develop brain aneurysms and liver cysts. Patients with the autosomal recessive trait present with progressive renal failure early in life and symptoms resulting from hepatic fibrosis. The autosomal recessive trait is associated with abnormalities of chromosome 6. Polycystic kidney disease may also result as a side effect in patients on renal dialysis.
lay_definition_en: A genetic disease causing fluid-filled sacs to form in the kidneys, leading to kidney damage and serious health issues.
lay_definition_de: Eine Erbkrankheit, bei der sich in den Nieren mit Flüssigkeit gefüllte Bläschen bilden, was zu Nierenschäden und schwerwiegenden gesundheitlichen Problemen führt.

general_definition_en: A bipolar electrocardiogram limb lead which records the voltage between the positive electrode near the apex of the heart (located in the ICS of left 5-6 rib close to the sternum) and the negative electrode behind the right ear near the right mastoid process. (CDISC)
lay_definition_en: A picture of the body seen from the side.
lay_definition_de: Eine seitliche Ansicht des Körpers.

general_definition_en: Branch of right coronary artery which runs over the anterior part of conus arteriosus and supplies the pulmonary conus and the upper part of right ventricle.
lay_definition_en: The conus is the bottom part of the spinal cord.
lay_definition_de: Der Conus ist der unterste Teil des Rückenmarks.

general_definition_en: The vessels carrying blood away from the heart. Used for arterial, capillary, and venous systems of an organ or region whenever the specific heading for the vessel does not exist. It includes blood flow through the organ.
lay_definition_en: Blood vessels that transport oxygen-rich blood throughout the body.
lay_definition_de: Blutgefäße, die sauerstoffreiches Blut durch den Körper transportieren.

general_definition_en: A combination of congenital heart defects consisting of four key features including VENTRICULAR SEPTAL DEFECTS; PULMONARY STENOSIS; RIGHT VENTRICULAR HYPERTROPHY; and a dextro-positioned AORTA. In this condition, blood from both ventricles (oxygen-rich and oxygen-poor) is pumped into the body often causing CYANOSIS.
lay_definition_en: A rare and complex heart defect known as Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF).
lay_definition_de: Ein seltener und komplexer Herzfehler, der als Fallot-Tetralogie (TOF) bekannt ist.

general_definition_en: A disorder characterized by a pathological increase in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: Severe high blood pressure that can cause harm to your organs if not treated.
lay_definition_de: Schwerer Bluthochdruck, der unbehandelt zu Organschäden führen kann.

general_definition_en: A proteolytic enzyme in the serine protease family found in many tissues which converts PLASMINOGEN to FIBRINOLYSIN. It has fibrin-binding activity and is immunologically different from UROKINASE-TYPE PLASMINOGEN ACTIVATOR. The primary sequence, composed of 527 amino acids, is identical in both the naturally occurring and synthetic proteases.
lay_definition_en: A medication used to dissolve blood clots in people who have had a stroke or heart attack.
lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das zur Auflösung von Blutgerinnseln bei Patienten eingesetzt wird, die einen Schlaganfall oder einen Herzinfarkt erlitten haben.

general_definition_en: A sharp, high-pitched click heart sound that indicates heart valve disease
lay_definition_en: A bone fragment near the hip joint that can be painful.
lay_definition_de: Ein Knochenfragment in der Nähe des Hüftgelenks, das Schmerzen verursachen kann.

general_definition_en: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.
lay_definition_en: When the heart muscle takes a break and gets ready for the next round of pumping blood.
lay_definition_de: Wenn der Herzmuskel eine Pause einlegt und sich auf den nächsten Blutpumpzyklus vorbereitet.

general_definition_en: A bipolar electrocardiogram limb lead which records the voltage between the positive electrode near the apex of the heart (located in the ICS of left 5-6 rib close to the sternum) and the negative electrode behind the right ear near the right mastoid process. (CDISC) and A gland duct that drains secretions from more than one lobe of an organ.
lay_definition_en: Supportive tissue in the lung around the blood vessels.
lay_definition_de: Stützgewebe in der Lunge um die Blutgefäße herum.

general_definition_en: The part of the brain that connects the CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES with the SPINAL CORD. It consists of the MESENCEPHALON; PONS; and MEDULLA OBLONGATA.
lay_definition_en: The brainstem is the base of the brain that controls essential bodily functions like heart rate and breathing.
lay_definition_de: Der Hirnstamm ist der untere Teil des Gehirns, der lebenswichtige Körperfunktionen wie Herzfrequenz und Atmung steuert.

general_definition_en: Formation of an infarct, which is NECROSIS in tissue due to local ISCHEMIA resulting from obstruction of BLOOD CIRCULATION, most commonly by a THROMBUS or EMBOLUS.
lay_definition_en: A territorial infarct is like a stroke in the brain caused by a loss of blood flow in a specific region.
lay_definition_de: Ein territorialer Infarkt ist vergleichbar mit einem Schlaganfall im Gehirn, der durch einen Durchblutungsausfall in einem bestimmten Bereich verursacht wird.

general_definition_en: The part of CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM that is contained within the skull (CRANIUM). Arising from the NEURAL TUBE, the embryonic brain is comprised of three major parts including PROSENCEPHALON (the forebrain); MESENCEPHALON (the midbrain); and RHOMBENCEPHALON (the hindbrain). The developed brain consists of CEREBRUM; CEREBELLUM; and other structures in the BRAIN STEM. - Parts of plants that usually grow vertically upwards towards the light and support the leaves, buds, and reproductive structures. (From Concise Dictionary of Biology, 1990)
lay_definition_en: The brainstem is the bottom part of the brain that manages heart rate, breathing, and other vital functions.
lay_definition_de: Der Hirnstamm ist der untere Teil des Gehirns, der die Herzfrequenz, die Atmung und andere lebenswichtige Funktionen steuert.

general_definition_en: The veins that return the oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the lungs for oxygenation.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom Herzen zur Lunge transportiert, damit es dort mit Sauerstoff angereichert wird.

general_definition_en: A surgical treatment in which heart tissue is scarred (cut-and-sew method), excised or otherwise destroyed in an open chest approach to direct electrical signals through a more controlled path via the ATRIOVENTRICULAR NODE. It is often used to restore normal rhythms in ATRIAL FIBRILLATION.
lay_definition_en: Surgery to fix a weird heart rhythm.
lay_definition_de: Operation zur Korrektur eines Herzrhythmusfehlers.

general_definition_en: In medicine, a small, abnormal patch of tissue on a body part or an organ. Plaques may also be a build-up of substances from a fluid, such as cholesterol in the blood vessels.
lay_definition_en: Calcified plaque is hardened fatty material that clogs heart arteries and leads to heart disease.
lay_definition_de: Verkalkte Plaques sind verhärtete Fettablagerungen, die die Herzarterien verstopfen und zu Herzerkrankungen führen.

general_definition_en: The lower portion of the BRAIN STEM. It is inferior to the PONS and anterior to the CEREBELLUM. Medulla oblongata serves as a relay station between the brain and the spinal cord, and contains centers for regulating respiratory, vasomotor, cardiac, and reflex activities.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel found deep within the brain's cerebral hemispheres.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das tief in den Großhirnhälften liegt.

general_definition_en: A period of time that it takes for Earth to make a complete revolution around the sun, approximately 365 days; a specific one year period. - Abnormal cardiac rhythm that is characterized by rapid, uncoordinated firing of electrical impulses in the upper chambers of the heart (HEART ATRIA). lay_definition_en: A device that helps fix a problem with your heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein Gerät, das dabei hilft, ein Problem mit Ihrer Herzfrequenz zu beheben.

lay_definition_de: Ein Medikament, das dazu beiträgt, den Blutdruck und die Herzfrequenz zu senken.

general_definition_en: Backflow of blood from the LEFT VENTRICLE into the LEFT ATRIUM due to imperfect closure of the MITRAL VALVE. This can lead to mitral valve regurgitation.
lay_definition_en: When blood vessels can't send blood back to the heart properly, they are called incompetent.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Blutgefäße das Blut nicht richtig zum Herzen zurückleiten können, spricht man von einer Insuffizienz.

general_definition_en: Organ chamber which consists of a wall that surrounds the cavity of a cardiac atrium or ventricle.
lay_definition_en: A hole inside the heart that disrupts blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Ein Loch im Herzen, das den Blutfluss beeinträchtigt.

lay_definition_en: An irregular heart rhythm that can cause fatigue and strokes.
lay_definition_de: Ein unregelmäßiger Herzrhythmus, der zu Müdigkeit und Schlaganfällen führen kann.

general_definition_en: A TROPONIN complex subunit that inhibits ACTOMYOSIN ATPASE activity thereby disrupting ACTIN and MYOSIN interaction. There are three troponin I subtypes: troponin I1, I2 and I3. Troponin I3 is cardiac-specific whereas troponin I1 and I2 are skeletal subtypes. Troponin I3 is a BIOMARKER for damaged or injured CARDIAC MYOCYTES and mutations in troponin I3 gene are associated with FAMILIAL HYPERTROPHIC CARDIOMYOPATHY.
lay_definition_en: Troponin shows if there is a little heart damage.
lay_definition_de: Troponin zeigt an, ob eine leichte Herzschädigung vorliegt.

general_definition_en: Having a severe and rapid onset of symptoms with short duration.
lay_definition_en: Sudden heart attack due to blocked blood flow.
lay_definition_de: Plötzlicher Herzinfarkt aufgrund einer Durchblutungsstörung.

general_definition_en: Triscuspid Flow in the opposite direction from normal, as the casting up of undigested food or gas from the stomach, or the backward flowing of blood into the heart, or between the chambers of the heart when a valve is incompetent.
lay_definition_en: A measurement from an ultrasound test that helps detect potential pulmonary hypertension in a patient.
lay_definition_de: Ein Messwert aus einer Ultraschalluntersuchung, der dabei hilft, eine mögliche pulmonale Hypertonie bei einem Patienten zu erkennen.

general_definition_en: A phospholipid-stabilized suspension composed of microbubbles containing the gas perfluorobutane (perflubutane, PFB) with an outer layer of hydrogenated egg phosphatidylserine (HEPS), which can be used as an ultrasound imaging contrast agent. Upon administration, the PFB microbubbles enhance echo differences between various tissues, which enhances the visualization of images during ultrasound. In particular, the PFB microbubbles seem to preferentially target the reticuloendothelial system (RES); they are taken up by macrophages in the spleen and liver (Kupffer cells), and are taken up in lymph nodes. This may aid in the detection and diagnosis of cancer and liver disease, and may improve imaging of the lymphatic and vascular systems. The microbubbles provide increased stability during ultrasound imaging.
lay_definition_en: A tiny bubble used for improving body imaging by injecting it into a vein or taking it orally.
lay_definition_de: Eine winzige Blase, die zur Verbesserung der Bildgebung im Körper eingesetzt wird, indem sie in eine Vene injiziert oder oral eingenommen wird.

general_definition_en: The innermost layer of the heart, comprised of endothelial cells.
lay_definition_en: Endocardial means the inner lining of the heart.
lay_definition_de: „Endokard“ bezeichnet die innere Auskleidung des Herzens.

general_definition_en: Abnormal increase of resistance to blood flow within the hepatic PORTAL SYSTEM, frequently seen in LIVER CIRRHOSIS and conditions with obstruction of the PORTAL VEIN.
lay_definition_en: High blood pressure in the vein that carries blood from the intestines to the liver, common in liver diseases.
lay_definition_de: Erhöhter Blutdruck in der Vene, die das Blut vom Darm zur Leber transportiert; tritt häufig bei Lebererkrankungen auf.

general_definition_en: An electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist.
lay_definition_en: Having a slow heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Eine langsame Herzfrequenz haben.

lay_definition_de: Die linke Lungenarterie ist ein Blutgefäß, das Blut vom rechten Ventrikel des Herzens zur Sauerstoffanreicherung in die linke Lunge transportiert.

general_definition_en: Change in HYDROGEN-ION CONCENTRATION across a membrane. The pH gradient together with the voltage gradient constitute an electrochemical proton gradient which exerts the PROTON-MOTIVE FORCE. recall echo

It is often caused by microorganisms including bacteria, viruses, fungi, and rickettsiae. Left untreated, endocarditis can damage heart valves and become life-threatening.
lay_definition_en: Visible signs on the body that show there might be a heart infection going on inside.
lay_definition_de: Sichtbare Anzeichen am Körper, die darauf hindeuten, dass im Inneren möglicherweise eine Herzinfektion vorliegt.

general_definition_en: The chambers of the heart, to which the BLOOD returns from the circulation.
lay_definition_en: The right atrium is the top chamber of the heart where blood enters from the body and head.
lay_definition_de: Der rechte Vorhof ist die obere Herzkammer, in die das Blut aus dem Körper und dem Kopf fließt.

lay_definition_en: When your heart is weak and swollen, it struggles to pump blood effectively, which is known as dilated cardiomyopathy.
lay_definition_de: Wenn Ihr Herz geschwächt und vergrößert ist, hat es Schwierigkeiten, Blut effektiv zu pumpen. Dieser Zustand wird als dilatative Kardiomyopathie bezeichnet.

general_definition_en: The dilated portion of the common carotid artery at its bifurcation into external and internal carotids. It contains baroreceptors which, when stimulated, cause slowing of the heart, vasodilatation, and a fall in blood pressure.
lay_definition_en: The carotid bulb is the spot where the main arteries in your neck come together and widen.
lay_definition_de: Der Karotisbulbus ist die Stelle, an der die Hauptarterien im Hals zusammenlaufen und sich erweitern.

general_definition_en: cavo-atrial junction
lay_definition_en: A spot in the heart where the top vein meets and connects to the upper wall of the right atrium.
lay_definition_de: Eine Stelle im Herzen, an der die obere Vene auf die obere Wand des rechten Vorhofs trifft und mit dieser verbunden ist.

general_definition_en: A device designed to stimulate, by electric impulses, contraction of the heart muscles. It may be temporary (external) or permanent (internal or internal-external).
lay_definition_en: A small device put in your chest to manage your heart rate.
lay_definition_de: Ein kleines Gerät, das in Ihre Brust eingesetzt wird, um Ihre Herzfrequenz zu regulieren.

general_definition_en: In medicine, to regularly watch and check a person or condition to see if there is any change. Also refers to a device that records and/or displays patient data, such as for an electrocardiogram (EKG).
lay_definition_en: A monitor is a device that tracks health information.
lay_definition_de: Ein Monitor ist ein Gerät, das Gesundheitsdaten erfasst.

general_definition_en: Sudden onset of shortness of breath that causes one to awaken coughing or wheezing; it may be associated with congestive heart failure or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
lay_definition_en: Nighttime attacks of severe difficulty breathing and coughing that can wake you up and be scary.
lay_definition_de: Nächtliche Anfälle mit starker Atemnot und Husten, die einen aus dem Schlaf reißen können und beängstigend sind.

general_definition_en: The main artery of the thigh, a continuation of the external iliac artery.
lay_definition_en: A blood vessel that brings blood back from the legs to the heart.
lay_definition_de: Ein Blutgefäß, das Blut aus den Beinen zurück zum Herzen transportiert.

general_definition_en: The determination of the amount of homocysteine amino acid present in a sample.
lay_definition_en: A substance in the body that can lead to health issues like blood clots and heart disease if there's too much of it.
lay_definition_de: Eine Substanz im Körper, die bei zu hoher Konzentration zu gesundheitlichen Problemen wie Blutgerinnseln und Herzerkrankungen führen kann.

lay_definition_de: Ein Messwert im Elektrokardiogramm, der auf Herzfunktionsstörungen hinweisen kann.

lay_definition_en: A heart attack occurs when the heart does not receive enough blood.
lay_definition_de: Ein Herzinfarkt tritt auf, wenn das Herz nicht ausreichend mit Blut versorgt wird.

general_definition_en: A nonspecific symptom of hearing disorder characterized by the sensation of buzzing, ringing, clicking, pulsations, and other noises in the ear. Objective tinnitus refers to noises generated from within the ear or adjacent structures that can be heard by other individuals. The term subjective tinnitus is used when the sound is audible only to the affected individual. Tinnitus may occur as a manifestation of COCHLEAR DISEASES; VESTIBULOCOCHLEAR NERVE DISEASES; INTRACRANIAL HYPERTENSION; CRANIOCEREBRAL TRAUMA; and other conditions. , A device used to detect airborne odors, gases, flavors, volatile substances or vapors. , AND THROAT
